spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

nasna~X rmi de / rta ༷khri cu du / / khrod dod gi sde khu / ji / nga 〉 ༵dza / de rdo dod 〉 / de / ༷༷rdo/khoXrdod+dha〉sherdo ne / / da rdo rdob— waṃXsna ༵༵spyi sbyiXblo rdo rdo rwa de / da sheXsli༈ji / rtsi ༄ cha8tha~Xr rdo sno rdo rtsordo / rdo / de rdo / de~X rdo rdo / / / / / snye / rdo / / rdo / / rdo / rdo rdo snye / rdo she ri / rdo mirngoXrdoḍā4༷stso / rdo she / rdo dkar tsha de / ༵gye chi sgo rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdesnyoram̐thi rdor+sha/rkeXkhuhūṃ/chu pye / de rdo / rdo|hūṃrderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdekyi/līXchis kyi kyis chirdo lha ni / / da—treje rten ༵sbos the de tshar sdu/jo 1 7 shad ste / de dod rdo sgyu rtse / rdo / / / da rdo rwa / lha—sgyu/ sgo

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dang/la brtsegs bong yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun nga/'i dpe rnyeng dpe/ tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan snye ma ma/cheg gis spyi'i ga sdu skyong gnang ste/dang/la brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis snye ba'i lo bcu tsam/ gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe ning ngo/ je brir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod reg pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gye dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas ngang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rning zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yeg myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes nga/'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhen yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngom byon mes ngo/ mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rlams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'da' nang don thang la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/'o rgyus/rtses ris ༵//sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung sna bu zhig — —

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob nga/ na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan rdo nig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du dzo pas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dnge/ gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsa'/ bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag ngar du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lhe gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu ngag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gas nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod lda na dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes nga/'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra chad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sprungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo rdogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde chan rnganang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshang sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo cam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos rde snyen thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngeg lo sa skya pa/ /bu sto na bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// 'es dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing she he chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs nga/ zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad chul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs nga/'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta ḍū rtsen ngo/ bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bang ga cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams ra 5da phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'jin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin nga / bang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rab/ gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen ngo/ sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig nga/ dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'jugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged rbog gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'as na yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar wegs skyes 'bul ma/ban gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'ga' mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad nga/'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang /chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje ba / trun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas/ dbang rnam/sa kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs/ zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snyi/za pos/ dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la/ 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar 2bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ri ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub pa shrī zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khya/mas po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod chul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sprungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros nga/rtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mjad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mjad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos chan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mjad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod nga/'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs nga/ rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod nga// da lta 'bras slungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'jam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdu ra theng gnyis nga/ zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang nga/ra ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mchungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen ngo/ mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug nga/ rbems kyang / gug rtags nang du rnga/cug te gsal jo/ byas yong/ rtag brtan nga/ra rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs nga// 'dzam thang nga/ra ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can da bu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod nga/ dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis ja 'go'i dge bshes ma/chog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs ba2nyegs mjad par grags pa bcas chos chan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma' dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan nga/ra rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis 'a/ med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'jam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi chul du bzhag yod nga/ bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dnge/'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi((08nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum/ gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈jaX 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi 7su nga lto sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'jam thang nga/ra gru/ra ba(zug yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i sko ra chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag ya/nga pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rna gru/sa su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba ma/nga ngo zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtses 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song cwa 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song cwa 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog rnga 4 po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'jam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'as/na che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo cwa ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang chan kha rag khyung bcun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo nyi ta'i snye 'gram/ du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575 ) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mchan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ ma/khas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel gdu sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/ de nas dgung lo drug pa myos yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed wo blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod kha pa ri gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo/sa slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/ chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mchan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi pa khya chen ja la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mchan gsol/chos rje brag stod nga/ lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mchan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3 —

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdo za ri yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngeg dkyil bdun/ rte rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mjub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngeg gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso rme) 'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid chul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū nyi smad lnga/ dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri nyu kra'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/ja lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4 —

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes nga/'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mchan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i nga bang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang /gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang /rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang /grub pa sde bdun/snying po skor drug yad la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang /phreng ba skor gsum/rgyud 'grel grags can nga/la che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam/ gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595 )‘5/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos nga/ bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mchams ku 4 bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob da tshe dpang ni pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba ‘ ngen po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam nga/ra bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'grir pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol ngo/ pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa nga/nga / bod kyi dge bzhas bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis nga/sa/ dang ngo/ nga/da 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags ngo/ rin po ches chos kyis rtogs nga/ brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myeng ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta nyusko rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas/ thams cad la shin tu mkhas par ‘re dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang/ ge bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ( pa dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang /chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni drwa ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dang/la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya cam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha nga/'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rled/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang ngo/ byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum pe'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa ra ba byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)'a// gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sobs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling jes don dga' ba'i chal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa bcugs te/ phyi gcug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyan/ rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs po/ser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dang/la 'khor lo sngom pa'i sku zhal phyag sku dungs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhes sa dang nang rten byams chen thog chad gnyis cam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang ngo/ bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang skyu 4 rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing ba spru sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams rdo kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsu 3 / mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag nga/ pe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mchan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mjad byang la nā ro pa'i mchan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdu sa kyi mjad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje cong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phe'/ sogs dbus gcang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs sbyo/ sa rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/ma/khan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshang na/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor zhar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog leb/sa pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' nga/stan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 1gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 1()—

bla ma rgyang 'bod bzhugs/ rkazhal gdams thor bu bzhugs/ 4snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/ ka0phar phyin khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/ 25dogs gcod mun sel bzhugs/ 39tshigs bcad bcu pa zhes bya ba lam gyi rim nga/ bzhugs/ 70phyag rgya chen po mi/ g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 74man ngag khrid yig shin tu zab nga/ bzhugs/ 8rkagrub chen lwa ba pa'i gdams pa cig char ba'i ngo sprod snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/ 9kagasol 'debs bzhugs/ 94rdo rje'i lam/ la 'jug pa bzhugs/ 96mngon brjod bla ma/ las 'byung ba'i dpyid kyi rgyal ngo/'i glu dang spel mar sbyar ba bzhugs/ rka0rkagaso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga bzhugs/ ka04gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi mngon rtogs 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho bzhugs/ rka18gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhugs/ 168

'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ rka83bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshejug dmar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ 256phyag rdor gtum chen gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhugs/ 3ka5phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dbang gi tha yig bzhugs/ 327'khor lo sgyur drug gi sgrub thabs sdo / na tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi zhes bya ba bsdon gas/ 333dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrung/ thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 345'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i rda skrub thabs me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 357'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 365'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen rnge'i/ sgrub thabs mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsung lnga sdo pa bzhugs/ 374dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gsal /byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 382rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa nga/dun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma ‘ges bya ba bzhugs/ 386rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bde chen 'bar byed bzhugs/ 396

rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 400'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya bzhugs/ 405'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam nga/ las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ 455

oX swā sti/ mchan snye ldan gyi bla ma thugs rje can/ /mgon gcag chog rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ /sem sa gnas lugs rjen par rtogs nga/ dang / /pha khyed kyi thugs dang mnyam par shog /brgyud pa kun 'dus/ kyi jo rje 'chang chen/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bla ma dam pa/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi yi daskalha tshogs/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'grodrug thar par drongs shig /bar chad kun sel gyi ma/ba 'a 'gro chas skyang / /dam tshig rjes dran gyi rdo rje spun grogs/ /rtag tu byams pa ma 'dras pa'i mdza' bshes/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /sla'agrodrug thar par drongs shig /rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras bcas kyi ngo bo/ /lung rtogasadam chos ma lus pa'i gter mdzod/ /'phags tshogs 'dus pa kun 'dus kya gtso bo/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /sil ma 'gra/drug thar par drongs shig /spros bral mkha' khyab rang rig gi chos sku/ /bde stong dbyer med kyi rang gsal longs sku/ /gang 'dul thugs rje mkha' khyab kyi sprul sku/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/— /cha kun du thugs rjes gzigs shig /

bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'at+padrug thar par drongs shig /chos kun gzigs pa'i ma/khyen nga/ mtha' yas nye ring mi mnga' brtse ba'i klong yang na// /'phrin las mtha' med nus mtshu'i bdagapo/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun du thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdagare sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byang sko rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongs shig /dgos 'dod ṭa/na 'byung yid bzhi gyi nor bu/ /bde skyid kun stsol dpag bsam gyi shing chen/ /rgyun chad med pa gzhan phan gyi chu bo/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag ra sagazhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar nga/ra drongs shig /'phongs bskyab kun sel gter chen gyi bum bzang/ /srid gsum/ mun sel gyi rdo rje nyi ma/ /nyon da lam pa / sa gdung sel gyi rgyu skar bdag po/ /pha bla rma/ drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drongasashig /brtan g.yo kun khyab kyi rdo rnge slob dpon/ /bde chen 'gyur med kyi lhan cig skyes dga'/ /rang rtsal 'gyur med kyi rnam pa kun ldan/ /pha glam drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs rje traṭa gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par drodasashig /bdag sems ma bcos so ma'i rig pa/ kham/sa gsum snang srid dran rtog gi 'char sgo/ /thams cad khyed thung kas 'od gsal du ro ma/nyam/ /pha bla ma drin can chos rje/ /dus kun tu thugs : ldos gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na ma—2—

mchis/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma/ 'gro drug thar par drodasashig /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas gcig pu/ /'gro kun bde la 'gad mjad khyod nyid/ /skyob pa bla med 'dren mchog chos rje/ /pha bla ma drin ༅ chosarje/ /dus kun tu thugs rjes gzigs shig /bdag re sa gzhan na mam chas/ /rgyud byin rlabs chu bos smin nas/ /ma 'gro drug thar par da dzin drangs shag /bdagasogs mkha' mnyam gyi sems can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /ma rgan sem/sacan rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /'a/bor bar gtan 'khyams byed la thugasarjes gzigs/ /'khrul pa'i 'khor lo bskor la thugs rjes gzigs/ /gdeng med rtag rtsis can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sdug bsngal g.yos sbyor mkhan lathugs rjes gzigs/ /dad med pho tshod ma/khan la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang sems gnas lugs ma rtogs pa la gzigs su gsol/ /nyon mongs rang gar shor ba rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /rig pa phyir ltas shor ba rnamasalagazigs su gsol/ /chos med bzang rdzun shor ba rnams la gzigs sugasol/ /blo rgod gyong bo thul bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag 'chib dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhen med nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yid tshesadad pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /le lo rnam g.yeng sangs par byin gyisarlobs/ /rang sems gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyon mongasaye shes su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun smin grol la 'god par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang nam mkha' brtso na 'grus kyis bskul nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //

na mo gu ra we/ pha dran pa1sa snying gi gdung ba sel/ /pha dran pas 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub/ /pha dran pas/ gnyug ma'i rang sa zin/ /pha dran chog rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdams :pag tshig gsum gyi gtam snyan 'di/ /rna bar ta kun la 'phrod mod kyi/ /lag ‘tren du thebs pa dkon par 'dug /dad ldan gyi slob ma'i yid la zhig /so song 'gol 'dod kyi dben gnas de/ /yun ring jo/ rtag thub dka' bas na/ /grong yul gyi 'du 'dzil ma chags par/ /snying nas ri khrod 'grim pa gces/ /dka' spyad kyi zhe rus sad sud de/ /bzang rdzu'i ngang la 'dun pa yal/ /snang sems dbyer med 'dres kyi bar/ /sred zhen gyi 'ching ba rgyang thag srings/ /'khri ba kun ༄5da nas ma chod na/ /zhen log tu re yang rang nyid bslu/ /'dod yon kha yan du spyod spyod nas/ /tshig lta skad mtho yang 'khor bar 'khyams/ /phyogs 'dzin dang zhan pa'i mos gus dang / kha drag dang 'jigs skyob kyi dad pa 'di/ /ste skyur 'grus kyis khyer nas rtag mi thub/ /thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres pa gcig 'tshal/ /gnas pa lteng po cig rkyen mi thub/ /rnam rtog rang ga ma 'khor rnga/'i rgyu/ /go yul dang yin snyam gyi nam phugs bslu/ /'gyur ba 'gyu stong gi nga rnga ri du zhog /rang rgyud la lta zhing rang sems 'dul/ /rtag tu rang sems la zer nga gros thob/ /rlom sems su ma byed rang 'tshang drus/ /blo brtsis btab meng/ pa/ zhe su skyol/ /da rtag tu bla ma la

gsol ba thob/ /chags sdang gi rnam rtog la 'bur 'joms gyis/ /zhen chags kyi 'khri ba rbad kyis chod/ /chos sgra bo che de mthar phyin yong / /rig nga/ gang shar gyi rang 'gros la/ /dgag sgrub kyi bdag rkyen ma byed ang / /phyi ltas su shor na rang la sdig /bya byed ye med kyi ngang la skyur/ /nyams len gyi gnad bskul cung zad 'di/ /bu slob ma'i sems la gros 'debs yin/ /gtad me/da kyi rig pa'i rang mdangs tsam/ /nges med kyi kha nas shor ta thal/ /rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā thas mthing stod sgom chen bka' rgyud rgyal mtshan la smras pa'o// //༄༅/ /oX swā sti/ rigs kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa'i/ /pha mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu khyed la dran bskul tshig gsum smra/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i mi lus la/ /rtag 'dzin gyi 'dun gros ma shom ang / /pho rgod po shom ra rgya che yang / /bya byed kun shul du bzhag nas 'gro/ /bu 'jig rten gyi blo rgya ma skyed par/ /chos nyams len la blo sna sgyur bar 'tshal/ /dus lan cig byed snyam ngang ring po/ /phyi shol gyi ngang la lus nyen gdog /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di rgal bar dka'/ /le lo dang snyoms las kyis mi 'grub pas/ /nyin mtshan du dran pa'i lcag gis bskul/ /sems lang shor la 'phral du 'jur thag thong / /sgra brag cha'i dbyangs 'dis bslu bslu 'dra/ /grags 'dod kyi phye 'thor ma 'gam shig /gtam mi zer la brtsis btab ma byed par/ /rang thag chod kyi shes pas sgom la 'bungs/ /gnas dben pa'i ri khrod nyams bag bde/ /'phral sdig dang ma 'dres 'tsho ba —5—

bsten/ khong nor shed dang dbang 1peng nag nga rgyal can/ /'phral mi rtag pa'i rang 'tshang bstan nas bslu/ /bu 'dod chung chog shes la blo rtse gtod/ /lar 'dod yon gyi 'khri ba 'di spyad dka' yang / /don snying po med pa'i tshul la soms /blo yid brtan gyi gdeng thub chos las med/ /dam tshig rang srog las gces par srungs/ /mos gus la ltem 9ku gyang med pa dang / /gdung shugs kyi gsol 'debs rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyams len la steng 'grubs med par 'tshal/ /rang shar gyi rig pa so ma 'di/ /bzo bcos med par rang sar zhog /rang 'gros la spang blang ma byed par/ /gang shar rang grol du lhug par zhog /spyod lam dang rnam g.yeng gang byed kyang / /gang shar la thug phrad ngo shes kyis/ /rang sar bzhag pas lhod kyis grol/ /ci dgar bskyur la cham me zhog /lar snang ba sna tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di/ /snang tsam ma gtogs don la med/ /nang rig pa dbyings su gdod nas zhi/ /cir yang ma grub rang rig tsam/ khyed lta ba'i dgongs pa de la mdzod/ /gang shar la bcas bcoskyu sdo ma byed par/ /gnas sam 'gyu'am ci 'dra yang / /rig pa'i rgyal po rang so zwaspring / /yengs med kyi dran pa sten skad kyang / /dran bya dang dran byed dbyings su stor/ khyed sgom nga/'i gnad don de la mdzod/ /las 'bras la yid ches dad pa skyed/ /'khor ba la ma chags nges 'byung 'phrul/ /ma rtogs pa'i 'gro la snyi//nga rje'i rtsal/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi bla ma bsten/ /dge ba ci byed ga 'a/na don du bsngo/ khyed spyod pa dgos na de la mdzod/ /gzhi gdod ma nas bzhub/sa pa'i chos sku de/ /ye grol dang ye rdzogs su bzhugs mod kyang / /de ma rton/sa 'khor bar 'khyams pa de/ /nam 'phel —6—

'grib med pa'i don rtogs na/ /skyon sgrib gnyis rang sar grol ba yin/ khyed 'bras bu bzhed na de tsug lags/ /da sgrub pa nyams su longs pa dang / /rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par smon/ /rang rgyud grol ba mthar phyin nas/ /gzhan rgyud smin grol byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas bso thog nang so ngag dbang phun tshogs la gdams pa'o/ /bkra shis// //༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ mos ldan thar pa'i lam la 'dren mdzad/ /rme/tshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la bshud nas/ /rang nyid nyams len sgrub la g.yel kyang / /gzhan la snying gros 'di skad 'debs so/ /mi lus lan cig thob res 'di la/ /g.yeng ma lam la mi tshe zad na/ /phyi nas chos dang mjal ba'ang dkon pas/ /god kha de las che ba med do/ /byis par yod 'phro dar mar 'gro zhing / /dar ma yin 'phral rgas pas sleb dang / /phal cher rgas long med par 'chi bas/ /long yod byed sa yod snyam gda' ye/ /rgas rgas sdod pa'i dbang du byas kyang / /sang dang snangs zhes drangs pas zla ba/ /zla gcig zla gnyis ngang la lor sleb/ /lo shas drangs pas ma chor ba la/ /rgas par sleb nas 'chi la thug 'gro/ /za rgyu 'thung rgyu 'gro 'dug cig dang / /gnyid dang gtam gyi zar zir cig la/ /byas rjes 'di yin med par zad 'gro/ /longs spyod ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra la/ /lang tsho rtswa rtse'i zil pa dang mtshungs/ /dus ni ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du/ /sdod pa'i gnas med 'di la soms dang / /mi zhig nyal ba'i rmi lam gsal por/ /yid 'ong dga' ba'i grogs dang 'grogs nas/ /glu len dga' —7—

ston bde skyid myong yang / /sad ces gar song ma med yal ba/ /rmi lam de la chags pas gdungs shing / /yal ba de la sdug bsngal byed pa/ /'khru/la snang cam la spang blang byed pa'i/ /mi de shin tu blun pa yin no/ /da lta'i grogs dang longs spyod dgra gnyen/ /thams shu kyi da 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam la/ /blo yi dga' sdug bcos pa ma gtogs/ /gan skyu5 lugs don la grub pa med do/ /gzhan yang dga' ba skyed nga/'i yul 'di/ /spru/tan gyi bde bar blo gtad mi thub/ /lo zla zhag 'ga'i 'dun ma yin pas/ / dha ga rtsis ma byed chos la 'bungs dang / /rang la gzhan gyis 'char kha zer ra dzo 5/ /'dod don bgegs dang gnod pa byed na'ang / /sngon dus bsags pa'i ‘pas ngan 'bras bu/ /ci rigs smin pa'i rnam smin byung gi /gzhan la tshig za zhe sdang spongs dang / /dge sbyor skul ma yin par shes nas/ /sdig pa kun la bsha/gas pa 'bu' zhing / /dge ba tshogs gsog gang 'grub gyis shig /rang 'dod can gyi mi ngan khyod la/ /rang gis nyes pa'i rnam smin byung gi /zol zog khyod la 'di rang mkho zhes/ /rang gis rang la zhe khrel gdab bo/ /rang nyid dge sbyor byed pa'i dus su/ /mdza' ba'i grogs dang gnyen gyi gdung sems/ /sgom 9/nga 'a/ sun zad med long gtam/ /'di bzhi bdud du che bas spongs shig /tshe ‘smu di mi rtag yad yud yin zhing / /bla ma slob ma dpon g.yog dgra gnyen/ /yul phyogs khang khyim nor rdzas kun yang / /yad yud cam gyi 'brel pa yin no/ /'chi ba'i dus su dam chos min pa/ /rang la phan pa'i bya ba med cing / /ga6na la phan pa'i thabs kyang med pas/ /rang gzhan kun phyir nyams len gyi1sa thig /'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes —8—

sam/ /brgya byin thob kyang tha mar lhung bas/ /rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal/ /yin pas thar pa thob thabs gyis shig /mkha' /byab sems can snying la bcangs nas/ /nyams len gzhan don kho nar bsgril dang / /da lta dngos su phan ma thogs kyang / /phugs su gzhan phan de rang che'o/ /ri khrod dben pa/ra nyams len byas nas/ /nyams myong 'phral du 'char bar 'dod na/ /theg shas snying rus drag tu bkyed dang / /de nas brtson 'grus shugs la 'byung ngo / /dang po stan thog tshugs pa cig dang / /gnyis pa lus gnad bsrangs su 'jug cing / /skyo na dran pas 'phral du sleb pa/ /de kha'i ngang la zungs thub dgos so/ /spyil bu man mun rang rod can la/ /dang ma chags par skyid skyid mo dang / /spro spro rig pa dngas dngas mo zhig /dgos na dge sbyor g.yeng ba'i rtags yin/ /ltogs 'khyags byung na sran bkyed thub pa/ /mun khung nang du blo bag 'bebs mkhan/ /blo sna mi mang chig 'dril byed pa/ /de la nyams myong 'phral du skye'o/ /las 'bras spang blang khyad du gsod pa'i/ /chos pa'i ming btags dmyal ba'i mchong stegs/ /dam tshig bzhi mdo'i rtsa bzhin 'dor ba'i/ /sgom chen bstan pa'i chom rkun yin no/ /des na dge sdig blang dor zhib la/ /dam tshig srog bzhin gces par gzung nas/ /nges 'byung snying rjes skul ma 'debs shing / /mos gus lam gyi rtsa bar zungs shig /'di tsam dran 'dzin skul ma yin pas/ /yang yang dran cing sems la bzhog las/ /sgos dus phan pa'i gdams ngag 'di ni/ /'phral 'phral lag len thebs par gyis shig /ces pa'ang tā ra nā thas badz+ra lwa phya zhes bya ba'i dad la gdams pa'o// //—9—

gzigs sprod/ rgyud kyi dka' 'grel tshigs bcad ma yin lags/ sdo ma/ pa rtsa rgyud kyi nges don 'chad na 'di med ka med nga/ yin kyang / sngon chad phal rgyas ma/ ma rled nga// bdag kun dga' snyi nga ngo/sa bsod nam/sa kyi bgo ska' byon nga/ lags so/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'chal lo/ /gang zhig bde ba'i gnas thob pa/ /'grib med dang 'bya ( pa dam pa ste/ /gzhan ni sna tshogs 'di dag la/ /'khor lo skor ba bzhin du 'grub/ /srid pa gsum du dus gyur pa/ /de dag thos la brten par byed/ /rnga ka zhung mang klog pas ngal ba dag /snying po'i gnas la ngal gso zhig /he ru sna ka dpal 'byung ba la/ /bla ma mchog gis 'di ston te/ /gzhan dang bstan bcon/ thos pa yi/ /snyems pa yis ni ci zhig bya/ /shes rab mchog gi rdo rje can/ /skyo tha' bzhi rnam par grol ba bzhed/ /mtshan ma rtsol ba 'di med de/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yis/ /med pa las kyi thams cad skyes/ /nam mkha' la sog 1 so 'byung ba dang / /'gro ba drug po lhan cig skyes/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yin/ /lhan skyes 'gro ba'i bdag nyid de/ /bde ba nyid de lhan cig skyes/ /gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /'di rbi snying po bsdus pa yin/ /zhi ba ku zu/ 'gro gnas pa ste/ /'gyur med 'gyur ba'i dri ma bral/ /gzhan las ma yin ra nyu ༄ la gnas/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yin/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa spros pa dag /gang la gnyis med gnas su bzhugs/ /rlung

gi 'khor lo phyin ci log /'di ni bya ba'i snying po'o/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /klog gi gzugs can sgra yi tshul/ /bde ba phun tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /bya ba'i snying por de bshad do/ /bdud rtsi dam pa'i thig le ni/ /dri bral ri bong 'dzin dang mnyam/ /rnam shes ye shes gnyis med pa/ /'di ni bya ba'i snying po yin/ /gang du lus ngag sem/sa med pa/ /de ni de nyid gsum du gnas/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gos pa med/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed snying po'o/ /bya ba rim pa bzhi yin te/ /bsgrub par bya ba de nyid bzhi/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed dbyer med pa/ /snying ngo/ bsdus nga/ra de bshad do/ /slob dpon gzhan dag 'dod pa ni/ kha cig 'dod chags chags pa nyid/ /de bzhin dbang gi gnas su yang / /gzhan dag nge las steng du 'dod/ /de bzhin nor bur gnas pa yang / /'ga' zhig phyin ci log tu sbyor/ /'ga' zhig mkha' dang mtshungs zhes zer/ /brgyal ba'i gnas skabs 'dod nga/ gzhan/ /rtog pa'i sgom pa'ang 'dod pa ste/ /phal cher de dag phyin ci log /bzang po gzhan dag 'dod pa ni/ kha cig ro mnyam ye shes te/ /zab dang gsal ba 'es kyang 'dod/ /gzhan dag sgyu ma lta bu dang / /'ga' zhig bde chen gzugs zhes zer/ /de dag 'gal min tha dad yin/ /brtul zhugs zhal snga'i bzhed pa ni/ /dpyid dang thig le sbyor ba ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na/ /rang byung ngo bo nyid ces bya/ /dpyid ni bde ba'i gzugs yi/na te/ /thig le de yang sna tshogs nyid/ /lhan cig skyes pa kun 'gro nyid/ /rang byung nyid ni 'gyur — 1/ —

bral lo/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyi/ /bla ma dam pa gnyis bsten na/ /longs spyod grol ba thob 'gyur te/ /snying po bsdus nga/ra de bshad do/ /he ru ka dpal mngon brjod nyu pre/ /'di nyid kho na der brjod de/ /rin chen phung po sna tshogs pa/ /der ni 'di las gzhan yod min/ /rdo rje'i tshig na dbye dka' ste/ /don gyi rnam pa du ma dab/ /spyod pa'i zhal snga las brgyud pa/ /snying po cam zhig bsdu bar bya/ /lha mo yis ni gsol btab nas/ /rgyud kyi rgyal ngo/ ta ru kas/ /drwa ba 'khor lo'i dbus gtsu sungs zhes/ /slob dpon phal cher sgrog nga/ra byed/ /lha mo thig le 'byed byed sde ste/ /rtsa rnams drwa ba gang ba las/ /dpyid kyi g.yo ba'i sgra yin na/ /de lta na yang ri legs pa nyid/ /dpa' bo bye ba rnams kyis 'di/ /dus gcig tu ni nges brjo‘ne pas/ /zhu ba po dang lan med ces/ /nas po'i zhal snga nas kyis bzhed/ /6pre dor bsdus pa ni dang ngo/ ste/ /rgyas pa nyid kyis bstan pa'o/ /gnas la sogs pa bstan rnga/ nas/ /brtsams te phyi ma bsdus pa'o/ /dang por rkang pa drug yin te/ /'di stu/ dgos pa la sogs bshad/ /de yi 'og tu rkang pa drug /gleng gzhi yis ni kla 5dor bstan pa'o/ /e zhes bya ba de bzhen nyid/ /srog chags kun la gnas pa yi/ /bde ba lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /de nyid thams cad snang bar snang / /baX yig brjod pa gang gang du/ /rab tu rig cing rang myong ba/ /'dzin pa po dang rig gzhi med/ /de ni yod dang med las 'das/ /de 'og ma yig zhes brjod pa/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /sgra yi de nyid zhes brjod ste/ /sna tshogs du ma'i skad du sbyar/ /de nas de las slar — 12—

yang ya/ /dbang po'i drwa ba ji bzhin gzugs// /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'di ni de las yang snang ngo / /snye lhan cig skyes nga/ dang po ste/ /de 'a sa gsang ba gsum 'byung ba/ /dngos dang dngos med ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin de nyid ces bya'o/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /tshig bcu yis ni bshad pa/ das /gsang ba chen po'i thig ler ni/ /brtul zhugs spyod 'chang nyid kyis bshad/ /sgra chul pag mor bshad pa ste/ /dam chig dpa' bor rjes su dran/ /dus/ gsum dag ni gnas gsum khyab/ /gnyis med sbyor ba mtshon bya'o/ /bsrubs pa sgrub byed nyid yin te/ /mdor bstan pas kyang nyan par gyis/ /bar ma la sogs gsum yin te/ /rja sa dang gsang ba ye shes so/ /a wa ju ༷na brjod nga/ dang / /'bar ba dang ni 'bar ba che/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i pho nya rmi/ /grub pa rngam pa gsum du brjod/ /thig le yi ni mchod la sogs/ /gang la yon tan bsngags pa yi/ /de'i 'og tu thabs bzhi bstan/ /tshogs kyi spyod pa'i dngos grub dang / /de 'og mchod pa chen po bzhi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /dngos po'i rlam/ par rtog nga/ rnams/ /lhan cig skyes pas bcing bar bya/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /gnyis gnyis dbang po snyoms 'jug dang / /stsoms 'jug de nyid 'dzin pa'o/ /gnas kyi khyad par nges bstan pa/ /ri bo la sogs phyi rol te/ /'khor lo sogs ni gsang bar spyod/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas gyur nga// /de yang gzhan du brjod pa yin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor legs gsungs nga// /dkyil 'bor rnam pa gsum po'o/ /— 13—

sum cu rtsa bdun rtsa rnams ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsungs/ /'khor lo bzhi las skye lnga sdo pa yi/ /rtsa yang dkyil 'khor zhes brjod do/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i khams rnams zi do / /rnam par dag pa mchod par bshad/ /sgo rnams la ni dris bsangs te/ /pum pa 'god par gang gsungs pa/ /bu ga brgyad la gnas pa'i rtsa/ /rab /gh+ri thim pa'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /'khor lo gsum la gnas pa rnams/ /rnam rkyo bcu sa yi dbang phyug yin/ /slar yang ma mo rnams bshad pa/ /de nyid dang po je/ mar khyab/ /dri chab pho nya zhes bshad ste/ /khrag ni me tog zhes su brjod/ /rdu kun 'byed pa ni bdug pa ste/ kha sbyor mar mer shes par bya/ /brgya phrag rigs la tha ṭa byung ba yi/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa//khams dang phung po la sogs pa'ang / /brgya phrag grangs kyis phye ba yin/ /bdud rtsi lnga las ye shes ni/ /steng du bsgreng ba rgyal mtshan te/ /de bzhin sna tshogs de'i rnam pa/ /gsang ba mchog gi rim pa las/ /'di la dkyil 'khor rnam bshad pa/ /tha dad so so gsal rngaza yin/ /gang las shes rab gsal 'gyur ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa lhan cig skyes/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas brtsams te/ /rab tu 'bar ba cheng sko po yin/ /chos kyi sku yi 'khor lo gang / /bcom pa gdong g.yogs phye bar nga/rjod/ khrag chen po ni mgrin pa ste/ /'di la lam gsum zlog par bshad/ /me ma thal mo yin par bshad/ /me tog dor bar gang gsungs pa/ /de ni 'bar ba nyid yin te/ /gang las dar ras legs bkab pa/ /mthong ba bcings pa bo gyur pa ni/ /gnyis med ma yi lam gang yin/ /shin tu bkag par gyur pa'o / / /— 14—

skor ba tshangs pa'i me gnas su/ /dung gi dbyings la rnam par gnas/ /pho brang nyams dga' sprul pa yin/ /bde chen he ru ka yi ni/ /gnas su yang dag shes par bya/ /mi choms pa dang 'brel bas na/ /de yi rigs ni gnyid mar bshad/ /ming bstan khu ba 'bab pa yin/ khyim ni bha ga zhes gsungs te/ /dpa' bo chen po der 'gro'o/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyon mongs bshig pas 'jig pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /de bzhin sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sogs/ /dang po'i bsdoms su gsal ba yin/ /de bzhin las kyi dbye ba las/ /rnam pa du mar gsungs gyur pa/ /gsang ba'i don ni rab tu sbas/ /'du shes bye ba gsod byed cing / /de nyid dag pa 'tsho bar brjod/ /ltung ba dgug pa yin par bshad/ kha zas bzung ba gnas pa ste/ /thim pa gdon chen pos bzung ba'o/ /sgo gnyis las ni 'gro dang 'ong / /de ni rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong / /hi yig la ni rtog par bshad/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis la/ /gang 'dod 'gro ba der 'gyur ro/ /a wa dha tī las 'ongs pa/ /sngags kyi dbab par de bshad do/ /yang ni ldog cing yang 'gro ba/ /dug gso ba yi las su bshad/ /rengs pa las ni rmongs chog ste/ /grol ba bde ba rig par brjod/ /'khor lo rnams kyi mngal gnas pa/ /brten pa 'pho bar 'dod pa yin/ /snying po khong stong las byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs 'byin te/ /dag pa las ni snang 'gyur zhing / /dag pa min las mi snang ba/ /sna tshogs 'dod pa'i gzugs yin no/ /tshig 'phrog la sogs gang bshad pa/ /dbang po las ni shes pa'o/ /bdun pa'i lus

can khu ba ste/ /sngags ni rlung zhes brjod nga/ yin/ /de nyid brgyas lhag brgya yi ni/ /skye gnas/ dbus su bcing ba shrī bya/ /de las lha yi lus su 'gyur/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /bde ba che dang raṇ+ḍa ka /kun gyi spyi bor gnas/ nga/ rbi/ /pho brang gnas kyi nang 'jug pa/ /rdo rje ra li brtul zhugs te/ /thig le gsum ni rdo rjer byed/ /khrag drang nyub zhes bshad nga/ ni/ /bcu drug bde ba rig pa'o/ /cho ga mang po gzhan dag chi// /re zhig bdag gi rnam par spangs/ /skye gnas 'og tu rtsa lnga rbi/ /bong bu'i rnam pa khrag gi gdong / /'dir ni rgyu ba chad nga/ gang / /sna tshogs shes par skye ba yin/ /sngags bzlas pa ni zla ba gcig/sngags rbi byang chub sems su brjong// /gnas su de ni 'ongs pa'o/ /snro ma gcig pu sdig spangs ma/'i/ /dbugs kyi thre/ bar bshad pa ste/ /yi ge mang po kla klo sgra/ /de yang 'khor lor spyod pa'o/ /ras/sa ldan gnyis spangs ma zhes bya/ /de yi thig we longs spyod nyid/ /g.yo ba ku myo/ tu spyod pa yin/ /rdul gyis nā da 'byed pa ni/ /rigs ldan ma yi mchod nga/ bzang / /gnyis gnyis las ni rtsa yi sgo/ /der yang rigs ldan ma rnams rgyu/ /ga pa yang thig le dngos po med/ /gang las rlung yang 'gog pa dang / /gang du rtsa yang rab tu dag /der ni gzhan dag yod min te/ /lhan skyes gcig pu gsal rnga/'o/ /rtsa yi drwa ba thams cad la/ /a wa dhū tī g.yogs shing gnas/ /de 'dra de las kun 'byung ste/ /'byin dang rwa kyid par byed pa mo/ /sna tshogs 'di ni gnyis med par/ /zhugs pa 'dres pa dzo mo zhes brjod/ /bskyed bya dang ni skyed byed — 16—

'dres pa yang / /dang po rigs ldan rigs ldan mo zhes brjod/ /de yi 'phel ba ring du sgrub byed pa/ /de 'og de la mchod pa legs pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i skor ni 'o ma'i mdog /ser po smin mtshams gnas su ste/ /raṇ+ḍa ka las sngo sangs nyid/ /lkog mar sto na ka'i zla ba 'dra/ /brang ngos dkar dang dmar po ste/ /'dom bar las ni ljang ser bshad/ /lte ba'i dbus nas glog gi 'od/ /sgrib nga/ra byed pa gos yin te/ /chags sogs la ni gos su brjod/ /rab tu gsal bar snang ba gang / /sna tshogs du ma'i ngad du bsten/ /mdo sde rgyud dang rtog pa dag /gang du'ang rnyed par dka' ba yin/ /skye gnas mkha' 'gro ma yi ni/ /sa ni drug cu rtsa bzhir brjod/ /mgo bo las byung bdud rtsi lnga/ /gzugs can la sogs brgyad po ni/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam rol ba/ /ā li kā li rab tu 'dres/ /sde tshan brgyad las byung ba yin/ /nyi mo rab tu 'phel ba'o/ /gzugs can ma la ku zhes brjod/ /'o byed ma ni tsha sogs yin/ khu yig las ni lā/ mar brjod/ /ta sde yongs su gyur mar bshad/ /dum skyes ma dang mi lngos rma// /su dang arnyasba zhes bya/ /e hi ka dang sdud byed ma/ / u mi ṇa dang a ang re hre da/ /gang 'di'i byed dang byed pa'i tshogs/ /de dag las kyi rnam 'gyur dri/so /kro yi la rme/ ni thod par bshad/ /dgra sta bshang ba'i rtsa yin te/ /sna yi bu ga che/che ba ra / /de ni gnyis su bcings pa yin/ /'khor lo rtags su brjod pa sde / /rgya ru ra ra chan dang ni ral gri dag /rdo rje de bzhin dung zhes pa/ /gnyis gnyis rmi ga dang rna ba yin/ /gang de dag la mchod byed de/ / mchod pa bde ba yin par bshang/ /khyad par las kyi pho nya mo/ /rnam pa brgyad du yang bshad pa/ /dmar ser nyi — 17—

ma'i khams las byung / /zla ba las ni sngo zhing skya/ /rtse gsum dang ni mdung thung gang / /de ni 'bar ba'i mtshan mar bshad/ /'khor lo'i rnam pa sprin sngo ba/ /de ni rlung khams las gyur pa/ /mkha‘spru khams rā hu lar brjod de/ /gnag dang dkar bar bshad pa yin/ /na ḍi lhong phrag bco lnga ni/ /yongs su khyab par byed pa yin/ /ser zhing gser gyi mdog 'drar snang / /'byung po 'dzin byed las byung ba'o/ /sha ni bdud rtsi zhes su brjod/ /rnam shes las byung dus kyi me/ /gang gi dpral ba'i thig le dang / /mgo yi dbus su 'gro bar bshad/ /char sprin lta bur bshad pa ni/ /chu las byung bco gri 'bar byed de/ /g.yon gyi mche ba lug tu bshad/ /gang rnams 'di dag tha'apres cad ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma ste sngags su brjod/ /lā ma'i rigs las byung nga/ lnga/ /'khor lo kun la gnas pa ste/ /rtag tu bha ga'i dbus gnas sam/ /'ing ga'i dbus su rgyu bar byed/ /tsaṇ+ḍa li ni stobs dang ldan/ /khu ba rdo rjer byed pa ste/ /de bzlog pa las khrag kyang ngo / /de yis sha dang lpags pa nyams/ khu bas rus pa 'joms pa te/ khrag dang khu ba'i sbyor ba las/ /mun pa skye zhi nga 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las rtsa dang rgyus pa dag /mun pa las ni me 'byung ste/ /zhag dang chu ser ba sbu dang / /rkang dang tshil bu skra rnams te/ /de la sogs pa mang po'i khams/ /thams cad dag par pyed pa nyid/ /snying ni rnam pa bzhi la brtas /gzhan rnams re re las byung ba'o/ /gang gis gcig ni yongs bcings pas/ /de dag thams cad rengs par 'gyur/ /lwa ma pad ma'i rigs yi'u ni te/ /'jig rten dbang ni nor bur brjod//— 18—

khrag 'thung rtag pa'i rigs su bshad/ khung bur snang ba stong pa ste/ /rdo rje'i rigs las gang gyur pa/ /rtag tu 'dod cing spro ba ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ /rta yi rigs las gang gyur pa/ /de ni rdo rje phas mor brjod/ /dga' ba'i skad cig grangs gang yin/ /tshes zhes/ kla kle'i skad du mjad/ /grong khyer pa yi spyod pa kun/ /bla ma'i kha yi bstan par bya/ /de bzhin phyag rgya sna tshogs pa/ /re zhig 'dir ni ma bstan no/ /sngags kyi gsang ba sbas pa gang / /de ni snying stobs brgyad du drag /gzhan dag kyang ni dpa' bos gsungs/ /mdor bshad rgyas par ma yin no/ /sha chen dag ces gsungs pa ni/ /thams cad 'du byed kho na ste/ /'du byed gang la rnam 'jig pa/ /'od gsal bar ni de bshad do/ /khyi sha tshor bar bshad pa ste/ /lus kyi dngos po phag par brjod/ /khyim bya dmar chen du bshad do/ /bza' ba mchan ma med pa ste/ /spyin sreg lhan cig skyed pa yin/ /bde ba gtor ma'i brda yis bstan/ /dung dang mu tig nya phyis ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'o/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi yi ni/ /lus la byung ba thod par brjod/ /'byung po lnga las byung ba yi/ /thig le phyugs zhes bya ba ste/ /khwa la sogs pa phyugs rnams ni/ /nyon mongs du ma yin par bshad/ /steng dang 'og gi sgo dag las/ /pho nya mo rnams dngos grub 'gyur/ /ba glang lhan dang lding ba dang / /skem byed rtsa gnas zhes bya ba/ /bde chen zhes bya 'byung po ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru bshad pa yin/ /bde ba nam mkha'i khams yin te/ /rus sbal rnam par shes pa'o/ /rlung rnams rab tu phra ba la/ /yang dag 'gro ba dngos grub nyid/ /zhal — 19—

bzhi zhes bya gang bstan pa/ /mgon po thabs kyi bdag nyid yin/ /rig ma phyag gi ming yin te/ /de yang bzhi pa bzhi nyid do/ /gang zhig 'bum phrag la sogs pa/ /yang yang bzlas pa phyag tu brjod/ /gsang ba'i mchod dang bsnyen bkur ni/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i de nyid te/ /pho nya gnyis med sbyin sreg gi /lha rnams kyi ni sku chen no/ /rtag pa dam pa mchog tu phra/ /phyag rgya rnams las 'di chen po/ /phyag rgya chos/ zhes bya ba las/ /dus min 'chi ba bslu ba ste/ /gang gzhan lus kyi spyod pa can/ /las kyi phyag rgya de yang ngo / lken tu rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba dran pa ba:rgo/ /bdag tu phyin ci log pa la/ /nges par sbyar ba yin par bshad/ /mi dge'i chos ni tshar gcod cing / /gang zhig phan 'dogs brtson pa ni/ /dge ba 'a/ ste yang dag spong / /de ni rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ /gzhan rnams gang dag byang chub phyogs/ /de dag rnams las dbye ba ste/ /sum cu bdun pa'i rtsa rnamasang ṣ+ka/ /mchog gi lam du sbyar bar bya/ /raṇ+ḍa ka gnas nas song ste/ /tshangs pa'i spru/nas la thug gi bar/ /byang chub sems kyis gang ba ste/ /de nyid phyag rgya'i mchon pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ye shes bla med pa/ /ma chen 'khor bar 'khyams pa nying/ /phung po dang ni skye mched rnams/ /gang gi dbang du 'gyur ba dang / /gang zhi‘ka sngags kyi khyad par las/ /rlung ni 'gog par bshad pa yin/ /sgron ma nya sha dang ni myong / /sum cu rtsa gnyis khams yin te/ /mtshan mo snang ba med par ra bca sdod/ /gang las skyes mched bcu gnyis ni/ /lus la gnas pa'i sgo dgu po/ /rnga/rgya dang rtsa brgyad ldan pa'i rlung / /sku dang de bzhin gsung dang thugs/ /thun gsum du ni mngon par brjod/ /'di la tshangs —20—

pa'i yul gyi sar/ /dpa' bo'i sgra ni mi choms pa/ /lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dag pa'o/ /yi ge mang dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /mgo ni blon por brjod nga/ ste/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi de las 'byung / /gang rgo ro ni spyod pa'i phyir/ /longs/ spyod pa ni rgyal phran te/ /'byung jo/ nyi shu bram ze la/ /de sgra rigs kyi gtso bor grags/ /dpyid dang nā da nyid la 'o/ /skye gnas 'khor lo rgyal rigs te/ /dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /sreg bza' rlung dang zla ba dang / /nyi ma nam ma/ba 'a bdun du 'dod/ /nor la gsang bar spyod nga/'i phyir/ /de 'og rje rigs yin nga/ra bshang/ /lnga po bdud rtsi'i ming yin no/ /de bzhin dmangs rigs bar pa ste/ /snying stobs rdul ngang mun pa ni/ /'di la sreg blugs byed par bshad/ /raṇ+ḍa g.yung mo mthar skyes ni/ /tha ma'i rigs su bstan nga/ yin/ /'di la gcig tu 'dres pa'i phyir/ /sreg blugs cig tu bya ba bsha/da/ /zhag grangs bye brag gsungs gyur pa/ /rig pa'i rtul zhug/sa de 'dod do/ /gzhan dag gang zhig sngar bshad dang / /gang zhig 'og tu ston gyur pa/ /las rgyas pa yi cho ga rnams/ /slob dpon zhal sngas btang snyoms mdzad/ /me tog dang ni chu bsres pa/ /sngags gsum gyi ni bya ba yi/ /lus kyi g.yo ba sgra dang ni/ /yid kyi brjod pa'i khyad par yin/ /mtshan mo rtag tu sha za ba/ /nges par shas rab pha rol phyin/ /glo bur sbyor ba 'di dag gis/ /the tshom med par thob par 'gyu/ra/ /ha ha he he rnam pa brgyad/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sgra zhes dang / /lus la byung ba snying stobs so/ /

dga' ba la sogs sa rnams ni/ /yid las byung ba rnam pa brgyad/ /sgrub po yis ni lha mnyes byas/ /gzugs ni brtan par gyur pa na/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba la zhugs nga/sa/ /sngags kyi juX/da pa spyad par bya/ /lha rnams kyi ni ring gzigs nas/ /sgrub la byin gya tha 5 rlebs par 'gyur/ /bskyed pa'i rim la gnas pas kyang / /'di ni the tshom kla yed pa yin/ /skyes bu'am shes rab las byung ba'i/ khu ba me tog zhes pa ste/ /snyim pa bkang ba dgag pa yin/ /'di la rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /gtso bo khrag 'thubang bka' yis 'gyur/ /yang na bya ba thams cad ni/ /ji bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed/ /lus kyi sbyor ba dang ngo/ ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa nus pa yin/ /gsum pa dag ni phyi yi nyid/ /bzhi pa yis ni dmigs pa med/ /sngags kyi rgyal po grub par 'gyur/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'o/ /'gro ba kun la khyab gyur pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod pa rbi/ /dbugs kyi dbye ba zad min pa/ /bud med stornga ri phrag nyi shu gcig /de yang drug brgyas lhag pa'o/ / ji snyed rtsa yi grangs kyi ni/ /rlung yang de snyed gnas pa dang / /rgyu ba ma yin mi rgyu min/ /khams kyi rnam pa / snang de nyid do/ /de dag lus la rnam gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang sems dpa' yi/ /ci phyir bsgrub bya sgrub ce na/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid sbyor ba'o/ /thog ma tha ma'i tshig dag la/ /lha mo bzhi zhes gnas pa ni/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo bzhi po la/ /steng dang 'og tu rnam gnas nga/'o/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yi rgyud/ /spang bar bya ba ma yin pa/ /rgyud ni rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /de spong ba ni ‘ me mkhas pa'o/ /kun tu gnas pa'i snying po —22—

ni/ /rab tu rgya che bstan pa dang / /sngon nas shin tu rnam dag pa/ /gsal dang 'phro ba'i rang bzhin no/ /dag dang shin tu rnam dag pa'i/ //shrī hre ru ka'i rnam pa ni/ /nges dang mthun nga/'i yid byed kyi/ /gzhi zhes bya ba dngos/ po'i rgyud/ /gang zhig dbugs dbyung gnyis gsungs pa/ /dbugs phyin nga/ nas yang dag thob/ /'khor ba ji srid zhugs pa ni/ /mi phrogs 'bras bu yi na par brjod/ /lhan cig skyes pa rin po che/ /phal cher rgyud du sbas pa yin/ /bla ma'i man ngag dran pa'i phyir/ /yang dag snying po bsdus pa'o/ /g.yo ba rlung gi de kho na/ /sna tshogs las rnams byed nga/ ni/ /rdo rje sku yi bshad pa ste/ /rtsa ba'i sngags su brjod pa yin/ /rgyal ba rnam/sa kyi sku gsum po/ /dag nga/'i dkyil 'khor snang ba can/ /chos kyi sgo yi rjes ston pa/ /gsung ni snying po brjod par bya/ /rnam pa bdun gyi rab dbye can/ /sdug spangs bde ba sbyin byed cing / /thugs ni sdug bsngal ngal gso ba/ /gsang sngags nye ba'i snying ngo/ yin/ /bde bas bde ba thob 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas bde chen bde ba'i mchog /nam yang gzhig tu med pa ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi go char brjod/ /de nyid rnam pa lnga po ni/ /gzugs rnams kun la rab tu gnas/ /yi ge ha lnga'i sbyor ba yis/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bde thob 'gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad skyed byed pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi snying po ni/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yi/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo gsang ba'o/ /gang yang mchog tu zab mo yi/ /chos la mos par byed de yang / /dpa' bo rang nyid dang mtshungs shes/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bka' bstsal to/ /don rnams kyi —23—

ni mdo cam ste/ /snying ngo/ cung zad bsdus nga/ las/ /dri med legs pa gang thob des/ /khrag la grung dang/la gyi gan rnga 5 thob rtse tsheg /ces pa snying ngo/ bsdus pa slob dpon nag po spyod pas mjad pa rje rigs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta ku ma ra dang / lo cwa ba rig pa gzhon nus bsgyur pa'o// // maṅga 'o///ga(spung 'di snar thar dang (na lu'i ba:sngan 'gyur bsdus pa'i dus ma rnyed bstan 'gyur tham/sa rbod de ga be sa/ las gyes pas bstan 'gyur phal cher la mi bzhugs/ phyis gong rma/ tshes lnga bas rled nas gsar du dnge/ bzhengs sne gdong gi bstan 'gyur rnying pa'i nang du bcug 'dug /'dir de dang /de'i/ ma dpe yin nam snyam pa'i dpe rnying sdos bo gcig rnyed nga/ las bshus nga// 'di dang 'gyur mi gcig pa zhig gi dpe rnying par rked gcig kyang ma/thong ngo // // shu bha//

oX swā sti/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don sgom chul ni/ dang ngo/ra lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa ni/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyi mtshan nyid ldan nga/'i slob dpon la/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang / /zhes sogs kyi bsten tshul dang / chos kyi dgos pa chod nga/ra bya/ /bla ma'i drung du maṇ+ḍal dang / /yan lag bdun pa dang / sangs rgyas dngos dang mchungs par lta ba'i mos gus bsgom/ dmigs skor dang po'o/ /gnyis pa chos la mos pa bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa thams cad kyi yon tan ji tsam pa de tsam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang yod de/ de rnams kyis 'di bsgoms pa las thob po zhes chos la mos pa bya/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang / /zhes sogs mos pa bskyed pa'i rgyu la 'bad/ chos kyi 'phongs pa'i rgyu dag dang / /zhes sogs 'gal rkyen spangs/ gsum pa tshig la dmigs pa ni/ yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bar byas nas/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas/dran pa rnal du bzhag /bdag gis bsgom par bya ba'i chos de gang las byung ba'i sde snod ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes bsam zhing / mnyam

par 'jog /mdo sogs ming la sems 'jog go /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /thun mtshams la 'jug khar dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ sngon 'gro dang rjes kyi bya ba 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dis/ rigs 'dre/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /bzhi pa don la dmigs pa :/ / so so'i nang na tshul bzhin du/ /de yi don yang rnam par dpyod/ /zhes pa'i don yin te/ bdag gis thos bsam sgom gsum bya ba'i yul shes rab kyi 6/ rol tu phyin pa 'di la/ dang por gleng gzhi yod de/ de nas sems bskyed mdor bstan nas/ 'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi lnga rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du yod cing / mthar byams zhus/ rtag tu ngu / chos 'phags/ yongs gtad rnams yod la/ le'u 'di tsam glo ka 'di tsam brjod bya yang 'di dag go zhes bya ba la sogs nga/ yang yang bsam zhing sgom mo/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa te sngon 'gro la de ltar bzhi'o/ /lnga pa lam dngos ni/ gnyarnga ga te/ dang po lam la 'jug pa'i sgo dang /gnyis pa lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshe 'di rnga ni nga 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i skyo shas dang /las 'bras slu med yid ches kyi rje ris pa dang / stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnams kyis thun gyi dbu zhabs bar gsum thams cad du/ bogs dbyu8/nga zhing / bskul ma 'debs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pas/ dad pa rnam pa gsum gyis spro ba bskyed/ zhi gnas kyi ngo bo sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu dang / nyes pa lnga/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad la sogs pa brten/ rwa/nga po byings rgod spangs pa'i zhi gnas rnam —26—

dag la bkris na rnam bzhag rgyas bsdus ji ltar byas kyang 'dra'o/ /des na zhi gnas sgom chul spyi dang mthun no/ /dmigs chen gcig go /gnyis pa lhag mthong la/ rjes dpag nges shes kyi lam dang / rtog med mngon sum gyi lam gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag bdag med sgom chul dang /chos kyi bdag med sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ nga'o zhes rnam/ par brtags pa'i yul la dmigs na/ nga zhes bya ba ma grub ste/ lus rnams ni rdul phran gyi bar du bshag nas dang / sems kyang skad cig gi bar du rnam par bzhag na/lus sems gnyis kyang nga ma yin la/ de gnyis kyi tshogs pa'ang ma grub pas ma yin/ de gnyis las logs pa'ang med pa'i phyir/ gang zag meng par rtogs pa na/ de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /dmigs chen gnyis/ bar bar du gang zag bdag 'gog gi rigs pa rnams shes na dran par bya zhing / des nges shes skye zhing bogs 'byin du 'gro/gnyis pa ni/ gong bzhin du/ shes pa rnams la skad cig dang / don du snang ba rnams la rdul phran du sil/ skad cig ma dang / rdul phran yang si/la bas/mtha' med du 'gyur bas/ gzugs sgra sogs ngo bo'i mtshan ma dang / ka bum sogs bkod pa'i mtshan ma dang / khong khro dang dad pa la sogs shes pa'i mtshan ma gang yang med cing / cir yang ma grub pa la mnyim par bzhagadamigs chen gsum mo/ /de skabs gcig du bral/ yod med skye 'gog /mu bzhi skye 'gog /rdo rje gzegs ma/ rten 'brel sogs mtha' bral du gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa rnams shes na yang yang dran pas bogs che ba yin/—27—

gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi ‘mam phyag rgya chen po'ang / 'khor lo tha ma'i ma/do'i sgom rim ltar sems kyi rang bzhin la lta shes pa'i sgo nas mi rtog nga/ra bzhag pas/ rnam rtog rang dwangs ‘pa song / chu ma rnyog na dungs nga/'i chul gyi rang bzhin gsal bar mngon du 'gyur ba yin/ dmigs chen bzhi pa ste/ de da la dbye na dmigs pa mang ngo/ra 'gyur la/ nge/ dag lam gyi 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni 'dir skabs nyu brgyad la lam rim ngo bo tha dad pa med de/'chad chus tha dad pa'i dbang gis phye bar shes dgos shing / des na/ rang don yid byed kyi kun nas bslangs na spre5/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi la dmigs/lta ba gang zag gi bdag med tsam dang / sgom pa mi rtag la sogs pa bcu drug gi zhi lhag /spyod pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims cam la gnas pas ni/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob pa yin te/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /zhes sogs kyi don no/ /de'i steng du/ lta ba gzung ba chos kyi bdag med bsnan/ spyod pa bskal ba brgya'i bar du tshogs gsog pa bstsa/na/ sgom pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis gtso bor sgom pa dang / mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor byed rang rgyal du smon lam btab na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ de gnyis kyi rtogs par bya ba thams cad 'dir yang rtogs dgos pa yin mod/ thob bru rnams ni theg chen 'di'i gol sa yin nga/'i phyir/ mngon du byed dgos pa ma /tren no/ /des na rang rgyal gyi lam ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa ni/ /zhe skyu sdo sogs kyi don no/ /theg chen gyi lam dang —28—

'bras bu ste/ de la chos sku na 'bras bu/ sbyor ba bzhi rni la/ma/ mkhyen gsum la ngo bo'i dbang du byas na/ rnam mkhyen 'bras bu dang / ga‘na myo gnyis lam yin la/nge ya/nga chos sku dang / sbyor ba ba'i las logs su med/ nang gru/khyen gsum gyi rnam bzhag thos bsam gyi yul du sgo/ nas/ yu tā de dang rma/thun nga/'i nyams len sbyor ba bzhi la 'bad nga/sa/ 'bras bu dngos/ su mngon du gyur nga/ sna/ chos sku 'phrin las dang bcas pa'o/ /de la mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag ni/ mkhyen pa'i ngo bo tshig this mtshon par dka' ba'i phyir/ mkhyen pa de rnams kyi gang mkhyen pa'i lpil sogs la rgyas bshad byed pa ni/ mtshon byed kyi chos kyi go ba yin la/ de'i phyir skabs dang po gsum char las/ lam rim rgyas pa re re 'byung la/ cha shas kyi sgo nas/lam rim cha tshang ba sna yang yang 'byung ngo / /de la theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi thog ma ni/ sems bskyed nas 'go 'jin cing / de nas skabs 'dir sems bskyed yang dag par len dgos/ sngar sems bskyed cam blangs su zin kyang / sher phyin gyi lta bas zin pa dka' ba'i phyir/ bdag med gnyis la myong ba thon nas sems bskyed cho gas len pa'i tshe yang des zin pa dang /dge ba ci byed sems bskyed kyis zin par byed dgos pa'ang lta ba bzang po de dang nges par sbrel dgos/ de la bdag dang / sems can/ sdug bsngal gsum rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs kyang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa sems bskyed bsgom pa ste/ dmigs skor gcig /bdag dang lam rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs kyang 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir du/—29—

spyin sogs la 'bad par bya'o hwa / ma pa 'jug pa sems bskyed de/ dmigs bskor gnyis/ dkon mchog gsu 5 dang / skyabs par bya ba'i yul 'khor ba pa thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid yin kyang / kun rdzo ba tu 'khor ba pa rnams skyabs med mgon med yin/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal dkon mchog gsum gyis bskyab nus par shes/ nas/ skyabs 'gro la 'bad pa ni/ rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdam ngag ste/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ /'phags pa mchog rnams kyi gzigs ngo dang / rigs pa'i ngo na/ blang bya dang / dor bya gang yang med kyang / kun rdzob rten 'brel 'gag pa med pa la/las nyon yod phyin/ sdug bsngal 'byung / lam la 'bad na/ las nyon sdug bsngal 'gag par nges shes bskreX/da cing bsgom pa ni/ dmigs yul bden bzhi'i gdams ngag gi dmigs pa ste/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /dmigs pa de rnams la myong ba thon pa na/ thun bzhir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa gsum po rngo de rnams sngon du song ba'i rjes su/ thun gyi dngos gzhi bdag med gnyis kyi lta ba la/ zhi lhag zung 'brel du sgom bden bzhi la 'doms pa'i dmin/sa pa des bar bar du bogs 'don/ rjes sgom lam lam shes kyi skabs su rnga༅da pa'i mos bsngo yid rang gsum gyi rgyur/de dang mthun pa'i dmigs med kyi mos pa dang / bsngo ba dang / rjes su yid rang ba gsum tshar re bsgom/ thun man rdoms su chos spyod kyi rim pa thams cad sngar gyi lta bas zin pa dang / lta ba des/ zin pa'i sbyin sogs la 'bad gang thub bya/—30—

sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag ste/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /dmigs pa'i ngo bo ni/ phyis kyang 'di nyid kho na bsgom par bya ba yin mod kyi rnam pa 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba rnams bsnan pas dmigs nga/ tha dad par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su/ nyams rtogs cung zad skyes pa la/ nga rgyal dang / bzang zhen byung na/ ma zhen pa'i gdams ngag bsgom ste/ 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dang lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu gang yang ma dmigs na/ 'di cam gyi nyams rtogs kyang gnas skabs bya rtsol gyi 'bras bu las byung ba'i sgyu ma lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhen du ci yod ces/rang gi nyams myong bzhag ste/ slar yang brtson 'grus drag tu rtsom pa ste/dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thob nga/ ni shin tu dka' ste/ yun ring du thogs pa dang /dka' ba dpag tu med pa byed dgos pa'i phyir/ bdag gis mi nus pa 'dra'o snyam du sems pa byung na/ dus yun ring thung gnyis kar rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs/ bde sdug kun kyang 'khrul ba'i snang ba cam las/ nga ngos gnas la grub pa med na/ yun thung ba dang / sla ba la dga' rgyu ci yong/ ring ba dang /dka' ba la mi dga' rgyu ci yod ces sgyid lug pa bsal nas/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa ni/ mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus te/ dmigs skor bdun pa/'o/ /lam yongs 'dzin dngos da lta med kyang / phyogs mthun ni/ chos thams cad stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la 'bab pa'i thabs su byas pas/ theg chen —31 —

gyi lam du ma/ 'dus nga/'i chos gang ri yang med pa dang / rang gi nyams myong gis/rang sems la phan thogs par rdo tses nas/ skad cig snga ma'i nyams myong la dpags nas/ phyi ma'i gnas skabs su gang la'ang ma zhen pa dang / ma’nyam bzhag la mngon par dga' ba dang / lam dang 'bras bu la yid ches bskyed nas / sgrub pa'i ngo bo 'bad rtsol bskyed pa ste/ dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /de dag tshogs lam gyi dmis/sa pa'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam nga/ rnams yang ya nga yid la /byed pa dang / de rnam/sa dang dam gas pa'i gzhi gcig tu byed pas gsal snang skyes/ pa na/ sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /man ngag gi tshe/ 'a/bor 'das kyi chos thams cad yul dus gnas skabs/rnam 'gyur gang yang ma dmigs rnga/ra shes pa'i sgo nas/ rten bya'i lam mtha' dag la/ dngos dang / mos pa'i sgo nas bslabs nga/ nyid kyis rnam pa de thams cad bsgom par 'gyur zhing / re re bzhin du dmigs nga/ sbyor ba sgom dka' ba'i phyir/ bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ma zu ngag tu mi 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang rnam nga/ de rnams kyi go ba ji bzhin du shes the/nga / yang yang yi da la byas na/ nges shes skye shing / shin tu bogs che'o/ /de dag tshogs lam phyir mi nye tshe/ga gi rtags thob thob kyi bar du 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag tu spyan lnga thob pa'i dre spyi chos la mkhas par bya ba dang / mngon shes kyi thob pa'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin la 'a bad par bya'o/ /sbyor lam gyi dmigs pa ni/sngar gyi gzhi'i dmigs pa'i steng du/ dmigs rnam 'di rnams yar ldan du bsnan pa yin te/ de la chos tham sgyu so cad dbyings rang bzhin spros pa dang bral —32—
