de nas phyag rgya chen po te bon dang sngar bzhin mnyam nga ra sbyar ba'i zhu bde'i mthar yas brtan la yang yang goms par byas pas/ rdo rje'i rtser thig le gcig brtan/ 'pho ba'i rlung gcig thim nga nas stong brgyad brgya pa re re rdzo gas pa nas re re rdzogs te/ rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gags/ rdul snri/ bo nas mar brtsegs pa dang / zla ba nor bu nas yar brtsegs pa'i chul gyis rten brten pa'i 'brel kla dag nga/ra 'gyur ro/ /der ting nge 'dzin rdzes sa pa na/ phyag rgya'i dngos grub zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'o/ /dran ting gnyis ka la bogs 'don las kyi phyag rgya yin pas/ de dbang rtul kho na la gsungs pa min gsung /yang gu ru shar phyogs pa'i zhal snga nas dang po gnyis la phra cho/'i rnal 'byor/bar pa gnyis la gtum mo'i rnal 'byor/ tha ma gnyis la bde ba'i rnal 'byor bogs 'don spyod pa skabs gsum du spyod/ de re re la sor bsdud sogs ya/na lag drug ldan du bzhed de/ khyad par phra mo sngar bkod pa rnams ma gtogs nyams len la khyad mi snang ngo / /'dir bsam gtan gyi skabs su lā ba pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang gcig pa'i man ngag mnon par mjad de ngo sprod pa ni phyag gzhes dam pa ste de bzhin du shes par bya la/ gegs sel ni zhan las blang nga/ dang /go don ni do ha nyid rgyas shing bzang bas/ de nyan pa dang 'dzin pa gal che'o/ /sngon 'gro zla ba brgyad dam dgu/ dngos gzhi 'dzin pa ya/na chad nyams khrid lo gnyis tsam du bskyang / de man chad tshig khrid bya ste lag len zhib tu shes dgos so/ /'di'i gzhung phal che ba dang / man ngag rdzogs par gu ru lho phyogs pa'i zhabs las mnos/ glu'i rlung gsum pa shas che ba sa du nā tha las thos shing slad —89—

chad pa bsab pa dang / man ngag rgi lus tshang ba gu ru shar phyogs pa las zhus te/ snying po ni de dag go /zhes pa'ang rje btsun dpal stag lung thang pa'i bkas tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum la bris pa'o/ /maṅga laX// //

ba'i tshul du ngo sprod pa'i thabs snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal ga tsho' byar zhes bya ba bzhugs/oX swā sti/ 'dir slob dpon lwa ba pa'i gdams pa/ skal ldan cig myong ba'i tshul du ngo sprod pa'i thabs/ snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba 'di la/ sems ma bcos pa lam du byed pa dang / rnam rtog ma bcos pa lam du byed pa dang / snying rje chen pos lha bskul ba dang / bla ma bskul ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni spro na skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnamasaspyi dang mthun par bya/ mi spro na ma byas kyang rung / lus gnad rnam snang ga chasabadun spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ rang sems la rang gis cher gyi gtad nasa'ajog pa las/ rnam dag gi rtsol ba ye mi byed pa nyid nyams len gyi mthiladang / de'i ngang nas rtog pa gang shar gyi rang ngo la bltas pas/ rnam rtoganyid dbyings su dag pa'i rig gsal tsam la mnyam par bzhag /gal te ngo mi shesasu cung zad 'jam na/ rig pa drag tu bcun la de ltar mi 'gro ba'i zhe bcad dam po dang rnam pa thams cad du sgrim pa gal che/gnyis pa ni/ des bcom med du sems gnas na/ rnam rtog gang shar 'char sgo lam me ba ma 'gags pa de la/ khong nas dran 'dun gyis zin par —91 —

byas te ched gtad bkag kyang mi bkag /bcas bcos kyang mi byed/ dran pasazin phyin chad 'gyur na'ang gyur tu bcug /gnas na'ang gnas su 'jug nga/ yin/ de'i sngar gyi dran 'dzin zhan du song na/ dmigs pa snga ma la brtan pa ma thob pa yin pas/ skabs der rnam rtog rgya 'jam du 'gro ba'i skyon yongs pas/dmigs pa snga ma/ la re shig 'bad/ dran 'dzin ngan du rma/ song na/ ga pa shar ngosa'adzin nga/ de kho na la 'bad cing / skabs re sgrims skabs re glod pa spel masanyin mtshan thams cad 'da' bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang yi dam gang mos su gsal zhing rtsa dbu ma spyi bo nasalhe ba'i bar du yod pa/ lte bar a dmar po/ rlung ro ma/na gsum phyir gsal/oX kyi gdangs kyis rlung nang du drangs/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar/ a'i gzugasadang / a'i gdangs la sems gtad/ mi bde ba med tsam du bzung nas dal bus 'bud pa na/ hūṃX gi gdangs kyis 'bud nga/ra bsam ste/ yi gogasum gyi rdor bzlas bum can no/ /yi ge gnyis kyi rdor bzlas ni/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ lte bar thig le dmar po/ rlung dal bus rgyun mi chad par nang du rngubs pa na/ ho'i gdangs kyi 'jug par bsam/ rngubs pa rdzogs pa dang /dal bus hūX gi gdangs kyis phyir 'bud par bsam/ 'di la cher 'dzin pa mi dgos so/ /bzhi pa ni rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang rang dang 'dra ba'i yum can zhig gsal btab ste/ mos gus dung bas/ bdag gi bde ba dang sdug bsngalakhyod kyis mkhyen no/ /bde yang rung sdug bsngal yang rung khyed las gzhan na ma —92—

mchis so/ /ci mang gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo nas snyi nga khar byon/ rang sem/sa dang dbyer med yin snyam du mos la sngar bzhin gsol ba btab/ mthar gang yang mi bsam// mdun gyi bar snang la har te lta ba dang / sngar lta ba 'a spros bralagyi ngang bskyong ngo / /de ltar na dmigs pa dang jo/ nyams len gyi mthil yin la/gzhan gsum bogs 'don yin cing / de ltar nyams su blangs pas phyag rgya cen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang sems la /bong nas 'char ba yin no//sems ma bcos pa dang rnam rtog lam du byed pa rdo rje'i tshig dang pos bstan/bde ba'i sgom tshul gnyis las bstan/ lha dang bla ma bskul ba nyid gas pa/ rwa sabastan/ de la brten nas ye shes 'chad chul bzhi pas bstan pa yin no/ /zhes/pa 'di yang rdo rje slob ma lhun grub bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras so/ /bkra shis so// //

na mo gu sa gnas dag pa'i 'khor lo rab 'jams su/ /dpal ldan lhan skyes bde ba 'gyur med dngos/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /dbyings spros dang bral ba stong ba'i dngos/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje phag mo la /dus da lta: /gnas u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du/ /grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /slob dpon lwa ba pa la /dus pa /gnas gaṇ+ḍa ba'i gnas nang du/ /yongs mthu stobs dpag med rdzu 'phrul brnyes/ /grub chen ga rba ri nā thā la /dus /yul ti pu ra'i grong khyer du/ /thugs snying rje chen pos 'gro don mdzad/ /rje ga rba ri bar pa la /dus /gnas lho phyogs go do wa ri sa khong grub thob mdo las gus bshud pa'i/ /grub thob ga rta' chu ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da lta: /gnas mkha' 'gro'i dbang po'i ri bo sa /dus da lta'i grub brnyes kun gyi gtso/ /slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa la /dus /gnas nges med rgyal khams yangs pa sa /rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /grub chen budha nā tha la /dus /gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rje skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang / /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /dbyings 'od gsal chos sku gnyug ma'i sems/ /gzhi 'gyur med rtsal bral lhun gyis grub/ /don ma bcos —94—

rtog bral phyag rgya che/ /dus da lta rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam rtog gi rba rlabs chos sku'i ngang / /dpe rgya mtsho chen po'i chu rlabs bzhin/ /don rang shar rang grol gyi rnal 'byor mchog /dus da lta rtogs par /dngos lha dang bla ma rang sems su/ /ye gdod nas gcig tu bzhugs pa'i chul/ /de tha dad du 'jin pa yongs bral ba/ /dus /ma 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la/ /rje khyed kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu yis/ /gnas 'khor ba'i mtsho las drongs mjod la/ /dus /dpal rtsol med phyag chen mngon gyur pa'i/ /mdangs snying rje chen po'i 'gro ba kun/ /gzhi 'gyur med rtag brtan g.yung drung la/ /dus da lta 'god par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa'ang smras nga/'o/ /bkra shis/'phel brtan/ rnam rtog rang byung gang yin ma skyes pa/ /rlung dang sems ni g.yo med ngang du gzhog /snying rjes lha dang bla ma rab tu bskul/ /bsam du med pa snying nas 'char ba 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i tshig/ //

na mo gu ru be/ na ma budha dharma saX bhe sduX rigs dang mos pa dag dang bla ma/ bsten/ /gdams ngag lam dang zung 'jug ces bya ba/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang sde snod bcas/ /mdor na gnas drug po ni 'di dag go /rigs las chos la mos 'gyur de las kyang / /bla ma bsten dang de las gdams ngag nod/ /de don bsgoms pas zung 'jug 3thob 'gyur phyir/ /rim 'di phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis dgongs/ /de ltar dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud du/ /rdo rje'i rigs bstan las dang lam de bzhin/ /grol ba'i rgyu mtshan gsum gyis/ mos pa dang / /dbang bskur gdams ngag lam dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /rnam bzhi phyi nas rab tu gsal bar bstan/ /ngo bo tha dad nges pa dang / /ma nges mchog dang dman pa drug /'di dag rgyu yi rgyud yin te/ /rigs kyi nges pa'i chig tu brjod/ /sems rgyun kun gzhi shes tshogs bcas/ /rlung dang snang ba'i yid lus dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni zung 'jug pa/ /rigs kyi ngo bo yin par 'dod/ khams dang mos dang sgrub dang 'bras/ /tha dad dmigs phyir nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal pha rol phyin theg dang / /'bras bu'i rigs rnams yod par brjod/ /rdo rje'i theg par smon lam btab/ /dbang sogs sos btab 'phel ba'i cha/ /lam la 'dun cing rtsol ba'i las/ /myur 'god sems bskyed 'brel gang nges/ /gzhan dag nges pa ma yin no/ /bde chen theg par legs smon —96—

cing / /zung 'jug la 'dun bzhi ldan mchog /gsum ldan la sogs dman par brjod/ /sems bcas lus kyang rang bzhin gyis/ /theg pa 'di la rnam par dag /nus ldan 'dra ba sems can kun/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs dang ldan/ /mos pa chung 'bring chen po dang / /mchog dang mchog rab bla med drug /yid ches las byung snying rje dang / khres rab dman ldan dge ba'am/ /theg gnyis 'dun pa'i las can te/ /'di ni mos pa dman par brjod/ /sgrol 'dod theg mchog dang las byung / /bdag dang gzhan mnyam shes rab dang / /gzhan don snying stobs 'bring gyur pa/ /byang chub mchog la mos shing 'dun/ /mos pa 'bring zhes brjod pa ste/ /pha rol phyin dang thun mong yin/ /rgyu ni rdo rje'i theg pa la/ /dang shing smon lam btab gyur pa/ /myur tu sgrol ba'i 'dun pas sad/ /'di ni mos pa chen po'o/ khren tu myur dang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /'phral du 'gog 'dun dag pa yi/ /gsal snang 'brel 'di lhag par che/ /gsang sngags spyi dang bskyed rim la'o/ /bde chen sdom pa dang 'brel ba/ /yud kyis byang chub thob 'dun cing / /mtshan med bde chen grogs bcas pa/ /de 'dra mchog rab rdzogs rim la/ /'bras mthong yid ches sgom byung dang / /sprul sku'i gdams ngag thos sogs rgyu/ /'gro kun stong par mngon sum du/ /'jug pa'i lam la 'dun bla med/ /rkyen dang rgyu dang lhan cig byed/ /bla ma rnam pa gsum yin no/ /rkyen ni rdo rje slob dpon dang / /rgyu ni lam gyi ye shes yin/ /lhan cig byed pa phyag rgya mo/ /de gsum ngo bo dbye ba dang / /bsten tshul gsum du shes par bya/ /ngo bo rdo rje'i lam 'god mdzad/ /dam tshig zlas pa spyin pa dang / /'chad byed man ngag —97—

ston pa dang / /dbang bskur ba dang las byed pa/ /rnal 'byor can gyi bla ma ste/ /las dang po yi gnas skabs la'o/ /skyon spangs yon tan ldan pa ste/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bsten tshul sogs/ /rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /ye shes cung zad brtan pa na/ /rang rgyud rtogs pa'i lha dag dang / /brtan nas mkha' 'gro ma mo sogs/ /brtan pa cher thob sprul sku dang / /sa bcu pa sogs longs spyod rdzogs/ /rgyu yi ngo bo gong ma yi/ /ye shes gsal bar mtshon nus can/ /bskyed rim mthar thug ye shes ni/ /dang po'i bla mar blo can 'dod/ /rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i shes dang po/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bla ma'o/ /bde ba chen po'i bla ma ni/ /phyag chen las thob zhu bder bsgrags/ /mthong lam dga' ba'i skad cig ma/ /re re'i sngon du 'byung ba de'o/ /nges par 'byin pa'i bla ma ni/ /sa bcu 'og nas gong ma sto /'phar byed yan lag bdun ldan yin/ /lam de nyid dang rgyu tshogs rnams/ /goms byed 'di yi bsten tshul yin/ /lhan cig byed pa'i ngo bo ni/ /bde rgyu thun mong min bud med/ /las dang ye/ shes phyag rgya che/ /ye shes la ni dam chig dang / /brtags pa'i rig ma gnyis su gnas/ /phyag chen rnam bcas rnam med gnyis/ /dang por bde sbyin dbang gi dus/ /smin byed phyag rgya bskyed rim dang / /zhu bde 'bras bur byed pa ni/ /rdzo gas rim dngos gzhi ma thob par/ /thob nas so skye'i lam du ni/ /rang bzhin bde ba 'bras bur byed/ /spros bral rnam pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /'phags pa'i lam du 'byung ba yin/ /'jag med bde ba'i don du ni/ /'dod chags stong par bsre zhing bsgom/ /dbang dang dam tshig brtul zhugs dang / /g.yo med dang ni zung 'jug —98—

dang / /nye rgyu ltos med rang nyid dang / /'bras bu lam gyi cha rkyen la/ /gdams pa rnam pa bcu zhes bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbang sogs mi dmigs dang / 1 /dam tshig la yang gnyis meng/ kyi/ /ye shes kyis ni 'jug pa dang / 2 /mchan bcas mchan med brtul zhugs kyang / /rang bzhin med par shes nga/sa spyod/ 3 /bya la'ang dmigs gtad kun zhig pa'i/ /stong dang bde chen lha skus sbyo/da/ 4 /bde la stong dang stong la bde/ /zung 'jug la yang mchan med bsgom// (( /rang dang phyag rgya ye shes dbang / /mnyam nga/ nyid du gdams nga/ dang / 6 /sgo gsum longs spyod ma chags bzhin/ /ngo bos stong dang ltos med nga/ra/ /cho ga'i sbyor bcas dmigs med spyod/ 7 /bdag gi rang bzhin ma dmigs kyang / /'gro ba byang chub la brtson cing / /bya dang lam gyis bdag mtshon dang / 8 /rang bzhin med kyang 'bras bu ni/ /dbyer med yon tan ldan la 'dun/ 9 /mngon shes sogs don sgrub cha rkyen/ /nyon mongs bdud sogs stong bde bar/ /shes pas rang bzhin don spyod do/ 10 /lam gyi gzhi dang rkyang pa bsgom/ /bsdus sgom bsdus sgom rab gyur pa/ /lam ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /rtse gcig ma gyur par dang ni/ / gyur nas brtan phyir sgom pa dang / /yan lag bdun ldan sogs rtsol dang / /de yi rdzogs rim rtsol med 'jug /rnam rtog shin tā nub gyur nga/'o/ /yan lag bdun dang rdo rje gsum/ /ched du bya bzhi yan lag drug /lam gyi ngo bo dam pa yin/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes gnyis/ /sku bzhi rdo rje rnam bzhi dang / /de yi rang bzhin sku bcu drug /ye shes rnam pa lnga dang ni/ /de nyid bdun du brjod pa yin/ /de skad brjod pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro ba byang chub myur thob —99—

rgyal pa glu dang la mar sbyar ba bzhugs/no he oṃ/snro ༷ bde ṭā dgyes pa kyi//bde ba'i sgongs da snyobyung ba//bad ba she zhi sbyar ba ya~X/she/rab kau sna pas dzadage dror byad//rki rmi rba / la la ha//she lte she haXchi/dho/ la da rgyas ha ru ka dpal bu / tha //༵de bas na skye a~X she ga tsho //sbyar bas zla kau sna baX ba'i po kheng 'as/she/lhan sa she langasda ༷spyod la 'a dge ge//ba she bgye~X/ṭardesnyen 'a/de/sheX pad+ma 'dzo ༷//thong gi par pa 1 ḍi(ha//gyi khu/pa ra sna sku pha zhe ba ba jama'i bde spre/la stir ma spege ye de skyed nas / she/rte/la ār sa haX//khuX rdem ba ge lte ni she na dzo shed nas//'dad rdo rmego ma' she gyas kyi//smri dzod rab dgye pa' dzo ༷ da//ba ba dzi/rnal she ma ba'i bde bstso//dgyesang 'i bde pa she ba mdzod / zhi rnga/'i/rtse ge ge ge yig dod dod da 'gra drwa ba 'a ba ba stsal///da rgyas pa' ba ba she ba mdzad/yī/ ba she gya khyod bdag gi//bdag la bde chen te ba ga pa//a gi /she /mgan khyad bdag zhi mdun du rab bzhugs //rtswa gh+ra stsu zhakhrul zhal brdergyu/ ge / ngas 'azu/d+ku// deb she 'jug pa bdag ni ma / ba' rdoXmadzad//wo mas dkaX ba ju / ka pas bde stso//mu rdo sde mu ge snye zhes tshodage de 'gra grwa 'i tha5sardecad la//snyams par 'ju / ga pas ba stsal 0 1 / byan gyas rlabs//thar pa mtshan

nyid rtse ge mu dī khyod//a la /bde ba spangs pas grol mi a myi//sgri med pa ba 'gabasngal gya 'a//bde snye /spya skyes he 1 deb 'di gnas//a / ci/nyasapa nga'i nga bas sa myos ri ngab te//bde ba 'a med bu'i dbus kyi bdeng//pad+ma'i 'a gnas na swo gzhal zhi khang //nor bu' das bde bsamadzo par gyas//'ge ༷rde da~Xs pa khyod ma gyur//sbyi ba che she grol bar a zhi//pad+ma rgyas pa' ra ra rdzos//bung ba ༈ 'a she//a la /a /tshwad pas ma dzi 'dad sas snre/ pa na//rmad du byung bde na smi drug gi 'dab//di mtsho dzo sa she je'am//mchon drug 'dab 'a ma skyes rī//sbrang dri che rda rje' bung zi ra 'a pa//yo du phur ba 'o gres cha chu dzor bangs// med mkha' 'a tso sngus kyas/ye5rdeshe she//zhes chas las dungaXs grub spun ste na sto/ sa'adi pa skuXn )//sa dziraXwi grub ngas pa /dri/sngu wozipa' mun sa na/'a/dpyad kya rgyal pa sngi blangasaXrdes//she ༷ glu cha tsā drwa ba yas//gi lha yi sgro nga pe du sku rba mdzad ṭā yan//ra bang mchi la 'ab shu zhes pa bya//rang lha zhin ba sa//rgyu dang ma rgyu lta bar bya//dam ning ni nyad she dus su//de ban gshe/snas pa thams cad dang //bad ni 4 stob/'deb ma/dzo/dra ge cha 'a she she 'gro ma/she/kun la bdag go yeb 'bas//rda rja pad+ma yad 'ang ba//sbyar bas dngas grub thams ho 'grub//dgyes pa 'di yis bskul na ni//bde ba wo po sngo ba yin//dpyid kyi rgyawage dzo:/rde ra tsho de pa the / :rdo ra 7 hu ste:rde ke 7pa glu blangs pas//'gra kun rda ༷na par shag/a la /lo /mngan/
nyis la sbyar ba'o

na mo shākya mu na ye/ na mo lo ka nā tha ya/ su sti pra dza khyuX gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga ni/ nam langs pa'i mtshams su/ kha dang lag pa bkru ba sogs gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan la sogs pa'i drung du/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa zhig bshams/ dkon mchog la mos gus dang / las 'bras la yid ches dang / chos kyi phan yon yid la bsam ste/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje'i spyan gyi 'gro la mchog tu gzigs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma sa /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' bsdod bcas//nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ /dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus —104—

bzhugs gsol/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi 'bral bde ba'i dgongs pa can/ /phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pas sgrib kun nges par grol/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab/ /thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul/ /nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la/ /brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'/ /thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni/ /mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi/ /lan ldon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang / /gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la/ /blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba/ /legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de/ /de dag skad kyis sems can gyi/ /'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus can rnams kyis khyod mthong na/ /skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar/ /mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang / /sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / /to nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i/ /bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gas don du ye shes dang / /spangs dang dge 'byung gegs byed rnams/ /ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis/ /mi brdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba/ /—105—

'khor gyi nang na bag brgyad gsungs/ /kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa/ /'khor sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang / /gnas pa kun la rtag par ni/ /kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ba/ /yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sems can kun gyi bya ba la/ khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas/ /mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba/ /mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod pa dang ni rtog pa dang / /ye shes dang ni 'phrin las kyi/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum dag gi byang chub che/ /rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du/ /sems can kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'/ /rnyog pa med cing mi gnas pa/ /mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la/ /spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs rnyed kyi/ /lus bsnyad pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /'phrin las sgrub —106—

cing yon tan rnam g.yer med/ /bskal pa mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la: /gang zhig 'byung po kun la thugs brtse bas/ /sngon chad ma thos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /skyob pa lha dang mi rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /srid pa mthar phyin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ /mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe/ /'jam bu'i grib mas sku lus ma btang zhing / /lha bu gzhon nu drug gis bshud gyur pa/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la: /mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur mdzad cing / /kun spyod 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas/ /mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang / sku kya thub pa go tam lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing / /spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe byang chub chen por thugs bskyed nas/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drug khri lnga stong la/ /lus ngag yid —107—

gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med/ /chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag: /rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal ba rtag pa dang / /he ru ka dpal rdo rje nyi ma dang / /pad+ma gar dbang rta yi rgyal po sogs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga de bzhin gshegs yum bzhi/ /sems dpa' che dang khro bo'i dbang po rnams/ /rang rang rigs kyi lha mor bcas la sogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phag mo bdag med sna tshogs yum/ /ye shes dbang mo rdo rje ro langs ma/ /rdor dbyings dbang phyug la sogs dkyil 'khror gyi/ /'khor los bsgyur ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dus pa bde dgyes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / /gdan bzhi mā ya thod pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs sngags rgyud kyi/ /ye shes lha tshogs kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po dang / /phyag rgya'i rigs byung la sogs sngags kyi lha/ /zhi khro lha tshogs rgyud sde bzhi po las/ /gang gsungs rnams la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa sbyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi sras/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag 'joms mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa —108—

na/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje bsnams la: /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing sreg /ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel/ /chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad pa/ /dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la: /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge glang chen me sbrul choms rkun dang / /lcags sgrog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa rnams/ /zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la pisko'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang / /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob mdzad cing / /dri med bde r+ṣa nye bar sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba sha wā rī/ /lha mo gang gi sgrub pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la —109—

phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i dpal las legs byung zhing / /sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'khrugs pa dang snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /rin wo 'od 'phro ri rab mu khyud dang / /'od dpag med dang rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /mthu stobs chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mchog dang / /ral gcig ma dang khro gnyer can ma ste/ /'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po stug sngon can/ /stobs po che dang lha yi bu gnyis po/ /rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang / /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so sor 'brang ma stong r+ṣa rab 'joms dang / /rma bya wo mo gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang / /bsil ba'i tshal dang gtsug tor gdugs dkar sogs/ /'phrin las lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ha ya shrī ba rta mchog dpal/ /'bar ba'i sku la ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ /pad+ma rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra ni la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brdzid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rgyal ba'i rigs kyi sprul pa ni/ /lha min 'joms shing bdud kyi klud pa 'gems/ /—110—

sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gzhin rje'i gshed/ /'od chen khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs thogs med rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /'phrin las lhun grub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs/ khro bo mngag gzhug tho he'i dbang po rnams/ /rig pa'i tshogs dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur dang mthar byed bzhi/ /stobs chen mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / /dbyug sngon hūX mdzad gnod mdzes rgyal po ste/ /phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa/ /rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang skyong zla 'od gzhon nu yul 'khor skyong / /don zab dgongs 'grel kun 'dri chos 'phags dang / /blo gros ngag yangs don dam yang dag bzhugs/ /yon tan 'byung gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i bka' 'khor shwa ri'i bu dang ni/ /mo 'gal bu dang kun shes nor spyin 'dzin/ /nye ba 'khor dang ma 'gags rab 'byor sogs/ /dgra bcom grangs la 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs/ /dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu zung bzhi dang / /tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pas bstan pa yongs gtad 'od srung che/ /kun dga' bo dang sha na'i gos can dang / /nyer sbas dhi ti ka dang nag po dang / /legs mthong rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ /tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes/ /in+d+ra bhu ti sa ra ha la sogs/ /dpag —111—

yas grub chen rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po klu sgrub ār+ya de wa dang / /thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /chos spyod yon to 'od dang dpa' bo sogs/ /'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba mtsho/ /brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ /blo gsal dbang po pad+ma'i ngang tshul sogs/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi yi dbang po chos bzhin sa skyong ba/ /rnam dpyod blo can des pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs kyi yongs bskor ba'i/ /rgyal blon byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /zhu chen bsgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba blo gros gsal ldan pa/ /lo tsā chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me spar/ /ngur smig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras gcig pu/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal tshul 'dzin cing / /gangs can khrod 'dir gdul bya ma lus par/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yis/ khri srong lde btsan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /sgrol mas lung bstan kha ba can du byon/ /lnga brgya'i dus su thams cad mkhyen par gyur/ /'gro mgon a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī/ /rgya gar bod dang kha che la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs yul du dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa chen yab sras rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzungs sngags rtog pa bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal —112—

'byor bla med kyis/ /dbang lung bshad pa lag len man ngag gi /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang / /'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che/ /legs par bsrungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel gyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /'dzin dang spel dang bsrung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje yis/ /sgrub pa po la ma yengs bu bzhin skyong / /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin wo bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod spyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po nga lha/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang rigs mgon po ste/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bska la ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de lta byung / /—113—

skyes rabs rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /bkra shis 'byung dang byang chub chen po dang / /chos 'khor cho 'phrul chen po lha las babs/ /dben sdum sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyisabarlabs/ /myang 'das mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yid rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /mchod pa rnams/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta zlo bi shwa mu khe bhāX sarba thā khaX ut+pa| te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/ zhes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis bsas/ bsdu na yid kyi byin tsos kyis kyang chog /mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkrams byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /de bzhi du mchod yon ces pa'i gnas su gas rnams kyang sbyor te/ me tog /bdug spos/mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ sil snyan rnams 'jug /de rjes su bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsdus pa blang bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la zhes sogs tshar gsum/ de rnams sngon 'gro'i rim pa yin no/ /dngos gzhi ni 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams —114—

cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing / byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis/sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzungs te/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /brdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spangs/ /bla med byang chub gnas thob shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol —115—

bar phe/ga /ces lan gsum mo/ /de ni dngos gzhi'i bya ba yin la/ rjes ni/ tshul khrims yongs dag gi gzungs bzla zhing / smon lam 'debs pa yin te/ oṃ a mo gha/ shi la/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shudha satwa pa sma bi bhu ṣi ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa 'e1 ki te huX phaṭa/ brgya rtsa'am/ ma 'grub na nyer gcig tsam bya/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing sogs sho lo ka gcig dang / rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /ji ltar nod pa'i bslab pa phra mo yang / /nges 'byung bsam pas byang chub ma thob bar/ /srog gi phyir yang gtong bar mi byed pa'i/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu 'dzin par shog/spyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / /bzod pa sgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cing / /sdug bsngal kun las thar par shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos nyid mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ga༈ yang ji ltar 'os—116—

pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ /bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga la nyan thos lugs dang / theg chen lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'di ni theg chen gyi lugs/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gzungs las 'byung ba yin no/ /'di dus dang por slob dpon las lan gcig blangs te/ phyis rang nam 'dod pa'i tshe/rang gis blangs pas chog pa yin te/ dam bca' brtan pa'i phyir dus nges pa can du blangs na bzang bar bzhed do/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i lag len mdo tsam 'di yang / shes ldan rnams kyi nan tan du bsgrub pa'i 'os so/ /zhes pa'ang sa la spyod pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i gsung gis bskul nas kun dga' snying pos bris pa'o// // —117—

rtogs pa 'dod dgu' rgya mtsho bzhugs/a swā sti/dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'dod dgu'i gter mdzod ces bya ba/bla ma dang dkyil 'khotshor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal go/mchog tu dang por ye shes bdud rtsi yi//bka' drin stsol mdzad bla mar phyag bgyis na gagangagithugs rje'i 'od zer las shar ba//'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la'ang 'dud//rgyaladang de sras rgya mtsho'i mkhyen pa kun//gcig tu bsdus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs//yan 'ag/bdun ldan rigs kyi dkyil 'khor spro//mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis bdag blo gsal bar mdzod//bskyed rim kun gyi gco bo zla med pa//'dus pa'i lam bzang ye shes zhabs kyi srog/phyogs 'dir ring mo zhig nas nyams pa de//rgyas par bya phyir 'di la spro ba skyes//ma lus rgyud sde'i chu klung kun//'dus pa'i rgya mtsho cher 'jug pa//lugs bzang mchog 'di mthong ba na//lugasardegazhan dag ni 'od mi gsal//de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis ni//lam mchog 'di la nyer brten 'os//'di la grub pa'i dga' ston ni//mtha' yas ci yi phyir mi 'thob//rdzer rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la nye bar brten nas bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog nyid kyang /lus kyi chos 'di nyid cis/ bde blag tu mngon par bsgrub par 'dod pa dag gis lugs 'di lan na tan tu bya bar 'os so//de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa sngags kyi da spros grub mchog brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ༷pa la ye shes kyi zhal snga nas kyis/rje btsun

'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor r+sā po las mngon sum du nod pa'i gdams ngag yin no/ /de yang sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po las/ la lar dri med chu ni phun tshogs shing / 'ang mchogamadzes pas rnam par bgyon pa yi/ /ri bo'i phyogs gcig tu ni bcom ldan 'das 'jam pe'i dbyangs zhes bya ba rab tu sgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su bde ba'i stan pa'adug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas/rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdorje'i skyilamokrung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang zin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang dnga'adraba'i yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdo rje sems pa'i dbu gyon can/ dpral bar oṃ nas hūX gi bar/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mya dzaX dzaXhūXbaX hoX rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyisadabang bskur/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX dkar po'i mtharayi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dngasems can thams cad kyi 'khore ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa sgrib pa nyes pa lhung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gso tshol/ ces gsol ba btab la/ rdo rje sems pa'i yi ge brgya ba ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/phyag 'tshal 'du da cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'du da la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdorje sems par bdag sgrub mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang zhes pa nas/ byang zhing dag par byin gyisari —119—

brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de smi ji srid du sdig pa byang ba'i mtshan mthong gi bar du bsgom par bya la/ de nas ji skad du/ cho ga bzhin du rjesaganang byas pa yi/ /blo dang ldan pas rang sngags bsnyen pa bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/tshe tog pho go pa'i lha de nyid dang por bsgrub par bya ste/ der sems brtan pa dang / lha de nyid mnyes pe'i mtshan pa cung zad mthong bar bya'o/ /des dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas pa yang sgom nus par 'gyur bas/ da ni 'di'i rim pa bshad par bya ste/ 'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs gnyis gsog pa dang / 'gal rkyen 'gog pa bsrung 'khor sgom pa'o/ /dang po laganyis kyi dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjeragasal ba'i snying gar zla ba dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i maX yig dmar ser rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'jig rten gyi dbul ba sel bar byed pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs bdag ni rnamapa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā tha lha ka tsit+taX pra ṇi mya badz+ra pa nāX ka ro mi/ dpal ldan bde rdzogs zab gsal gnyis med 'od zer ldan/ /de yi rang bzhin zhi ba bcu drug phyed cha 'bar/ /don dam snyingapo de ston bla ma gsum po rab/ /de la bya byed gsum mnyam pa yi rtagatu'adud/ /ces bla ma dang / dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing / khres rosayan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rab mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir—120—

de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes yi dam la phyag bya/ oṃ ar+ghaX pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūX/ de bzhi du 'dir/ pu duX/ pu po dhu pe/ u lo ke / ga rnye/nai wi bye/sha lta/ rū pa/ ga rnye/ ra sa/ spar+sha dharma dh+wa tu badz+ra rnams sbyar ro/ / gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshad par bgyi /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyi dgob gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub tu yongasasubasngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrub/ / snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grolazhing / /sems pa dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad rogacig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnamasalas nges par grol gyur cig /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dngaldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs/dbangapo'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag lcung pag /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam parabargyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyid/ /bde sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /spyin sogs rnams bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dganyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad bde dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par—121—

gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /bdagagis sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i don du 'jam pa'i rdo rje thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan thams cad 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bgyi'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa gle /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni ngesapar grol/ /oṃ shā rgyu tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes brjod do/ stong pa'i ngangalas/ nam mkha'i khams su āXlas byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi dbusasu/ rang gi bar do'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āXdamar po/ huX sngon po rnams thabasashes chags sems kyi rang bzhin ho dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/gnyis pa la thun mong gi bsrung 'khor dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor ge nyes las/ dang po ni/ 'og tu aX las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ huX las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa'i lte bar nyi ma la huX nag po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas 'og tu 'phros pas/ 'og thams cad sra zhing brtan pa'i rdorje'i sa gzhi/ logs rnams su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du 'phrosapas gur dang bla bre/ de thams cad dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdorje'i me kha dog lnga pa rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/gnyis pa ni/ de'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du/ bhuX ser po yongs—122—

su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas bskor du mgyos para'akhor ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin gyi 'phreng ba phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtse mo'i steng dang /steng 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du huX re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ steng gi ser po/ gzhan rnams sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus dang shar sogs phyogs dang me sogs mtshams g.yas bskor dang / steng 'og rnamasasurim pas/ rdo rje dang / tho ba dang / dbyug pa dkar po dang/ pad+ma dang /rdorje khagyes pa dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / rtsegasum dang/ ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/dbus su hūX mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dngapo gnyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rjedangaral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyi nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje mtharabyed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug godang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khu/da pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis/ kyis tho ba dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar ste/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum: g.yas gnyis kyisardorjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang ral gri: nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmarapo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum: g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed —123—

nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje nag po khagyes pa dang / gzhan khruX mdzad bzhin/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdorje: shar lho le don pa'i rgyal po sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i: g.yas gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang : lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po sngon dkar dmar ba g.yas gnyis kyis dbyugapa sngon po dang : nub byang du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhalangugayas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang : steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po : ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum: g.yas gnyis kyis 'khore lo serapo dang : 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsu༅phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yasaganyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o//mi g.yo ba 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes hūX mdzad rnams sgeg pa'i nyams can mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs la rin po che'i cod pan dang /dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ khro bo gzhan thams cad sbom zhing thung ba misdug pa'i nyams can/ mche ba drag tu gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur ba/ smar dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul/gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / medapunga'abar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gshi/na rje mthar byed larnam snang / pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pa yab yum re res dbu brgyan pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dpral bar yo/ mgrin pa —124—

āX thugs kar huX/ snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs rdepa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur/ oṃ kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX nasashabha'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo bcu'i mtshan sngags sam/ rtsa sngags rgyud las 'gyung ba rnams kyangaspro na bzla bar bya'o/ /mdor bsdus su sgom na gong du 'bar bas bskor ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor long gyur zhes brjod de/ khro bo bcu 'khor lo dang bcas bzhag kyang rung ngo / /gal te phyir bzlogabyabar 'dod na/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / steng du hūX mdzad sgom pa ni khyad par te de dang / gzhan yang bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo bskor bo'i gnad/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i gnad de/ gnad lnga ldan du bya ba dang / gzhan dag rgyas parat+na zhi ṣa'i gdams ngag lugs gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /de'i bzlas pa ni/ tsho( āX gi ste ṣa tsakra/ brti/sarba lo ki ka lo kot+ta ra ni yan+t+ra mun+t+ra bi rtse ju ya/ pra yo gā dī ni/ mam spo te ye na ke na tsi zhi tā ni/ ka ri ha tā ni ha na sarba ni/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bin+ta bin+ta kaX pa kaX pa ha na ha na/ da had ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bi dhan+t+ra ya bi dhan+t+ra ya/ sha da sa ha sra/ bi tsu rje ya bi tsuṇi ya/ gi zhi ṣa tsakra brti bhuX bhuX bhuX hūX huX hūX/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po spyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog dang / las rgyal po mchog gsum las/ dang po la/ rten bskyed pa dang / brten pa bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/dbus kyi khro bo yongs su gyur pa las saX las rdo rje dkar po saX gis mtshan pa las/ kun bzang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug /dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'byud pa/ lhag ma gnyis rdo rje dang ralagri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'od can/ rdo rje skyil mo —125—

krung gis zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po tshes spras pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ nam mkha'i khams bde ba chen po rang bzhin chos 'byungagrugasum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rtsa ba phra ba/ thub du zuskapa/ gdeng kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i nang du paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ ltebar hūX nag po las/ sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i lte bar zla ba la/bhuX las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bhuX gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams bde ba chen pos mchod rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs te/ bhuX la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmaraba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'byud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po tshedangapad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'od can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de yongasasu gyur pa las/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang rin po tshe sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar seradamar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po tshe'i pha gudamar pos bskor ba'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i drwa ba drwa phyed/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyabs can gyis yongs su bskor ba la/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyas pa/ cig—126—

pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stangasadang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu grubazhi pa'i steng du/ bum pa la/gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis/ btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi'am snam bu bcu gcig gi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i ge ngor lo dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/ sgo dang sgog kyi phyi mtshams dang / grwa bzhis zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po la rdorjesamatshan pas brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du/ bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing dang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang / sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang / dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ rdorje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba labarten pa'i ka ba brgyan dang ldan pa ste/ shar du 'khor lo/ lho ru rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur buragyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che tog gis spras pa rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i khang bzang dam pa/ nang bltas phyi gsal zhing phyi bltas nang gsal ba'i nang gi steng 'og gi gzhi rnams/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i nang le tshe dgu dang/—127—

rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang / shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dang / sgo bzhi rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re/ nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogasagasum dang / sgo bzhi rnams su nyi ma'i gdan/ gzhan rnams su zla ba'i bdan rtsere ste/ ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs paragyur/spro na dag pa 'di yang brjod de/ mi mnyam pa dag med pas zur bzhikhomanyam/ /dran dang dbang po mchog gi sgo rnams yin/ /bsam gtan bzhipornams kyi rta babs te/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer gyis ni legs par bskor/ /kha khyerader legs brten pa'i mchod pa ni/ /dam pa 'dzin rnams gzungs kyi tshog༅rdeyin no/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /gang phyir 'gro ba'i bsam kun rdzogs byed pa'o/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang/ /sgrasgrog dril bus phyogs sgo kun khyab pa/ /gang phyir dam chos gsung rab yan lagadagu/ /gdul bya thams cad la ni bskyod pa'o/ /me long drwa ba drwa phyed tshe togo gi/phreng ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan mnyam med pa/ /me long ye shes dri med byang chub kyi/ /yan lag me tog dri ni phun sum tshogs/ /ka ba bzang po bgyod kyis nyeramadzes pa/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam par dag pa yin/ /rdo rje'i thig dang yangadag ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje theg chos 'khor lo rab bskor ba'o/ /bla kho mas yas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam par dag pa yin/ /mchod pa lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /chos dbyings rnam paradagapa'i rgyu mthun no/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar legs gnas pa'i/ /nyi zla mgon —128—

bcas lha yi gdan rnams ni/ /skyon gyis ma gos mi shes mun sel zhing/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa bskyed pa la/ bsnyen sgrub chung ngu dang / bar ma gnyis/dang po lka bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi zla ba'i bdan labarasnang gi yi ge las 'phros pa'i rang gi sgo gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum gzu gas brnyan ltar gsal bas/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs su 'tshang rgya ba'i phyiradu/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul bas de rnams kyis rang la byin gyis brlabs shing 'od du zhu nas 'og tu/ a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ le lī/ e i/ o.e// aX aXrnams g.yas bskor dang / slar yang a ā nas aX aX rnams g.yon bskor te/ mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyangs so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangasadakar po so gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza sa nya/ ṭaṭhaḍa bha ṇa/ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaX kar la wa ḍa dha rnamasagayas bskor dang / slar yang ka nas dha rnams g.yon bskor te/ dpe byad brgyad curangabazhin gsal byed brgyad cu yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil zha khroragasal byed dmar po brgyad cu'i mtshan pa de ltar zla ba gnyis ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba de gnyis dbyer med du 'dres nas gcig tu gyur pa ni nyon yid gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng du huX dmar po lasabyung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa nor bu pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i lte bar/ zla ba la—129—

gnas pa'i hūX yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan pa ni yid shes gnas gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /huX gi 'od zer gyi 'grob thams cad rnam par sbyangs shing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la bkod de/ slara'adus nas huX la thim pa ni dbang shes gnas gyur pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra at+pa ko3haX/ slar yang huX gi 'od zer gyis phyogasabacu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes par byas nas/rdo rje sems pa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams hūX la thim pa'i rkyen gyig zla ba rdo rje huX dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po kun gyi rdul phra rab las byung ba 'gro ba rnams kyi de kho na nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi yab tu gyur pa'i rdo rje sems pa kun tu bzang po dkar po lko pa nas/ zin po tshes spras pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de ltar sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs gnas gyur pa dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta thā a haX/ de dag ni rgyu rdorje 'dzin pa pha mdang 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /'dod chags wo pos gdulaba'i sems can rnams la/ gsang ba 'dus pa ston par dgongs te/ yab yumasnyom par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgra'i dbyangs kyis rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang nyid bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yum mnyes par gyur zhing / rang gi lus las spyan sogs yum bzhi dang / gzugs sogs lha mo lnga ste/ rig ma dgu phyir spro so te yum la thim pas/ yum bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab mnyes par khyung/—130—

slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas thams(cad rdo rje 'dzin pa lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid du spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal nasazhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdorje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pagathig le yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems pasagatso byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa dus gcig tu grub pa las 'phros pa'i 'od dang / rangagothugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad bkug nasaslob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug ste/ dkyiwa'akhor gyi nang du 'khod par gyur/ slar yang rang gri thugs ka'i 'od zer gyisaphyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sems pa sems ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ rjes su chags/pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig par gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas le'u/ te/sems can de rnams la dbang bskur bas phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas/ thig ler zhu ba mongs su gyur pa las/ k+ṣ-i dzi khaX gaX skaX saX dzaXtshwaXbaX hoX khaX raX laX maX paX taX bhuX aX dzo khaX huX rnams las byung ba'i sa snying dang/ phyag rdoradang / nam snying dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / sgrib sel dang / kun bzangadang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang / spyan ma dang / mā ma gī dang / gos dkar mo dang/ sgrol ma dang /rnam snang dang / rin 'byung dang / 'od dpag med dang / don sa dang/ mibaskyod pa ste/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mtshan dpe la—131—

sogs pa tshang la yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa rnams/ k+ṣi nas huX gi bas snang phug brjod/ pad+ma nas phyir spros pa nam mkhar 'khod nas bka' drin rjes su sprin pa'i tshul gyis bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha'o/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi ma'o/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi ston pa'o/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jug pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rnyog med rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /de dgani sbun zla lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /bdag nyid dri za'i tshul du gnas pas/ sangs rgyas yab yum 'dod chags chen po'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba mthong ba'i rkyen gyis/bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yutshagyi pad+ma ra babs pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i 'od kyis reg ma thag tu 'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'i thig ler gyur/ de'i 'od kyisayab yum gnyis kyang byang chub sems su zhu ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phro bar gyur te/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhiba'i 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa chos sku'i ngang du zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas sngon yun ring du goms pa'i rang gi byams sogs tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin lha mo bzhin gyur pa rnams mtshams bzhir 'khod nas/ snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ māmakis/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen —132—

mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don datsharjes su phan brtson pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchisabazhed na/ /'dod chag/sa dam tshig chag/sa pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan cing thugs brtseb/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po: /rab dka'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sgrowams/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzog༅sangs rgyas kyis gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskulabs sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i thig le de thig le gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'i maX yig dmar ser du gyur/ de las byung ba'i ral gri sngon po gser gyi yu bas bgyon pa 'od kyi drwa bas bskor ba'i yu ba la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du maX yig gis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad 'jamadapal gyi go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas rnams dang lhan cig 'jam pa'i rdorje'i rnam par spyan drangs te maX yig la thim/ ral gri zla ba maX dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsu5phyagadrug pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur kum gzhon nu lta bu/ btsotshagaser gyi lhun po la/ nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs 'bum phrag phog pa ltar gzi —133—

'od 'bar ba/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra ni la ltar sngo sangs/ g.yon zhal ston ke'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum ka'ang rab tu zhi ba'i spyan dkyus ring zhing yangasal bkra ba gnyis gnyis dang rab tu mdzes pa'i smin tshugs kyis brgyan pa/rin po che'i sor gdub gyis spras pa'i phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyas kyis ral grim da'/ g.yon gnyis kyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ mchog tu sgeg pa'i gzhon nu dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'phro zhing / mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga la/ dri zhim me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing / sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po tshe'i dbu o/snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ gdu bu/ sen mo do dang ska rags te/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong ut+pa la'i gdengs ka dang/dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lha'i darasna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing / srid zhi'i mtha' las brgal ba/ skug sdangathugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bu lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /oṃ dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ mig tu mig dbang k+ṣi las 'khor lo dkar po'i ltebar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣi gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad bde bas mnyes/ sa snying gi rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhawa—134—

gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'phyud pa/ lhagamagayas gnyis 'khore lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/de bzhin du sbyar te/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i: dzi nag po :rdorje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang dzi nag po/ phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag rdor nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum: g.yas sa nyis kyisardo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyi nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ snar khaX serar+ṣarin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa: nam mkha'i snying po ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal: g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lce la gaX dmar po: pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bgyod pa: 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i : g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ralagrigayon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ sgra mtshams kyi dpral ba'i nang du lus kyi dbang po'i ngo bo skaX ljang gu: ral gri sngo sangs 'od 'phro ba: sgrib seloljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal: g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khore lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte bar yid kyi dbang po'i ngo bo saX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa: kun bzang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum5g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/thams cad kyang rdorje skyil mo krung gis zla gdan la bzhugs shing / zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /de dag ni glo pa'o/ /gal te 'bring du mos na sa bon las de dag bskyed pa tsam gyis rung zhing / bsdun yid kyis 'bring ltar gsal btab nas/ ngag tu/ mig tu k+ṣ-i dkar po las sa snying / rna bar dzin ga po —135—

las phyag rdor/ snar khaX ser po las nam snying / lcer gaX dmar po las/'jigarten dbang phyug /dpral bar skaX ljang gu las sgrib sel/ nye bar saXsngon po las kun bzang / zhes pa tsam brjod kyang rung ngo / /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rang gi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i rangagi sems kyi ngo bo hūX nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i ltebar yang huX nag po/ de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams thugs rdo rje'i go 'thangal bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bde bas mnyes/ thugs rdo rje'i rnawapar spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje nag po sogs phyag rdor lta bu'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga'i lte bar zla ba la huX sngon po/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ mgrin pa'i nang du: ngag gi ro bo āX dmarapopad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa: gsung rdo rje dmar po sogs gog le rdo ga rten dbang phyug dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la āX dmar po/ spyi bor: rang gi lus kyi: oṃ dkar po/ zhe boralodakar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ sku rdo rje dkar po sogs gong sa snying lta ga thragasadakar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/thams cad kyang rdo rje'i skyil krung sogs gong ltar ro/ /de gsum gyi thugs ka yige 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros shing / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha momatha' yas pa sprul te/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad spyan drangs nam mkhang/bzhugs pa la/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaX—136—

nas shasta'i bar gyis bsrung 'khor skabs ltar mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'changab/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ga /rdorje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ga /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdorje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams thugs rdo rje rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+raswa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ chos kyi gsung laX dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed: /dengabadag: /rdo rje gsung gi: /phyogs bcur sogs gong ltar las/ rdo rje gsung gi4ces gsol ba btab pas gsung rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams gsung rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa bo ྅ haX/ dpal ldan rdorje'i sku 'cha ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed: /deng bdag: /rdo rje sku yi yo /phyogasabacur: /rdo rje sku yis /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams sku rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ gal te 'bring por mos na/ phyag mtshan sa bon las rdo rje gsum bskyed kyang rung lkabasdu na skad cig gis bskyed nas cho ga lhag ma bya dgos te/ gsol 'debs gsum dang thimatshuwabasnyen sgrub 'bring po ltar yang rung /bzhi pa sgrub pa r+sā po ni/ rang gi snying ga'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla ba laganas pa'i maX yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri yu ba'i nang du zla ba la maX gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ 'jam dpal gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas maX la thim/ ral gri zla ba tshaX 137—

pa'i shes ༵ ༷sa su gyur dro las/rang dang 'dra bsgi ye she dzo pa 'jam pa rda rja ra snga dkar ba 'a zhal gsum phyag drug /dang pa gnyas rngeng snangagi yum la 'khyud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/g.yon gnyisarde:sdo ra la rje'i / skye la bye ra blo mi de)rme pa rde0rnyi dang gzhu 'an sdo gyi/'a rja' la ma krung du nas pa'i pa' ma zag se kaXrdenge sa sems pa ral 'a rdzu bar zla ba la rgedza spe pamaX' ri 'dzi/rni na snyang gar rwang dang 'dra ba 'a ye ༷sa tsho sems sheXpang migs kar kau nge she mas pa rtse mun rtse maX she si zer paX//spyo bang rig gi nga dgas pa tsam gyas ga tshordego/thugs ka' maX las 'ad ra 'phras/snyen mu lha rgyal ba yab yum zhaXsparardedang 'di ge mu pa dzis rdad mu ge drangs bsnyenas/mdun gya dzo mkhar bzhugs/ar+gha nasashe bar gyas mgo/da bzhan rdorjes 1 pa rnams kyas bdug dhi dzi lngar sngas ba gsal//lko pa'am/byang chubarda mus cha rgyas la//'aXrdorje de ltar snas ba ces/she/bdag kyang rab kyā bsgral ba 'a phyar//muX mkha' rda rja semasang rga༈sdu///sa gsa~Xb btaX nas/gas 'a dbang 'ab// ba 'a dgangs pa mdzad/ mas da shi kyiX/ma rnams sa rdo rje' glu dang 4sa pa' bkra shas drigs cad brjod/khro bo khro mo rnamasabagegs skud/༷༷wo po 'a po che'i bum pa ye 'a dud rtsis gang ba thogs te/dbang bde ge mu ge ge ge ge ge sde mu/khams gsum kun sbyin par byas ༵༷//sangs/rgyas kun kyā da gsum tha shi//gaXzhe las sung zhi : na par bya//sarba ta thāg ta ༵ da ṣa //'a hū/shes 'a dring dbang bsdi//lus thamasardecad shas kya bsna ༵bor mi /she stun ci pa/sa snyi sheralud pa las/rang bar bskyad ༷sa dbu brgyan nga /sa sang las spu/sa

pa rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/spro na ye shes sems pa thugs rdo rje phyag rdor kun bzang rnams la mi bskyod pa sku rdo rje dang sa snying la rnam snang / nam mkha'i snying po la rin 'byung / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung rdo rje la 'od dpag med/sgrib pa rnam sel la don grub rnams kyis dbu bgyon/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de dag ni yan lag bzhi chung dza'i skor ro/ /gnyis pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi mdun na sa nas pa'i thigale yongs su gyur pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmaraser gur kum gzhon nu lta bu/ g.yas sngo zhing g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gtso bo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis/ ut+pa/la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil pre ta/gis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ltag par phyed bcing shing / phyed sil bur grolabs sku stod khyab pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar gzhon nu lang tsho lab ba cing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ gnyen lcug 'khril bag chags pa'i sku sgeg cing mchor+sha/ tu mdzesapa/ shin tu 'dzum pa'i zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa sgyu rtsal gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang cod pan can/ rin po che'i gyon bgyod kyis brgyan pa/ shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/oṃ dharma sogs gong bzhin brjod/gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas nas gong bzhin rgyas pa dga'adir ye shes kyi phyag tsho dbang du byas nas/ mig tu k+ṣi dang 'khor lo'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las sa snying dkar po zhes sogs sbyar te/ rna bar dzi dang rdo rje: snar khaX dang—139—

rin po che: lcer gaX dang pad+ma: dpral bar skaX dang ral gri: lte bar saX dang rdo rje zhes sogs sbyar ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsdus pa yang gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rgyas par na gong bzhin las/ lus ngag yid kyi ngo bo zhes pa rnams bor ba dang / rigs gsumagyigasol btab bor ba dang / sngags gsum mjug tu sbrel nas brjod pa ni khyad par te bsdus pa yang rigs 'dre'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub chen ni/ gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gnasasu/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhes pa dang / rang la mi bskyod pas zhes pho skabs sa yuma'ajam pa'i rdo rje ma la zhes 'don pa spo ba ni khyad par ro/ /'dir gzhung gi dngos bas ni dngos kyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de la mngon byang bzhi pas yan chad dmigs pa gcigacing lnga pa mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i bar du/ bdag nyid yab dang / rig ma yum gyi nga rgyal gnyes kas bya/ zhu ba na gnyis ka dmigs pa gcig cing / 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs nas sgrub chen rdzogasakyi bar ni/ sgrub pa pos dkyus ltar gyi dmigs pa dang / rig mas kyang rang nyid thig lo'i gzugs kyis nga rgyal gnas nas/ mdun du bskyed pa'i tshul gyi yab kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi sgom/bsnyen sgrub 'bring po dang chen po'i skor rnams ni yab yum dmigs pa 'dra'o/ /yid kyi rig ma labarten pa la/ yab yum sbrags te bsgoms nas/ 'bring po skor bzhi logs su mi sgom pa dag ni/yan lag bcu gnyis ma tshang ba'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /yum gyi spyi gtsug nas snying ga'i bar du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po rnam snang gi rang bzhin/ snying ga nas nye ba'i bar du huX nag po mi bskyod pa'irang bzhin/ lte ba nas gsang ba'i bar du swā ser po rin 'byung gi rang bzhin/gsang ba nas brla'i bar du āXdamar po 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin/ brla— 140—

nas byin pa'i bar du hā ljang gu don grub kyi rang bzhin rnams nyi ma la gnas pa/de rnams kyi 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang ba'i yum gyi sku de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūXlas byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ dkar po las skyes pa'i nor busamatshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ spyiXlas pad+ma dmarapo 'dab ma brgyad pa āXlas skyes pa'i ze 'khrus mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu gaphaṭa kyis bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba'i bde ba chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ ces nga rgyal bya ste/ dang po sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la yang / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi las/ dang gro bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i laX las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/phyogasabacu'i rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs te/ rjes chags/kyi mes byangachub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa'i thig le maX yig dmar ser gyis mtshan cing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sangs rgyasathams cad kyi ngo bo thig le de yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas pa yongs su grub pa'i dbus kyi gdan la/rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag —141—

drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'phyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gsakhro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhika thugs ka nas phyar phyung/ phyogasabacu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor palasogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ thugs rdorje dang chosadabyings ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te rang nyid la thim par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rangagi thugs kar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / phyogs bsnye'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangasargyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi po khyi mug sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ sku rdo rje dang me long lta bu'i ye shesalabakod/ slar 'dus te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi le tshe dgu'i shar du zla gnasala'akhod/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ lhor rin 'byung nam snying lta bu rin po che ljang guchadagu pa 'dzin pa/ rat+na dha ka khyad par du sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal sbyangagatshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ yon to rdo rje dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shesalabakod/ lhor nyi gdan la 'khod/ nub tu 'od dpag med 'jig rten dbang phyugalta bu pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'dzin pa/ u ro le ka /khyad par du les —142—

chags sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ gsung rdo rje dang so sor rtogapa'i ye shes la bkod/ nub tu nyi gdan la 'khod/ byang du don grub sgrib sewalta bu ral gri sngon po 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ pradz+nyā lha ka /khyad par du phrag dogasbyang / 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ 'phrin las rdo rje dang bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang du nyi gdan la gnas/ 'di man chad du chos kyi ge(rdor lo bsgorabal sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad ces pa'i mdzad pa spyi'i tshig 'di mi brjod do/ /gzhan thams cad sbyor lugs 'dra bar byas te/ rang 'od kyi yab la zhes sbyar nasashar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang lta bu/ mo ha ra tī/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med mngon du byas/ kyi thabs pharaphyin: shar lhor zla gdan la'o/ /lho nub tu mā ma ki sngon mo mi bskyod pa lta bu ut+pal la dmar po 'dzin pa/ dī ṣa ra tī/ chu'i khams/ byams pa tshad med pa/smon lam gyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan la/ nub byang du gos dkar mo'od dpag med lta bu la rā ga ra tī/ me khams/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ rkebs kyi phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan la/ byang shar du sgrol ma ser mo rin 'byungaltabu la rin po che'i gnas su ut+pal ser po/ badz+ra ra tī/ rlung ni khams/ btangasnyoms tshad med/ ye shes kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhi du/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khoralo'i gnas su me long dmar po/ oṃ āXhūX/ rang gi thugs ka nas phyir phyung/phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi —143—

gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs te/ spyin pa'i phar phyin la bkod nag slar 'dusate rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ lho nub tusgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su pi waX sngon po/ o.āXhuX/ sgra'i skye mched/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan/ nub byang du khri rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su dri'i dung chos ser po/ oṃ duXdri'i skye mched/ bzod pa'i phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan la/ byang shar durordo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su ro'i snod dmar po/oX āXspyiX ro'i skye mched/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan la/shar sgo'i g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang gu don grub lta bu la/ ral gri'i rganasasu gos kha dog sna snags pa/ oṃ āXhuX/ reg bya'i skye mched/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zla gdan la/ shar sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo rdo rje sems pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su chos kyi 'byung hāsadakar po/ oṃ āXskyoX chos kyi skye mched/ shes rab kyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yon du zla gdan la 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung sa bzhugs shing / dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan dang phyed bcings kyisamadzes la/ zhal re re la shin tu zhi ba'i spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan zhing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bde ba wo po'i longs spyod la lhag par rol ba nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubasapa'o/ /rnam snang dang lha mo thams cad zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ gshegs pa gzhan —144—
