gsum nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /de bzhin sngar bzhi du sbyar te/ shar sgor gon na rje gshed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje thob/ ya sh+ka krita/sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud thams cad sbyangs/ dad pa'i dbang po labakod/ slar 'dus te shar sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ lho sgor shes gra mtharabyed dkar po rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/pra rnyen+ta krita/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud thams cad sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi dbangapo la bkod/ lho sgor nyi gdan/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed 'od dpag med lta bu/pa snyin+ta krita/ 'chi bdag gi bdud sbyangs/ dran pa'i dbang po la bkod/ nub sgor nyi gdan la/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/rdo rje'i gnas su/ rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa 'dzin pa/ ru krita/ lha'i tshu'ibadud sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po la bkod/ slar 'dus te byang sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang sbom zhing thung la mi sdug pa'inyams can dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes shing / smin ma dang / smar dmaraser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum/dang ldan cing / mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ha he'i rgad rgyangs drag po sgrog cing / bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim tshe zhing gsusapa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing / stag go lpags/pa'i sham thabasacan/ sprul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' sdiyas sngon po'i dbu skra bcings shing / 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan cing / pad+ma dkar pos mgul rgyan byas—145—

pa/dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing /stobs rgyu ljang gus mchod phyirathogs byas pa/nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing/pad+ma 'a po dkar snro rkang gdub byas pa/'ge wo pha rol gnon pa/sku las skyes pa' ye mu ge kya me rab tu 'bar ba 'a dbus na/gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa' 'phrin las la mu char pas g.yon ris ji gis stabs kyis nas phyir pa'o//spyod kyi 'jig rtse rang ga thugs ge sde ge mu rus/ āXhuX/thugs nas—raphyung /snod — 'ag rten sbyangs/ye shes kya dkyal 'khor du gyur/slar 'dusanas gzhal yas khang la thim/rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes semasardepa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaXshar sgo'i thad kyi nam mkharabazhugs/oṃ ya mun+ta krita huX/oṃ pratswan+ta krita huX/oṃ pa dhan+ta krita guX.o bisnrun+ta tso r+shardekrita hūX/zhes bgegs bskrad/ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ ya murnya krita dzaX.oṃ pratswan+ta krita huX/oṃ pa dhan+ta krita paṃ/oṃ ru krita ho/zhes dgug gzhug changamanyes bya/gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/lha thams cad kyi mig tu zla ba la zhes pa nas/brgyan pa'o zhesapa'i bar gtso bo'i skabs ltar bya'o// 'a 'a 'gasum pa sgrub pa ni/lha thams cad kya nu ma gnyas kya zhes sogs sbya ge brgyalabazung ba gsum gyi bar yum gyi skabs bzhin no//yan lag de gnyis kyi 'bring dang bsdus pa'i chog yang snga ma rnams kyi rigs bsgre'o//bzhi pa sgrub pa wo po ni/rang gi thugs ka'i maX las 'od zer phyogs bcura'aphros pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/chu'i // ma yar lud pa las rnam snang sogs

bgegs snamathar byed rnams/mi bsang pas nam/she rim po/lti//༷ka ba brogashe(mthar byad rnams la dri shos pa/smra ma/she she/ye she lja da rnams la da snang /byo rja ma la non skyang /ngang re/she/dhodo zi/pad+ma mdzi 'a she swā 'ad ye/ swā/sgral ma dang rdi dā rdzumache//grub/chas/ 'a mal rda rja mas gi~X dbu 'a she/ ma dang sku gsung thugs kya lha rnams la rang rang gas kya bdag pas ji ni ji / ra)rden/ mu sa 'i nide /sa sgrub ༷ gya yan she /mchoX stod 'a rdzu ba 'a she /dang po /she 'a ziX las 'od zer 'phros rnyi/rang : go/cu' 'dad pa' snan to rnyi ༵po pa' ya ༷ thams rje sgyu rel cad bkug /rang lus swā thig ce ༵spe byangasaX ༷ mas su zhu rda rda 'a lam nas phyung /༷blar 'a she sag bu/'i'a~X/pa sbyiX/sdoXhuXbaXrnyaXkhaXjeXrnamasaXsu gyur/rang las yum bzhi darnga lha spra 'i lā she drangs te thim ༵'dzi gyur ༷/ thams cad kyis brgyan par ma zhe ni gzuX/sa dang lang re med / pa dpa yan to thams cad sa phyir spo lo te gyur ta/lte mu sgo rtse ge mu dkyi/ tu she dā dang bcas pa maX' nang nas tsho gos khi ni/sgyu ma lta bu' tshul gya da~X zhabar gya lha rnams la mchad par gyur/༷gos lamiskabs lta/ mar pa byas la/ lted ta sdo ga dzhai pū dza badz+ra su she rje sna/ ka3haXshe/dkyil rda she shes che//rda rje 'ge mkhas pa che//kyi gsu5mchag/dal zhabar gsum//gsang ba 'a dbyangs la phyag mu ge ye ge//spror pa thi : /mdzad dag pa che//rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che//rang bzhan 'od gas5'gro/4

mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ rdorjemakha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'o dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ / rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ro bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tir badz+rasu bhā wa ut+pa ko ྅ haX/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mtheb srin g.yon pasa'abul te/ thog mar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas smos shing 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na bla marigs bdag gi ngo bor mos dgos pa'i phyir/ lha rnams nyid kyi mtshan sngags kyis phul ba des chog pas/ logs su ma byung kyang rung tsam mo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la ni/ 'og nas 'byung bo'i sngags re re'i mthar yi ge 'grugasum btags pas rung rdzo / /gsum pa las rgyal po mchog ni/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul du shes par bya nye de la/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nang gi ye shesasems dpa'i thugs ka'i ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maX yig dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdorje'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ de la thim pa'i rkyen gyis maX yig 'od du zhu nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rangabazhin du gyur pa'i thig le phra mo 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba dwangs shing gsal ba yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam shin tu 'tsher ba la sems bzung zhing / sems 'phro bar rtsom pa na thig le de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ral gri dang/ de las ye —148—

shes sems dpa'/ de las rang nyid/ de las dkyil 'khor de las snod bcud kyi bar rim gyis kun tu snang bar byas nas slar yang de bzhin du rim gyisabasdus te thig le la thim pa'i thig le las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'bab par yun ring du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas thig le la sems brtan pa na/ thig le'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la dkyil 'khor thig le dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rang gi ba sbu'i sgo thams cad nas 'phros te phyi nang thams cad snang bas khyab par bsgoms pas bying ba mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ /gnyis pa phra mo'i rnal wor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyisanam mkha'i khams gang ba'i rigs lnga la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri nas 'bru tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su/ tsa na ka'i 'bru tsam gyi thigaleye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer shin tu gsal ba'i nang du/ lha bcu dgu zhi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste/ de la yun ring du sems bzung bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur la/ mtshan ma de 'dra ma mthong gi bar du mi spro zhing / mthong nas dkyiwa'akhor du ma yang dang yang du spros te/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas slar yang bsdub spro bsdu la bslab par bya'o/ /bsgoms pas skye na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sku gsungathugs rdo rje ye shes sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar/ rlung dang chu dang medang—149—

sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar maX gyi mthar bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ rdo rje bzhi'i thugs ka'i o.u loXhūṃ rnams las/ rlung 'gro 'ong dang lhan cig rdo rje gsum rim pas sam cig caraspros/ nam mkha' gang ba la lha mo rnams kyas 'byud pa sogs mchod pasamanyes shing / 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas maX gyis 'od zer gyis bsdus te yiga'abru rnams la thim par bsam la/ oṃ āXmaX hūX zhes gtso bor bzlas shig gzhan yang oṃ āXmañju badz+ra slaX huX/ oṃ āXbadz+ra dhika huX huX/ oṃ āXdzin lja ka hūXpaX tshe gis rat+na dha ka aX huX/ oṃ āX.a ro kla ka khyeXhuX/ oṃ āXprarnyo lha ka khaX hūX/ oṃ gi ge6ha ra tri laXhuX/ oṃ āXdre ṣa ra tī maX skyoX/ oṃ āXrā ga ra tī paX smyaX oṃ u yaX dzod ra ti taX huX/ oṃ.āXrū pa badz+ra dzāXsmyaX oṃ āXtshan sta badz+ra huX huX/ oṃ āXgan+ta badz+ra baX guX oṃ urasabadzā ho huX/ oṃ āXspar+sha badz+ra khaX hūX/ oṃ āXdharma bhā tu badzā raX guX o.āXya murnya krita huX hūX/ oṃ āXpratswan+ta krita hūX hūX/ oṃ āXpa dhan+ta krita hūX hūX/ oṃ āXspre / /rnya krita hūXskyoXces bzlas pa bya'o/ /gal te sgom bzlas kyis dub na/ lha mo bzhis glus bskul bar bsam nas/dkyilas bor lam rdzo bstod bya'o/ /gal te lus stobs nyams par gyur na/ spyi bo nas mtho gang tsam gyisa'aphags par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i 'og phyogs kyi dbus su oṃdakar po las ye shes bdud rtsi lnga babs te/ spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang brlan dang drod 'a kyas khyab par bsams na/ mi rgas pa dang / lus rgyas ⑫gyurabasogs shad do/ / dkyil 'khor bsdu bar 'dod na sku'i rags rnams sku rdo rje dang / gsung gi rkesna—150 rke

rigs rnams gsung rdo rje dang / thugs kyi rigs rnams thugs rdo rje la thimapa'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur pas/ rdorje gsurashin tu brtan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ thun mtshams spyod lam thams cad du snangab thams cad/ rdo rje gsum gyis ngo bor mos pa dang / rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos snod g.yi thams cad snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o/ /kha zas gtor ma ltar gyis gyis brlabs/ snying gar zla ba la maX yig lha thams cad kyi wobor gyur pa mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' zhing / phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gis phung khams 'od gsal du sreg pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa dang / gzhan don byed pa rnams rgyal ba la mchod pa dang / lus phyag rgya dang / ngag sngags dang / bya ba thams cad thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pas dge bar bsgyurabar bya'o/ /dam chig nyams na/ rang dam tshig rdo rje don yod grub par bsgoms te/ snying gar zla ba la sna tsho gis rdo rje khaX ljang gus mtshan pa sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/skye( āX9༷gahūX zhes bzlas shing / dbang rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba blangs pas dag par 'gyurardokhrus la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang dkyil 'khore gyi gtso bor skad cig gis gsal btab nas/ thugs kyi lam gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyisadabang bskur zhing bkrus par bsam par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe mchod bstod byas nas dkyila'akhor snying ga'i maX la thim/ der stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i don lamanyam par bzhag ste gnyid par bya'o/ /ldang ba'i tshe/ tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin lha mo bzhis bskul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgetso boralangs par bsam/ gal te bar chad kyi mtshan ma mthong na/ khro bo 'dud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rnal 'byoragyis dbang bskur ba blangs te bgegs gzhom par bya'o/ /gal te lha tshogs la mchod par 'dod na/— 151 —

maṇ+ḍal byas te yi ge 'bru gsum gyi sngags kyis tshom bu bkod la/ lha so so'i rang sngags kyis dawatshig pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ skye mched de dang sgo gsukhobyin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ lha rerebazhin du lha sngags kyis mthar rdzas sngags sbyar bas/ chu gsum nyer spyod rnams re re zhing so soraphul la/ rol mo/ 'dod yon drug /rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad spyi mthun du phul/ nang mchod kyang so sor phul la/ bstod pa dang gtor ma dang rdo rje'i glu gab la sogs pas mchod de/ yan lag bdun pa byas la/ smon lam dang gsol ba yang dang yang du thadagadangos grub blangs la bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs te bkra shis kyi dzigs su bcad pabarjod par bya'o/ /thun mtshams thams cad dam thun tha ma la nges par gtor ma 'bul bar bya dgos pas dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar dang nub kyi g.yas su re re ste ba lci'i maṇ+ḍal bcu gcig /dbus mar me tog gi tshom bu bcu dgu shar dang byang du nyis sgrig /shar gyi g.yas su su༅sgrig /nub kyi g.yas su nyis sgrig rnams bkod/ g.yin rnams su re re/ de dag re re zhing gtor ma dang mchod pa rgyas pa 'grub na bya/ ma grub kyang / zas bzang dgu sha dang myos byed kyis brgyanagabadud rtsi lngas bgyon pa'i gtor ma gnyis mchod pa dang bcas pa mdun du bshams la/ oṃ.āXspre krita huX/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rma gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibasacan rgyal mtshan dang yaX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khoradamar po gru gsum pa raX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyis steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dpral ba rangal— 152—

bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi shar du/ bhāX las dri chen bhāX gyis mtshan pa/lhor aX las rak+ta aX gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dzi les byang sem se dzi gis mtshan pa/ byang du khaX las sha chen khaX gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūX las dri chu skyoXgomatshan pa/ thun mong gi steng du oX yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i maX gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te/ rangarang gi sa bon la thim zhing / rlung g.yos te me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhingakhol/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing kha dog dmar ser nyi ma 'char kha'i mdogacan gsal zhing dwangs par gyur/ de'i slangs pa gyen du 'phyur ba las byung ba'i huX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba gsum yang bar snang de nyid du zhu ba thod par lhung bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i ro dang bcud kyis brgyan par byas/ oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'phen rten na gnas pa'i snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas bstims pas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āXskyoX lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgyatsheb rnams kyi nang du/ aX paX aX pūX dhuX aX gaX no shaX dzaXhuX baX hoXkhaX rnams te mchod rdzas so so'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa rnams dang sa bon rnams so sor zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ tshe tog /'dug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung/byed las rang bzhin gyis dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par —153—

byed pas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/oṃ ar+ghaX āXhūX de dza 4 ni du 2 ༷5/u lcamakhanaX/puspe/dhū pe/ā lo keg rnye/nai wi bye/shasta/hwa pa/pa rna/gan+ta/rāgaspar+sha/dharma dh+wa tu āXhuX/badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaX/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phrok+ṇidakyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaXpad+ma ka ma la ya stuX/zhes gdan phul te bzhugs par bsam/mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi sa par naX snas byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi bu gu gtor ma ma ma shwarnyi ku gyur/rgyas par na āXbadz+ra lha ka sarba ྅spyin/ sa ma ya rlu ༷du pra bhañja ka mam shā kugī rak+ṣa tsa ku ru swāhā hūX/spyo sam/gas 'dra ba la/shan+ta ku ru sruhwa rak+ṣaXku ru phoXmu ku ru oX/wa shaXku ru ho/mur yahuX spre tshogi sde sde ba ge rwa tsa ṭa ya hūXphaṭa/a kar+ṣa ya hruXdza/spyo sh+ka bdun gyis mi bskyod pa dang /badz+ra dha ka gi mtshams su lha rnams kyi mtshan sosor bcug ste lan gsum gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bya'o//badz+ra lha ka gi gnas su/mañju badz+ra go ༅ pa ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje la'o//'gring du na/gonga~Xkhe skos ḍā ba'i sngags spru mthar/sarba sdo ྅ 'di sogs sbyar ba lan 'dun dbul/bsdu na āXguXmaX/bhuX/aX/ —/khaX/laXmaX paX taX dzaXhūṃ baX hoXkha raXspyiXhuX spyiXhūX/pañca༅tsan+t+ra ta hūXspyo pa gsum mam lnga'am 'dun gyis phul/gal te khro bo so so la brten nas las 'tshol ba yin na/khro bo so so'i phreng sngags kyis sgos su sh+ka mang du 'bul snya las la po skul ba yin no//mthaldetshogs wo gi skabs bzhi mchod pa phul la/de wo lnga pas bstod nas/rdo rje gsus/de ngos/mi phyed sku//ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che//'dus pa'i dkyil zha bor lha tshogs rnams//mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//spyo sogs 'phrin wo ga sto/'jig rten pa'i lha rdzos rnams la spri 5 4 ma 'bul bar 'dod na/rang gi snying ga

nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad a kar+ṣa ya dzaX zhes bkug ste gong ltar gdan phul la/ phyogs rnams su 'khode pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po rdo rje 'dzin pa mig stong dang ldan pa glang po tshelabazhon cing / bde sogs ma la 'byud pa/ de'i g.yon du khyab 'jun nag po mkha' lding la bzhon pa/ phyag bzhis ga ḍa'i dbyug pa 'khor lo dung nor bu rnams 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la bzhon pa/ phyag bzhiskyabs spyin phreng ba dbyug gu gsum pa tsho dhi rnams 'dzin pa/ lhor gzhin rje nag po ma he'i steng na brkyang bskum du gnas pa/ dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po sbom thung khro bo'i lus can mi ro la bzhon pa/ ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po sbrul snel bzhan pa/sbrul zhags 'dzin pa sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang gu ri dwags dgo ba ser po labazhon pa/ rlung ras nam mkha' la brkyangs shing 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod spyin ser po mi la bzhon pa/ bi dzā pu ra dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yas su loga'adren dkar po glang po'i gdong can byi ba la bzhon pa/ phyag bzhi ska/ la phugaphreng ba la du dbyug pa rnams 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang phyug dkar po glangalabazhon pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rtsegasum dngaḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ dbang po dang dbang phyug gi bar du nyi ma dmar po rta sa skyen gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la bzhon pa/ pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ khi g.yon du zla ba dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa/ de—155—

gnyis kyi dbus su tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la bzhon pa bram ze mi'u thung gi rnam pa can gdong bzhi pa/ dbyug gu dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ chu lha dang bden bral gyi bar du/ thags bzang rigs nag po shing rta la gnas pa ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser mo sna tshogs pad+ma la gas pa/ bum pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'od kyis mun pa sel bar byed pa rigs mthun gyi 'khor dpag tu med pa bskor ba'o/ /mchod yon dang nyer spyod kyis ma rdzo la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu bcu/ stod rang rang gi phyogs kyi srung 'khor gyi khro bo'i dbyibasasuganas pa/ nye ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bu shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa spros nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo spros te/ g.yon pas phur bu'i mgul ba nas bzung / g.yas pa rdo rje tho bas spyi bo nas brdung zhing sngagasa'i de brjod par bya ste/ oṃ āXya mun+ta krita sarba duXni in+d+ra sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī la ya spruXphaṭa/ oṃ āXpradz+nyā ta krita/ sarba du giX ya ma sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī la ya skyoX phaṭa/ oX.āXpa dhan+ta krita/ sarba du niX nā ga sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sgyu/dha krita sarba du niX ku be ra ga ṇa pa dhi sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī la ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ zhwaṭaX rkirādzā sarba du niX āsne sa pa ri wā rā ṇa ki la ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ u shīX la daṇ+ḍa sa bo duXni ni ri ti sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī la ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXmahā bā la sarba duXni wa yu sa ya riwā rā ṇa gī la ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ āX.a tsa la sarba du niX yī shwa ra sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī laya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXtsakra brte sarba du niX arka tsan+t+ra pra ti mahā na sa pa ri wā ra ṇa gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXr rā dzā sarba du niX be+e ma tsi tri pri shrī de wi sa pa ri wā rā ṇa gī la —156—

ya huX phaṭa/ de ltar phur bus btab pas/ ma dag pa'i lus sems 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings su bcom zhing brlag par byas nas/ rnam par shes pa mar me ltabu thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis drangs te zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas/ lha mo'i mtsho skyes su babs pa thig le'i ngo bor gnas par gyur/ oX āX oX spyi he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya lha khriX sarba dugaX sam ya mu du wan/ tsakra e lgaX ā ṣa do lgaX ā pa na ya skyoX phaṭa/ ces he ru ka'i sngags kyis de rnams kyi shes sgribadang gnod sems bsal/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phreng sngags kyi dzi bi nān+ta ka rā ya zhes pa lasamajug tu/ sa rbe khu ā sha do khyiX ā pa na ya huX phaṭa ces btags pa bzlas pas nyon6stso/ pa'i sgriXb pa sbyangs/ thig lo de nyid cha bco lngar gyur te/ badz+raX/ guX re/ kaX/ māX gaX yaX/bhaX/ sho// maX/ aX/ be+e/ maX maX laX zhes pa rnams su gyur/ de dag kyang rim pas/rdo rje 'khor lo ghu khyu dang / /dbyug pa gri dang sbrul zhags dang / /rlung ras shingathog pad+ma dang / /rtsegasum pad+ma ut+pal dang / /pad+ma ma ral gri pad+ma rnams/ /rangarang sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ /'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams su gyur/ /dbang po klu dang rlung lha dang / /dbang ldan zla ba tshas/pa dang / /sa lha mo rnams zla bar gnas/ /nye dbang me dang gshin rje dang/ /srin po gnod sbyin tshogs bdag dang / /nyi ma dang ni thags bzang ris 'i de dag nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /de yang shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yasaganyis na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ sho) g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i —157—

zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na 'khordo ra lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang pad+ma/ shar lhor rdo rje me dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan ngo/dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na bgrang phreng dang mi 'jigs pa ster ba/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang ghurnye/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ nagadakar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dngaralagri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ lho nub tu rdo rje gtun shing nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang khrag gisardegang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar po 'od dpag med kyi ca pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na sbrus zhags dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ nub byang du rdorje rludaljang gu don grub kyi cod pan can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drugagi /g.yas gnyis na gos dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang zin po che/byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ ser nagadakar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na bi dza pu ra dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang ne'u le thogs pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs na rdo rje sna ringadakar po 'od dpag med kyi cod can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyagadrug gi g.yas gnyis na la phug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dngapad+ma'i chang gis bkang ba'i kha phor/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bodakar po 'od dpag—158—

med kyi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yasaganyis na rtse gsum dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ dbangapo'i g.yas kyi maṇ+ḍal du rdo rje 'khyil ba dmar po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang rin wo/ de'i g.yon du rdo rje 'od dkar po rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyas na ut+pal dkar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ dbus su rdo rje mismra ser po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyagadrug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lodang rin chen/ nub dang bden bral gya bar du rdo rje thags bzang ris sngon po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gog yasaganyis na ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yone gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi rigamal 'phyud pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan thams cad kyis bgyon pa/ lha'i gos dang phreng ba dang / byug pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed pa'i sku can no/ /bsdu na/ rang rang gi phyogs kyi ming dang rang rang gi ming dang kha togatsamo—159spre

brjod nas 'di dag thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na zhes sogs tsam zhig brjod kyang rung ngo / /de nas rdo rje ma drug dang / nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha smo du phye tshegator ma 'bul ba las/ kho bo cag gi bla ma dag gi man ngag ni 'di yin te/ oṃ ulaX rdzu yud dha sarba du : ༷ sa ma ya nas hiXdzaX zhes dbang po la 'bul ba dang / yang na mtshan mthar a kā ro'i sngags btags nas phul kyang rung bar bshad pa bzhin dang / badz+ra yu lho/'i gnas su ma ya badz+ra dang / badz+ra a na la dang / badz+ra kā la dang / badz+ra mu sa la dab nā ka badz+ra dbābadz+ra a nī la dang / badz+ra shoṇ+ḍa dang / badz+ra bhe ra ba dang / badz+ra kro dha dang / badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li dang / badz+ra pra bha dang / mo ha badz+ra dang / be ma tsi tri dang / pri shrī deb ta shes / rnamasabacug nas so sor lan gsum sogs phul/ de nas oṃ āX dus gsum skyes pa kun/ dngaphyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyi/ khren tu phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyila'akhordo ra ni/ /phan tshun gcig gi nang du gcig son pa/ /snyoms par 'jug/parakun tu gnas pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi yongs su mthar thug pa'i/ /dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bstoyi/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong / /kun dang sems can kun kyang 'di ltaste/ /rdo rje mardzo cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang / /rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni/ /rdorje twan shing rdo rje klu dag dang / /rdo rje rma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang/ /rdorje snaring rdo rje khro bo dang / /rdo rje lol ba rdo rje 'od dang ni/ /mi smra rdo rje dang ni —160—

thags bzang ri 1 sa me//ri dri dang lha rngams 'a spyas pa la//me ldan / nyebangashe pa nga ni she// /nga she ༷༅/sa la 'di yang sdeg she// b.rabadag gi dbyig gser 'a//sa nga cen / /zhes shang nye bar langs spyad nag/bdag ra rdzo gser nor ༵/hri lang tshe/she/nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams//'phrag par byed rdo dong mi myo da 1 nga stu / ce lag 'dren kun//ye dngar tusdang bcing lha bang za dang //jigs ma she rnams rmongs pa~Xmadzad//zengasadang ra lang mu na tshe rnam par 'gas par mdzad//bdag la dag she nora'abru lang tshe//na/ ༵/ pa dang bde snyi spra dam pa dang //bde ba chen pa rab tu'aphela~Xrnams// da byang chub nga 'di da 1 nga ni thug par//khang b.rashe nga rtag tu snrongs grogs dang //ring ri she bar sna ni rdorje 'dzin/3/༷she kau ba tu phul la//la mo sbyar te/sa she ldan dag gos khyo 'an pa' la zhi/skyan can kun zhi phyag ni bsha/ga pa pa//she gtan phul bdag la ba dang //dus 'a nas bsrung ba mdzad du ba༈ru55rde//dkyirdogasol ba 'debs pa bskyar ba lan gsum maX bdun la sogs pa bya/de nas de thams cad legs so go gsung bas dgyes rdo dang /dngos sbyib ci 'dod pa 'a bar zhal gyis ༷lko ⑫bsam/der ༷di bstod bsdus pa ga spro na bya/ da na 'phrin bdag sherdem lus pa stsal ba 'ji /no zu/kha cad sdib pa'i she las mdzad du ༷sa pa/yi ge brgya pa mang du bya/'ag rte~X 'a na nga bzhi/gyi mgran rnams kun//phyagasardeskyong sems can kun dang lha lha//rang ba sa grub sbyor bas sbyangs/pa rnams//bdag ni brtson dang mi ldan bkren r+pā te//mchod gzhan tsi yang6

bdag la ma mchis na//gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon po khyed rnams kyis//thugs dang mi 'gal rang gi mthus bzhes shig/bdag ni rnam g.yengs rmugs/dang le lo yis//sems ma 'dul dang mi gsal ba bsgrubs pag/mgon po khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba dang //rang bzhin dag gi chos gzigs bzod pa mdzod//oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad//rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol//sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang //slar yang lon paramadzad du gsol//oṃ a kwa ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX a bya nu can tā ta/badz+rachuzhes gshegs su gsol/smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyang bya'o//de ltar bzlas pa dang /bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang /ting nge 'dzen gyi bcud len dang /dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang /zas kyi sto 'byor dang /bya ba'i rnal 'byor dang /dam tshig gso ba dang /khyus kyi rnal wor dag lta pho rnal 'byor/ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang /bar chad zlog pa dang /mchod pa dag hor ma ste/༅bzhi po de dag ni rjes spyod yan lag dang bcas pa'o/kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa'i min ga galardete rang gas gyi don du gtor wo bya bar 'dod na/maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang gtor chog sbrags poyin te/gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/bsrung 'khor rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/thun mong gi bsrung 'khor gyi dbus ga sgruX las gzhalayas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/lha bskyed cing mchod gtod 'bul ba gong dang 'dra ba las/lha mo bzhi dang khro bo bcu la phreng sngags kyis 'bul ba yin te/oṃ ru ru sbu ru dzā la ba/sirnyi lo tsā ni/sarba a the swā dha ya swā hā/zhes spyan ma dang /o shang ka ge shwarnyikare ghuṣ+ṭa gu zla snga ni tsho ni ghā ta ya ghā ta ya ni ghu ni swāhā/zhes tso5ki dga.oṃ6

ka gle bi kaṅge ni kaṅge ka ṭaX ka ṭi swāhā/ gos dkar mo dang / oṃ tā re snyostu re tu re swāsmasgrol ma dang / na maXs man+ta kā ya wa kyi t+ta badzā ṇaX/ oṃ kha kha 'a hi khyahi sarba du ni satwa da ma ka /a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pā sha ha ste tsa tu : dza tsa tu rmu kha khas tsar ṇa ā ga smo sarba du ni pru ṇa a pa hā ri ṇi/ mahā bi ghā ghā ta ka /bi kri tā naX na ri ta/bha yaX ka ra aṣ+ṭa ṭa hā sa nā nai ne/ bya gh+ra tsa mi ba sa na/ ku ru ku rus ma ka| ṇi/tshin+da tshin+da sarba man+t+raX bhin+da bhin+da pa ra mu drwaX/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ sarba bhā tā na/ ma tha ma tha ni rma tha ni rma tha sarba dusaX/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ maṇ+ḍal la rmedheX bai ba swa ta/ rdi bi twarnya ka ra/ ma ma sarba kar+shaX ku ru ku ru da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi laX ba/ mā bi laX ba/ sa ma ya ma nu rma ra huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi spro ṭa ya sarba nā sha ya/ ka ra ka ra bighā na/ sarba ā sha pa ri pū ra ka hai he bha bān/ ki khyin ya sim ma sarba arbu na swā dha ya swāhā/ zhes dzin na rje gshed dang / na maXs man+ta kā ya bā kyi t+ta badzā ṇaX oṃ huX dzi na ri shis huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes shes rab mthar byed dbun maXs man+ta kā ya bā kyi t+ta badzā ṇaX/ oṃ hūX hūX hūX ta ru la bi ru la sarba bi ṣa grwa ta ya dzā li ta/ bi slu liṅga/ aṣ+ṭa khye hā sa ke sa ri sa ṭa ā ṭo pa/ badz+ra khur na rgyu ta na tsa li ra ba su dh+wa ta la ni shwa sa/ ma ru to ta khyo ba ta dh+wa ra ṇi dha ra/ snri ṣa ṇa/aṭa sga hā sa a pa ri mi ta ba la/ pā rā kra ma/ urla ga na sgyi ta ta ga ṇa dha ṣi ta/bu dh+ya bu khyu hā ya shrī ba/ ji da ji da/ pā ra man+t+ra na/ tshin+da tshisdo ma medi sha /a be sha ya ā be sha ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pi shā tswan/ sarba gra he ju a prati ha to bha ba badz+ra daXgi ki nyi rā ya si/ i daX du ni gra haX du ni sarbaX bā/ dhu na dhu na/ mthamathamadom rdi pā ṭa ya ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ban+ta ban+ta/ brnya dharma sa ṅgha a nu dz+nyā taX karma ku ru ha ya gyi—163—

bā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra phaṭa/ badz+ra ga tra ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ne t+yā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra deX zhu ya phaṭa/badz+ra khu rā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu ra rke ta nā ya phaṭa/ tre lo kya bha yaX ka rwa ya phaṭa/sarba karme khu a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ku la san+t+ra sa nā ya phaṭa/ spyiXspyiXspyiXphaṭaphaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ wo pad+ma mthar byed dang / na maX sa man+ta kā yo bā krit+ta badz+ra 'oX/ na momahā badz+ra kro dh+wa ya/ mahā daXsne༈ ṭa ste na bā ya/ a si mu sa la par+sha pa sha hasta ya/oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali kha kha ji hi ji hi tiṣ+ṭha ban+ta ban+ta ha na ha na da ha da ha/ gaphywag rdza bi sbo ṭa ya bi spro ṭa ya/ sarba bi ghā bi nā ya kan mahā ga ṇa pa dhi dzī bi twan+ta karā ya swāhā/ zhes 'dud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / na maXs man+ta kā ya bā skyut+ta badzā ṇaX/ a tsa la kā na/ tsaṇ+ḍa nas na sna mas ni mas/ mos mos/ ta sna tag/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/mo ha mo ha mo ha ka ra/ sa ha sa ha/ badz+ra ha saX ku sa ha sa ha sa mdor gamador ṭa/ ga rdza ga rdza/ ha na han ban+ta ba dha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ u bi sha /mahā man+t+ra pā ma ka /dhu na dhu na ti ṇi ti ṇi ji da ji da bi ka mā ra ya mā ra ya duXrnge ri bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba na/ kuru ku sa ki ri ki ri/ mahā bi ṣa badz+ra sbo ṭā ya sbo ṭā ya/ skyoXhūX hūṃ tri bā li/ ta narmon rta ka /loX aX aX/ hāX hāX hāX/ a tsa la tse ṭa/ spro ṭa ya spos ya hūX guX los ma zhi ka /ston mahā bā la shā ta ya/ pa ra mar+sāX/ aX aX haX haX māX/ shu dha shu ju tu lo kastu khu5 tu ba dzī/ na ma stu/ a pra ti ha ta bā le bhāX/ dzā la ya tru ṭā/ los ha na maXswāhā/ zhes mi g.yo ba dang / na maXs man+ta kā ya bā krit+ta badzā ṇaX/ ṭak+ki spyiX dzaX zhe༅'dod rgyal dang / na ma sma man+ta kā ya bā kyi t+ta badzā ṇaX/ oṃ e hre lke rtog tshwa rnyel badz+radaṇ+ḍa/ tu ru tu ru hu lu hu lu/ hā hā/ gu lu gu lu/ gu lā pa ya gu lā pa ya/ kra ma kra ma bhā ga wān/ bā yu be ge na/ bhū tan/ shī r+ghaṃ/ da ha da ha/ ra da ra ba ha ba ha/ pa —164—

tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ pā ta ya pā ta ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ mo ṭu pa ya mo ṭā pa ya/ sarba karmā ṇi tshin+da tshin+da bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ta ya me rda a pya/ me daX madz+dza ru dhi ra pri ya e hre he/bha ga wan/ sarba bi ghā ni/ sarba mū la karmā ṇi/ kri ti ma biṣ+ṭha di ni/ sarba gra hwasmoha na ha na/ bhañja bhalga mde marda i dam me ka rlaX swā dh+wa ya/ huX nī la ya/ nī la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ya tu ru tu ru bi snar+bhe nā ya kaX /nā sha ya nā sha ya/ hu ru hu ru di gtsaṇ+ḍa ya/sarba sha snon ṇaX/ lha da yā ni/ bī ḍa ya tshin+da tshin+da/ pa ra bi du ni tshe da ka skyoX/ bi phywa nāX shi gi ka sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ badz+ra dh+wa ra ba tsa na/ ma rma ṇi ni grin+ta spruX ha na ha na da ha da ha/ ku ru ku ru tu ru tu ru hu ru hu ru phaṭa huX skyoX/ kri tan+t+ra ya/ de ba ṛ khri bi drwa pa kā ya/ ha na ha na/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍi na swāhā/ zhes dbyig sngon can dag na mas man+ta kā ya bā krit+ta badzā ṇaX/ oṃ huX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ u gra shā la pā ni huX skyoX skyoX phaṭaphaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ phyo ti ni rna da huX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bā la swāhā/ zhes stobs po che dang / gong du brjod pa'i phyir zlog gi sngags kyis gtsug tor bsgyur ba dang / oṃ sum+bha ni ke huX/ gro sna gro sna huX/ gro sna pā ya gro sna pā ya skyoX/ ā na ya ho bha ga lhan bi bya rādzahuX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas gnod mdzes la gtor ma 'bul te/ yang thog mar dkyil 'khorabaskyed pa'i rjes su/ phyogs skyong rnams kyang bskyed nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe dkyil 'khorapadang 'jig rten pa'i sngags sbrel nas phul kyang rung ste/ mjug tu mchod bstod dang rdo rje'i glu co ba la sogs pa byas nas/ sa phyogs gtsang sar rol mo'i sgra chen po dang bcas nas bskyal bas/so so'i las thogs pa med par 'grub pa yin no/ /lha mo bzhi'i las tshogs rnams dang/ gshin rjegashed kyis bu mo dgug pa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bskrad pa dang / rta mgrin gyis dun zhibadang / gzhan gyi mi thub pas srin po la sogs pa'i gdon gyis 'dzin par byed pa dang / becon sngon —165—

pos gsod pa dang / stobs po tshes char 'bebs pa dang / ṭa ni sa dbang du byed pa dag migayo bas lha mo sogs dgug pa dang / sa 'og gis lha min mo dang klu mo sogs dgug pa dang/ gtsug tor gyis phyir zlog rnams la las tshogs gzhus las 'byung ba bzhin dang / gtor ma 'bul ba'i dbus kyi maṇ+ḍal du khro bo de rnams nyid so so'i las kyi skabs la 'god pa yin no/ /de ltar bskyed rim goms pa brtan pa na las tshogs rnams bsgrub par bya ba dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ de ltar rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyis ye shesalacung zad dbang bar gyur pa na/ thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams kyang sgrub cing / sems can sna smrags pa rnams don chen po la gzud pa'i phyir/ rig pa 'jul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing des ye shes la yang dag par dbang bar 'gyur/ de nas phyag rgya'i spyor ba las nang gi sa bcu mngon du byas te/ dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes kyi sku rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed payin no/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kun gyi snod/ /ma lus rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po ni/ /dpalaldan gsang ba 'dus pa yin no zhes/ /mkhas grub kun gyis lan brgyar bsngags par mdzad/ khri/sgrub lugs dang ye shes zhabs kyi srol/ /'dus pa'i dgongs 'grel rnams kyi gtso bor snag /phra thig phyag rgya'i lam dang spyod pa sogs/ /'phags skor las kyang 'di nyid mchog tu gyur/ /bskyed pa'ang 'di nyid rtsa ba'i rgyud la 'byor/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyi gsung gi man ngag 'di/ /rgya bod mkhas grub mang pos gtan la phab/ /phyogs 'dir shes pa ding sang kho bo tsam/ /de ltar sgrubathabs bshad las bsod nams gang / /thob pa des kyang mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog /da lta nyid du thob pa'i rgyur gyur zhing / /lam bzang legayangaphyogs bcur rgyas par shog /de ltar gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni lung rigs smrab — 166—

kun ldan gyi lo chu stod can gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i srin par rnam rgyal rab brtan du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' rnam rgyal lo/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par 'dus pa'i lugs srol 'di phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //maṅga laX//

rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho khyo zhes bya ba bzhu kyigs/na mo gu ru mañju shrī ye/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dga' mkha' mnyam dpe med bde bar gtso/ /zab gsal dbyer med mi shigs rdo rje'i sku/ /lhun grub bsam pa ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don/ /sgrub mdzad bla ma lhag pa'i lhar btud nas/ /de nyid mchod pa'i rim pa gang / /rgyud gzhung bla ma'i man ngag ltar/ / sems ni snying rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /mdo tsam rnam par dbye bar bya/ /'dir phyi rol gyi mchod pa dang / tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel bar mchod chog gi rim pa ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar mchod pa byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal chog gi skabs ji lha bar mchod pa'i lha mo spro ba rnams byas la/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i cho ga dngos la/ yang mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyi dang / nang dang /gsang ba dang / bla na med pa dang / de kho na nyid dang / nyer mkho'i mchod pa ste drug las/ dang po la chu dang / nyer spyod sogs dang/ 'dod yon dang / rin r+ṣa sna bdun dang / bkra shis kyi yo byad dbul ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag — 168—

la bka' drin stsol/ /oṃ mañju badz+ra de wa tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra āXhri pra wa ra sa t+pa zaX/ ar+ghaX pra ca ye swāhā/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ yon myong zhes pa'i tshab tu/zhabs bsil dang / ar+ghaX zhes par/ bā bye/ zhal bsil dang / a3khri ma naX/ gsang gtor dang / prok+ṣa ṇaX/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen tu bstan pa dang / g.yas pa'i rdo rje kha tshur kha 'og tu phyogs pa'i mtheb mdzub brkam pa'i tshul gyis me tog len tshul byas ste/steng du kha phye la mthe'u chung nas rim pas sor mo lhag ma rnams 'brel ba dang / de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ steng nas blangs ste/ 'og tu phyogs pas 'grol ba dang / lag pa g.yon pa dung chos 'dzin pa'i tshul las/ g.yas pas ku sha bzung ste 'thor ba'i tshul rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ lha yi me tog dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /'di la spro na/ oṃ āXmañju badz+ra badz+ra dhika/ rat+na dhikra/ a ro lo ka /pradz+nyā dhika /mo hā ra ti/ dī ṣa ra ti/ rā ga ra ti/ badz+ra ra ti/ rū pa badz+ra/ shasta badz+ra/ gan+dha badz+ra/ rā sa badzā/ rdo a badzā/ dharma bhā tu badzā/ ya mun+ta krita/ pru sgon+ta kritra/ pa dharnya tra/ bi ga nān+ta kritra pukhye pra ti ts+tsha huX swāhā/ de ba smi du rol mo'i bar du sbyar ba'am/ yang na sngags phreng ltar las/ sngags so so'i mjug tu/ pukhre/ sogs kyis dbul/de tsam mi lcogs na/ mchod yon sogs kyis rigs 'gre bar byas te/ pur+sha sogs su 'don pa bsgyur/ de bzhin du/ bdug pos/ dhu pe/ snang gsal a lo ke/ dri mchog /ga rnye/zhal zas/ ni ju/ rol mo/ shasta/ gsum pa la/ thabs kyis mchod pa dang / shes rab kyi mchod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ / de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas —169—

rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /'bul sngags g.yin rnams gong bzhin la/ u pa ya rū pa zhes 'don pa spo/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o/ /u pa ya sha p+ta/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'gyung gnas gtso/ /u pa ya gan khyu/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /u pa ya tā sa/ /reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /u pa ya spu rna/ /gzugs sgra ro la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po btus pa'o/ /u pa ya dharmā khyu tu/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ /de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sa snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /pradz+nyā rū pa/ yang dag glu dang brjod bral dbyangs/ /de bzhin sgra la dbye ba gsum/ /sgra yi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /phyag rdor la ni dbul bar bya/ /pradz+nyā shag/ ga bur a ka dzā ti sogs/ /de bzhin dri la dbye ba gsum/ /dri'i rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /nam snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /pradz+nyā ga rje/ 'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang / /ro drug de bzhin dbye ba gsum/ /ro yi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dbul/ /pradz+nyā rā sa/ rdo rje pad+ma yang dag —170—

sbyor/ /'phyud dang gos sogs dbye ba gsum/ /reg bya'i rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sgrib sel la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /pradz+nyā sta khye/ phyi yi chos rnams 'di dag kun/ /brtags pa dang ni ma brtags pa/ /chos dbyings rdo rjer yang dag bkug /'jam pa'i rdo rje la ni dbul/ pradz+nyā dharma dh+wa tu/bzhi pa ni/ dngos dang yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhing 'di 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pas spyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin rer bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /tsakra rat+na/ zhing 'di nor bu rin chen gyi/ /sogs/ ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo sdi rat+na/ blon po pu ru ṣa rat+na/ glang po hasti rat+na/ rta mchog a shwa rat+na/ khyim bdag: /gro ha pa ti rat+na/gnyis pa ni/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i lpags pa dang / / yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' 'gyur brtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod blta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thags bzang bsreg bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi bying ngal dub med pa'i lham/ / nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag 'bul/ /sa sta u pa rat+na/lnga pa la gnyis las/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil/ /dge ba'i yo byad mnga' ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /shrī btasu/ tshig thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/gser gyis 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar/ /he ma tsakra/ gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ /bde ba'i yo byad mchog phul ba/ /—171—

tshwa traX ka /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yis/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar/ /dh+wa dza/ re ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i/ /bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar/ /ni dhi gha ṭa/ skyon gyis ma gos 'dam skyes pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po phul ba ltar/ /pad+ma snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi/ /'bud dung dkar po phul ba ltar/ khaX kha/ na bza' gser gyi nya ris can/ /bde ba'i yo byad phul ba ltar/ /ka na ka mar su/ gnyis pa rdzas brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ / bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /maṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya/gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ oṃ āXhuX lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi spyi bo'i thad ka nas 'thor zhing / dpal ldan rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du oṃ āXskyoX/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/gnyan lo smo ba dar ma grags/ snang kha'u ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma kirti shrī/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/—172—

mkhas pa kun dga' tshe 'phel/ ral gsal zla ba mgon po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan ste dbang dka' gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du/ oṃ āXskyoX/ rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam dbyangs ye shes zhabs/ /mar me mdzad bzang kun snying tha ga na/ /shan+ti pa dang ta sha sna rin chen bzang / /skyang po chos blo dge gzhes skyabs seng dang / /rdo rje sra brtan jo sras dkon mchog 'bar/ /dge bshes dbang rin phu thang ston shaka dang / /rong pa chos mgon losnro mchog ldan pa/ /dpal ldan seng ge bu ston chos kyi rje/ /gzhon nu bsod nams ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / /kun dga' bzang po gug ge paṇ+ḍi ta/ /glo bo mkhan chen rje btsun grol mchog zhabs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug kun dga'i mtshan can ste/ /lung brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /yang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad bzang po/ /'jam dpal grags pa bde ba chen po yi ge pa/ /ka rje pa dang dz+nyā na shrī mi tra dang / /ba li ā tsar+ya dang gnyos lo yon to grags/ /rdo rje bla ma jo sras dpal seng grags pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas ras chen ston lung ye 'bar chos 'od dang / /'phags 'od bu ston byang chub rtse mo grags rgyal ba/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mon rdzong nyi zlar grags pa gnyis/ /nam mkha' rin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /dbang rgyud man ngag gsum ldan bla ma rnams la 'bul/ /brgyud pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig ltar na/ mar me mdzad bzang po'i rjes su sman pa'i zhabs/ ce lu pa/ kaṇi pa/ ka ma la gu phya/ mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan/ sras dz+nyā na rā dza/ de la gnyos lo —173—

'byung pos dbang dang man ngag tsam thob nas brgyud zhu long ma byung bas/ rgya gar du byon ces snang bas/ de bzhin du ded kyang rung ngo / /gnyos lugs brgyud pa snga ma de lta na yang / bde ba chen po ni ye shes zhabs kyi dngos slob du snang bas/ bar gyi bla ma gnyis po de ma bcug kyang rung bar sems so/ /'jam rdor jo bo lugs sam 'jig rten dbang phyug ltar na/ shān+ti pa dang dpal ldan a ti sha /'gar dge lha btsun byang 'od wal pa dang / /lcags ri ba dang ljing bu thang stod pa/ /zhang ye bzo pa don grub bar thang pa/ /dar ma shākya bsod dbang lo mchog dang / /gzhon 'od grags chen 'phags 'od bu ston rje/ /thugs sras lo tsā 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal dang / /ye shes rgya mtsho mkhyen rab mchog grub dang / /spyan snga lha dbang spyan snga ngag dbang dang / /byams pa chos 'byor rnam rgyal rin chen dang / /ngag dbang rnam rgyal rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /ces dang rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor mi bskyod pa'i brgyud pa ltar na/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes zhabs dang thugs sras bzhi/ /sman zhabs sangs rgyas dpal dang rdo rje gdan/ /so ri pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas dang / /dge 'byung stobs bcu rdo rje dpal dang ni/ /chos 'byung dpal dang sangs rgyas grags pa dang / /rin chen grags pa rā ti gup+ta dang / /grub chen zhi ba pan grub rnam gnyis te/ /ngo mtshar bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /ces bya'o/ /oṃ āXmañju badz+ra maX hūṃ/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal du skye( āXhūX/ glu te āXbadz+ra lha ka hūṃ sogs so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'khru gsum btags pas phul/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud te/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs —174—

rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ dgos kyi chos skyong yod na/de dang de'i snying po'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa bskyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXjiX/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āXspyoX/ gzhan yang / phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu bdun/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul/ oṃ āXhuX/gzhan yang / bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag/grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āXspyoX/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i/ sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim par gyur cig /bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni rtse bas nyer dgongs ste/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ āXpañca a mri ta pu dzi te huX/gsum pa ni/ bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa ni/ /dri dang me tog phreng brgyan te/ /yon tan ske rags mā ma ki khres rab can gyis byin rlabs la/ /'khor lo'i dbus su mchod par bya/ /rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gi brgyan/ /dngos grub —175—

rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun la dbul bar bya/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rig ma la/ /'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs//'pho med bde ba mngon du 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /sgrub thabs spyod pa ltar/ /dngos sam ye shes rig ma la rjes su chags pa tsam ste/ oX sar+pā ta thā ga a nu ra ga na badz+ra swā bha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ bzhi pa ni/ thabs shes snyoms par sbyor las byung //byang chub sems spros de bzhin gshe/gas/ /ma lus nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla med mchod pas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ āX.a nu rta ra pu dzi te skyoX/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+ma ra phyung / /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /oṃ badz+ra pur+sha ā skyoX/ rnam par rtog pa kun gyi tshogs/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par bsreg pa de'i spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /dhu pe/ yi ge huX las yang dag byung / /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /a lo ke /bde ba chen po'i nam mkha' gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / /de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni/ /thugs kyi: ga rnye/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i phyir du mchod par bgyi/ /nai we t+ya/ rdo rje pad+ma ra yang dag bskyod/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung / /rnal 'byor pa yis mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyi shasta/ rgod dang sgeg dang rtse 'jo ni/ /sna tshogs kyis ni sems dgar byed/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gang dag /thugs kyi: mahā su khaX/lnga pa ni/ de kho na nyid bsgom bzhin du/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /—176—

bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob thog/oX mañju badz+ra sogs gong bzhin la/ badz+ra wa sta ye/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa ni/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog ka ni ka ra dang / / ma li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog ka ra wi ra dang / /lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam du/ /gru bzhi shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /mchod rten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi lus/ /bla ma bshang dang gci bas mchod/ /mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ khu ba blangs nas mchod par bya/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan lda ldi sil snyan sogs/ /rta babs mchog dang bla re dang / /bsil g.yab khyams dang khri stan sogs/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam shing / /nam mkha' mdzod sogs dbul bar bgyi/ /dngos grub thams cad bstsal du gsol/ /gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar de nyid lnga pa dang / 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud kyi bar/ 'dud nyi shu dang / bsdus pa la dga' ba'i tshe/ zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cig /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad —177—

kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud/ /sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing / /byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /gti mug dga' ma sogs phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna la sogs rnam dag cing / /phar phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor mchod la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rdo rje gzugs sogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ba'i thibs po rnam bcom pa/ /bsdu dngos bzhi'i ngo bo nyid/ /dgug gzhug bci nge dang dbang mdzad pa'i/ /sgo srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing //byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi/ /sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces pa'am long skabs yod cing spro na/ dus gsum rdo rje'i thugs yin srid dang thar gyur gang / /zhi zhing sgrib med nam mkha' dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnam rgyas byang chub dbang phyug rdo rje can/ /de la lus ngag yid kyis rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang / /rnam par shes dang skye mched drug dang dbang po drug /sa chu me dang rlung dang nam mkha' thams cad ni/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug nyes pa 'dod chags rdo rje chos bcas gang / /rig pa'i sbyor ba las byung rtag tu rab 'bring bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bas myos pa'i dngos gyur pa/ /byang chub sems: /sdud dang dga' dang rnam par de bzhin mi 'gyur dang / /rgyu dang —178—

'bras bu'i rang bzhin sems su rjes thogs chos/ /rmongs dang zhe sdang 'dod chags sgrib pa rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems 'dra /gang zhig thog ma med dngos rnam dag 'di sgom pa/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung spros dang rnam par bral/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur brtul zhugs dam tshig sbyor ba brtag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog gi thabs ni 'di bsgoms shing / /bsnyen pa'i cho ga nye bar bsgrub pa sgrub pa dang / /sgrub pa chen pos blo mi 'gyur ba'i sgrub dbang po/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la: /gang zhig thun bzhi'i rdo rje dag ni sgrub byed pa/ /mi snang la sogs sna tshogs mchog dang sman 'grub cing / /bla ma'i drin gyis 'di na ma nor lam rtogs pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'dra lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rab gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud ni nyan pa dang / /'don par byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang / /mchod pa byed pa dang ni 'bri'am 'brir 'jug pa/ /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /gang du zhi sogs las tshogs shin tu brtags pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor sngags kyi cho ga de bzhin rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /bsgrub bya 'di dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i dbang po ni/ /byang chub: /gang gis gtso bo sgrub pa po mthong reg pa dang / /legs par dran dang ming tsam nges par thos pa dang / /dad par byed cing phyogs cig tsam zhig 'dzin pa dag /byang chub rdo rje 'drar lta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu rtog pa ma lus spangs/ /dri ma dang bral bdag nyid can/ /kun bzang chos dbyings ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i/ /'od zer brgya phrag rnam 'gyed pa/ /me long ye —179—

shes ngo bo nyid/ /rnam snang gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ngan rtog pa dang bral zhing / /skyon med mkha' ltar rnam par dag /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag med 'od kyi mkha' kun khyab/ /tshad med yon tan phreng ba yis/ /kun rtog ye shes mkhyen pa yi/ /'od dpag med la: /'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po/ /ji bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur ba yi/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /don yod grub pa de la 'dud/ /sa ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu rnam par 'dzin spyod pa/ /thugs rje spyod pa g.yo ba po/ /lha mo spyan mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sems can rnams/ /nyon mongs nyid ni rab zhi ba/ /chu ltar phan pa don chen gyi/ /mā ma gī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs nyid ni bsreg par brtson/ /bya ba rtse mo mchog grub pa/ /na bza' dkar mor phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa'i/ /rtsad 'byin 'gro la bde ba stsol/ /ut+pal la yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gzugs ni rgya che zhing / /rnam pa kun tu mi 'phro ba/ /rtags bral gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /mnyam med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sgra rnams kyi/ /de nyid rnam pa gsum rgyas shing / /rna ba'i bde ba stsol mdzad pa/ /sgra yi rdo rje mar phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi longs spyod lhun grub pa/ /sems can ma lus la sems pa'i/ /bung ba'i sgra mdzad rdo rje dri/ /ma smad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang rig bstan du med/ /gnyis med ro myong stobs kyis su/ /sems can bde la gnas mdzad pa/ /rdo rje ro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji bzhin du ni 'byung 'gyur —180—

ba'i/ /re ba gang la sred mtha' sa /'gro gsum rtag tu dga' mdzad pa'i/ /reg bya rdo rje mar phyag 'tshal/ /gang phyir kun nas nyon mongs pa/ /gcod pa'i rgyud gyur chos rnams kyis/ /kun la rtag tu rtog mdzad pa/ /bla med chos kyi rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang phyir theg pa chen po la/ /mi rnams dga' ba bskyed mdzad pa/ /dad pa rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /gshin rje gshed por phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa gang gi stobs kyis su/ /byang chub tshogs rnams rdzogs mdzad pa/ /brtson 'grus rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab mthar byed phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sems can rnams/ /dge ba brjed med bskyed mdzad pa/ /dran pa rnams dag ngo bo nyid/ /pad+ma mthar byed phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi stobs kyis sems can rnams/ /bgegs bral bde la gnas mdzad pa/ /bsam gtan rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /bgegs 'joms mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad zin to/ /gal te ye shes zhabs lugs las 'byung ba'i/mi bskyod rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor sogs dkyil 'khor gzhan dang / gzhan dag mchod par 'dod pa rnams kyang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sngags dang / bstod pa bzhag pa tsam gyis/ g.yin rnams mchod chog 'di kho na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rnam snang la sog pa rigs lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor la ni/ rigs lnga'i bstod pa rnams la gong 'og brje ba tsam bya'o/ /'jam rdor gyi bstod pa la mtshan brjod klog pa yang shin tu 'brel zhing / bla ma snga ma rnams kyi phyag len la yod par snang bas/ long skabs yod pa'i tshe nan to du bya ba'i 'os so/ /mchod pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ byis pas rang dgar byas pa yi/ /tshig sbyor mang po rnams spangs te/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i gsung bzhin bkod/ / 'phags bskor la sogs 'dus pa'i 181—

lugs/ /kun dang phal cher thun mong ste/ /thun mong min pa'i khyad par yang / /mang du yod pa shes par gyis/ /'dir 'bad dge ba nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /ma dag snang ba'i smag rus mun bcom nas/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'gro rnams smin las slar/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs rgyal ba'i dbang por gyur/ /ces pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel//—182—

dkyil ge ngor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhu/gas/oṃ swā sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor ra gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'od gsal bde chen rdo rje'i thugs/ /gnyis med ye shes dag pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /zung 'jug gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la/ /rtag par dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shigs thig le'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zab gsal rnam dag bcu dgu'i lha tshogs su/ /kun nas sgrub thabs rim gnyis sgom rnams kyang / /nges par smin byed dbang la ltos pa yin/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /sngags rig kun gyis yang yang mdzad/ /'on kyang mos pa gtsor gyur pas/ /'bri ba 'di la skyon yod min/ /'dir dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / slob dpon sman pa zhabs kyis dngos grub 'byung gter las bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni lugs 'di'i dkyil chog gi rtsa ba yin la/ de gnyis kyang rgyas bsdus 'ga' zhig ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig par yod cing / gzhung de dag shin tu brling ba yin na'ang / bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sman zhabs pa dang / rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shan+ti pas rnam bshad rgyas pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ gtso bor de dag dang mthun par bya la/ gzhan yang 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ye shes rdo rje'i 'phreng ba yang gtso bor bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i dgongs pa 'grel pa yin zhing / tshad dang ldan pa'i slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i phyir/ kha — 183—

'gengs rgyas pa la spro na skabs su bab pa dag blang bar bya'o/ /bsod snyoms pa la sogs pa rgya bod gzhan dag ni/ de dag dang mthun zhing / 'thad pa rnams blang bar bya ba yin mod kyi/ gnig tu gal che ba ma yin no/ /des na go don rnams rgyas par de dag tu shes par bya la/ 'dir ngag don dang 'brel ba tsam zhig bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por/ slob ma rjes bzung ni/ ding sang phal cher lag len mi byed par snang bas re zhig ba 'ag go /de nas bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni sgrub thabs su shes par bya'o/ /'dir lnga ste/ sa chog dang / sta gon dang / dngos gzhi zhag gi cho ga dang / dbang bskur ba dang / rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po la/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bslang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhan du shes la/ gnyis pa la gsum gyi dang po snang ba las bslang ba ni/ sa'i bdag po las rin nam tshig gis bslang ngo / /gnyis pa mi snang ba las bslang ba la yang gsum ste/ phyogs skyong las bslang ba dang / sa lha las bslang ba dang / bde bar gshegs pa las bslang ba'o/ /de dag ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su sa lha'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ dmar gtor gnyis dang / dkar gtor gcig /chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyi mchod pa tshar bzhi bshams/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa nas/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/a las/ nas/ ṇa 'a gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ badz+ra lha rnye ra ṇi ta la sogs pas rol mo byin dbab bya/ gtor ma rnams kyang rgyas par na mngon rtogs ltar bsang sbyangs byin brlabs bya zhing / bsdu na bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum byin gyis brlabs pa tsam bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros zhes pa nas/ dpag tu med pas — 184—

bskor ba'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ asna ye/ ya ma ya/ ne ri kyi/ bā ya we/ ku be ra ye/ i shā na ya/ gi khyuX bra h+ma/ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ti tsan+d+ra na kla tra/ a dhi pa ti/ a dho pra thi ldi de lī khyuX a su ra khyiX nā ga khyuX oṃ ā kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX a du nu tu sno twata/ oṃ āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer spyor na/ khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /de ltar khyod la bdag gis ni/ /gus pas gsol te ma bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang / /legs nyes rtags rnams bstan du gsol/ /gtor ma gnyis pa yang gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag sogs la dmigs nas/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag gis dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs par bgyi yis/ phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i 'byung po gang dag de/ thams cad kyis sa phyogs 'di bdag la gnang du gsol/ zhes brjod/ dmar gtor rnyag dang / dkar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa sa gtsang sar bto / tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ baX las byung ba sa'i lha mo ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing / g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhi zhing dgyes la/ rgyan dang na bza' ser po can du gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūṃX gsum/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyis phyag rgya sa la reg ste/ hūṃX hūṃX hūṃX/ ṭak+ki hūṃX dzaX sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas spyan —185

drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX.ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi tañca huX/ zhes dbang bskur/sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ pri thi skyi de ldi sa pa ri wā ra khyoX ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ de bzhin du shasta'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ pri thi lī de lī sa pa ri wā re khyuX a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khore bri/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gnang ba byin par bsam/ sa'i lha mo nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ de'i mchod gtor tshom bu rnams bsdu'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'jam dpal rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor ra zhes pa nas/ dharma bhā tu badz+re zhes pa'i bar tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin/ spro na sgrub thabs bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul/ mthar dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la phan don du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bgyid/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ 'grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bul/ gnang ba byin nas gshegs su gsol bar bsam/ gsum pa la/ dang po rdzas kyis sbyang ba ni/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa dri'i chu dang /—186—

yungs kar dang / chu gtsang dang / thal bas sa gzhi der g.yas bskor gyis gtor bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ las dang bya bas sbyangs ba dang / gsum pa khang brtsegs bya ba dang / bzhi pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams ni phal cher la mi dgos pa shas che zhing / gal te dgos na'ang / 'phreng ba la sogs par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs pa ni/ shā n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'i maX yig ces pa nas/ ut+pa ko3haX/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs khar hūṃX/ rang gi thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dza hūṃX baX hoX thugs kha'i maX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ bgegs gzhom pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ gtor chog tu po gad pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags de ci nus su bzla'o/ /drug pa sngags kyis sbyang ba ni/ lag g.yasardo rje dang bcas pa la reg te/ oṃ bhā khaX/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oX me de ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hūṃX/ oṃ bo dz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ āXhūṃX sho dha ya sho dha ya hūṃX phaṭa/ bdun pa sa'i lha mos sbyang ba ni/ slar yang dri bzang gi chus byugs pa'i dbus su tshom bu bkod la/ tso rna pri thi wi ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX nam mkha'i sa lha maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhugs/mchod gtor po sdoms/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod gtor phul/ gsol ba btab/gnang ba byin par mos la/ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ brgyad pa bla na med pas sbyang ba ni/ de ltar sna tshogs pa'i chos thams cad kyang stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa la gsum ste/ bdag bskyed bsgoms nas nga rgyal bzung ba/ gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor 'degs pa/ bskor zhing bka' bsgos nas stang stabs bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob —187—

dpon dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su 'dug la/ lha'i mas su zhugs/ kha shar du phyogs te/rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba zhes pa nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgom/ de nas snyems pa dang bcas pas/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje can/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /bdag ni phyag na rdo rje brtan/ /bdag ni bdag po rdo rje che/ /byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'dor ro/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob dpon gyis phyogs bzhir/ nang mchod dang / mchod pa tshar re bshams/ lha la legs par bsnyen pa'i slob ma bzhi rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du gnas bzhin pas phyogs bzhi nas sgrub thabs nang ltar mchod pa dang / nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul bar mos te/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang drang ste/ shar na gnas pas/ de bzhin ba/shogs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho nas/mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ mtshan min thams cad yang dag spang / /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor: nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor :byang nas sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor:zhes so so nas lan gsum gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyas pa la spro na/ re re bzhin mchod pa byin —188—

rlabs/ mchod bstod maṇ+ḍal sogs mdzad pa'i phyag len yang yod/ de nas slob dpon gyis/sems can ma rig pa'i mun pas khebs shing bdud kyis dbang du song ba rnams kyi bdud dang nyon mongs pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod la/ drag shul gyi spyod pa dang ldan pas rdo rje dril thogs te/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ hūṃX badz+ra u tigribadag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la zhugs par gyur/gsum pa ni/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yongs su bye ba'i rdo rje hūṃX mdzad nag po nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ sbom shing thung la lko pa nas/stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃX las 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yon bskor du bltas pas bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ g.yas bskor du bltas pas rwa gur dang mtshams bcing bar gyur/ kro dha zhi spyi hri/ lan gnyis rang gi rkang mthil gnyis su'am a las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba re gnas par 'gyur/ de nas hūṃX glur len bzhin du dga' ba yongs su gyur 'gros kyi dbang ldan du song la/slar g.yas bskor gyi sna tshogs rdo rje'am/ rtse gcig pa'am/ rtse gsum pa'i 'gros dang bcas pas bskor ba gcig byas la/ dbang ldan nas dbus su gdong phyogs pas/ hūṃX lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus gsum las byung dgas bya ste/ /gal te bdag bsgo las 'das na/ /'jigs par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /wo nga ro drag pos brjod cing / rol tsho sgra dang /gu gul gyis bdug /yung kar gyis brab bo/ /de nas bgegs dang bral ba'i sa gzhi la/ zhi 'gros/—189—

khro 'gros/rdo rje 'gros ci rigs pa bskor zhing /shar du g.yas brkyang / lto ru g.yon brkyang / nub tu sag /byang du zlum po'i stang stabs bya/ shes shing spro na/ sman zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar/ khro bo bcu la tshul drug drug bshad pa ltar ram/ 'phreng ba las 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ phur bu gcig tsan dan dmar pos byugs/ srad bu dmar po dkris/ me tog gi 'phreng ba btags/bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃX las sam skad cig gis bgegs mthar byed nag po nas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūṃX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs mthar badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaXhūṃX baX ho ཿ mig tu k+ṣi/ rna bar dzi/ sna la khaX/ lce la gaX /dpral bar skaX/ lte bar saX/ dbang bskur ba sa lha dang 'dra ba las/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃX las 'od zer 'phros/ brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad yongs su bkug ste/ hūṃX las byung ba'i 'brub khung 'bar ba'i nang du bcug /rdo rje'i phur bus btab cing / rdo rje tho bas brdung bar gyur/ ces dngos su dkyil stsor gyi sa'i dbus su phur bus btab la/ glu( gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba ṭa : ༷ phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya/ sarba pā paX phaṭa/ hūṃX hūṃX hūṃX badz+ra gī la/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti sarba birtswan kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas/ rkang mthil gyi bar phug ste/ bgegs rnams lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlud rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog pa rgyun chad de/ 'od gsal du thim par gyur/phur bu las 'od zer rnon po phyogs bcur 'phros te/ 'gro ba thams cad —190—

bgegs dang bral bar byas la/ sa gzhi'i phyi rol tu hūṃX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / baX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhi nas dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor dang / mtshams bzhi nas me'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshams bcing bar gyur/ de nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la mchod de/ gsol ba btab smon lam dang / bkra shis gang 'grub bya ste/ nub dang po'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa la spyir lhag gnas bzhi yod kyang / slob ma lhag gnas 'og tu bshad na lag len bde bas/ 'dir bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas sa'i lha mo lhag gnas dang / lha lhag gnas dang /bum pa lhag gnas dang / rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha lhag gnas kyi sa bzhi dri bzang gi thig le bya/ sa'i lha mo'i mchod gtor dang / spyi mchod rnams spun mas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlud / raX las me/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la'i nang du/ bhuX aX dzi khaX hūṃX rnams las bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūṃX ha ho hiX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX oṃ in+t+ra ya/ asna ye/ ya ma ya/ ni ri tu/wā ya we/ ku be ra ye/ yī sha na ya/ tsho prad+ma/ snyu rlu gra ha a dhi pa ti tsan+t+ra na k+ṣa rā/a dhi pa ti/ a dho pri thi ldi de lī khyuX a su ra khyoX nā ge khyoX oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX ā du nu tra rgya twata/ oṃ āXhūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ sogs gong bzhin lan gsum dang /oṃ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa thams cad sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bhu te spyoX ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis —191—

mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer spyod na/ khyed kyi bar po ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod spyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bcur bzhugs te bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song zhig /ces tsham rngams dang / rol mo'i sgrar bcas pas gtor ma btang /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/hūṃX yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ gnas khang bhuX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i nas/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi bar sgrub thabs dang / gong du bshad pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs ltar ro/ /de nas gtor ma ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs bsgom/ de nas sa blang —192—

ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar sa'i lha mo mchod de/ mthar sa sbyang ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar sa gzhi nyid la stim/ gnyis pa ni/ phyis kyi lag len ltar na skabs 'dir lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i don du las thig 'debs/ 'on kyang las thig btab nas ye thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ ye thig btab nas las thig gis cha dbye ba gang byed kyang rung ste/ 'og dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi nyin mo byas na legs par mngon no/ /gang ltar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sar dri bzang gis byugs/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / lha gzhan gyi gnas su zlum po bkod de rnams kyi steng du me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bya/ lha re re la sgos mchod bcu bcu las mi nyung bar bshams/ de rnams lag len mthong bas shes/ shar gyi g.yon du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma mug mas/ spyi mchod kyang kha gso/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzo gas par gyur/ lha'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ maX bhuX aX dzi khaX laX maX paX tāX/ dzaXhūX baX hoX khaX raX hūX hūX hūX huX/ zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du grub pa'i steng du/ dri'i thig le gnas rnams la lha bcu dgu'i gdan sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma dang / zla ba'i gdan rnams su gyur/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor las lha bcu dgu'i tshogs rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ oX āXmañju badz+ra maX hūX nas/ du tā krita huX hūX gi bar brjod cing / rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad —193—

dang ldan par gyur/ de'i pang du yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po/ nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du lho ru rin 'byung sogs rigs bzhi bskyed/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo sogs yum bzhi bskyed/rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma drug bskyed/ de thams cad kyang nas nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol gyi shar du shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed sogs khro bo bzhi bskyed nas/ khro bo bzhi po nas bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol tu/ rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes kyi me ri dang bcas pas mtshams bcad par gyur/ huX zhes lan mang du brjod/ 'di la sa chog ma byas na/ rang rang gi sa bon las dam tshig pa rnams bskyed cing / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ skye mched byin rlabs sogs kyang bya'o/ /〈rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi ye shes sems dpal lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khordo ra zhes pa nas/ birtswan tā krita hoX zhes pa'i bar gyi ye shes pa stim/lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣi dang / 'khor lo'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas/ kun tu bzang dkar po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ /〉sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod 'phreng du ji skad zugad pa'i tshul gyis mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig long skabs dang bstun te bya/ gtor chog ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma yang 'bul lo/ /gsum pa ni/ rab tu lha bum bcu dgu las bum dang bcas pa dang / min na rigs lnga yum bzhi las bum dang bcu bshams/ de yang ye ma 'byor na rnam rgyal bum pa dang / las bum gnyis su bsdu'o/ /bum pa rnams kyis mtshan nyid dang / nang rdzas dang / 'cha' tshul dang mchod gtor rnams ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bum pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang /—194—
