a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ baX las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang snying po thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oṃ ta ste ta ste mahā ta ste swāhā lha'i chu bo dal gyis 'bab pas yongs su gang ba rnams su gyur/〈dbus su pad+ma'i bcu dgu/ so sor nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi steng du/ maX bhuX aX dzi khaX/ laX maX paX taX/ dzaXhūṃX baX hoX khaX raX huX hūX huX huX rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa ca'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhi no/ /〉 de yang lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du/ pad zla la/ maX las dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ phyogs mtshams kyi bum pa brgyad las/ shar du pad zla la bhuX las rnam snang sogs dang / lho ru pad nyi la/ aX las rin 'byung sogs/ nub tu pad nyi la dzi las 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du pad nyi la khaX las don yod grub pa sogs/ shar lhor pad zla la lam las spyan ma sogs/ lho nub tu pad zla la maX las mā ma gī sogs/ nub byang du pad zla la paX las gos dkar mo sogs/ byang shar du pad zla la taX las sgrol ma sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i bum pa drug la/ shar lho pad zla la dzaXlas gzugs rdo rje ma sogs/ lho nub tu pad zla la hūX las sgra rdo rje ma sogs/ nub byang du pad zla la maX las dri rdo rje ma sogs/ byang shar du pad zla la ho las ro rdo rje ma sogs/ shar gyi g.yas su pad zla la khaX las reg rdo rje ma sogs/ shar gyi g.yon —195—

du pad zla la raX las chos khams rdo rje ma sogs nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi'i bum pa rnams la/ pad nyi'i steng du huX/ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nas/ bzhugs pa 'o'i bar lha sta gon bzhin/ lha bum dgu'i lugs la rigs lnga yum bzhi las mi bskyed pa yod na'ang / thams cad bskyed na legs pas/ bum pa dbus ma'i nang du/ gtso bo la rdo rje ma drug dang / khro bo bzhis bskor ba bskyed/ gnyis las med na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i bcu dgu/ so sor nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi steng du/ maX hūṃ dzi aX khaX/ laX maX paX taX/ dzaXhūṃX baX ho~X khaX raX hūX huX huX huX rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa/ dbus su dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ gang ltar yang / las bum du pad nyi la huX las bgegs mthar byed nag po nas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams ni lugs 'di la lhar bskyed mi dgos par mngon la/ bskyed par spro na'ang spyi dang mthun zhing legs pas ci bder bya'o/ /skye mched byin rlabs dang / lha rnams kyi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su nas/ rgyan pa 'o'i bar gyis sku gsung thugs kyis byin rlabs sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ ya mun nas hoX yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nas/ rang rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan gyi bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi sgrub chen bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hūX dang / oṃ āXhūX lan bdun bdun gyis dung chos kyi chu bdud rtsir mos/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste gtso bo la brgya phrag gnyis sogs dang / gzhan rnams la nyi shu rtsa gcig re las bum la snying po —196—

brgya rtsa dang 'phreng sngags ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de nas hūX lan bdun gyi dung chos gyi chu dang /bgegs mthar byed kyi snying po lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gsum bum par blug /mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi mchod dang / mchod 'phreng du bshad pa'i bstod pa 'bring po des bstod/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ ku shas las bum gyi chu blangs nas/ bum pa rnams la bskor zhing bsangs gtor byas nas/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad slar yang bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mjodi/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis rlabs nas/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul te sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /yig brgya lan mang du brjod pa'i rjes su/bum pa la rdo rjes reg ste slar yang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs kyis bstod/ bum nang gi lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mtshan ma lhar bskyed na phyag mtshan du bsgyur dgos/bzhi pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra bar mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gsum byas nas/ lce huX las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/spos phor dang dril bu thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus pa/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub brtan gnas dang / /sems can —197—

bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /'jam dpal 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba mi shes dag pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas rnams la/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /tshogs pa dang bcas thams cad ni/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gse(la/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gnang ba byin par bsam/mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ bstod pa shin tu bsdus pa dgos pa'i rigs la/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs sho lo sgo gcig gi mthar/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /zab gsal bcu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'dis bstod do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol thams cad phyogs bcing bar gyur/ zhes brjod la/ re zhig mi 'degs par zhag de nyid kyi nub mo mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /mchod pa mi 'byor na/yig brgya dang / bzod gsol gyi mthar nam mkhar 'degs dgos so/ /gsol btab yan lag dang bcas pa 'di rnams dkyil 'khor lhag gnas kyi cho ga'i 'phros yin pas gong du byed pa mang zhing mi legs pa'ang min mod/ 'di nyid kyi rang gzhung rnams nas 'dir bya bar bshad do/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / sgrub pa dang / mchod pa gsum mo/ /dang po la/ ye shes kyi thig gi cho ga las thig gi cho ga /rdul tshon byin gyis brlabasapa/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ tshon skud sna lnga yungs kar gyi phye ma dang / bdud rtsi lnga bsres pas byugs/ dri zhim posabagos la/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang khu lnga po rim pas mthe bong sogs kyi rtsa bar bkod nas cung —198—

zad bskyangs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ huX las byung ba'i thig skud nag po/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ zlaX las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam snang gi ngo bo/oX las byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ dzi las byung ba'i thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ khaX las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs khar hūX bhuX aX dzi khaX rnams las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs/ oṃ āX.a khyo khyuXbadz+ra snyu traX me pra ru mahā ma maṇ+ḍal snyu tra ṇa ya huX/ zhes lan gsum dang / de bzhin du ak+ṣi khyuX gnas su/ sha shwa ta dang / rat+na saX bha wa dang / a mi ta bha dang / a mo gha sirnyi zhes pa rnams bcug ste/ gsol ba btab/ rang gi mig gnyis su dza las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can/ mig 'bras huX/ oṃ di sta drisgyi a du sha dzaXnam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu rigs lnga rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ de nas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'am 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba dang lhan cig thig skud brkyangs te/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra bri ni sarba dharmā/ a yin+da a nu pra bra spyi sarba dharmā/ sarba dharmā oṃ āXhūX/ zhes dang po so sor sgril/ de nas phyogs gcig tu sgril lo/ /thig skud kyang lnga tshan lngar byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nyid snod gtsang mar bzhag la/rang gi mig g.yon pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yas pa ṭa las zla ba/ badz+ra tri ni ma ṭa/thig skud la drag tu bltas pas brtan par byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga —199—

dang / yungs kar dang / dri bzang gi chus gtor/ lag pas reg la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra huX dang / glu( āXhuX brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas so/ /las thams cad pas bsrung ba byas nas bzhag/lhag gnas kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa gsar du bshams/ sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs/mchod bstod bsdus pa dang / nang mchod phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags rgyas dkyil 'bor ba khos la/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ de nas ma rdzo bstod bsdus pa dang / las thams cad pas bsrung ba bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la/ skye( sarba saX sgo te dha ni huX/ zhes dri bzang gi chus gtor/ byi dor bya/ mtha' la me tog bkram/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pas bde bar lag pa g.yon pas thig skud bzung / slob ma nub tu phyogs pa la g.yas pas thig sna gtad/ ljobaXzhes brjod/ slob mas g.yon pas blangs la lte bar bzung / de nas ji ltar thig gdab pa ni/ thig 'dzin tshul de nyid las/ slob dpon gyi g.yas pa'i theb mdzub kyis thig skud nam mkhar 'debs pa'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra ma ti kra ma hūX/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig /thig gi sgras/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul te/ mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas thig skud la thim/ de yang / nub shar gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ /lho byang gnyis pa me dbang shar gyi logs/ /rlung srin nub dang rlung dbang byang yin te/ /me srin gnas pas lho yi rtsa thig gdab/ /srin dbang zur thig dang po me rlud gnas/ /zur thig gnyis pa btab de thig chen brgyad/ /ces pa ltar la g.yasabaskor dang / 'gros sogs lag len bzhin bya/ thig gzhan rnams 'debs par spro na'ang btab de/logs kyi zhor la btab na legs so/ /de dag tu slob dpon rkang pa g.yon skyil krung dang / g.yasarkang mthil sa la btsugs pa'i tsog pu dang slob ma de las ldog pas so/ /—200—

gnyis pa ni/ thig skud de nyid dam/ gzhan yin na bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bgegs mthar byed las bum gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ gnasagasum byin rlabs dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab sa lha'i skabs bzhin byas la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra be gā a kra ma ho / ༷༷ zhes pas ye shes kyi thig btegs te/ thig sna gtod tshul sogs ye theg dang 'dra bar byas nas las thig gdab par bya'o/ /de la dang por tshangs zur gyi thig gdab/thag ring du byed na skam thig gi cha thams cad phye nas/ de nas rtsa thig gdab cing / de'i rjes su nang gi thig rnams btab/ de rjes rtsa thig gi phyi rol rnams btab thig thung ngu byed na/ thig chen brgyad dang por btab nas/ de'i 'og tu cha dbye'o/ /rtsa thig gi nang du cha chen gcig lha snam du bzhag nas/dbus su le tshe dgu'i thig btab/ rtsa thig gi phyi rol tu logs su thig drug dang / g.yon ngos su thig bdun bdun/ cha chen gnyis kyi tshad du sbyar bas/ mda' yab tshun chad grub pa yin la/ de nas rta babs kyi thig gdab bo/ /zlum thig thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i phur bu btab pa la thig skud bkon te bskor bar bya'o/ /de la rta babs sgo tshad gcig pa dang / gsum ni gdam nga yin la/ rta babs snam bu bzhi mar grags pa ni/ ngan song spyong rgyud las/ them skas bzhi yi 'phreng ba dang / /zhes pa'i don du mi mkhas pa dag 'dod la/ de lta mod kyi kha che'i mkhan po snga ma rnams kyi ni lag gis len no/ / nyi 'og dang / bal po'i yul du bzhi pa 'di med kyang / sngon ni sna tshogs pa dag yod cing / phyis bstogacig pa kho na dar ro/ /gang dgadakyil 'khor gyi rta babs la snam bu bcu gcig ma dang / bzhi ma gang rung gis khyab par 'dod pa ni/ rgya gar nas byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa rnying pa rnams ma mthong bar zad do/ /de la 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi lugs ni thig gi cha rnam par dbye ba ni logs shig tu 'bri bar —201 —

'dod/ snga ma phal che ba ltar na 'di ltar/ tshangs dang zur thig legs btab nas/ / cha chen bcu drug bgo bar bya'o/ /dang drug phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab/ /gnyis bdun bzhi cha bzhi ru bgo /gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag /lnga brgyad dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /dgu pa rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /bco lnga pa ni mda' yab thig /de gnyis zur nas zur du'o/ /bcu pa la sogs thig lnga ni/ /zur thig nas brtsams tshangs thig ngos/ /gnyis par reg pa dang po gnyis/ /bdun par reg pa phyi ma gsum/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams gnyis pa ni/ /bcu nas bcu gcig bar du'o/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams dang po ni/ /dgu nas bcu gnyis la reg pa'o/ /de nas dngos su gsum pa'i bar/ /steng du bcu gsum pa la reg /de gnyis rtse sbrel bzhi pa ni/ /bcu gcig pa nas bcu bzhi'i bar/ /rtse nas rtse ru bcu bzhi pa/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams lnga pa dang / /drug pa bdun rnams bcu gcig nas/ /bco lnga'i thig la reg par gdab/ /mda' phyir gcig nas tshangs thig steng / /cha chung gnyis kyi steng du bskor/ /g.yas g.yon sne las mthud nas ni/ /cha chung re res g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /nang gi bskor thig la reg par/ /bcu drug la sogs thig bzhi ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams bdun pa dang / /drug lnga bzhi la reg par gdab/ /de dag rnams kyi rtse mo'ang sbrel/ /nyi shu la sogs thig gsum ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams dang po la/ /reg pa tsam du gdab bar bya/ /yang na rtsa ba cha chung gnyis/ /rtse mo cha chung gcig dbus rwa/ /tshangs phyir gnyis dang mda' phyir gcig /ka rgyan rtse nas nang ra bskor/ /de nas ngos gnyis steng du gcig /phyi nas snga ma'i tshad kyis bskor/ /dbus kyi cha gsum bzhi bzhir bgo /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu steng bskor/ /gsum pa bzhi pa bsnol mar btab/ /le tshe dgu par 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi rol rim pas bskor thig bzhi/ /gcig phyed gcig gi tshad nas bskor/ /zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni tshon sna lnga'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga legs par bshams/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i —202—

ngang las sogs/ thig skud ces pa'i gnas su rdul tsho ni zhes pa dang / badz+ra sru traX zhes pa'i gnas su badz+ra tsi traX dang / snyu tra nā ya'i gnas su tsi tra ṇa ya zhes pa'i khyad par ma gtogs ye thig dang 'dra/ mig g.yas pa la zhes pa nas/ brtan par byas kyi bar yang rdul tsho ni zhes pa nyid khyad par ro/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūX/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla zhing mtheb srin gyis mnye/ rdul tshon rnams la hi yig bris te/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang /rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig /ces brjod la yid kyis mchod/bzhi pa ni/ spyir 'di la sngar bshad pa'i las thig btab nas/ ye thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag len shas che bar yod pa spyi dang mthun par legs mod/ 'di'i rang gzhung gzhan na las thig mi gsal yang / sman zhabs kyi gzhung na/ ye thig gi rjes su las thig 'debs pa gsal ba'i phyir/ 'dir de bzhin du bkod do/ /des na skabs 'dir/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hoX zhes pas las thig kyang btegs la/ slob dpon nang du zhugs te/ hi hi zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang bcas sgo thams cad kyi rtsa thig dbyi'o/ /gal te las thig la bskyed chog med par cha dbye ba tsam yin na 'degs mi dgos so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dbus kyi phur bu phyung / ye shes pa lag pa'i rdo rje la thim/ phur khung rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i rdul tshon gyis 'gengs bzhin du dril bu dkrol la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid nya'ajam dbyangs rgyal po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa'i don dran bzhin du glur blang ngo / /dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa 'bri ba mtha' gcig tu dgos pa —203—

ni ma yin no/ /de nas ci bder 'gyed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi cha thams cad kyi kha dog dang mtshan ma ni spyi dang 'dra la/ bum pa brgyad kyang 'bri/ le tshe dgu'i dbus ma sngo ba/ g.yin rnams phyogs mdog ka ba nag po rang rang gi mawo ma can/ gdung zlum nag po la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba'o/ /lha mtshan bskyed chog las shes shing / glang rgyab phyogs mdog dang sngon po gnyis kar mi 'gal lo/ /gal te 'phreng ba ltar na yang skyog po dang mig gsum yang gdam nga yin no/ /rigs kyi byin gyis byas pa'i bya ba bsdus pa dang / da chu ṇa sto rla'i bya ba kun las btus pa'i lugs rnam grangs su bzhag pa thams cad kyang / de'i lugs kho na yin pas de ltar bya la/ de nas skabs 'dir thig tshon la lhan cig tu/ mchod bstod byas te ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba'am/ gong du thig dang / 'dir rdul tshon gyi dge bsgrubs na yang / shin tu legs so/ /de ltar 'bri ba'i bya ba zin pa na/ spyi dang mthun par bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba dang / las bum gyis khrus gsol rnams byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas shing bsrung rgyan dang / mchod rdzas kun la'ang las thams cad pas bsangs gtor byas nas/ sa rgyan/ gnam rgyan rnams bkram/ mchod pa sta gon gyi dus las mi nyung ba nges par bshams dgos shing / mang ba la ni tshad med do/ /bum pa yang lha so so'i gnas su 'god pa'am/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon du 'god pa'am/ phyogs mtshams su 'god pa ci bde bar byas la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byasal/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la 'jug go /de yang de dag nyin zhag de nyid la song zhing / mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa yin na ni/ skabs 'dir bdag bskyed byed mi dgos so/ /gang ltar dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'og tu oṃ las byung ba'i nas/ 'bar bas skor bar gyur/ de'i dbus su saX las rdo rje dkar po nas/ yongs su rdzogs par —204—

gyur/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams kyi rang bzhin dbus su/maX las ral gri maX gyis mtshan pa la yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ shar du bhuX las 'khor lo bhuX gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam snang sogs/ lho ru aX las rin po che aX gis mtshan pa las/rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ nub tu dzi las pad+ma dzi gis mtshan pa las/ 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du khaX las ral gri khaX gis mtshan pa las/ don yod grub pa sogs/ shar lhor laX las 'khor lo laX gyis mtshan pa las/ spyan ma sogs/ lho nub tu maX las ut+pal dmar po maX gyis mtshan pa las/ mā ma gī sogs/ nub byang du paX las pad+ma paX gyis mtshan pa las/ gos dkar mo sogs/ byang shar du taX las ut+pal ser po tāX gis mtshan pa las/ sgrol ma sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ dza las me long dmar po dzaXs mtshan pa las/ gzugs rdo rje sogs/lho nub tu hūX las/ pi waX sngon po hūX gis mtshan pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma sogs/ nub byang du baX las dri bzang ser pos gang ba'i dung chos baX gyis mtshan pa las/ dri rdo rje ma sogs/ byang shar du hoXlas ro drug gis gang ba'i snod dmar po hoXs mtshan pa las ro rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yas su khaX las lha rdzas kyi gos kha dog sna tshogs pa khaX gis mtshan pa las/ reg rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yon du raX las chos 'byung dkar po raX gis mtshan pa las chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs/ de thams cad kyang nas nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ khar sgor hūX las rdo rje tho ba rwa nyi shu pa huX gis mtshan pa las/ gshin rje mthar byed sogs/ lho sgor huX las rdo rje mtshan pa'i be con dkar po hūX gis mtshan pa las/ shes rab mthar —205—

byed sogs/ nub sgor huX las pad+ma dmar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ pad+ma mthar byed sogs/ byang sgor hūṃ las rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa huX gis mtshan pa las bgegs mthar byed sogs dang / khro bo bzhi po nas bzhugs pa'o/ /bdag nyid dang dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi pang du rme sha can gyi rigs las byung ba'i bu mo ut+pal mthing kha lta bu'i mdog can lo bcu drug lon pa/ gzugs dang mdangs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas gnas par gyur/ de nyid kyang maX yig dmar ser du gyur/ me las ral gri maX gyis mtshan pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas rdzogs par gyur/ yum gyis spyi gtsug nas snying ga'i bar du nas/ut+pa ko3haX/ de ltar rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo'i dbang po rang rang gi lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs shing gcig tu 'dus pa sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes pa nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par grub par gyur/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mkha' nas nang phyir spros/ khro bo bzhis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes kyi las mdzad par gyur/ oṃ ya ma rta krita dzaXnas hoX lha thams cad mig tu nas brgyan pa'o/ /lha —206—

thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi sngags brjod zin pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin bya'o/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du nas/yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang / rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ bdag pos dbu rgyan gyi bar sgrub chen chen po bzhin no/ /dbang gi lha thams cad kyang gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi skabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs zhes pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum ser sngo dkar zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur dgos/ yang rang gi thugs kha'i maX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaXnas/ ta krita hoX'i bar bsnyen pa chen po'i skabs bzhin no/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni/ sgrub thabs bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ mchod 'phreng du rgyas par bshad zin pa ltar/ mchod pa thams cad rdzogs par bya la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ de dag gi mthar bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya zhing / yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma ni/ skabs 'dir nges par 'bul zhing / de yang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs ma thag mdun bskyed kyi lha la phul bas mchog gis/gtor ma'i lha spyan 'dren pa mi dgos so/ /sgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na/ bar 'dir bya la/ de nas/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i cho gas phyogs skyong la nang gtor 'bul lo/ /phyogs skyong la phyi rol gtor ma kho na byed pa li lag len yang snang mod/ de la phyi rol tu phyi'i cho ga kho nas phul na/ nang gtor gyi cho ga ma tshang ba'i nyes pa dang / 'ga' zhig ltar nang chog gi phyi rol gtor ma btang na/ cho ga gabrul par 'gyur bas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la phyi chog nang chog gi dbye ba phyed 207—

par byas nas/ gnyis kar byed pa gal che'o/ /lag len mang po zhig la/ phyi rol gtor ma rnams nang chog kho nas byed kyin gnang kyang / dam tshig can phyi rol tu phyung ba'i nyes par 'gyur zhes de nyid rig pa dag 'doms so/ /de nas phyi rol gtor ma gtong ste/ gtor ma lcog zlum tshad che zhing /sha chang la sogs pa kha zas sku bag can gyis sbags pa/ ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pa btsugs pa zhig dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /chu gsum mam/ gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / nang mchod/rdo rje dril rol cha sogs 'dus byas/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu nas/dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /ma rdzo yon dang / nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ āXbadz+ra yu sna sogs kyis so sor phul/ oṃ āX dus gsum skyes pa kun dang / nas/ bsrung ba mdzad du gsol gyi bar gyis spyir bto/ de nas mchod pa rnams gtor snod du bsdus la/ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas kun 'grub shog /yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ 'jig rten 'di na nas/ bzod par gsol/ oṃ a kā ro mu nas badz+ra muXzhes gtor ma rol mo'i sgra deng bos gtsang sar dor/tsham rngams dang bcas te bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad do/ /slob dpon gyi rting mnan la 'ongs te/ nang du nye reg bya/rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs ste/ lha snam gyi steng nas bskor ba byas par mos la/ hūX bzhi pa bzla zhing / bskor ba lan gsum bya/ shar sgo nas/ me tog sngon po phul ste/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaXhūṃ baX hoX hi hi hi mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ yang nub sgo'i thad du song ste/ pad kor las huX mdzad kyi phyag rgya bkrol bzhin pas/ tso( badz+ra ut+pa/ ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya huX/ zhes pas shar sgo phye —208—

bar bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sgo bzhi char phye nas/ sa ma ya pra we sha ya mi/ zhes me tog phreng ba blangs te/ mgo la bcings/ tsho( pra ṇa ma mi sarba ta thā ga taX/ zhes phyag bya/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/bar 'dir sbyin sreg gi cho gas lha mnyes par byas nas spros pa la dga' zhing spro na slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ bskor ba'i gar dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ hūX huX/'khor ba 'don byed sku 'dzin pa/ /gnyis gnyis 'byud pa'i sbyor bas mchod/ /mi bskyod rdo rje khyod 'ba' zhig /te ṇa rgyuX/ te ṇa rgyuX/ te ṇa te te hūṃX/ khyod kyis zhabs kyis pad+ma la/ /lha dang mi yis 'dud pa'i mchog /sprul pa'i me tog sna tshogs bdag /mi bskyod rdo rje/ te ṇa huX/ dngos po rnam grol rnam par gnyen/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba 'dzin pa khyod/ /bdud rtsi mtha' med gsol la khyod/ khyod kyi dgongs pa pad rgyas min/ /te ṇ+ḍa sogs/ rtsom yang sems can don mdzad pa/ /rgyu med gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /te ṇ+ḍa sogs/ zla ba ltar mdzes sku gtsang zhing / /ston ka'i zla bzhin mdzes pa'i zhal/ /te ṇ+ḍa sogs/ phan tshun 'byud pa'i spyor ldan pa/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya mchog /te ṇa sogs/ bya ba khyab 'jug legs ldan gzugs/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis gzugs can te/ /te ṇa sogs/ sgyu 'phrul las kyi 'gro ba gzugs/ /rkyen gyis ma byas gzugs can yin/ /te ṇa sogs/ bkra shis dbyangs kyis bkang byas nas/ /thams cang/ kun gyis glu blang ngo / /te khyu sogs/ de ltar bkra shis kyis glu blang ngo / /de nas bdag nyid 'jug par 'dod na/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe yin yang rung min yang rung ste/ dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams ji tsho 'dod pa ltar sa blangs/ 'jug pa rgyas bsdus —209—

gnyis kas kyang rung mod kyi/ gtso bor rgyas pa bsngags so/ /de yang 'og tu 'chad pa ltar slob ma la dbang bskur ba ji lta ba bzhin no/ /sgrub cing mchod pa'i yan lag tu bdag 'jug gi dbang nges par blang dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /des na 'di dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang 'brel la/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang yang 'brel zhing / slob dpon nyes lhung gi dri ma phra mos kyang ma gos pa la ni/slob ma dbang bskur ba'i yan lag tu yang mi dgos par bshad mod kyi/ 'phags pa'i sa ma thob pa la de lta bu nyung ba'i phyir/ de'i sngon 'gror nges par sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i bya ba la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong dang /thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ bsam pa 'chos shing bu ru bya/ /gsol btab mos pa bskyed pa dang / /thun mong sdom bzung byin rlabs dang / /mchod dang so shing dor ba dang / /'byor chu ku sha bsrung skud spyin/ /spro ba bskyed cing rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar bcu gsum las/ dang po ni/rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ /de dag kun la dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga yang dag rjes su gnang / kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /slar yang dad pa ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas//zhes brjod la don sems su bcug /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba la gnas shing /snying khar yang raX yig las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kar 'bar ba —210—

las/ sdig sgrib dang / tha mal gyi phung po lhan cig tu bsregs te/ rnam shes slo āXhuX gsum du gnas par gyur/ de nyid slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūX gi 'od kyis bkug /zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ slar yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas/dbang bskur zhing mthar gnyis su med par thim/ huX zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ gral la rim pa bzhin du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda' sprad/ gsum pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu ga tre tshel/ /lan gsum gsol ba btab/bzhi pa ni/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin ste/ / bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi zad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug —211—

rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don wad do/ /lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes lan gsum/ drug pa ni/ las thams cad pa bzlas pas slob ma la bsrung zhing / rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas kyis slob ma'i snying ga la sogs pa gnas gsum du/ dri bzang gi chus thig le byed cing / 'bru gsum brjod pas/ snying gar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūX sngon po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āXdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams bsam du bcug /yang yas mar reg pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum spyan drangs te bstim la 'bru gsum brjod/ yang mas yar reg pas slob ma'i sgo gsum dang rdo rje gsum dbyer med par gyur/bdun pa ni/ mchod pa rnams las thams cad pas bsangs/ tso rna āX huX gis byin gyis rlabs/ me tog spyi bor byin pa sogs sam/ oṃ badz+ra puspro āXhūṃX/ sogs kyi mthar/dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos ltar/ /mchod pa kun dang khyod ldan pas/ /dus rnams kun tu bde bar mnos/ /zhes brjod/ brgyad pa ni/ dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi khru gang bas mi chung bar byas la/ so shing huX las byung bar mos te/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ slob mas kyang rtse mo nas 'cha' ba'i tshul byas te/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du ltos med du dor/phyogs bzhir las bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir gter kyi bum pa sogs dang /—212—

steng du rig 'dzin/ 'og tu sa 'og sogs 'grub pa dang / phyi rol tu lhung na grub pa med par bstan no/ /dgu pa ni/ dung chos kyi chu la las thams cad pa lan bdun bzla/ de nas tseX( khyiXbi shurnya sarba dharma sarba pā paX ni tsa a gya sha/ dh+wa ya/ sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya huX/ zhes 'khyor ba bkang te mthung du bcug /bcu pa ni/ ku sha bsangs sbyangs/ huX dang dhīXlas byung ba'i ku sha che ba stan dang / chung ba sngas kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ hū ཾ ༷ dhīX zhes sbyin/ ga rtog rtseg pa ni/ slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu dmar po gsum ltab tu sgril la/rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bto/ de bsangs sbyangs/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu slob ma'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mthu can du gyur/ las thams cad pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ las thams cad bzla bzhin du 'ching ste/ skyes pa la dpung pa g.yon dang / bu med la g.yas dang / byis pa la mgul du bcings/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i gzhung 'grel las/ skyes pa la g.yas su 'ching ba 'dug na'ang / rgya dpe ma dag pa'am/ 'gyur gyi gzhi'i bod dpe 'khrul ba'am/lo tsā ba thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa gsum las ma 'das so/ /'dzoganyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal ba bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang —213—

bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod rnams kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la/don pond/ bcu gsum pa ni/ khyed rnams do nub dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'am gnas khang g.yin du yang rung ste/ ku sha chung ba sngas su bcug /che ba stan du bting / dug gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas/ lha dang bla ma rjes su dran bzhin pas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol cig /des dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rmi lam gyi khyad par rnams mthong bar 'gyur bas/ rmi lam ci byung ba thams cad nangs par nga la smra dgos so/ /kyai/ bu dag nyon cig do nub ni/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs bzhin du nyol/ /khyod kyi rmi lam dge mi dge /mthong ba tho rangs bdag la smros/ /spa brjod la/las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bsang chus gtor zhing bzung ba bya'o/ /'di'i mthar yang gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod na/ sman zhabs kyi gzhus dang mthun pas legs so/ / gnyis pa ni/rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang phan chad bskur ba la dgos kyi/ rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam bskur ba la mi dgos par bshad na'ang / ding sang dbang bskur phyin chad bzhi char bskur ba ltar na/ 'di yang —214—

slob ma thams cad la bya'o/ /de yang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang / /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /zhes slob dpon gyis dris pa la/ gsang ba nas/ bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan btab/ de nas sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas snar+sha5 dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu byin/ /'di ni rin chen rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom par rtag tu bshad/ /phyi nang theg pa gsang ba gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /zhes dang / spro na/ de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu —215—

bshad/ /spangs shing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bar zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bslab par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod la log par mi spyad cing / /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar brten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su bsrung / /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yong mi spangs/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya ba the ne pa mtshon cha dang / /mtsho ni cha 'gog par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ /ces pa rnams kyang brjod do/ /de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /—216—

dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog r+ṣa po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyid nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma dgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum mo/ /'di sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i bar du byed par kha cig 'dod na'ang / gzhung thams cad nas slob ma lhag gnas nyid du gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma la ji tsam dbang bskur ba rnams bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul gyis slob dpon gyis blangs te/ mthar dam tshig gsum gyi glu dang / bden pa'i stobs brjod —217—

pa ni/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes su chags/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid kyis ni bdag grub mdzode/ ṣe/na tu rnam dag kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /dam tshig mchog gyur 'dod pa mchog khres rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces brjod do/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bya ba ni/ gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / zhugs nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gdong g.yogs dang bcas pa'i bya ba dang / dkyil 'bor mthong —218—

ba'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la yang phyi 'jug dang / nang 'jug gnyis las/ dang po la/ slob ma rnamasakhrus byas/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsol btab/ slob ma dang / mas gos rnams lhan cig tu las thams cad pas bsangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a laṅka ra wasta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āXhūX gis smad g.yogs dmar po dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haX gis stod g.yogs dang /oṃ badz+ra urdzi ṣa hūX gis gtsug tor sngon po bcing ngo / /'di gsum 'phreng ba'i de sbyar ba ma yin par 'jig rten snang byed kyi 'grel par shan+ti pas bshad do/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra mā na ya hūX gis mig dar bcing / yang las bum gyi chus slob ma la gtor zhing / tsho( āXbirtswan tā krita hūX hūX/ rang skad cig gis rnam snang dkar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūṃ/ mig tu k+ṣi nas/ lte bar saX sngon po/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃX/ sogs slob ma sta gon bzhin 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis lus gsal zhing dag par byas/ shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol du gnas par mos shig /de nas rigs dang mos pa brtag pa'i phyir du/ kyai/ khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan gdab/ slar yang 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang / bdug spos phul la/ ā khaX lī ra hūX gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng na/ don dam byang wo sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po gyen du langs pa/gsal btab la/ 'di'i rjes bzlos bya/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+ta da ya mi/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar gtso/sa la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya stuX ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi brlabs par 'gyur gyis/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i —219—

dkyil 'khor 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams so/ /de dag la bar sdom ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab/ /bsangs dang mas 'jug gdong g.yogs dang / /bgegs bskrad lhar bskyed mig sogs sgrub/ /sgo gsum byin rlabs dri lan bya/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod dang sems bskyed dang / /brtan bskyed gsang gdams phyi 'jug yin/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas oṃ āXya mun+ta krita huX/ sogs sgo ba bzhi'i snying po dang / ā khaX wi ra huX dang / na maXs man+ta ka ya wa ka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaX/ oṃ ṭak+ki huX dzaXzhes pa dang / huX bzhi pa'i sngags rnams brjod kyis rim pas sgo bzhi nas dang / re ga lnga'i nang du 'jug pa dang / lag nas khrid pa dang / bgegs rnams bsrung ba'i don du'o/ /skabs 'dir thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba sgrub thabs kyi rgyun bshags ltar bya'o/ /dam bzhag rnam pa bzhi ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub g.yin rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyed kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra zhig /dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dbang gi ye shes gsang bar gdams pa'i sgo nas dang / rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu drag te gshe/gas/ /zhes ye shesadabab pa la brten nas dang / thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu —220—

'thung shig /oṃ badz+ra ud ga ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ces dam tshig bsrung ba'i sgo nas dang /rdo rje spyi bor nas sa la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyu/ra ta re/ zhes bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la ba 'ag go/'di rtag tu 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i phyag 'tshal bdun dang / nyes dmigs kyi dam bzhag gnyis pa ni/ rang gzhung rnams nas ma bshad pas/ mi dgos par mngon no/ /de nas thal mo sbyar te/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig /lan gsum/ skad cig gis rang nyid slob ma 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i snying gar laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa la grwa bzhir rdo rje dang / dbus su thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo huX nag po mtshan pa/ mgrin par baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āXdamar pos mtshan pa/spyi bor yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su/ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo ha dkar pos mtshan pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng na/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ long bu gnyis su rdo rje gsum bskul bar byed pa'i sa bon dzhaiXdamar po me'i rang bzhin can/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od —221—

zer phyung / rlung g.yos me sbar/ dzhaiXyig bskur/ de las 'phros pa'i me 'od rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhug/sa pas lus gang / snying ga'i sa bsregs/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan pas/ chu'i dkyil 'khor las babs pa'i bdud rtsi sa la thim pas/ bde drod 'bar te lus sems mchog tu tshim pa thob/hūX āXhe'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang / bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i lus la thim par gyur/ bdud rtsi lnga dang / gu gul gyis bdug cing / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ āXbe sha ya staX bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ huX āXha dzhaiX zhes drag tu bzlas shing dbab bo mthar/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ lan gnyis kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bldan nas brtan par bya/ 'dir lung ston 'dri ba ni da ltar mi mkho la/ bden stobs brjod pa'ang rang gzhu pa nas ma po gad pas mi dgos so/ /de nas nam mkha'i kha dog dri zhing dngos grub lung bstan/ traX las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog phul bar mos te/ pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoX zhes rjes zlos byar gzhug /de yang sngar me tog 'phreng ba lag tu gtad pa/ de'i nang nas me tog phra mo gcig 'bul ba yin pa las/ 'dir me tog de 'phreng ba dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgo la bcings par mos te/ pra te gro sna stuX/ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes me tog slob ma'i spyi bor byin no/ /bar sdom ni/ 'jug sngags tshan bzhi rgyun bshags dang / /dam bzhug bzhi dang gsol ba btab/ /ye shes 'bebs dang brtan byed dang / /nam mkha'i mdog 'dri lung bstan dang / /me tog 'bul dang 'phreng dbang bskur/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bya ba ni/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ gyi 'od kyis ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal bar mos su bcug la/ oṃ rdo rje —222—

sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed khrar ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /ces mig dar bkrol/ he badz+ra pa ju zhes blta bar bskul/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo rdzogs par bstan dgos la/bdag 'jug la ni rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i che ba brjod pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho ho zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug do /bar sdom ni/ mig byin rlabs dang mig dar dgrol/ /blta bar bskul dang lha ngo bstan/ /ched du brjod pa rnams su bshad/ /de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa mtha' dag bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gnyis las/ dang po la/ chu dang cod pan dang /rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / ming dang brtul zhugs te drug go /de yang phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kya rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag lha sko5/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas thams cad la thun mong du las bum gyi chus gtor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsang ngo / /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na bgegs la gtor ma byin te bskrad pa dang / til dang chus byur bsal ba'ang bya'o/ /de nas dbang dngos la/ chu dbang ni/ gtso bum du bum pa g.yin rnams kyi chu bsdus la 'di —223—

skad ces bya ste/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ oṃ swā bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba nas/ pad+ma 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ de las dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi lha gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i huX gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dza hūX baX hoXganyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis zhes brjod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs/ lan gcig /dbang bskur ba po'i lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ huX zhes gsung bzhi dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / bde ba chen po myong / dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhuX/ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang / rol mos ma rdzo/ de ltar na dbang lnga las chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon nus pa mthu can du byas so/ /'dir bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel dang /dngos grub 'byung gter gnyis ka las chu dbang dang / cod pan sogs bzhi po la/ rgyas bsdus med par mdzad cing / rdo rje slob dpon gyi skabs thog mar dbang lha spyan 'dren pa dang / mjug tu shis —224—

pa brjod pa mdzad pas/ 'di'i rang lugs 'di kho na yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te/ stong par gyur/ oṃ su bhā wa sogs stong pa'i ngang las/ aX las rin po che aX gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nas/ 'dzin pa/ dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan can/ spyi bor oṃ nas/ thugs ka'i huX gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ ar+ghaX nas/ shaga'i bar gyis mchode/ rin chen rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ byang chub rdo rje sogs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid tshe/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ti3 huX/ zhes dbu gyon mgo la bkon/ oṃ badz+ra tu rtsi ho/ zhes dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsung zhing / nas/ rin chen 'gyung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin mchod dbang lnga las cod pan gyi dbang : nga rgyal dang ser sna: tshor ba'i: mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes: rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdo rje'i dbang ni: de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje: dzi las pad+ma dzi gis mtshan pa las/gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po nas/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/'od dpag med sogs kyis bstod/ 'od dpag med yab yum: rdo rjer gyur/dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la —225—

bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyi longs / /oṃ sarba nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang / 'dod chags/ 'du shes kyi/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ khaX las ral gri khaX gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang / don yod grub pa ljang gu/ nas/ don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ don yod rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/don yod grub pa yab yum/ dril bur/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi ṣañca huX/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā ma ya stuX/ don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/dril bu'i dbang / phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi/ bya ba grub pa'i/ don yod grub pa'i/ ming gi dbang ni/ dbang rdzas/ me tog 'phreng ba'am/rdo rjer bcas pa'i dril bu/ zlaX las 'khor lo zlaX gyis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rnam par snang mdzad dkar po nas rnam ma rdzod kyi dbu rgyan can/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /sogs kyis bstod/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum/ me tog phreng bar gyur ces sam/rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bur gyur ces brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi khiñca mi/badz+ra nā maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal sne mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes ming dbang bskur zhing / rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ rnam snang gis dbu rgyan/ ming gi dbang / gti mug dag /gzugs kyi/ cho se dbyings ye shes/rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de ltar dbang lnga bskur bas/ rang rgyud kyi phung po lngar ma zad/ snang ba thams cad kyang rang gi sems dang / sems nyid de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhi du shes par byed dgos te/ rang la dngos kun gang snang ba/ / de ni gtso chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /gang de'i sangs rgyas ye shes nyid/ /chos kun rang —226—

bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing / don rgyas par bshad do/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ 'dir dam tshig gsum sbyin pa la byed de/ dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcing / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /lag pa g.yas su gtad lan gsum gsor la snying gar gtod du bcug la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX/dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi huX/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes brjod pa'i don bshad la bsgom du bzhug go/dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las dril bu as mtshan pa las/ kun tu bzang mo dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las dril bur gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyis rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces lag pa g.yon tu gto la/phyogs brgyad du dkrol du skug la/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ zhes brjod cing /don shad la bsgom du 'jug go/'di skabs rdo rje dang dril bu skad cig gis lhar bskyed pa'ang yod pa ltar rung ngo / /de nas slob ma nyid bsangs sbyangs/ skad cig gis kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po dkar po nas/ rin po ches spras pa/—227—

lha sku yab yum gsal stong la sems gtod du bcug ste/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis/ /gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlas/ /rang gi rigs pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab gyur pa/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /mi bzad dka' thub sdom pa ni/ /brten kyang mi snang mngon shes dang / /mkha' spyod sku gsung thugs rnams las/ /byung ba'i dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /'gyur med mchog gi cho se brnyes so/ /sdug bsngal ma yin bdag bde bas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams brten/ /gang gzhan dman par bshad pa rnams/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur zhing / /ye shes don gnyer chags can gyi/ /sbyor bas sku gsung thugs rnams ni/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces brjod la don bshad cing bsgom du 'jug go/slob ma'i dbang kho na bskur na dbang lha rnams 'dir rtsa ba nas stim dgos la/ slob dpon gyi dbang yang bskur na 'og tu snga phyi lhan cig tu stim pas chog go/'dir dam tshig gsum 'dzin du gzhug go zhes pa'i tshig la rten nas/ dam tshig dang po gnyis bzung ba'i tshig la rjes zlos byed pa'i lag len yod kyang / gsum kar 'dzin du 'jug par gsungs pa las/ phyag rgya sku'i dam dzig slob mas brjod rgyu ma yin par shin tu gsal bas/sems kyis 'dzin cing bsgom du 'jug pa'i don yin no/ /dbang de tsam ni slob dpon gyi sgom pa bzung bar mi nus pa la yang sgyin pa yin te/ 'jig rten snang byed kyi 'grel pa las/ yang gang zhig rig pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam sbyin nam zhe na/ slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba don du mi gnyer ba'am/ de don du gnyer yang spyi'i sdom pa nyi tshe tsam len par byed kyi/ slob dpon gyi sdom pa ni ma —228—

yin pa dag la'o/ /zhes dang / rig pa'i dbang bskur bas ni/ thun mong gi byang chub nges par thob kyi/ khyad par gyi yang dag pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de tsam la mtha' rten yang brtul zhugs kyi mthar bzlas lung dang / gsang bar gdams pa tsam byed kyi/ mos pa dang / spro ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i phyir yin na ma gtogs/ rjes gnang / lung bstan/dbugs dbyung / gzengs bstod rnams mi bya bar bshad la/ dbang 'dis rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tsam po rnams dang / rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig nyi tshe tsam thob pa yin la/ rigs lnga so so'i sdom pa dang / spyi'i khyad par gyi dam tshig dang / sdom pa ni mi thob par rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang la dbye na/ rgya che ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang / zab mo gong ma'i dbang gsum dang / spyi'i mtha' rten rnams so/ /de la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar 'os pa rnams la ni/ mos na dbang lhag ma rnams kyang nges par spyin dgos te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ gang la dbang bskur 'di sbyin pa de la/ gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / khyad par gyi byang chub thob pa'i nges pa zhes pa'i don yang /de nyid kyi ni rdo rje 'chang r+ṣa po 'di nyid ni/ rdo rje r+ṣa po'i dbang bskur ba dang / phyir mi ldog par dbang bskur ba dang / slob dpon du dbang bskur bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes tshe 'di nyid la phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob pas sangs rgya ba'i dus nges pa la bshad do/ /de la gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gi thog ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dngos dang / mtha' brten gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btang 'khor lo phyir mi lde rwag pa sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ gsang ba chen po sogs dri ba dris lan bya/ che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal lko —229—

dkyil 'kho‘ra gyi lha la gsol ba btang/ des kyang gnang ba byin par bsam/ sta gon gyi skabasabazhin sdom pa bsgrags bzung bya/ 'jig rten snang byed dang / dngos grub 'byung gter gnyis ka las/ slob dpon gyi dbang kho na la dbang stegs bshad pas/ khrus kyi khang pa'i gzhal med khang bris/ khrus stegs bang rim gsum pa'i steng du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad shing stan dang bcas pa bya/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas spras la/ mchod pa'ang bshams/ ma 'byor pa'i ma grub na dkyil 'khor gyi shar du dbang gi gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo gcig nub tu bstan pa/ dbus su khrus stegs bang rim gsum pa la/ rin po che dang pad+ma'i gdan/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' skor du mchod pas skor bar gyur/ /zhes pa wo/ khrus khang mi byed na/ shar gyi lha snam la rin po che dang sogs/ yid kyis bsgom pas kyang chog go /dbang gi ngo bo ni/ chu dbang kho na bskur ba'i lugs mang du 'dug kyang / dngos grub 'byung gter las/ bum pa gtso sogs bzung byas nas/ /sngon bzhin chu sogs dbang bskur bsam/ /ces gsung pas dbang lnga char dgos la/ dam tshig gsum dran pa'ang zhan byung du yod pas/ sngon bzhin zhes sngar bskur ba'i dod thams cad 'dir bskur bar gsungs so/ /de nas 'di skad ces/stong pa'i ngang las/ dbang stegs kyi steng du/ rang sems hūX dkar po las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po/ sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug nas rin po ches brgyan pa'i bar mi bskyod pa dang 'dra/ spyi bor oṃ nas huX/ rgyas pa la spro na/rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngon du skye mched byin rlabs kyang byed cing / shin tu rgyas pa las dga' bas ni byin rlabs de rnams kyang bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sngar ji skad bstan pa ltar/ sems nyid —230—

spros pa thams cad dang bral ba snying rje chen po'i rnam par snang ba rdo rje'i de kho na nyid dang / rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu'i chos kun yang rnam par btags pa'i ngo na nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa'i stong nyid ni dril bu'i de kho na nyid dang /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i sems kun tu bzang po yab yum gyi sku 'ja' tshon lta bur shar ba ni phyag rgya'i de nyid de dam tshig gsum po de nyid dran par gyis shig /rang nyid kun tu bzang po yab yum rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya chen po gsal stong rnyog pa med pa la sems bzhag cing / rang gi yid ngag lus gsum rnam par dag pa thugs gsung sku rdo rje te rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i snying rje chen po dang stong pa nyid phyag rgya tshen po'i mtshan nyid can ste byang chub kyi sems mdun bskyed kyi/ yid kyi lus rang snang gi rig ma la 'phyud pa'i bde ba chen pos sems gang ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin te/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan las kyang / /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /bzung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes gsung pas khyed rang rnams de kun gyi rnal 'byor la gnas bzhin pa la/ dbang rnams rim pas bskur bar mos shig /slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i maX las 'od zer 'phror sa/ /zhes pa nas/ shrī huX/ yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin te chu dbang dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ski nyu hūX zhes dbu rgyan dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /zhes sogs kyis rdo rje dang / shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang / /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed phyir/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes dril bu dang / oṃ badz+ra a dhi sogs ming gi —231—

dbang bskur ro/ /slar yang brtan byed du dbang bskur rdo rje nas sbyin par bya/ /spyo gsung zhing / bum pa'i chu gdabang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang slob ma'i lus la gnyis su med par thim/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbang rtags rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu bgyon cing / thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yang grub par gyur/ de ltar khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba la/ brtan bzhugs ni bgyis par mos shig /byas la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor/ bkra shis mchod pa/ brtan bzhugs gsum la rol mo bya'o/ / gnyis pa la ni/ de nas 'a skad ces/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /ded dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsung / /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas//khyed kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ khyud pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes bugs dgung ba skabs 'di sman zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /dbang bzhi char ni nub cig kho na la byed na/ skabs 'dir rjes gnang kho na sbyin pa yin la/ nub so sor byed pa'am/ bum dbang tsam las mi bskur ba yin na/ 'chad 'gyur rjes gnang rnams kyi mthar bgrung skud ba khas/ gsang bar gdams/ lung bstan/ ngo bo nyid kyi sems can don sogs brjod mi dgos/ de nas dbugs dgung ṣ+ka gzengs bstod do/ /de kho na nyid rnam pa gsum brjod pa ni/ rjes gnang gi sngon la byed pa'i lag len mang zhing / tshad ldan 'gas kyang —232—

4gad mod kyi/ lugs 'di la ni rjes gnang gi mjug tu bya bar gsungs so/ /des na rjes gnang dang / de nyid brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngags dbang mig thur me long dang / /dril bu mda' gzhu yang me long / /chos bshad sprul bshad sems can don/ /sgom sgrub rjes gnang bsrung ba'o/ /zhes bstogacig las/ sngags dbang ni/ sngags kyi dbugs gshi gi rjes la byed pa'i lag len yang snang mod kyis/ 'phreng ba ltar thog mar byed na legs pas/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i gtso bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gsal bas/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang mi bskyod pa'i sngags/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar yang rang rang gi sngags gsal btab la/ bco me ldan bdag la bstsa'/ lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes me tog gtor zhing /gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung / slob ma'i kha sgo nas zhugs/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar 'khod par gyur/ wom pa'i rdo rje'am/ mi bskyod pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rnams gsum gsum la sogs pa rjes slosabya'o/ /yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags 'phreng dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs te snying ga'i gzungs sngags la thim pas sngags rnams nus pa mthu can du gyur/ me tog le sgor wo / bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /spa brjod do/ /de nasamig thur gyi rjes gnang ni/ mig thur gyis mig sman byug pa'i tshul bya zhing / tsho ( badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ri pa ṭa laX hri/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal —233

ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /zhes so/ /me long dang po ni/ chos thams cad snang stong du shes dgos pa'i brdar/ me long bstan la/chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /lko brjod cing don spyod/ dril bu'i rdo rje gnang ni de nas don dam skye 'jig thams cad las grol ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes pa'i brdar dril bu'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa yin te/ dril bu bkrol bzhin pas/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /ces brjod mda' gzhu'i ni yi ge ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu gtad cing / phyogs bzhi steng 'og ste drug tu 'phang ba'i tshul byed cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ /zhes brjod du gzhug /de nas me long gnyis pa ni/ a las byung ba'i me long / oṃ badz+ra sa tra a/zhes gto la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems yin par shes par gyis shig /ces brjod la don spyod/ chos shad ni/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du oṃ badz+ra he tu maX/ zhes pas 'khor lo/ lag pa g.yas su oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa tha gyi dung / lag pa g.yon du oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi a yis dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar raX pang du āXzhes rgyud kyi po ti gto la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /brtsams te chos kyi 'khor —234—

lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces so/ /bdag 'jug dang slob ma dbang skur gyi skabs gang yin yang rung ste shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas mig thur nas de yan chad bzhag kyang rung zhing / rje gnang 'di dag dbang bzhi pa'i mthar sbyar na'ang legs pa yin no/ /rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal du rim pas 'phor bcug la/ tshigs bcad re re bzhin rigs so so'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogasa'adul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhi du/rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /ces pa'o/ /de nas sems can gyi don gyi rjes gnang ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can gang / /ji lta ji ltar 'dul gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /chags sogs dag pas sgrub par gyis zhes so/ /bsgoms shing dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjesaganang ni/ nyin re bzhin yang dus gsum du/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang / /ldan pas thun mong cig shos ni/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /mi snang bar ni stong thig dang / /mngon shes ldan pas stong gnyis snang / /rig pa 'dzin pas stong gsum dang / /rdo rje can gyis 'gro kun bdag /g.yin —235—

yang zhi dang rgyas la sogs/ /gang la ci 'dod las rnams ni/ /'khor lo rjes mnyes sbyor ba yis/ /bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /lkog brjod cing don bshad/ bzung ba ni/ las thams cad pa'i bum chus bsangs shing / sta gon bzhin zung skud 'dogs so/ /bzhi brgya lnga bcu par/ rjes gnang phyi ma gnyis lung ston gyi phyis su mdzad pa ni/gzhung der lag len bsdus pa la dga' ba'i dbang du mdzad nas rjes gnang thams cad kyang gnyis po der 'du ba la dgongs te/ sngags dbang nas sprul bshad kyi bar mi byed phyin chad/ dbang bzhi nub gcig la bskur ba la/ mtha' rten thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas na 'ju ga pa bde bar dgongs so/ kha skong rnams byed cing / rjes gnang rnams bum dbang gi mthar byed pa'i tshe/ 'dir bshad pa ltar byed pa na gnyis kyi man ngag dang / lag len las 'byung zhing / bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel par yang shin tu gsal lo/ /yang rnam pa cig tu na/ mda' gzhu sbyin pa yan chad bum dbang gi mthar sbyar nas/ chos bshad dang / sprul bshad dang / sems can gyis don byed pa/ sgom zhing dngos grub sgrub pa/ bzhi char lung bstan gyi mthar byas na/ 'phreng ba sogs dang mthun pas shin tu legs so/ /des na chos bshad sogs 'dir byed cing / sems can don gyi rjes gnang sogs bzhi pa'i mthar byed pa ni/ lugs gnyis ka dang yang mi 'grig go/gnyis pa ni/ mi mnyam med pa zur bzhi ste/ sogs bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i tshig bzhin brjod nas don zhi ba mor spund na'ang shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang de kho na nyid dang po gnyis ston byed kyis tshig rnams dang / sgub thabs kyi gzhung gi/ tshig rnam dag rnams/ shin tu go dka' bar 'dug pas/ dngos grub 'byung gter ltar brjod na/ rtogs bla ba'i phan yon yod do/ /de yang 'di ltar/sangs rgyas ma rgyas mnyam pa'i phyir/ khri/ bzhi ru ni rab tu bstan/ /dran pa nyer bzhag shar gyi sgo/ /yang dag spong ba lho yi sgo/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa nub kyi sgo/ /—236—

bsam gtan bzhi ni ta ra ṇa/ /ting 'dzin rnams ni kha khyer brgyan/ /gzung rnams der gnas lha mo rnams/ /bsam pa skong zhing lha tshogs brgyan/ /gsung rab yan lag sgra sogs so/ /rnam par thar brgyad ka ba brgyad/ /sngags tshul rdo rje'i phreng ba zlum/ /phyir log rnam dag yon to lnga/ /dri med stobs sogs mchod pa lnga/ /bum pa chus gang thugs rje dang / /tshogs rdzogs ser po ye shesagater/ /'gro ba rnams dang dbyer med kyang / /de ni nyes pas mi gos phyir/ /sna tshogs pad+ma bcu dgu ste/ /sdong bu dang ni bcas pa'o/ /mi dge 'dam rdzab skam mdzad cing / /dge ba'i myu gu gso mdzad pa/ /nyi ma'i gdan ni bdun rnams so/ /nyon mongs tsha bas bsil byed dang / /ma rig mun nag sel ba'i phyir/ /zla ba bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /nyon mongs thams cad las grol phyir/ /gzhal yas khang du brtags pa'o/ /snying po la ni 'dus pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang / chos dbyings rnam dag mi bskyod pa/ /gzugs thung gti mug che dang sku/ /me long rnam dag rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba'i phung po mnyam pa nyid/ /nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen 'byung / /'du shes phung po 'dod chags gsung / /so sor rtog pa snang mtha' yin/ /'du byed phung po nan to dang / /phrag dog rnam dag don yod grub/ /sa dang stong nyid thabs dang ni/ /snying rje zhi byed spyan ma'o/ /byams dang mtshan med smon lam dang / /chu khams srung byed mā ma gī /dga' dang smon med stobs dang ni/ /me khams rgyas byed na bza' dkar/ /btang snyoms ye shesarang bzhin gsal/ /rlung khams sgrol byed sgrol ma'o/ /sbyin pa rnam dag —237—

gzugs rdo rje/ /tshul khrims rnam dag sgra rdo rje/ /bzod pa rnams dag dri rdo rje/ /brtson 'grus rnam dag ro rdo rje/ /bsam gtan rnam dag reg rdo rje/ khres rab rnam dag chos rdo rje/ /'jig tshogs shes bya phung po'i bdud/ /dad dag gshin rje gshed 'gugs pa/ /nyon mongs de bdud mthar 'dzin lta/ /brtson dag 'jug byed shes mthar byed/ /skye 'grib 'chi bdag log par lha/ /dran dag 'ching byed rta mgrin no/ /las dang lha bdud mchog 'dzin lha/ /ting 'dzin mgu mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /ngo bo nyid de rnam bzhi ni/ /thugs sogs rdo rje ye shes sam/ /phyag rgya bzhi zhes bsha/da pa yin/ /rnam par rtog pa dang bral zhing / /gting dpag dka' ba zab mo ste/ /phyag rgya chen por rab snang bas/ /rang gzhan smin byed gsal ba po/ /zab mo dang ni yang dag gsal/ ṣe/sa rab thabs kyi bdag nyid ste/ /mtha' gnyis skyon ni rab bkag pas/ /thams cad dus su dbyer med do/ /zhes lha'i de kho na nyid de/ de bzhin du dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub kyi don du dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / sgrub pa dang / rab tu gnas pa dang / sbyin sreg dang / dbang skur dang / zhi ba la sogasapa'i las rnams ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de dag brjod par mi lcogs na/ /gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa yin la/ lha rnams ni phung po dang khams dang / dbang po yul dang bcas pa dang lta ba bzhi rnam par dag pa/ ye shes lnga dang / tshad med bzhi dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / dad sogs bzhi'i ngo bo yin no/ /zhes pa tsam brjod na'ang / phreng ba la sogs pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun no/ /—238—

de nas yang / de bzhin slob ma dbang bskur dang / dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs ni rab bstan pas/ /gang zag gnyis su shes par bya/ /gzugs brnyan glegs bam la sogs pa/ /yod na khyod kyisarab gnas mdzod/ /des ni ji srid bar du ni/ /sems can don du 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /bum dbang 'ba' zhig bskur ba'i tshe/rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi de ma thag tu 'di rnams brjod pa la spro na lung bstan dang dbugs sgo/nga dang / rjes gnang dang / dam tshig bstan pa rnams ma byas na sman zhabs kyi gzhung dang cung zad mthun par 'gyur te/ de dag gi mthar 'di skad ces/ de ltar na lus te gzugs brnyan can gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /zhes brjod de bum pa'i dbang mtha' dag bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi so sor bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spro na chu gnyis nyer spyod/ nang mchod/ na bza' sogs kyang 4nams/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin brlabs byas/ de tsam ma lcogs na yid kyis sprul kyang rung ste/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ slob mas mchod pa 'bul ba ni ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar dang / 'bru gsum dang /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya rnams kyis bya ste/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'i rjes zlos byas kyang rung ngo / /de nas yon phul te/ dbang gong ma sngon 'gro dngos gzhi spyi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ khyod kyis bdag la sogs pa 'jigs pa che las skyob/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun khyod kyis sdug bsngal —239—

sel/ /che ba'i tshe khyod khams gsum stongs slad skye bo skyongs/ /thog ma med khyod nga ro thigs pa steng cha med/ /rje btsun yi ge med khyod bdud rtsi bde stong rab dga' byed/ 'gro la phan phyir dga' bas sangs rgyas rnams kun la/ /rab dgyes bde ba mgon chen khyod kyis btang bar mdzod/ /skyon gyis ma gos bla na med pa'i byang chub lam/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal zhi mdzad skom pa ngoms mdzad cing / /'khor ba'i rba klong thar mdzad bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /dngos kun rgyal bas mi dpogs lam 'di bstan par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i zhi ba rdul dang rab bral zum pa spangs/ /sgom pa las 'das mkha' 'dra dri mas ma gos pa/ /sgyu ma kun 'das 'dod pa kun la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /de 'dra'i rje btsun khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dregs med 'jigs med byang chub chen po thob kyis bar/ /'khor bar mtsho bar 'jig rten dmyal rtsub ma ltung bar/ khyed gsung dam tshig sdom pa thun mong min pa rnams/ /bdag la sogs pas rtag tu rab tu bskyang bar bgyi/ /gar chen rnam par rol pas gar mdzad cing / /sna tshogs phyag mnye bcu dang bsgrims pa yis/ /pad+ma'i lo ma 'jam po brgyad phye la/ /gnyis med bde rgyu rdo rje bzhag par mdzod/ /gsang ba'i de nyid mi nyams gsal bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dam skyes zla ba yang dag 'du/ /thabs shes las byung dngos kun de nyid mchog /rje btsun bdag la phan phyir sbas pa shod/ /cesalan gsum dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ min kyang rung ste gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir 'grub na tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/sngon 'gro'i don du ma rdza phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i —240—

'khor lo rnam sbyong bar/ /de ring lhend pa'i rin wo gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la dka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa/ / dmyal ba nas ni gtso bos drongs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad mthar mdzad pa/ / mgon med bdag la thugs brtser ma sgyu di/ /ces kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab pa la/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur tshul las ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa/ /de ltar byang chub spyod pa sogs/ /dge ba'i tshul gsung gzhan gyis min/ /de bas bu khyod dam tshig dang / /sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar byos/ kha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' zhing / /de las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung / /dkon mchog gnod byed gzhom bya ste/ / bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrung / /lkogabasgrags la slob mas kyang de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes lan btab/ 'di ni dbang gong ma gsum gyi thun mong gi dam tshig bsgrags pa yin pa'i phyir/ sman zhabs kyis thog mar mdzad la/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu par tha mar gsungs so/ /des na dbang gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i bar du byed pa mi legs so/ /gnyis pa la gsang dbang dang /shes rab ye shes dang / bzhi pa'i dbang ste gsum mo/ /de'i dang po ni/ slar yang gsang dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dbang gi don du maho nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma lo bcu drug nas nyer lnga'i bar gang yang rung ba slob dpon la phul bar mos te/ 'di skad ces gsol 0gdab bo/ /rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba rab tu sgrub pa ste/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen —241—

sras su gyur pa rnams/ /yun ring stong pa nyid bsgoms pas ni rab tu gdung ba la/ /dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod/ /'dod chags de ni dri med kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /dag pa'i rdo rje 'dod chags dam tshig las ni phye mdzad nas/ /dga' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdung ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes dbang 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid la 'jog par mdzod/ /pad+ma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab phyung nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu ni bskams pa la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung ba'i ye shes chu/ /dri ma med pa rin chen spyir dbab dbang bskur gsol/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas/ /pad+ma'i gnas su rdo rje'i mdzod gtong ba/ /sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can brlag gyur pa/ /sbyor ba gzhan min ma thogs bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni dbang mchog bgyid mdzad cing / /rdo rje pad+ma phye ba'i tshul du sbyor mdzad la/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab ston te/ /bde ba thams cad sgrub pa nyid kyis mnyes mdzad gsol/ /zhes lan gsum bya/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ me tog bzung / bum dbang bskur ba'i nyi ma de nyid ma yin na/ slob dpon dang / rig ma yan lag bzhi bskyed kyis rgyas par bskyed pa blo yul du gsal 'debs dgos la/ sngar gyi 'phros yin na/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang gnyis su med pa/ oṃ shā n+ya ta yā sogs/ rig ma stong pa'i ngang las/ maX las ral gri maX gyisamatshan pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas rdzogs par gyur/ mig tu k+ṣi nas/saX sngon po/ snying gar huX nag po/ mgrin par ā:dmar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te nas mchod par gyur/ dga' ba'i sgras —242—
