sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa sku'i dbyibs rgyud/ nor bu'i rtse mor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas nas/ mthar mtheb srin gyis phyung la/ bum pa'am dung chos sam pad+ma'i snod du gas gong bzhi pad+ma'i dbus gnas zhes pa nas/spyir dbab dbang bskur ro/ /zhes dang / oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyis ni bdag po mchog/sems can ma lus bde bskyed bde ba chen po ste/ /de yis deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis rde/ga /ces sogs bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pas dbang bskur te/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yi/ /de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /tsho( āXhūṃX/ zhes thig le slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag /des kyang myangs la a ho / mahā su kha zhes brjod/ 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar/ shes rab las byung ba'i bdud rtsi myang ba'am spro na bya zhing /gang ltar yang rtsa khams byin gyis brlabs nas bde stong gi pad+ma'i dbus gnas rin chen zhes pa nas/ dbang skur ro/ /ye shes skyes pa'i nyams skyong du gzhug go khyud kyi rgyal po phyi ma las/mig yangs sngags kyi snod du rung / /me tog bcas bzhin sa bon dbyung / /blangs nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /sngags pas slob ma dag la sbyin/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dri chu rkang dang yang dag ldan/ /zhesabya ba'i rim pa dang / rdo rje pad+ma'i sbyor ba yis/ rdo rje can kun yang dag bsdu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /de dag thams cad snying gar bsdu/ rdo rje'i lam nas —243—

phyung nas su/ /slob ma'i khar ni dbab par bya/ /zhes dmigs pa'i khyad par gsungs pas/ dngos su byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang pad+ma las bzhengs par bya ba ni rgyud gzhan gyi dgongs pa dang / dri chu rkang dang sogs kyi don/ bum pa snyo thod par dam rdzas sbyar ba'i 4 sogs la/shes rab kyi me tog dang / thabs kyis sa bon bsres te/ sbyin pa ni/ dpal ldan 'dus pa dang zla gsang thig le sogs nang rgyud sde lnga'i dgongs par mngon te/ lugs 'di'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa thams cad nas bshad cing / gzhan yang gsang ba 'grub pa dang / rim lnga/ spyod bsdus/ sgron gsal rnam kyi'ang dgongs pa yin la/ des na snga ma mchog dang / phyi ma dman par byed pa ste/ snga ma smin byed kyi dbang dang / phyi ma rdzogs rim gyi dbang yin par bod snga phyi phal cher la grags pa rnams ni snying po yod par ma mthong ngo / /des na/ brda'i dbang la ni khyad par med kyang / dngos kyi dbang yin na gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs 'dir phyi ma nyid bya'o/ /de nas 'bru gsum gyi mig dar bkrol la de ltar na/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam thig le gsum gyi rnal 'byor snang bcas sgyu lus dang bcas pa sgom pa la dbang / ngag gi dri ma: 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod pa'i sku zhes 'don pa spo/ ciganyis pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas nyi ma gcig la 'di kho na bskur na/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs pa gong bzhin gsol ba 'debs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal nyan thos de bzhin te/ /sku gsung —thugs su spyor ba na/ /phyag 'tshal na ni ma rung 'gyur/ /kun tu rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor ra la/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gsum sbyor bas/ /sngar bzlas pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /mdor na sems can khams —244—

rnams ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi phyag 'tshal mchog /dam tshig rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ /glegs bam bklag par mi bya zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yong mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya'o/ /rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba nyid/ /sngags kyi sems dpas mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub brnyes par dka'/ /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo / /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /rgyal ba kun kyang mi 'da'o/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrags pa la/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /thams cad stong pa bla na med/ /mngon par byang chub mthong bar ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /las dang skye las rnam grol ba'i/ /tshe 'dir byang chub mchog thob pa/ /rang myong mtshan nyid gcig pa nyid/ /sems dpa' chen po bstsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya slob ma la gto/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyi brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa spyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ /zhes brjod/dri ba dris lan/ ched brjod kyang spyi dang mthun par byas kyang legs mod lag len bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir med kyang drang ngo / /lha mo 'di ni khyod dang mthun/ /sems chen khyod kyis 'dod pa gyis/ /yid 'ong bu mo 'di nyid —245—

ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis spyod du gnang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i cho ga yis/ /bu mo grol byed dga' sbyin ma/ /byang chub chen po grub pa'i phyir/ khyod kyis bde chen myong bar gyis/ /gzhan gyis sangs rgyas mi nus pas/ bu mo 'di ni yang dag mchod/ de bas mtha' med 'khor ba'i bar/ khyod kyis 'di dang 'bral mi bya/ /zhes gtad la de nyid chos khams rdo rje ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus dri snyo por byugs te/ smros shig bu khyod rdo rje can/ kha khrag khu ba la sogs dang / /dri chen dri chu sogs bza'am/ /bha gar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /gzungs ma nga la khyod spro'am/ /zhes dris pa la/ kye lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /dri chen dri chu sogs bza'o/ /lha mo khyod la bkur sti dgos/ /bha gar 'o byed nga mi rtog /ces lan btab bo/ /des kyang phyogs kyi gos can du gyur nas pad+ma gsal bar byas te/ e ma ho bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gal te cho ga bzhin rten na/ /de yi mdun na rtag tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bskur ba'i gnas/ /pad+ma dam par don 'di byed/ /rang byung bde ba chen po ni/ /'di na rtag par zhugs pa yin/ /bhañja mok+ṣa ho/ zhes pa nga du byon/ rang dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs ste stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang maX las ral gri maX gyis mtshan par gyur/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid dpal ldan nas/ ldan par gyur dang / rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma nas/ rigasabadag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin rdzogs par brjod la dmigs pa 'bogs/ khyad par bum pa'i chus dngos su dbang bskur/ yum gyi spyi gtsug zhesapa nas/ phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur gyi bar yang sgrub thab‘rga bzhin/ de nas yab yum phan —246—

tshun du blta zhing rjes su chags pa yang dag par bskyed/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis/ slob ma'i lus kyi lha rnams gsal zhing chags par byas/'od zer rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra zhugs pas/ de'i lus kyi lha rnams gsal zhing chags par byas/ 'od zer rnams yum gyi zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs pa sogs 'od zer rnams snga ma'i rim pas 'khor lo ltar yang nas yang du 'khor bar gyur snyi ta shi shi shi ha ha ha/ slob mas/ gnyis su med pa bde ba chen po mchog /lha mo khyod ni sgyu ma'i phyag rgya ste/ /zhal bzang khyod ni nga dang lhan cig tu/ /rnam par rtse bas mkha' 'dra myong bar bya/ /zhes brjod pa la/ des kyang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i na ṭi mtshon par byas ste/ bde mchog rgya chen bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i bde chen ngag dang ldan/ /mi g.yo tshig dang bral ba'i dbyangs snyan pas/ /bdag la khyod kyis rol pas bzhengs su gsol/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i rol pas snang mdzad cing / /byang chub snying por 'gro ba'i lam mchog 'dis/ khyud rnams yang dag gang la mi brten pas/ /bde wo yid 'ong nga yis grol bar gyis/ ho ho ho/ rol cig rol cig bdag la rol/ /'dod pa gyis shig dga' gsal ba/ khyod kyis gzhan du mi rtog pa/ /rtog pas the i ma byed cig /a la la ho/ zhes smra bar gyur/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i sbyor bas rjes su chags pa yang dag par brtsams shing /lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba'i ye shes rnam pa lngas/ rgyan pa thob par 'gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3stu/ zhesang rgyal bzung / de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bkug pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang 247—

sems thams cad byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba slob ma bdag nyid rig mar bcas pa'i/ phyag rgya bzhi la dbang bskur tshul gyis thim par gyur/ rmongs la gti mug bdag nyid sbyor/ /gti mug dga' ma yang dag ldan/ /gti mug rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /gti mug rdo rje rang nyid 'gyur/ /de bzhi du sbyar te/ sdang la zhe sdang / zhe sdang dga' ma/ zhe sdang rgyun/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ chags la 'dod/'dod chags dga' ma/ 'dod chags rgyun/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid/ rdo rje dga' ye shes rgyun/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes dbyangs snyan pa rol mo snyan por bcas brjod do/ /ye shes ngo sprad pa 'di skad ces brjod de/ nam mkha'i khams dang rdo rje sbyor ba las/ /yang dag spyan lhan bde chen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang gang yang dag dga' byed chags bral dga'/ /gnyis pa bden gnyis mthong byos brtan par gyis/ /pad mkhar rdo rje nor bu pad+ma'i snying / /gnyis lam sbyor gang rdo rje'i skyil krung sems/ /nor bu'i dbang du mthong byas gang bde bde/ /'gyur ba de nyid nges par ye shes te/ /'dod chags bral bar ma dmigs par/ /ye shes lha ni skad cig de ru gsal/ /'di nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin par bla ma mchog rnams kun gyis spund/ chu tshod brgyad dam nyin gcig zla phyed zla ba gcig tu'am/ /lo cig bskal ba'am bskal ba stong du ye shes de myong bya/ 'dam skyes la gnas bdud rtsi khu ba blo gros can gyi kha yis blangs nas btung bar byos/ /zhes brjod la don spund/ mig dar dgrol/ slob mas/shes rab dam pa mchog gi zhabs la phyag byas te / /gzhi'i don la bdag 'khru/la bas/ /g.yang sa 'di ru mun ring 'khyams/ /brgal dka' 'khor ba'i 'dam —248—

rdzab las/ /mgon khyod kyis ni di ring bsgral/ khyod ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gdul bya'i don du sku sprul pa/ /bdag sogs rnams kyis mchod bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi bsam pa 'di bzhes shig /ces brjod cing yon 'bul/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba/ lam dbang gi ye shes dang / 'od gsal bsgom pa/ yid kyi dri ma/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku zhes 'don pa spos/ dbang de gnyis ni rgyud phyi ma'i dgongs pa/ zhal lung gi bshad pa la/sman zhabs pa'i gzhung gis kha bskang pa yin la/ kho bos ni sman zhabs pa'i lugs rje bzhi gup+ta las thob/ zhal lung gi lugs khrid kyi sngon 'gror rje btsun pha bla ma las thob pa/ spyir dbang ni g.yin las rgyas par zhus so/ /gsum pa tshig dbang bzhi pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs pa zla li ri bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bka' drin gyis ni bdag la skyobs/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gsang / /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ de la don dam pa bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ bzhi pa de'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsum pa dang dpe don du sbyor ba yin la/ de ltar yang spyor ba bdun par/ rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po yi/ /sku ni blta bas mi ngom shing / /zhal gsum phyag drug ltar snang ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rig mas 'byud/ khres rab ye shes dbang dus su'ang / /mtshan nyid dpe yis tshul du gnas/ /zhes gsungs la/ de yang / rtsa rgyud las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs —249—

pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /stong pa nyid kyis rang bzhin no/ /zhes sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa yin la 'bras bu'i mthar thug de nyid chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyang yin cing / de nyid zab gsal gnyis su med pa dang / yan lag bdun dang / ro myang brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ /go brjod la don ṣ+ka mor spyod do/ /yang khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ khyod kyis ma byin par yang longs/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ /zhes bsgrags/ de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bzhi pa rin po che'i dbang / lam zung 'jug bsgom pa/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma/ 'bras bu sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid sku zhes 'don pa spo/ dbang dngos gzhi rnams bstan zin to/ /gsum pa mtha' rten ni/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang / lung bstan dang / dbugs dbyung ngo / /dang po ni/ lag g.yon slob ma'i lag g.yas su gtad la/rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas rig ma 'di ni mchog /gnyis su med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /gnyis kyi dngos pos mtshon pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar bral bar ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gis dngos grub med/ /'di ni mtha' rten yin pa'i phyir dang / 'phreng ba sogs las kyang bzhi pa'i rjes su bshad pas/ 'dir byas na legs par mngon cing / dbang gsum pa'i mtha' rten dang / bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro lta bur dgongs nas/ sman zhabs kyis de gnyis kyi bar du byed par gsung pa ltar byas kyang legs so/ /dbang gsum pa'i skabs phyag rgya bzhi la dbang bskur ba dang /—250—

mtha' rten rig ma'i brtul zhugs 'di gnyis bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las mi 'byung yang / sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa ni shin tu legs te/ rgyud phyi mar shin tu gsal bar 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon oṃ las byung ba'i shākya thub pa'i skur gyur/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal nas/ a gang zhig de ltar lung bstan pas/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi gtso/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis lung bstan no/ /zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yi/ /sdig pa kun las rnams grol te/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /ston pa mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung / /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tsho mi med/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid rnam par bstan mi bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs btang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bde bzung nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi —251—

bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun brnyas pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur/ /rim dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo wo po/ /dge la rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rim sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'di la legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ste/ khams gsum gyis ni rgyal srid che/ /bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster brten par gyis/ /'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa'i/ /rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /spyo brjod la don —252—

rgyas par bshad do/ /'di ni lugs 'di 'dzin pa rnams snying la 'bab pa'i tshig brjod pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad cing / 'phreng ba sogs las dbugs dbyung du gsungs la/ bod rnying phal cher la gzengs bstod du grags so/ /'on kyang tshad dang ldan pa'i dkyil chog shas che ba zhig tu/ gzengasabastod dbugs dbyung phal cher don gcig cing / res 'ga' lung ston pas gzengs bstod pa'ang yod/ dbugs dbyung ba de la dbye na/ rgyu'i phyogs nas rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa dang / 'bras bu'i phyogs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag par go ba bskyed du gzhug pa'i sgo nas rnam pa gnyis su yod do/ /de gnyis gang dang yang ma 'brel bar dam tshig bshad pa dang / gsang ba bsgrags pa la rgyu'i dbugs dbyung du byed pa ni legs pa ma yin par shes so/ /de nas spro na/ gdugs dang rol mor bcas pas slob ma dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te/ shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal du bcu skal/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes brjod la/ slar yang dbang stegs la bzhag ste/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyis/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhesabarjod de la mchog tu gsang ba'i sogs 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung dang / de ring khyod nyid sogs rgyu'i dbugs dbyung yin la/ phyi ma 'di rdo rje slob dpon gyi 'os su gyur pa la ma gtogs mi byed par bshad do/ /de nas slob mas kyang / gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /ces lan gsum gyis khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas —253—

brtsams te sogs kyis yon dbul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'dir slob ma zhes pa rnamasabadag 'jug gi tshe rang nyid ces 'don pa spos pas kho nas chog go/de nas nus na zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg gis kyang lha mnyes par byas/ khyad par dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod rgyas pa dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / glu gar la sogs pas mtshan mo'i lhag ma 'das par byas nas/ skya rengs gsum pa shar ba na/ mchod pa bshams pa'am kha gsos nas/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa dang / dus gsum rgyal ba'i sogs kyisabastod/ nang mchod 'bul/ rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i gsol ba btab/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ lhag pa dang ni sogs/ bag med spyod pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / oṃ āXhūX muX mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa las/ sku'i rigs rnams nas/ brtan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu 'a sarba dharmā ṇaX ā bya nus sno twata oṃ āX huX phaṭa/ zhes dang por lha mtshan rnams bsdus/de nas tshangs thig nas/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar rnams rdo rje'i rtse mos phyis/ mthar thamasacad phyags la bum par blug ste chu bor spyan drang ngo / /phur pa phyung zhing phur khung dgang / smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung dngos grub 'byung gter dang / / 'jig rten snang byed rtsa 'brel la brten nas/ /lo chen rje dang gnyan lugs dang / khyad par ga spos lo'i man ngag cung zad blangs/ /bod yul slob dpon bzhi dang 'phags yul gyi/ /paṇa grub gnyis las lugs 'di —254—

zhib mor thos/ /rgyud rgyal 'di dang lugs srol 'di nyid la/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog mchog tu gus pa thob/ /rim pa gnyis dang dbang gi cho ga la/ /go don gsal dag thun mong min pa dag /'chi bas ma gtugs bya bsam g.yengs na/ /dus gzhan zhig na 'dri bar 'dod pa tsam/ /de ltar rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang sngags kyi theg pa 'dir/ dang por 'jug sgo bar du srog shing mthar phyin dus na yang / /'bras bu smin byed dbang bskur nyid yin de yi cho ga rnams/ /bshad pa'i dge des 'gro kun mtha' dag rdo rje 'dzin par shog/ /khyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces pa 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so bzhir son pa la/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o/ / gcig zhus// bkra shis//—255—

'a po lha lnga' rge de de spra kā can gya dkyal 'khor gya cho ga 'khru/la ba 'a — bral bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khrul ba'i dri bral zhes bya ba/bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo//gang gi zung 'jug ye shes me chen gyis//dus min 'chi dang 'tshe ba sna tshogs dang //gnyis snang rlung gi rgyu ba bcas 'joms pa/khro rgyal dus kyi dgra bo la btud nas//dang po'i las can rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir//dkyil 'khor cho ga 'dus gsal go bde ba//gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir 'chad kyi//bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis dge bar mdzod//'dir skyon rje tshig da dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba dang bcas pa bshad par bya ste/de la/sa'i cho ga lhag par gnas pa/dngos gzhi'i cho ga/rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/dang po la/sa brtag pa spyi dang mthun yang /da lta lag len la mi byed pas/de phyin chad ni/'di ltar bya ste/sngon 'gro gtor ma la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/las kyis rdo rjes sngon 'gro gtor ma'i zhu 'bul bya/a mṛ tas bsangs/swā bhā was sbyangs/lag pa g.yas dang /g.yon gnyis ka rim gyis bstan la/skye( āXhuX zhes brjod/hoXzhes bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang /huX zhes 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas byin gyis bsas/rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang brdoX pa dang /gnas bdag gzhi bdag

yul bdag /grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra khyeXsarba slo tra pā le khyoX sarba bhā mi pa ti sa pa ri wa re khyoX sarba dh+wa te smoX oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ de bzhin sdu/ pu duX zhes sbyar te chu gnyis 'bul/ oṃ de sha di ka sogs kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam bco brgyad kyis 'bul/ de yang lag len/ gtor ma lcog zlum mtheb kyu rba mo brgyad kyis bskor ba byed cing / dbus ma de spyi bungs dang / bco brgyad po de rnams phyogs skyong bco lnga dang / snyo skyong dang /gzhi bdag dang / bgegs rnams la bsngo ba yin pas lan bco brgyad 'bul ba yin no/ /de nasa.oṃ da sha di ka sogs kyi mthar srin nas sha lta'i bar sbyar bsam rdzo/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po legs par bzhengs te/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i bsrung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim pa gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhing /stuXsgyi drag tu bzla ṣ+ka / rdo rje bsor/ rol r+sā dang cas te ga sto ma ga rngu sar bto ngo / /slob ma dbang bskur ram rab gnas kyi don yin na/ gong gi 'phrin bcol skabs/ bdag nyid 'ju/ga cing dbang bskur ba'am/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal/ na zhes pa'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par 'tshal na zhes 'don pa spo/—257—

sngon 'gro gtor ma gshed bskor spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung mod kyi/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa de nyid do/ /gnas yo byin rlabs kyi don du zhu 'bul byas la/ a mṛ tasabasangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang bhuX las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung / byed las rang bzhin gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyis bde bas tshim par byed pa/ ngo bo kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bzang zhing rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oṃ pu bye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXhūX/ tsho( badz+ra dhu pe āXhuX/ glu khebadz+ra ā 'e1 ke āXhūX/ glu( badz+ra ga rnye āXhuX/ skye( badz+ra ni wi te āXhūX/ oṃ badz+ra shasta āXhuX/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaX lan gsum brjod/ rol r+sā dang cas/ oṃ badz+ra lha rjer ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/sarba brnya slo tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra ṇi ta/ na da saX bha we ta/ badz+ra dharma lha da ya/sa rnyo ṣa ni/ hūṃX hūṃX hūṃX/ ho ho ho/ a 'a swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabasasems sngon du 'gro bas/ shu rgyu tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūṃX las dbyug pa hūṃX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nas/ dmar mos 'byud pa/ zhal cig phyag —258—

gnyis nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma nas/ yab la 'khyu/da pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dbyug pa dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa rnams kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pa ste/ 'di ni lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'o/ /de nas hrīXspyi cung zad bzlas la/ yungs kar dang thal ba cung zad bsres pa/dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs su lan gsum gtor zhing / khyiXsgyi lan gsum brjod/ ba byung gis byug cing / dri bzang gi chus bsang gtor byed bawo du'ang sdiXsgyi bzla/ slob dpon gyi lag pa gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su bzhug la/ tso r+sha bhu khaX/ lan gsum/ tha mal gyi sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ laX hūṃ/ lan gsum/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me de ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hūṃ/ lan gsum/ bskal pa'i bar du mi shigs shing brtan par gyur/ dkyil 'bor gyi sa gzhir slob dpon 'dug /de'i phyogs bzhi kyi mchod pa zug mas/ dam tshig dang ldan pa bzhi phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pas 'dug /slob dpon gyis/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs rdzogs par sgom/ slob ma bzhi po'ang gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa so so'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par byas la/ lhan cig tu bzlas pa cung zad cig bya'o/ /mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi nas/ a khaX sruhwa'i bar gong bzhin/ slob dpon gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba la/ phul bar mos te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pu byaX pra tismo swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhūṃX/ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og thig tshon gyi skabs ltar/ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba'i de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de nas so sos gsol ba gdab —259—

pa ni/ bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog ltar byas kyang rung mod kyi/ lag len la/ 'dus pa dang mthun par byed pa ni shin tu legs te/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim par/ dbang gi cho ga 'dus pa'i dkyil chog ltar bya bar slob dpon nyid kyi gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ dril sil dang bcas/dbyangs kyis brjod pa'am/ min kyang rung te/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor : /nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor : /byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / zhes so sor lan gsum gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /gal te gsol ba 'debs pa por 'os pa med na/ bdag nyid kyis brjod pas rung ngo zhes bla ma phyi ma rnams gsung ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor 'degs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐ badz+ra u sta bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo las bdag nyid gtso bo zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa can de/ dkyil 'khor gyi las la zhugs par gyur/ dbyug thod dam rdo dril lag tu bzung la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bgyi ba dang bcas pas gnas la/ rang gi mig g.yas su ma las nyi ma/ g.yon du ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur/ de nas lha la gzhi bca' byas la/ g.yon brkyang gi rkang stabs dang / hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ phrag pa —260—

g.yas nas/ g.yon gyi phyogs la gdong bsgyur la/ kro dha dhī sgyi hriX rdo rje'i lta zer 'bar bas bgegs rnams bsreg cing bskrad/ yang g.yas su bsgyur la/ kro dha tri ( dh+waXbasregs pa rnams sos shing byang chub kyi lam la bkod par gyur/ de nas dga' ba yongs gyur gyi 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song la/ gar gyi la byeng rtsal zhing / khyoXsgyiX'am hūX brjod bzhin pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'gros kyis g.yas bskor du bskor ba lan gcig bya zhing / spro na de nas rkang stabs bzhi'am brgyad kyang byas nas/ dbang ldan du gnas pas/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /rdo rje gzugs ni 'bar ba yi/ /lus gsum las skyes bsgom par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jigs par 'gyur gyi g.yin du min/ /zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ sa'i phyogs 'dir gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bya yi/ lha dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang yi dwags dang sha za dang / brjod byed 'byung po dang mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang / rnon po dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang rig sngags grub pa rgan po rgan mo g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa gang dag 'khod pa rnams dengs shig /'di ltar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thob nas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni/ phyag na rdo rje hūṃ zhes bya bas rab tu khros pa'i bzhin 'bar ba can rdo rje 'bar ba kun tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /a pa sa rdo/ shu bha dang khyoXsgyi drag tu bzla zhing /rdo rje bsor bas/ yungs kar brab/ gu gul bdug /rol chen bya ste de ltar lan gsum mo/ /'di la rigs lnga'i sgo nas bka' bsgo ba ni mi mdzad pas de tsam gyis chog —261—

go/de nas gang yang rung ba'i phur bu la dar dmar po'i cod pan dang / yungs kar gyi thum bu btags/dri bzang byugs/ gu gul bdug /bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ phur bu stod phra dog gshi/na rje gshe/da ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ smad phur bu'i rnam pa can/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhi khyod/ /sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas/ khro bo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bgegs rnams kyi mgrin pa zhag/sa pas bcings/ snying ga lcags kyus phub ste/ sdigs bzhin du bkug nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbang ldan gyi phyogs su hūX las byung ba'i 'brub khung zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du bor te/ khro bo rnams rang gi snying gar thim/ glu( gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba sdo rdziX phaṭa/ ki la ya/ gī la ya/ sarba pā paX phaṭa/ hūṃX hūṃX hūṃX badz+ra gī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bi snan kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūṃX phaṭa/ ces sgril shing btab/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal byung du phub te/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la btab pas/ lus g.yo ba med pa/ ngag rlud rgyu ba med pa/ yid rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba/ 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃX hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ phur bu'i gnas dang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur rab tu 'bar bas bsrung bar gyur/ smon lam dang shis brjod cung zad bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar phur bu skul bskyod mi bya'o/ /de yan chad —262—

kyi sdom ni/ gtor ma mchod pa tshar lnga yungs kar dang / /ba byung dri bzang gu gul phur pa dang / /rdo dril cang te'u nang mchod la sogs bshams/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod pa byin bebs dang / /lhan skyes rnal 'byor sa gzhi sbyang ba dang / /dkyil 'khor sgom dang mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ /nam mkhar 'degs dag mig dang rkang byin rlabs/ /bskor ba stang stabs bgegs la bka' bsgo bya/ /phur bu bskyed cing 'debs dang bsrung ba'o/ /de dag gi nub dang po la bya ba sa chog rdzogs/gnyis pa la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang / lhag gnas dngos so/ /dang po ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas/ spyi'i mchod pa cha tshang ba zhig bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sa chog gi skabs ltar mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ma yin kyang / skabs 'dir lag len la zhu 'bul mdzad pas/ phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal bshams/ phyag gsum btsal la me tog bskyed/ /phyag gsum btsal la zhu 'bul bya/ /phyag gsum btsal la me tog bsdu/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal/ 'bul/ /phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal/ bskul/ /phyag gsum btsal la gral du 'khod/ /ces pa ltar yin pa las/ gzhan rnams lag len mthong ba nyid kyis shes shing / gsol gdab ni/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /tshogs pa yod na 'di dag bya ba yin gyis/ gzhan du mi dgos so/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas rnams byas la/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang skad cig gis bstug na rje gshe/da/ zhes pa nas/ yang dag spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i don to/ /zhes pa'i bar bsgrub thabs yongs su rdzogs par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnasasu/ dri bzang gi thig le la me tog gi tsho pa bu bkod/ sa lha'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ rdo —263—

rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX tshom bu'i steng du baX yig du gyur pa 'khod/ baX las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/g.yon gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor nas 'thon pa/ bdag la mngon du phyogs pas bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ pri shrī/ de skyi sa pa ri wa ra/ ar+ghaX pra tī ts+tsha na maX zhes mchod yon phul nas/rdo rje dril bu 'dzin bzhin du/ oṃ pri shrī de lī zhes pa la/ pur+sha sogs btags te nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gtor ma a mra tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'am ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar/ hūṃX las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhūṃX ha ho khyoX oṃ pra shrī de ldi sa pa ri wā ra khyuXzhes pa la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /bcom par byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces brjod cing snang ba thob par bsam/ pri shrī mtshan sngags la ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis btags pas mchod/'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa'o/ /—264—

gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ de nas de ma thag tu sa lha'i tshom bu dang / mchod pa rnams bsal la/ skabs 'dir lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i don du/ las thig yongs rdzogs 'debs pa dang /thig chen brgyad tsam 'debs pa dag kyang yod mod/ 'di ni lha nyung ba'i phyir/ lhag gnas mi 'chol bar byed sla zhing / 'dir thig 'debs pa la dgos pa gzhan med pa'i phyir/ bshad tshod dang mthun par bya ba nyid legs so/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ tsho( āXhuX lan gsum gsum gyis/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi dang / gzhan 'khor bzhi dang bum pa'i gnas rnams su zlum po re bya'o/ /lha rnams la so so'i rang sngags lan gsum gsum dang / bum pa bzhi la 'bru gsum lan gsum gsum gyis tshom bu bkod la/ mtha' bskor du lha grangs las mi nyung ba'i mchod pa dang gtor ma lag len ltar bshams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/zla ba'i gdan/ oṃ khyo gyiX sogs/ oṃ dī ṣa rā ti sogs yo mo han kraX ta nas zhir sgri rā ti huX dzaX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ tshom bu'i steng du lha rnams bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bco pa pa ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ zhes pa nas/ gang bas kha brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sku las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas dzaXhūṃX baX hoX'i bar sgrub thabs bzhi/rdo rje'i sa gzhi zhes pa nas grwahwa re bar/ sa lha'i skabs ltar mtshams bcing / gong bzhin mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par na dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar ram/ bsdus par na/ phyi mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byas la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs kyang sgrub thabs —265—

bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas/ khro bo zhes pa nas/ phyogs skyong rnams bshegs su gsol ba'i bar yang sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /de nas spos snod dang bcas pa'i rdor dril thogs te/gshin rje gshed rdor bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal mchog khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni bri bar 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub gtan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /gshin rje gshed dmar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bgyid/ /de bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar gnas pa mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gsol bas gnang ba thob par yang gsal/rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ tsho( badz+ra spru/ tiṣ+ṭha zhes dkyil 'kho ra nam mkha' la bteg /yang na phyis kyi lag len ltar/ bum pa lhag gnas dang / slob ma lhag gnas grub nas/ mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mchod bstod rnams byas nas nam mkhar btegs kyang rung / gang ltar yang nam mkha' btegs ma thag /ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes —266—

bstod/ bcom ldan 'das skyon rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir bzhugs la/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa'i bar chad bsrung zhing / slad nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas grwahwas mtshamasaḥng ngo / /dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa'o/ /gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa drug /gnyis kha dog dkar por bsgyur ras bzang pos mgrin pa dkri/ hiXsgyiXbazlas pa'i yungs kar gyis brab cing gu gul gyis bdug thams cad la mtshan ma ni/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i dbyug pa 'od zer 'phro ba kho na 'god do/ /de rnams chu gtsang mas bgang / gser/ da chu pa/ byu sa mu men/ mu tig te rin chen lnga/kan+ta ka ri/ dbang lag /sle tres/ rgya mtsho lbu ba/shu dag dkar po ste sman lnga/ gur gum/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ dza ti/ ga bur ste dri lnga/ nas gro sran ma/ 'bras/ til dkar ste 'bru lnga/ 'o ma/ mar/sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ lan tshwa ste snying po lnga/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste bum rdzas sum/ cung zad snga blug /shing bzang po'i yal gas kha brgyan/ stegs bu gang yang rung ba la/ g.yas su dbang gi bum pa lnga po lnga tshom dang / g.yon du las bum bkod/ /mdun du mchod pa dang / gtso bum gyi steng du dang chosaspos chus nang bkang gzung thag rdo rje dang bcas pa/ bkod bsangs dang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du baX las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gosakyi mgul ba bcing ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i/ bum pa rnams kyi nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i —267—

gdan re re/ de yang dbus su/ ya las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ dpa' bo nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid kyi phung po 'bar ba la yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mos 'byud pa/ shar du spu las gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dang las bum gyi nang yum tsu ka nag mos 'phyud pa/lho ru ma las ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po la yum phag mo ser mos 'byud pa/ nub tu me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po la yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du de las phra dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la yum go rī ljang mos 'byud pa/ dpa' bo nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i mtshams bzhir pad zla la/ shar lhor mu men/ nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /bum pa gnyis las med na rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i nye ba dang / phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la nyi ma'i gdan re re dbus su ya las sogs gong dang 'dra bzhugs pa'o/ / mtshams kyi 'dab ma zhi la nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nas/ dza hūX baX hoX'i bar bdag skyed kyi skabs bzhin/ gzungs thag nas bzung / rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ lha rnams kyis thugs kar phog /thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa rnams gang bar gyur/ so so'i sngags brgya rtsa re dang / khyiXsgyi lhag par mang bar bzla'o/ /las bum la hiXsgyi gang 'os dang huX bdun bzlas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes pa'ang lan bdun las mi nyung ba bzla/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum —268—

btanas pas nang mchod 'bul/ gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal/ du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ las bum gyi chu ku shas blangs te/ bum pa rnams la skor zhing / gnas dang yo byad sogs la gtor/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mjodi cig /yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ oṃ āXhuX zhes dung chos kyi chu bum pa so sor blug /mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha rnams byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhugs/ bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ las bum gyi lha mi zhu ba'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ dkyus ltar bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ de yang nyi ma de nyid kyi sang nub kho na dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur byed na/ 'dir slob ma lhag gnas bya la/ nyi ma g.yin dang gzhan la dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe/dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rjes su slob ma lhag gnas bya ba 'thad pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar/dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam/ gsang ba'i yo byad rnams sbas nas/ dkyil 'khor khang pa de nyid du'ang rung ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul ba la/ 'di ltar/ sems bskyed nang dbang gsol btab spro ba bskyed/ /rgyun bshags byin rlabs mchod pa so shing dang / /'khyor chu bsrung skud chos bshad ku sha sbyin/ /rmi lam brtag dang sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen blo can rnams la ni/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pas gsungs pa yi/ /cho ga yang dag rjes su gnang / /sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer —269—

'jug /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ /zhesadon spyod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams bkug te zhal du bcug /sku'i lam brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas mkhar babs pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste/ gtso bo zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur pa la/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams yab kyi zhal du bcug /thugs kar byang chub sems su gyur te/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ huX zhes bya bas gsang ba nas phyir spros te/rang gi stan la 'kho / da par gyur/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mā ma ki dang lhan cig sbyor/ /bdag gi ston pa dgyes chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya'o/ /de nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin no/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyis mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag —270—

brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ / 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don bshad/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags bya ba'am/ yang na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / khyiXsgyi lan gsum gyis bgegs bskrad cing bsrung ba bya/ slob ma'i snying khar huX las rdo rje dang / mgrin par a las pad+ma dang / spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo rnams gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyi dri bzang dang bdud rtsi sbyar bas thig le byas pa na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dang / gsung dang / sku rdo rje'i ngo bo huX āX.oṃ rnams byung zhing slar yang dpral ba nas mar reg pas/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtan par mos shig byas la/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le bya'o/ /de nas snying gar dri chab/ mgo bor me tog mdun du spos dang /mar me rnams sbyin pas mchod/ so shing bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX las byung ba'i rin po che'i so shing du gyur/ khyiX sgyi bzlas shing slob ma'i lag tu gto/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes so shing gi rwa bar 'dor du bas / ltas dang mthun pa'i dngos grub lung ston/ stong pa'i ngang las/ shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor gyi dbus su/ baX las byung ba'i 'khyor chu nus pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun bzlas te/ oṃ khyiXbi shu khri du dharmā sarba pā paX ni tsa a phya 3( dha ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya huX/ zhes —271—

snyen ra ba lan gsum bkang shing sbyin/ stong pa'i ngang las/ huX las dang dhi las byung ba'i ku sha'i stan dang / sngas su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rwa / baX/ zhes byin/stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX las byung ba'i bsrung skud dmar por gyur/ dbung pa g.yon par changasanas/ oṃ brnya mi tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbaX swā hā/ zhes brtan par bya/ de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung / /gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal ba bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa dag /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams ni/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /de rnams kyi ni sdug bsngal kun/ /'byung ba'i ngan 'gro yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring brnyes/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de yis khyed rnams theg chen las/ /legs pa nyid du bskyed par 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang la khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes brjod cing don bshad do/ /de nas/ rmi lam brtag cing ga na bsrung ba ni/ bu kyai sang ni dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur —272—

ro nyol zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smros/ /zhes brjod la de'i don spund cing / ku sha'i gdan la dge ba'i sems dang bcas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol cig /ces kyang brjod/ de nas nangs par slob dpon gyi sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang / /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gis/ /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /slob dpon bdag 'gyur bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ spro na dri ba dril lan sogs kyang bya ba yin mod kyi/ gzhung na mi gsal ba'i phyir mi dgos la/ sdom pa bsgrags pa ni don gyi dgos pa ltar snang yang / lugs 'dir mi 'byung ba ni/ sdom pa bsgrags pa'i tshigs bcad mi brjod par de'i don slob dpon gyis 'chad pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar na/rigs lnga'i de dam tshig bcu bzhi sogs ci rigs pa zhig slob dpon gyis bshad la/ de rnams bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis zhes brda sprad la sdom pa bzung ba'i tshig ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub rtsa kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog —273—

gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog r+ṣa po la/ / rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gi bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs phyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug /des sta gon gyi chos rnams legs par tshar ba yin zhes brda sprad nas/ dge ba bsngo/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang / 'di la dpal ྅dzin gyi dkyil chog las ni/ slob ma lhag gnas nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'i skabs 'dir ma gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor bris zin pa'i 'og tu byas na 'jug pa bde ba la dgongs so/ /'on kyang phyi rabs kyi bla ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi dang mthun par 'chad pa bzhin bkod do/ /gsum pa la dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba gsum las slob ma bzhug cing dbang bskur ba ste/ bzhi las/ dang po la/ thig skud byin rlabs this sang0 rnga ྈ'a tshor byin rlabs/ rdul tshon dgye ba/ rgyan bsgram pa ste bzhi las/—274—

dang po ni/ nangs par snga bar langs nas sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gong bzhin byas la/ ras bal gyi srad bu kha dog sna lnga'am/ lnga la nyi shu rtsa lnga rkyang la mchod pa bshams/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/srad bu sngon po ya las zhe sdang gzhan rje gshed/ dkar po spu las gti mug gshin rje gshed/ ser po ma las ser sna gshin rje gshed/ dmar po me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ ljang khu da las phra dog gshin rje gshed/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /thams cad rang snang gi yum dang bcas par bskyed pa'am/ sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed kyang rung bar mngon no/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi khiñca hūX zhes dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams dam tshig pa de rnams la thim/ dza huX baX hoX ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /sogs kyis bstod pa'i srol yod kyang de nyid lnga pas bstod na legs pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /—275—

dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud lngar gyur/ bsdu na/ sa bon lnga las byung ba'i thig skud lnga rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos pa tsam gyis chog /'dir lugs rnying 'ga' las lha lnga'i lugs la/ spyi dang mthun par rigs lnga dngos bskyed pa ltar/ legs par yang mngon cing / sgrub thabs su gtso bo'i sa bon hūṃ nyid rigs kun la sbyar ba de ltar yang gtso bo rgyal ba gcig pu nyid/ /lnga yis tshul du rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs pas te/ 'dir yang ya sogs 'khor lo'i skabs las gzhan na ma gsungs pas/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga bskyed na yang / sa bon hūṃ rnga / hūṃ sogs lnga las skyed na legs par kho bo sems mo/ /'on kyang bla ma rnams mi mdzad pas dkyus bzhin bya ste/ bum bskyed dang / rdul tshon dang / dbang lnga la'ang rig pa mtshungs so/ /rang gi mig gnyis su dza las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras huX du gyur/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs dang bcas pas rdzi ma sdeb cing / oṃ da ste sgi 〉 a du sha dzaX de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ oṃ āXpra ca dī ṣa kā la a ri su tsakra snyu tra na ya hūṃ/ de bzhin du dī ṣa'i gnas su/ mo ha dang / pi shu nā dang / rā ga dang / isgri zhes pa rnams bcug la lan gsum gsum bzlas pas gsol ba btab te/ las kyi rdo rje phra dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga brgyal bzung ba dang lhan cig thig skud sgril bzhin du/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra khrug sarba dharmā ad+man+ta na/ a nu pra bri ni sarba dharmā hūṃ/ spyo ci nus su brjod do/ /de nas dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che'i rtsod du bzhag ste/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs sa mchod/ khyiXsgyi bzlas te bsrung ba bya'o/ /—276—

gnyis pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyis gzhi dris byugs/ me rta po sil ma bkram/ nam mkha'i dbyings su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas thig sna phyogs shig nye ba'i thad du bzung nas/ slob dpon bden bral du gnas nas/ dbang ldan du phyogs pa dang / slob ma dbang ldan nas bden bral du phyogs pas gnas pa las/ sdo hū ཾ zlu/ zhes gnyis kas brjod bzhin du thig sna gtod cing len/ de nas slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas/ oṃ āXbadz+ra sa ma ya snyu traX ma ti kra ma hūX/ sems can don la khyod rnams kyi/ dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces pa dang / thig gi sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa rnams bskul nas/ thig la thim/ ces dang por nam mkha' dang /de nas sa la gdab bo/ /rim pa de nyid kyis thig chen brgyad po gdab pa yin te/ de yang 'di skad — ces bya ste/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin drung dbang me srin po/ /g.yas bskor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab/ /me rlung srin po dbang ldan nas/ /rgyab 'gros spang ste zur thig gdab/ /gnyis sdeb dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob ma'i gnas su shes/ /de dag la/ thig chen brgyad ni/ re re bzhin nam mkha' la lan gsum dang / sa la lan gsum gdab/ 'di'i logs thig ni/ rtsa thig gi yin la/ rtsa thig gi phyi rol gyi thig drug po rnams 'debs par spro na/nam mkha' la gdab mi dgos pas 'og tu gdab pa gsum gyis chog go /de nas thig skud de nyid kyis las thig gdab par bya ba yin la/ de yang 'di ltar/ dbus su mtshan ma legs btab nas/shar nub tshangs thig drang por btab/ zlum bskor gsum gyi nya ru 'gyur/ /nya steng tshangs thig gnyis pa btab/ /lho dang byang du zlum por bskor/ /bya rjes steng nas zur thig btab/ /zur thig steng nas bya rjes bzhi/ /de la phyi yi thig bzhi btab/ /logs gtub gsum gyi bya rog rjes/ /sto ri ji jiji—277—

mnan pas cha chen bcu drug 'gyur/ /phyi rgyu cha chen re re mnan/ /dang po gnyis pa bdun pa dang / /dgu pa rnams ni bzhi bzhin bgo /gsum pa'i nang du cha phran gcig /bzhi pa rang sar bzhag par bya/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /brgyad pa'i dbus su cha phran gcig /tshangs thig zur thig ma gtogs pa/ /de rnams skam thig gdab par bya/ /dbus su phur bu btsugs nas ni/ /bzhi lnga bcu pa'i thig steng dang / /bcu nang cha chung phyed tsam bskor/ /'dab thig lag len bzhin du gdab/ /bcu cig rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig go /bcu bdun pa ni zla yab thig /rtsa ba'i thig las phyi rol tu/ /zur nas dngos su thig lnga las/ /dang po gnyis ni gsum par reg /de gnyis cha chung gnyis kyis sbrel/ /gsum pa bzhi pa lnga ba rnams/ /brgyad pa'i thig la reg par gdab/ /rtsa ba'i phyi nas gnyis pa'i thig /bcu bzhi pa yi bar du'o/ /de nas dngos su bzhi pa'i bar/ /steng du bco lnga pa la reg go /nang du bcu gsum la reg pa'i/ /ngos su rim pas thig bzhi ni/ /dang po bcu drug pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bcu drug pa/ /gzhan gsum bcu bdun pa la reg /tshangs dang nyer gcig 'dzoms sa nas/ /cha chen gcig gis bskor ba ni/ /g.yas g.yon logs su bzhi par reg /bcu dgu bzhi pa 'dzoms sa nas/ /snga ma'i sne nas bcu bdun bar/ /cha chung gnyis kyis bskor bar bya/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /glang rgyab mig gsum bskor lugs yin/ /gal te skyog po byed 'dod na/ /mda' yab thig gi phyi ngos su/ /dang po'i thig nang phyed dang drug /gnyis pa gsum pa drug drug go /bzhi pa la ni bzhi yin ste/ /lnga pa la ni phyed dang bzhi/ /drug pa gsum nas gcad par bya/ /bdun pa tsha pas dang 'phrad mtshams bcad/ /de rnams nang du'ang phyer re'o/ /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig ni/ /gur nas gsungs par kho bo smra/ /bco brgyad la sogs thig bzhi ni/ /dgu pa nas bzung glang rgyab bar/ /rtse mo cha chung gsum du sbrel/ /de 'og brgyad pa cha chung gcig /nyer gnyis pa dang nyer gsum pa/ /—278—

brgyad pa nas bzung bskor thig bar/ /nyer bzhi la sogs bzhi po ni/ /bdun pa nas ni bdun pa'i bar/ /nyer brgyad lnga nas lnga pa'i bar/ /de 'og lnga pa cha chung gcig /nyer bzhi la sogs bzhi po ni/ /bdun pa'i thig nas gcad par bya/ /de 'og drug pa'o nyer gnyis dang / /nyer gsum brgyad pa sbrel ba yin/ /de 'og bdun pa'i thig tu bcad/ /nyer brgyad pa yi phyi ngos su/ /gnyis pa'i thig las mthon pa yi/ /cha chung bzhi pa byin gyis phra/ /rtse mo ral gri'i dbyibs su bya/ /brang ngos cha chung gnyis kyi tshad/ /nyer gnyis pa dang gnyis 'dzoms par/ /cha chung brgyad kyi thig skud kyi/ /bcu bdun pa yi thig nas ni/ /dbus rwa'i thig la reg par bskor/ /de yi phyi rol cha chung gcig /bskor te rwa yi nang thig go /nyer gnyis nyer gsum bar gyi ni/ /bzhi pa'i steng nas cha chung dgus/ /sngar bzhin bskor ba phyi thig go /thig skud nyis ltab byas nas ni/ /dbus kyi phur bu la dkon te/ /rta babs mda' yab rtse mo'i tshad/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas g.yas su bskor/ khyams su 'gyur zhing phyi nas slar/ /cha chen gcig dang cha chen phyed/ /slar yang cha chen gcig gis bskor/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du mos/ /de nas skam thig rnams dbyi bar bya'o/ /'di la dur khrod 'bri ba'i srol ni med la ka ma la k+ṣi tas nag po la bshad pa ltar 'dir yang legs par 'gyur ro//gal te thig thung la mos na/ zur thig gi rjes su/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang mtshungs pa'i rtsa thig btab nas/ phyi rol tu thig drug dang / ngos su thig bdun btab/ de nas byar rjes btsal la rta babs kyi thig logs su btab bo/ /de'i rjes su bskor thig rnams bya ste/ 'di la mda' yab kyi thig dang por 'debs pa ni gang nas kyang ma bshad do/ /de nas skam pa'i phyag rgyas dbus kyi phur bu phyung / ye shes pa lag gi rdo rje la thim par yid kyis mos/ thig skud la mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba gtsang sar bzhag go /de nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/ mig gnyis la hi las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras huX las —2 9—

khro bo'i rdo rjer gyur/ khro bo'i lta bas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bgegs rnams bcom par gyur/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgo'i gegs thams cad gsal bar bgyi'o/ /sto rtsa thig dbyi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rdul tsho ni sna lnga'am/ lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga lag len bzhin bshams la/ yak+ṣi ma me da rnams bris/ gong gi thig skud brkyang zhing sgril ba'i sngags dor la thig skud kyi gnas su rdul tsho ni zhes 'don pa spos/ rdul tshon mtheb srin gyis mnye bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūX/ zhes lan bdun bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams/ rdul mang zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams chags pa dang rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig /hiXhiXhiXzhes bzlas shing sbar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hoX zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/ slob dpon gyis dang por phur khung bgang bar bya ste/ dril bu dkrol zhing dkur bsten la/ /dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pas bkang / /de nas 'di ni i dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnams grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol la/ mthar g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su sgo tshad gcig gi bar du rtsig pa rim pa lnga bri bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams kyis ci bde bar tshon dgye bar bya ste/ kha dog dang bkra shis kyis bum pa brgyad sogs mtshan ma thams cad/ dkyil 'khor spyi dang 'dra bar shes pa/ khyad par ngo bo ni/ dbus kyi —280—

sna tshogs pad+ma/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlud ser/ /bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ /zhes pa ltar dang / glang rgyab kyi nang phyogs mdog dang / mda' yab dang / spu shu zhes mi 'dod par/ shar bu dang mda' yab tu 'dod cing / mda' yab dang pad+ma phyed pa'am/ mchod rten gyi dbyibs so/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog nyid bya'o/ /lugs 'di'i 'gyur byed dam pa dpyal rgyan dā nā shī la glo bo lo tsā ba te bzhi po de thams cad thun mong gi cho ga rnams dpal 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin cing / khyad par chag gis ni/ deng sang phal cher rang rigs rgan po'i ngag /gtsor 'dzin legs bshad mi 'dzin gnyis skyes 'dra/ /de'i phyir bde chen lam bzang 'jigs med gzhung / /rgyud pa'i gdams pas brgyan pa 'ga' la gnang / /zhes 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub mtha' yas pa la grags pa'i gzhung bzang po rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs dang mi mthun na/ bod rgan po 'ga' dang mthun yang snying po med par bzhed pas/ chag gi rjes su 'brang bar khas len bzhin du bod rnying pa'i lugs g.yin dang 'bad pas bsre bar mi bya ste/ nags la gnas pa'i spre'u dag /ljon pa'i shing la mi gtsang mthor/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lha'i mtshan ma la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug par 'dod pa ni/ rgya gar ba gzhan dang / bod kyi gshed dmar ba phyi ma kha cig dang mthun srid kyang / lugs 'di la ma yin te/ gong du smos pa'i lo tsā ba chag sogs gsum dang ye mi mthun cing / birba pa dang / dpal 'dzin gyi lugs gnyis ka las phyir phyogs par 'gyur bas gyi nar spyod pa'o/ /'on te dpyal pa rnams bdag bskyed la phyag mtshan de bzhin 'dod pas rung ngo snyam na ma yin te/ dpyal lugs la ni bdag bskyed pa yang sgo bsrung 'dod pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i mtshan ma rnams bcu gsum ma ji lta ba bzhin 'god pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kha cig lha mawo mi nor ba'i phyir de ltar 'god pa yin no zhes skyon spong ngo / /bum pa la ni nor ba'i gnas kyang yod cing / mtshan ma btab pas len 'jog /sol bas mi nor ba'i —281 —

dgos pa yang yod pas 'debs pa yin mod/ 'di la ni de gnyis ka med la/ med kyang dgos na ni/ka ba dang / rta babs la sogs la yang mi nor ba'i mtshan ma dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na gzhan dang mi mthun zhing rang nyid 'gal ba de spangs la/ pad+ma'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams la/ nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma ji lta ba'i dbyug pa re bris la/mtha' me 'od 'bar ba'i nang rigs dang mthun pa'i kha dog shas che ba 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba bri bar bya'o/ /mu khyud bzhi dmar po la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba bri/ bum pa'i kha dog sogs ni sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /tshon bkra brtag pa spro na spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ mthar dkyil 'khor bris zin pa na/tshon gyi lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa nam mkha'i lha'i thugs khar gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te bzhag go /lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' kun tu dri bzang gis byugs/ me tog sil ma sogs mchod rdzas dang / rgyan thams cad bkram/ rnam rgyal bum pa gtso bo'i gnas su ba theg par mos nas shar sgo'i g.yas su bzhag /bum pa gzhan bzhi phyogs bzhin bkod/ las bum dbang ldan mtshams su bzhag go /mchod pa'i bum pa dang gos zung dang / lha re re la mchod rdzas bcu las mi nyung ba rnams so sor bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaX/ zhes yang yang brjod do/ /gzhan yang yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya ste/ de rnams lag len mthong ba tsam gyis shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ gzhus las ji skad 'byung ba ltar/ snga dro bdag bskyed legs par byas pa'i rjes su/ thig skud byin brlabs nas/ rgyan bgram pa'i bar nyi ma de nyid la grub cing / bre mo'i gtam la sogs pa bya ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par yid yang dag pa'i don la/ rnal du gnas bzhin pas de'i rjes thogs nyid la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa yin na/ sngar gyi bdag bskyed kyi nga rgyal la gnas pa kho nas chog gis/ bdag bskyed bskyar nas len mi dgos pas/ 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs—282—

kho na la zhugs pas chog go /phyis kyi lag len ltar lhag gnas kyi mthar thig tshon byin rlabs/thig 'debs par byed pa dang / gzhan yang nyi ma de nyid la dkyil 'khor bris ma zin na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ dag pa dran pa yan chad/ sta gon ltar byas nas/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa yin te/rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs par mos la glu( badz+ra be ga a kra ma huX/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gi nang shar gyi lha snam la 'dug par gyur/ khyiXgyis bsangs/ swa bha wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ smon lam gyis nas/ mtshams rnams su zla ba'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du lha'i mtshan ma rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nas/ dmar mos 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du slo las thod dbyug snyes mtshan pa las/ gti mug nas/ nag mos 'byud pa/ lho ru ma las thod dbyug mas mtshan pa las/ ser sna nas/ser mos 'byud pa/ nub tu me las thod dbyug mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags nas dkar mos 'byud pa/ byang du da las thod dbyug das mtshan pa las/ phra dog nas ljang mos 'khyud pa/ dpa' bo thams cad nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /dbus su gtso bo yab yum dang / bdag nyid gnyis su med par gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nas at+pa ko3haX/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad bkug /zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i phung po lnga dang / nyon mongs pa lnga dang / khams lnga dang / dbang po drug —283—

rnam par shes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag yongs su sbyang nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid sgrib pa thams cad dang rnam par bral bcom ldan 'das gshin rje dzind dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs su gyur pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems 'od zer dang bcas pa slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur pa mkha' nang du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ oṃ khyiXsgyi nas swā hwa'i/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum gsang ba'i lam nas spros/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum la thim oṃ mo han krita hūX phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūX dzaX mkha' nang gi gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum phyir phyung / shar gyi gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum la thim/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ pi shu na/ pi shu na/ mkha' nang gi ser sna/ lho'i ser sna/rā ga /rā ga /mkha' nang gi 'dod chags/ nub kyi 'dod chags/ in/ ilgamakha' nang gi phrag dog /byang gi phrag dog /glu tshe āXhuX lan bzhi/ mkha' nang gi bum pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhi'i bum pa bzhi/ glu tshe āXhuX/ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang bsru/nga ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa phyir phyung / phyi'i gzhal yas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim/ snying gar huX nas brlabs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ nas/ dza huX baX hoX'i bar rnams sgrub thabs bzhi/ yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi ye shes pa rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX rol mo dang bcas pa khyiXsgyi bzla zhing bgegs bskrad/hiXsgyi gcig gis bgrung ba'i sgo phye/ oṃ hi ha bho mahā kro bhā ā ca ā gasmo asma ta pā —284

dza pra ti spro tshwa skye pra swā dha me dhī man ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du sbyan drangs/ hiXsgyiXgacig bzlas pas sgo bcings/ yab yum bcu'i sngags re re'i mthar/ ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ zhes sbyar te mchod yon phul/ pukhye nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /sogs kyis bstod/ dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis brlebs te dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba bto/ dzaXhūX baX hoXgatso bo yab yum la lan gsum gsum/ lhag ma lha bzhi/ bum pa bzhi/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dmigs nas re re brjod de/ yang dag par bsre bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i nas sha p+ta āXhuX gi bar gyis gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis kyang chog la/ shin tu rgyas par na sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i mchod chog rgyas pa rnams ltar bya/ 'dir 'bring po'i tshul du brjod na/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ oṃ khyiXsgyi rnyaX de bzhin du/ sngags kyi zhabs bsil zhes dang / oṃ huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me |zhe dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /gtso 'khor bcu'i snying po'i thar/ oṃ ku ma ra rū pi ṇi dzaXdzaXlhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na/ /ci bde: oṃ hi ha he phaṭa/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar gyis/ /oṃ di sta nas swahā/ lhan cig —285—

skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ bi nas gaX kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i kha zas 'di/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ne we tu ā:huX/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra shag āXhuX/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yangs mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wastasta ye āXhūṃX/ gzung 'dzin nga rgyal bcom pa'i stag lpags dang / /nyon mongs sha khrag zad pa'i thod skam dang / /bdud rigs gshin rje bsad pa'i mgo bo'i 'phreng / /dug lnga 'joms byed bdug pa'i sbrul rgyan 'bul/ /oṃ byā gh+ra tsad+ma wa sa ni āXhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shu rka ka pā mu ku ṭa āXhuX/ oṃ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa/ mā la a bha ra ṇa āXhūṃX/ glu( aṣ+ṭa nā ga rā dza a laX ka ra ā:huX/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pa tshim pa'i mchog /ro yi mchod pa bla na med/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bde mchog ldan/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing rnams yongs bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod/ /oṃ pañca kwa ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āXhuX/'dzam bu'i gling 'di'am gling gzhan dag /'khor lo rin chen gyis bkang ba/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin ste/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na pā dza/ me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sam ye āXhūṃ/ nor bu/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo/ s+t+ri/—286—

khyim bdag /gro ha pa ti/ glang po/ lha sti/ rta mchog a shwa/ blon po/ pu ru lgazhes sbyar/ de bzhin du/ bkra shis brtags brgyad kyis bkang ba/ /ces dang / aṣ+ṭa maṅga la aX ka āXhūṃX/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /rnga yab rdul yab sbrang yab dang / khyams dang skyed mos tshal dag dang / /gzim mal dang ni gdan khri dang / /myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /rta babs dang ni bla re sogs/ /bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs dang / /glu gar la sogs mtha' yas mchod/ /bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen lag pa nam mkha'i mdzod/ /blo yis blangs te 'bul bar bgyi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/mchod bum bteg la/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto phye bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan dang ldan/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcugs ma yang / /dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsi ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnams pa ni/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod de/ phyi mchod rnams so/ /bstod pa ni/ a ye kye kye nas/yongs la gzigs/ / zhes pa'i rjes su/ ma he dbang phyug chen po lha bdag po/ /gnyug mar gsungs pa'i dngos kyi mnga' bdag po/ /sdig pa 'jigs rung bgegs rnams —287—

bcom bdag po/ /gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor gsang sngags mchog bdag po/ /dbyug pa mkha' dbyug dkar po bsnams pa po/ /mi thod phyag na mi thod 'dzin pa po/ /zung 'jug bde ldan zung 'jug bde ba po/ /gshin rje 'joms mdzad gshin rje gsod pa po/ /mi thod klu yis brgyan byas 'jigs pa po/ /bcos ma'i sku yis sprul zhing mdzad pa po/ / thar bde'i go 'phang gnas su 'god pa po/ /brtan gter blo gter tshe ring gter ba po/ /de bzhin yid mdzad pha rol phyin pa po/ /lhan skyes bde chen gcig thugs dgyes pa po/ /thugs rje ro gcig bsod nams byed pa po/ /thugs gsung las kyi lam ston dge ba po/ /zhabs la lha dbang cod pan btud pa po/ /bgegs tshogs mtha' dag go 'phang bcom pa po/ /nor ster sku mdog nyi ltar dmar ba po/ /bde chen gshin rje gshed la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gtso bo la bstod/ gti mug rdo rje nas dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal bar dang / rtse dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par spyong / /nyon mongs kun dag ye shes dngos/ /rdo rje ro langs mar phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje zhi ba byang chub sems/ /gti mug rdo rje nyid dbyer med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag mo che/ /rdo rje tsartsi kār phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes ni/ /zhe sdang bdag po thugs dbyer med/ /mi phyed rnam rtog rab gcod ma/ /rdo rje phag mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gsung ni ye shes che/ /pad+ma shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'dod chags chen po nyid sbyor ba/ /rdo rje mthar mdzad khyod la bstod/ /rdo rje las ni kun grol ba/ /phrag dog rdo rje dbyer med sku/ /thams cad rdo rje btang snyoms ni/ /rdo rje las la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgeg sogs rdo rje lha mo brgyad/ /—288—

snod dang gang ba'i bum par sprul/ /sna tshogs 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i gzugs/ /mchod ldan de dag rnams la bstod/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal yas khang par sprul/ /'jig tshogs lta kun 'joms byed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i gzhi dang bcas la 'dud/ /ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /nyes spangs pad+ma'i 'khor yug ste/ /bdud 'joms bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar la bstod/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdud bzhi 'joms zhing las kun 'grub pa dang / /lha mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dpa' bo ni/ /bde chen gshin rje gshed dpal thob par shog /ces bstod/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba slar yang byin gyis brlabs te 'grub na lag mchod bya zhing / ma 'grub na lha so so'i snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum sbyar bas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'bul/ phyis kyi lag len ltar spros pa la dga' na/ dang por bla ma rnams kyis mtshan nas smos shing 'bru gsum gyis 'bul ba dang / mtha' mar dgos kyi chos skyong dang / chos skyong spyi dang phyogs skyong 'khor bcas dang rigs drug la sbyin pa sogs kyang bya ste/ de yang / 'jam dpal gzhin rje gshed dang bi rū pa/ /ḍom+bhi he ru ka dang dpal 'dzin zhabs/ /blo gros bzang po da rban ā tsur+sha/ /glo bo lo tsā shes rab rin chen dang / /thugs sras sa pa lo tsā mchog ldan dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang gzhon nu tshul khrims zhabs/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mkhan chen grub she dang / skyo/sa rab rgya mtsho rwa ston yon tan dpal/ /byang sems mchog grub rje btsun grol mchog zhabs/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug kun dga'i mtshan/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āXhūṃX/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad sogs dang /—289—

mtshan sngags sam snying po rnams kyi dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ g.yin yang rgyud sde bzhi dang sogs dang / dgos kyi chos skyong la snying pos phul/ gzhan yang bstan pa bsrung bar sogs dang / gzhan yang phyogs skyong ba bco lnga lha chen po brgyad sogs kyis phul/gzhan yang bod khams skyong ba sogs kyis phul/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ a khru ta su da na badz+ra swā bha nywa t+pa ko3haX/ zhes bdud rtsi myang ba rnams so/ /nang mchod do/ /dngos sam yid kyi sgron ma lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga phul te/ dri chen rdo rje'i chur ldan byang sems dkar dmar dang / /mi sha rta dang ba glang glang chen khyi sha ste/ /sgron ma che dang ldan pas dur khrod mdzes byas pas/ /rnam par rtog bral bde gshegs 'khor lo dam pa mchod/ /ces brjod de gsang ma rdzo do/ /mngon rtogs ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te bde ba sgom pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar nang gtor rnams a mṛ tas bsangs pa nas/ chen por gyur zhes pa'i bar gyi byin gyis brlabs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i nang nas/ naX dza/zhes pa'i bar gyis phul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / nang mchod dang /gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin sogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/ bar 'dir mgon po lcam dral sogs chos skyong rnams dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang /phyogs skyong la yang nang gtor 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha spyan 'dren gyi tshig bor nas/ lhag ma gtor chog sgrub thabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas phyi rol gtor ma ni/ gtor ma che ba sha chang ba dan sogs kyis brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas pa phyi rol tu bshams/mchod pa byin brlabs dang / gtor ma byin brlabs sngar bzhin byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/—290—
