khyiXsgyiX'i mthar/ oṃ dā sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX gtor snod kyi phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni nas/ thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ nas/ gsol bar gyur/ oṃ an+t+ra ya nas/ phe swāhā/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra khyuX zhes mgor bor sbyar la ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod pa'i tshe/ mchod pa rnams gtor snod du blugs/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni nas/ 'dud kyi bar gyis bstod/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'brang bcas 'dir/ /'khor ba de dag thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar rigs par gyur pa yi/ /dri dang me tog sogs gtor ma/ /so sor bzhes te sems can la/ /byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la/ /gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol/ /mchod sgyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir/ lko pa nas/ song cig ces pa'i bar gong ltar brjod/ slob mas mchod yon gyi lhag ma 'gro phyogs su sbreng te/ oṃ hiXbi shudha'i sngags brjod cing / gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ slob dpon gyi tsham rngam byed cing / gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ mthar slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du 'ongs/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi nga rgyal dang bcas me tog blangs la/ huX bzhi pa'i sngags 'don zhing dkyil 'khor gyi mthar 'ongs nas/ oṃ hūX phaṭa/ oṃ hūX a phaṭa/ oṃ āX.a/༷༷55༷༷phaṭa/ tso( huX/ ha na mā ra ya du rdziX/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ āXyi/༷༷hūX hri phaṭa/ces bzlas shing /rdo rje dril stabs dang / rkang stabs gang yang rung bas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ gzhi rtsa drag po dang / g.yon brkyang las/ lag pa hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ las —291—

mdzub mo lto sprad de dral ba sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra u rgyu ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya huX/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis nub nas shar sgo dbye/ de bzhin du byang nas lho sgo dang / shar nas nub sgo dang / lho nas byang sgo dbye bar mos/ me tog dor/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi/ zhes pas me tog blangs nas/ spyi bor bcings pa'i gar stabs bya/ /sems can kun la dngos grub ni/ /ma lus dang bas bstsal/ du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs shing / phyag bya/phyogs mtshams brgyad du ba dan brgyad 'bul/ spro na skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa dang / bzlasapa yang ci 'grub bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba'am/ rgyas pa'i spyin sreg gis kyang lha mnyes par bya ste/ deng sang lag len byed pa nyung yang 'grub na nges par dgos pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ phyis kyi lag len rnams ltar na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'jug pa nas brtsams te/ dbang gi bya ba mtha' dag bdag 'jug tu len pa ltar byas kyang rung la/ yang lugs 'di 'dzin pa snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar na/ 'phreng ba nas bshad pa'i bdag 'jug 'bring po dang mthun par mdzad pas/ yol ba'i nang du 'jug pa yan chad 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/oṃ badz+ra u rgyu ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya huX/ zhes pas shar sgo phye nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dza hūṃ baX ho hi ho hi hi twoX mgon po snyim pa'i me tog so sor bzhes/ ho zhes me tog dor la/ slar yang spyi bor bcings ste me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang ngo / /'jug pa'i cho ga de tsam gyis chog la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul te chu dbang man chad rdzogs par blang ngo / /mthar dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs kyang rung ma blang kyang rung / sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin/ /dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes 292—

mchog khres rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzode/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ khyu dang las la yang dag 'byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces bden stobs brjod pa lan gsum bya/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba yod na'ang skabs 'dir bya zhing /srung ma'i gtor ma rnam snang ma btags na lhag gtor dang dus gcig tu gtong /bzhi pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba gnyis las dang po ni slob ma rnams khrus byas yol ba'i phyi rol du 'khod pa la sngon 'gro'i chos bshad/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/mā ma ki dang lhan cig sbyor/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ khyad par g.yin bdag 'jug la ni rgyun gzhags 'di bya ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sdig /bgyis dang de bzhin bgyid bstsal dang / /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /de kun dus gsum mgon la bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /'phags rnams dge tshogs rjes yi rang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs mchog bcas la skyabs su 'chi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos kun ston pa yis/ /sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs su gsol/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsung ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas brten par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems —293—

bskyed bgyid/ /bsod nams kun nas gang bsags pa/ /bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ khyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyid/ /ces so/ /slob ma dbang bskur la ni rgyun sags dang sdom bzung sta gon skabs song bas/ dngos gzhi'i nyin mi dgos la/ ci ste byed na dris lan gyi 'gor byed pa mi legs te/ bdag 'jug bzhin 'dir bya'o/ /de'i rjes su snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar na mas 'jug gsum yang mdzad/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+ta wā ra ma na ya hūX gis mig dar bcings/ a khaX wāX ra huX gis me tog gtad/ khyiXsgyi'i sngags kyis bsangs/ slob ma rnams gti mug gshin rje gshed du skad cig gis bskyed/ snying gar rdo rje'i lhe bar nyi ma la hūṃ nag po dang / mgrin par pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la āXdamar po dang / spyi bor 'khor lo'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lus gang bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par mos la/ gnas gsum du dri'i thig le bya/ slar yang khyiXsgyi bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis gtor/ gu gul gyi bdug cing / las bum gyi chus bsang ngo / /de nas/ kyi dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin zhes dri zhing / bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags zhes lan btab/ slob ma'i snying khar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nye ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa bskyed la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta uta pa ta ya mi/ zhes rjes zlos bya/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya stuX sirnyi badz+ra ya tha su khaX zhes brtan par byas/ lugs rnying pa rnams ltar na/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad par yang mi bya'o/ /zhes skabs 'dir gsang gdams mdzad pa nyid legs so/ /de nas oṃ ya man+ta krita —294—

huX zhes pas khrod nas/ aX khaX bi ra huX/ yol ba'i nang du bcug /spro na lugs rnying pa thamasacad nas bskor ba dang phyag bdun byed par bshad pa ltar byas na legs shing / mdor bsdus pa'i tshe phyis kyi lag len ltar ma byas kyang rung ngo / /de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyi de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes dang /rdo rje snying gar bldan la/ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshe/gas/ /zhes dang / yang spyi bor bas la/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ /tho yig rnying pa 'ga' las lha lnga la 'di mi byed par yang bshad cing / phyis kyi dkyil chog phal la/ 'di'i tshig rkang gnyis pa med pa ni/ gshed dmar dkyil chog la/ chag lo'i rgya dpe'am chag 'gyur gyi bod dpe thog ma yi ge nor ba'i ma dpe'i skyon du snang bas gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /dung chos kyi chu blud cing / oṃ badz+ra u da ka tha lan bdun bzlas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /ces dang / yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba —295—

ma spang par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ dmyal bar gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob ma'i spyi bor baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la/ haXdakar po sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snying gar laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa la huX nag po thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ lte bar raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa la āXdamar po gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ rkang 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa la dzhaiXdamar po drag cing bzod par dka' ba/ rlung dang dzhaiX'i 'od zer gyis lte ba'i me drag tu sbar/ snying ga'i sa bsregs te rab tu 'bar ba'i ngo bor gyur pa la/spyi bo'i chu'i dkyil 'khor las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs pas tshim zhing bde bas khyab/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gang zhing / dzhaiXyi 'od zer/ rlud dang bcas pas lus nam mkhar 'degs bzhin par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rnam pas ba skru'i bu ga nas zhugs par bsam la/ bdag nyid gshin rje gshed kyi sku mi bzad par gsal bas bsnyems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje bsor la dril bu dkrol/ glu sto khyiXsgyi bi kri tā na na huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa ā be sha ya staX bha ya/ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ huX haX.āXdzhai hūX phaṭa/ ces drag tu brjod cing bdug pa dang / rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /mthar sto badz+ra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ yang dag —296—

pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyis rim pa dang / /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de'i dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /de nas nam mkha'i kha dog dris shing lung bstan/ sngar gyi me tog gi phon po las yangs shing ma rnying pa'i me tog gcig traX las rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi me tog tu byin gyis brlabs nas phul bar mos la/ oṃ pra titsā badz+ra hoX zhes dor/ slar yang slob dpon gyis blang ste/ u dum wa ra man+ta ra/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang ma li ka /kaṇi ka yi 'phreng ba 'di/ /legs par mnos la bus zungs shig /oṃ pra ti groṇ+ḍa stuX i maX satwa mahā ba la/ zhes slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang ngo / /snying gar zla ba la huX/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /ces gdong g.yogs phye/ de nas blta bar bskul zhing ched du brjod pa 'di'i lugs rnying rnams weng ba ltar mdzad pas/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyis phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol bas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ /zhes lta bar bskul/ slob mas thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen —297—

por bdag dbang bskur/ /hoXhoXhoX lko༅ho du brjod pa'i rjes zlos bya'o/ /gtso bo nas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor ra lo'i bar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs par bstan/ yang na gdong g.yogs phye ma thag bstan kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa la/ dbang bzhi bskur ba dang / rjes su bya ba'i rim pa gnyis so/ /dang po la bzhi las/ bum pa'i dbang la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni rigs lnga'i dbang ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /mchog kyang bdag la ba3nyal du ga the(la/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bum chu rnams rnam rgyal bum par bsdus la/ slob ma dang / dbang rdzas rnams la las bum chu dang / khyiXsgyis bsangs skye( swa bha wa sogs/ bdag dang / dbang rdzas dang / slob ma rnams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i gdan la ya las dbyug pa yas mtshan pa las/ gsum ga'ang zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po la/ yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'byud pa/ dbyug pa dang / thod khrag 'dzin pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūṃX/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dam tshig pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dkyil chog gsar pa rnams na dbang rdzas la dbang bskur bar 'dod kyang / rnying pa rnams na de med pa ltar 'dir yang 'dod do/ /dbang rdzas kyi zhe sdang gshin rje gshed zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin —298—

gshegs pa 'khor dang btsun mor bcas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /spyo gsol ba bto/ so so'i rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zhu bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+ma ra lhung ba/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rdo rje ma drug /khro bo'i dbang po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ slob ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis glu dang gar dang /me tog gi tshogs la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje tsartsi kā la sogs pa yum bzhi po rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba thogs te/ bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar mos shig /bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /de ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces me tog dor/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi tiñca mi/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba'i yal 'dab kyis bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing 'thung du —299—

bcug /de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de nyid la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhuX nas/ ni wi te āXhuX/ dngos su mchod pa lngas mchod par yang bya'o/ /de ltar na/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang thob 'gyur gyi nus pa sos btab/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas las dang dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /zhes brjod/ 'di man chad la/ dbang lha spyan 'dren pa nas shis brjod kyi bar mi dgos/ g.yin stong par sbyang ba nas rtog pa bskyed pa'i bar rigs 'gre bar byas te/ 'don pa spo ba'i tshul brjod na/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan dang / ma las dbyug pa mas mtshan pa las/ ser sna gshi/na rje gshe/da ser po la/ yum phag mo ser mos 'phyud pa/ ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par/ ser sna gshin rje gshed zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbu rgyan ཿngas/ dar dpyangs dkon la/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas a bhi khiñca mi/ dbang gi lha las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i tshogs rnams byung / dbu rgyan gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ bum pa'i chus kyang gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi khi ྅ stu sku chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi/ nga rgyal dang ser sna/ i ba/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rin chen 'gyung ldan gyi go 'phang / ser sna dang gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas/ yig rnying 'ga' na skabs 'dir rdo rje ma/ sngags rgyas dbang bskur ba dang / dar dbyangs sbyin pa sogs 'phreng ba bzhin mdzad pa ni/bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog gi dgongs par yang mngon mod/ snga phyi phal cher mi byed par mang bas —300—

'dir yang spyi dang mthun par byas so/ /de nas rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rnams rdo rje me las dbyug pa mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags gshi/na rje gshe/da dmar po la yum dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'phyud pa/ dbang rdzas kyi 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ rdo rjer sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje bzung / /rdo rje snying ga la sogs pa'i gnas gsum du gshugs la/ lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ glu( badz+ra sogs gong bzhin chus kyang dbang bskur te/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi 'dod skas gshin rje gshed kyi dril bu'i dbang la/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ da las dbyug pa das mtshan pa las/ phra dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu la yum go ri ljang mos 'phyud pa/ dbang rdzas kyi phra dog gshi/na rje gshed/ dril bur/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi khri nyu mi/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ dril bu lag pa g.yon par gto/ lcog kyang dbang bskur/don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i/ phrag dog /'du byed/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ don grub kyi phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi/ ming dbang ni/ dbang rdzas med pa'i phyir dbang rdzas dang 'brel ba'i tshig gang yang brjod mi dgos/ bdag dang slob ma/ spu las dbyu/ga pa snyes mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang / gti mug gshi/na rje gshed dkar po la/ yum tsartsi ka nag mos 'byud pa/ slob dpon gyis rdo dril bsnol ba lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ slob ma'i mgo steng du 'khro(la bzhin pas/ glu( badz+ra satwa stuX a bhi khiñca mi badz+ra na maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin ‘ gshe/gas pa'o/ /zhes rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btanas/ chus kyang dbang bskur rnam —301—

snang gi dbu brgyan/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi /gti mug /gzugs phung /rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi/ mthar 'di skad du/ dbang bskur ba 'di dag gis bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang / sngags sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang lnga po 'di nyid cod pan gyis dbang ste/ thams cad du tsartsi ka la sogs pa rnams cod pan la sogs pa dbang gi tshul du bya ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes brjod/ 'dir gon na rje gshed rigs lnga bskyed pa mi rung bar 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad la/ lugs rnying pa 'gar rgyal ba rigs lnga nyid bskyed pa yang shin tu legs te/ 'og tu slob dpon gyi dbang la zhe sdang tshi nin rje gshed dang / rdo rje 'chang sgom pa yang ngo /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gang gis bdag gis khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis ni dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /zhes gsol ba bto la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs yin na/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung yang bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma 'dab brgyad shig stan dang bcas pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag pa'am/ bzhag par mos la/dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i gdan gyi steng du slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs ma dmar mos 'byud pa sogs gong bzhi/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje bdud thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i ral grir byin gyis brlabs par gyur/sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/ /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung / /zhes gto la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu —302—

bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes rdo rje'am de kho na nyid brjod cing don bshad/ a las byung ba'i dril bu thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid du gyur/shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sgrub phyir/ /bu yis yang dag gus pas bzung / khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes gtad nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i srid pa mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dril bu'i de nyid brjod cing don bshad/ slob ma bcom ldan 'das gzhan rje gshed rang snang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs ma lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu la yang dag par 'phyud pa'i bde ba dam pa thob pa na/ lha sku dang / bde ba dang / stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes 'di ni bum pa'i dbang gi gtso bo'o/ /'byud rgya byed du bcug la/ yid kyi lus brtan de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes brjod la don mug da/ de nas dbang bskur sogs sngon bzhin chu dbang bskur ba las/ khyad par ni rnam rgyal chen po dung chos kyi dbang bskur ba dang / sngags kyang tsho( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi bhe ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā tsarla a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes dang / rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang slob ma la gnyis su med par thim/ dza huX baX hoX oṃ su pra la badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhesame tog gtor/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i bkra shis brjod/ de la 'di dag tu/ dbang bskur ba'i las byed pa po ni/ dbang lnga po la/ yum bzhi yin la/ slob dpon gyi dbang la ni gtso bo nyid rig —303—

mar bcas pa'o/ /dbang re re'i mthar/ dbang lha slob ma la bstim pa'i tshe/ chu dbang du bshad pa ltar/ dbang lha spyan 'dren yang re re bzhin dgos la/ gang dag slob ma dang dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba'i rjes su ye shes pa 'jug pa dang / dbang 'di rnams thams cad la dbang gi lha spyan 'dren med pa de dag ni cho ga cung zad 'khrul ba yin zhing / dbang bskur gyi rjes su ye shes pa 'jug pa pha rgyud kyis khyad chos nges pa can yin no snyam pa las byung ba te 'khrul ba'i rgyun gyi 'khrul ba'o/ /slob ma la shis brjod mi byed pa ni/ dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang bzhin du de'i gzhung dang yang 'gal ba'o/ /de nas de kho na nyid brjod par bya ste/ 'di la dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid brjod nas/slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid mi brjod pa ni/ brjed ngas kyi dbang du gyur pa'i ngang tshul can te/ des na de kho na nyid brjod phyin gsum gar brjod dgos so/ /dkyil ga bor dang lha'i de nyid mngon rtogs kyi dag pa bzhin brjod na/ lha'i de nyid sngon la 'byung ba'i phyir/ go rim cung zad 'khrugs par 'gyur na'ang / de nyid kyang / rgyud kyi tshig yin pas shin tu legs par ni 'gyur la/ 'on kyang mdor bsdu na/ rgyud las 'byung ba 'di tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ dkyil 'khore gru bzhi bden pa bzhi/ /zur bzhi myongs pa'i gnas bzhi ste/ /sgo bzhi bdud bzhi skrag par mdzad/ /rta babs bzhi ni bsdu ba bzhi/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rtse bar mdzad/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed gzugs su/ /zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad par mdzad/ /bcom ldan : /gti mug gshin rje jo /gti mug ni/ gti mug thams cad jo /bcom ldan phra ma gshin rje/ phra ma yi mnan 'gro ngu /phra ma thams cad/ bcom ldan/'dod chags gshin rje/ 'dod chags kyi/ 'dod chags thams cad/ /bcom —304—

ldan phra dog /gzhin rje/ /phrag dog /phrag dog thams cad zad par mdzad/ /byams pa tsartsi kar gsungs te/ /phag mo de bzhin snying rje'o/ /dbyangs can dga' bar shes bya ste/ /btang snyoms go ri'i gzugs su'o/ /chags sogs gzhan gyur sku mdog dmar/ /dus gsum mkhyen pas spyan gsum ste/ /mtha' gnyis rtog spangs phyag gnyis te/ /thabs dang shes rab yang dag sbyor/ /zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ slob dpon gyis las bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / gtor ma'i cho ga dang / bsrung ba dang / phyir bzlog dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / slob ma 'jug pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las rnams sgrubs shig /ces brjod/ de la spyir de kho na nyid gsum po 'di dag slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba thob pa la spyi tsam nas bshad dgos pa yin gyi/ dbang gi cho ga'i yan lag tu mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de'i phyir dkyil 'khor cho ga tshad ldan mang po zhin las ni mi 'byung la/ 'byung ba rnams la'ang tshig gi brjod tshul sna tshogs yod cing dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i dmar nag gi dkyil chog na/ rgyas par bzhugs pa yang mar me mdzad bzang po'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu par gsungs pa'i 'grel pa lta bur sbyar ba yin gyi/ rgyud kyi tshig ma yin no/ /de rjes su mtha' rten rnams sbyin par bya ste/ de la rjes gnang dang / brtul zhugs dang / lung bstan dang / gsang ba bsgrags pa dang / dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dpal zhe sdang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam pa can du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ze hūṃ oṃ dzi khaX rnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin/ nor bu rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin/ pad+ma 'od dpag med kyis rang bzhin/ ral —305—

gri don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin rnams su gyur/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rim pas lag tu gtod/ sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ spyo brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'phyud pa/dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dang po'i rdo rjer gyur/ de lag tu gto la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX dha ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi huX huX/ gsum pa ni/ g.yon chos gos kyi grwa snying gar 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ slob dpon oṃ yig les byung de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa gyis spa brjod la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bya/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kyi che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya stuX/ sgyir bhu waXsuX gang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de/ 'di nyid las byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mthu dang /—306—

sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so/ /zhes dad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /mahā sa ma ya ha na huX phaṭa/ lnga pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong shing zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ /de ring khyod rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ / rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tsho mi med/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob da rga sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /zhes brjod/ dbang gzhi nub gcig la byed pa'i tshe/ mtha' rten 'di thams cad dbang bzhi pa'i mthar byed pa dpal 'dzin gyi gzhud gi dgongs pa yin cing / lugs rnying gi yi ge 'ga' wo na yang mngon du snang ngo / /de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du —307—

zhugs shing / bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bskyed rim dang thun mong gi dngos grub/ las tshogs dang bcas pa sgrub pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du gyur pa'i rten 'brel legs par tshogs pa'o/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ e ma ho/ sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsole// /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong gi sngags kyis gdong g.yogs bcings / slob dpon bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ yum rdo rje ro langs mar gyur/ yum gyi mkha' nas at+pa ko3haX/ rjes chags snyoms par zhugs pa'i mchog tu dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras dang / btsun mor bcas pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thig le nor bu las/ mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs te/ byin par mos shig /btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub byed/ /bu khyod de ltar shes gyis kye/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ āXhūX/ zhes thod pa dang po nas bdud rtsi spyin/ a ho mahā su je zhes rjes zlos bya/ shes rab kyi mkha' nang na gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyang khar babs par mos/ zhes brjod la/ ka pā la gnyis pa nas bdud rtsi sbyin/de nas 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs 'grol lo/ /de ltar na/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khore du zhugs shing / gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ ngag gi dri ma dag /rdzogs rim steng sgo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba sogs —308—

rtogs pa bskyed do/ /gsum pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis /mgon la dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /bla med byang chub gnas bya'i phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur bya'o/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gong bzhin mig dar bcing / de nas rig ma mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dngos grub kyi don du/ khyed rang rnams la gto par mos shig /gzung ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyi/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar sbyor bral ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /dngos grub mchog kyang yod ma yin/ /de nas/lha mo des kyang / tsan dan dang / gur gum la sogs pas byug cing / dri zhim pos me tog gi 'phreng bas mngon par brgyan nas/ phyogs kyi gos can rab tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma gsal bar byas te/ dri chen dri chu bza' ba ste/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bud med mchog gus de bzhin du/ /bha ga'i pad+ma ra tsum pa ni/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig /ces dris par mos la/ dri chen dri chu sogs bza' ba/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med mchog tu rtag gus bya/ /bha ga nyid la tsum pa nam/ /zhes lan btab par mos shing / rjes zlos bya/ de nas des/ e ma nga yi pad+ma ni/ /—ge ye ne —— bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho gas bsten byed na/ /de'i sto mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /pad+ma ra bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni brtag tu ri ri —309—

bzhugs/ /bhañja mok+ṣa ho/ zhes gsung par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa yis byang chub sems/ /ji srid 'byin par mi byed par/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde gzhan ci/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /rnam shes phung po brgyal 'gyur bas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje'i kun sbyor dang / /reg byas kyis ni rmad byung che'i/ /dga' ba bskyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa'o/ /dga' bral dag gi dbus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos la brtan par gyis/ /pad+ma'i nam mkha' rdo rje yi/ /lte bas mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ /ye shes skye ba gang yin de/ /ye shes ngo bo zhes bya ste/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal pa'am bskal ba pa stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya/ /spyo brjod cing don spyod/ slob ma dang / rig ma mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'khor lo'i gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' nas at+pa ko3haX/ lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dam pa mngon du byas/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ gsang ba'i dbang / yid kyi dri ma/ rdzogs rim pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la/ 'bras bu chos sku/ rtogs pa bskyed/—310—

bzhi pa ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcing bkrol dbang 'di la dgos pa ni ma yin mod/ byed na snga ma rnams kyi rigs 'gre'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ dbang bzhi pa'i don ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa med/ khams med rnam par shes pa med/ /nam mkha' dag ni mnyam nyid gnas/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pas/ /chos 'di bde ba chen lnga'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / de nyid sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pas/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang / /rig pa'i de nyid ma 'gags pa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ rang bzhin spros bral bde ba chen po la bde stong gi sems bzo bcos med pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par zhog cig /ces pa'am/ spro na dbang bzhi pa'i don rgyas par spund do/ /de ltar na/don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor/ bzhi pa'i dbang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku/ rtogs pa bskyed do/ /gnyis pa rjes ni/ mtha' rten rnams 'dir byas na de rnams kyang yin la/ khyad par dam tshig brjod cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ nges par 'dir bya ba yin ste/ mchog du gsang ba dam pa nas/ 'chi ba khyed la med/ srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung / /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros nas skrun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can —311—

rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par btang sh+ka bya/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la mi smad do/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ /chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dgrang / /gdug la byams pa rtag tu spangs/ /chos nyid tshad bzung mi bya'o/ /dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig brten par bya/ khres rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzlas/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs brten/ /gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med gyur pa ni/ /de tshe dkyil 'khor nges bris la/ /bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ /dam tshig lhag rnams dang mnyam par/ /gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pa/ /kun gyis tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ /khams gsum gyis ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu rab zhugs so/ /de ring khyod nyid sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob par 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gis dam tshig mi bzad bde ster brten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro ba bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams brten par gyis/ /spyo brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /ces rjes zlos bya/ gto rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te —312—

sogs dang / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung/ /de ni de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyi sgrib med mthong bar shog /lan gsum brjod do/ /slob ma sta gon dang slob ma dbang skur ba bya ba ni dbang chog 'khrul ba'i dri bral du shes par bya'o/ /'grub na sbyin sreg bya zhing / slob ma'i lag pa nas 'jus la bgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul la 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob mas kyang skabs 'dir yon 'bul lo/ /gzhan yang gtor ma dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pas kyang lha mnyes par bya ste/ de ltar yang / lha ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bdag nyid rnam par sun 'byin yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ nangs par nyi ma 'char kar gyur pa na/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos/gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ khyiXsgyiXha/ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang / gong bzhin nang mchod dang / a ye kye kye sogs kyis bstod cing / sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra bya/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi dngos grub dang / 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten nas 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can rnams bde skyid 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhesa'adod don zhu yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ skye( khyed kyi sems can sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ glu( badz+ra muX zhes/ ye shes —313—

pa rnams gshegs/ dzaXhūṃX baX hoX dam tshig pa rang la thim/ lha'i nga rgyal dang / stong nyid kyi lta ba brtan pos a kā ro'i sngags dang / chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing / sarba bi snan+dha dza dha ra adz+nyā pa ya ti huX/ rdo rje rtse mos shar sgo nas brtsams te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dbyi'o/ /mthar las rjes mi mngon par bya zhing / phur bu dngos su btab na/ skam pa'i phyag rgyas/ skye( badz+ra gī la gī la ya huX phaṭa phaṭa lha rte zhes phyung / tu tu sgru tu sogs kyis shul 'o mas bgang / yid kyis btab pa la ni mi dgos so/ /rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren ni gzhan7 du shes par bya'o/ /de nas smon lam dang / bkra shis rgya cher bya zhing / slar yang dge 'dun la ston mo bya zhing / slob dpon 'khor bcas tshogs kyis mnyes par bya'o// //'dir smras pa/ 'di la cho ga yi ge mang yod kyang / / bzang po 'ga' zhig deng sang lag len dka'/ /lag len bde 'ga' legs pa'ang min mthong nas/ /skyon bral yon tan ldan pa 'di sbyar ro/ /gal te nongs na blo yi nyes par zad/ /drang po'i bsam pa na yang zhig pa med/ /chos tshul 'di la mchog tu gus pa'i blos/ /legs sbyar 'di yang blo ldan dga' byed yin/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bris pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro kun lhan cig skyesapa'i dngos po ni/ /zung 'jug snying po'i gnas la reg par shog/ // ces pa'ang don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu so bzhi son pa la/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel// bod kyi brda sprod pa sngags 'chang blo gros rnam rgyal gyis chos spyod bcu'i phyir du bris/ /—314—

rgyas pa bzhugs/na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje gtso/ po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ bdud bzhi'i stobs 'phrog zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo gang zhig dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs sku/ /hūṃ gi sgra yis bdud sde'i klad pa 'gems/ /thugs rje chen po'i chu 'dzin kun la khyab/ /bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin der 'dud/ /'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du huX sngon po/ de'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sna bug nas phyir 'phros/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa'i rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs la mkhas phyir sna tshogs skur bstan nas/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /sdig pa ma lus bgyis pa rnams/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags par —315—

bgyi/ /shes rab snying brtse ldan pa'i byang chub sems/ /dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin/ /de yi rjes su bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang mi gtong ngo / /bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang ni/ /gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul na/ /bzhes nas bdag la rjes mthun pa'i/ /dngos grub rnams ni bstsal du gsol/ /dang por byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /da lta dge ba gang bsags pa/ /bdag dang sems can don slad du/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyid/ /ces pa'am/ bsdu na/ gyur nas 'byung ba ltar rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ shu rgyu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'gyung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ yaX raX baX laX suX rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/drwa ba/ gur bla re/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhuX las/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ pañca re ga'i rtsig pa dang / rin po che'i pha gu dang / drwa phyed dang / mda' yab dang / pu shu dang / phyi rol gyi 'gram stegs la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dang / nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i/ steng thog gru bzhi pa dang / dbus su gtsang khang phyur bu mchod rten gyi rnam pas spras pa dang / phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang / lha snam shar 316—

dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ 'phar ma gnyis dang bcas pa'i dbus mthing nag gi gzhi la/ bhuX las byung ba'i 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i steng du/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang / sgo mtshams brgyad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhi la zla ba'i dkyil 'bor ro/ /gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ mngon byang lnga bskyed byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ gtso bor cho ga gsum bskyed nyid do/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang sems huX mthing nag 'bar ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus huX la thim pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar huX gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi huX phaṭa/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal mche ba gtsigs shing / ljags 'gyur ba/ 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i hūX gi mgrin pa gang ba/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing gsor ba/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'byud pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang / dbu skra me ltar 'bar ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng dang / g.yon brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu mnan pa/ sbom thung gsus khyim che ba/ yan lag hrags pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / khrag 'dzag mi —317—

mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa dang / rin po che dang / klu wo po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan zhing bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag brlag par mdzad pa/ 'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum/ rdo rje gtum mo/ sna tshogs bde ma/ sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/dbu skra dmar ser grol ba/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ thod skam lnga bcu me do shal can/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing / gnyis ka'ang gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems pa yab rkyang / de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems pa hūX mthing ga khres rab kyi mtsho skyes khyiXlas byung ba'i pad+ma as mtshan pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje/ huX las byung ba'i rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar byang chub kyi sems kun da lta bu'i rnam par gyur te/rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ oṃ khri lhaX.a/ e baX ma ya/ huX sa hri a dzaXhuX baX hoXstuX dza a ya/ zhes pa sa bon nyi shu grub par gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ phyi rol tu so so'i gdan la 'khod/ gtso bo nyid kyi sku'i gnas rnams su yang / sa bon nyi shu rtsa gcig skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ brnya ka ru ṇa oṃ/ spyi bo dang shar rtsibs su oṃ las sang se rgyas rigs kyi bya khyung dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ badz+ra ka ru ṇa hūX/—318—

thugs kar huX las rdo rje rigs kyi bya khyung sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rat+na ka ru ṇa traX/ lte ba dang lho rtsibs su traX las/ rin chen rigs kyi bya khyung ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ pad+ma ka ru ṇa khyiX mgrin pa dang nub rtsibs su khyiXlas pad+ma'i bya khyung dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ karma ka ru ṇa a/ gsang gnas dang byang chub rtsibs su a las/ las kyi rigs kyi bya khyung ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ e pus ka ru ṇa/dbyi g.yon dang shar lho'i rtsibs su e las khyung me tog ma dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa/ baX dhu pe ka ru ṇa/ dpyi g.yas dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs su baX las khyung bdug spos ma sngon po spos snod 'dzin pa/ ma ā lo ke ka ru ṇa/ phrag pa g.yas dang nub byang gi rtsibs su ma las khyung mar me ma dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa/ ya ga rnye ka ru ṇa/ phrag pa g.yon dang nub byang gi rtsibs su ya las khyung dri chab ma ljang khu dri bzang gis gang ba'i dung phor 'dzin pa/ huX ka ru ṇa tshin+ta/ lheng sna dang rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ huX las dri za 'dul byed kyi khyung dkar po rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin pa/ sa ka ru ya ma/ sog phrag dang lho nub tu sa las/ gzhin rje 'dul byed kyi khyung nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ hri ka ru ṇa hu lu/ lte 'og dang nub byang du hri las klu gdul byed kyi khyung dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ a ka ru ṇa yak+ṣa/bcu drug mdo dang byang shar du āXlas gnod spyin 'dul byed kyi khyung lja ser ཿga to 'dzin pa/ dzaXka ru ṇa/ sna'i 'dom dang so dang shar sgor dzaXlas khyung lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ huX ka ru ṇa/ kha dang lho sgor huX las khyung zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/ baX ka ru ṇa chu lam dang nub sgor baX las khyung lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ ho ka ru ṇa/ bshang —319—

lam dang byang sgor ho las khyung dril bu ma ljang nag dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ āXhūṃX sa ma ya/ stuX ka ru ṇa/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar dang / me mtshams kyi grwar/ stuX las sprul pa'i khyung dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ āXhuX sa ma ya/ dza ka ru ṇa/mgrin pa nas snying ga'i bar dang / bden bral gyi grwar/ dza las yang sprul gyi khyung dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āXhūṃ sa ma ya/ a ka ru ṇa/ snying ga nas lte ba'i bar dang / rlung mtshams kyi grwar a las gsum sprul gyi khyung sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ oṃ āXhuX sa ma ya/ ya ka ru ṇa lte ba nas rkang mthil gyi bar dang /dbang ldan gyi grwar ya las bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i khyung khra bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sprul pa'i khyung 'di dag gis sku'i ba sbu'i khung bu thams cad khyab pa/ bya khyung thams cad g.yas rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing /g.yon rang mdog dang mtshungs sbrul bzung nas za ba/ rang rtags phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i mchu dang gshog pa can/ spyan gsum pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi lte bar oṃ baX las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar snya yoX las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hri moX las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hre tri las bskyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huX hūX las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tshwa kwa dud kha/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /phyi dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram/oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX/ lan gsum/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go char gyur/ rang gi —320—

thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX bde gshegs gtso bo gtum po dang / /lha rnams phyogs bcur 'khod pa rnams/ /bdag kyang sems can rgyud sbyang phyir/ /skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod bstod bya/ dzaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni 'khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yis chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /dbang bzhi thob/chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ shar dang shar lho pa rnams la rnam snang / lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung / nub dang nub byang pa rnams la snang mtha'/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams la don grub rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim par sgom par 'dod na/ phyag rgya r+ṣa po dang / gtum mo dang / phra thig gi rnal 'byor rnams te/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud yan lag dang —321—

bcas pa bzhin sgom par 'dod mod kyi/ da lta ni de'i rgyun yod par mi mngon pas/ rang nyid gang la gtso bor byed pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa de bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ rgyas par dkyil chog gi skabs bzhin/ yid kyis dran par bya ba'am/ mdor bsdus na 'di skad ces brjod de/ byang phyogs so bdun gzhal yas khang / /phung po lnga dag rigs lnga ste/ /'byung ba bzhi dag bzung ma bzhi/ /sgo ma bzhi ni tshad med pa/ /'dul byed rnam bzhi bdud bzhi 'joms/ /sprul sogs bzhi po gang yin pa/ /rgyal ba'i mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'o/ /chos dbyings gtso bo yab yum nyid/ /ces so/ /bzlas pa ni/khyogs kyi bzlas pa dang / spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gang rung gi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ glu( badz+ra pā ṇi hūX phaṭa/ nye snying ngo / /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūX phaṭa/ ka ru ṇa tsa le tsa le huX phaṭa/ phyi sgrub kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ badz+ra ka ru ṇa huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ h+pho ṭa ya h+pho ṭa ya/ badz+ra bā tim ga ru ḍa be ge huX dza/ ri dza phri dza huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra ḍā ki nī huX huX phaṭa/ nang sgrub kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa/ bud+dhā ga ru ḍa/ rat+na ga ru ḍa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa/ karma ga ru ḍa/ huX huX phaṭa/ badz+ra ba to/ ga ru ḍa be ge huX dza dza/ ri dza pri dza huX phaṭa/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūX huX phaṭa/ ru tra mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa ni gsang sgrub kyi snying po'o/ /mngon par rtogasapa 'di ni/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gcig tu 'dus pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum gar gyi bzlas pa byar rung la/ rgyun bzlas ni phyi sgrub kyi snying po nyid gtso che bar mdzad do/ /grangs ni/ gsum 'bum/ dus ni zhag nyer cig /mtshan ma ni gtum po'i rtags brgyad de/rim pas/ 'bring dang / tha ma dang / rab kyi bsnyen par bshad do/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis/ nye snying la 'bru 'bum sngon du song ba'i rjes su/ phyi nang gsang gsum so so'i bsnyen pa skyel ba'am/ phyi sgrub —322—

la grangs bsnyen/ nang sgrub la dus bsnyen/ gsang sgrub la mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rnams rim pas thems par bya'o/ /de nas snying po gsum gyi mthar/ spyi dril gyi sngags 'di theg bdun la sogs par bzlas pas/ gtum chen gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs so zhes gsung ngo / /de la spyi dril gyi sngags ni 'di yin te/ huX huX/ hril hril/ dim dim/ phob phob/ shar shar/ di ri di ri/ rbad rbad/ kha thum kha thum/ dza re dza re sbyo/ ha sa ha sa/ te sa te sa/ kri ta ha kri ta ha/ kri khug kri khug /tshal pa tshal pa/ srog tshig nan rbad/ lus dul/ma ra ya rbad/ raX raX dz+wa la/ shi shi/ rdul bun rbad sod/ gnod byed 'byung po sde brgyad thams cad mā ra ma phaṭa/ huX gnod byed 'byung po sde brgyad sarba ka ru ṇa ji hi/ zhes pa'o/ /phyis bsnyen pa song nas las la sbyar ba'i tshe/ gnod byed 'byung po sde brgyad zhes pa'i dod du/ so so'i sngags thems 'jug go/thun bsdus zin pa'i mjug gam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung / raX las me/ oṃ āXhūX las mi mgo'i sgyid bu/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/bhuX aX dzi khaX huX las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/a las zla ba/ huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu/ oṃ dang hūX gi 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /oṃ yig zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa yang thim ste/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hruXlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron gong gi ye shes pa ltar spyan drangs la/ phyi sgrub kyi snying po'i mthar/oṃ āXhūX pañca a mṛ ta pu dza kha raX ji hi/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa—323—

mahā ro ṣa ṇa maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra i daX bā li gro hā gro hā kha kha/ ji hi ji hi/ bhu dza ho/ a mṛ ta pi pa to/ a ti kra ma ho/ rak+ta pi pa to sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa dang / ā ka ro lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa la phul/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /gsung mchog 'bar ba'i sgra dbyangs can/ /ngag gi nyes pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs mchog 'bar ba'i ye shes can/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sel mdzad/ /rdo rje rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal chen bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bsrung dang skyob pa'i las mdzod cig /mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog par mdzod/ /yams dang dal kha bzlog par mdzod/ /rims dang khrag gzer: /gshin rje'i zhabrul 'khor: /gza' dang byad stems /ban bon sbod stong : /zor kha ngan pa: /klu yi byad ma /gdon gyi las rnams: /dgra dpung 'joms pa'i las mdzod cig /yul phyogs skyong ba'i las mdzod cig /'khor nor spel ba'i las mdzod cig /dbang dang dgug pa'i: chos spyod 'phel ba'i:/rigs slob 'phel ba'i:/ /dngos grub mchog stsol las mdzod cig /las rnams mdzad pa 'di dag ni/ /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam lags/ /thub par srungs shig thugs dam can/ /srog la ma ltas khyod sgrub kyis/ /re ba 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /huX dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag ces pa nas/ kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms dang / /dgra rnams thams cad med par 324—

mdzod/ /mchod sbyin 'di yi mthu stobs kyis/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces las bcol/ te ṇ+ḍahuX/ te ṇ+ḍahuX/ te ṇ+ḍa te te huX/ zhes pa lan bzhis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad nad med cing / /zhes sogs smon lam btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra muXzhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gsum thams cad/ rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas khyung nyi shu la thim/ de rnams lus dkyil gyi khyung la thim/ bdag nyid lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa yang / ye shes sems pa la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems pa la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus nas dmigs med du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang bdag nyid dpa' bo gcig par gyur/ gnas gsum du 'khru gsum dang / gnas lngar khyung rigs lnga bkod la/ dge ba bsngos te/thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /spyir 'di'i phyi sgrub kho na ni/ yab rkyang phyi dkyil can/ lus la khyung rigs lnga kho na bkod pa yi myo/ la/ gsang sgrub ni/ yab rkyang la lus dkyil 'ba' zhig bkod pa yin cing / nang sgrub kho na ni/ gtso bo nga ba yum/ phyi dkyil dang bcas pa/ sku la khyung rigs lnga kho na bkod pa'o/ /'di ni nang sgrub kyi steng du/ phyi sgrub dang gsang sgrub kyang tshang ba yin pas/ tshul 'dis sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob nas/ gsum gar thob par 'gyur ro zhes/ rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla mas gsung ngo / /phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sngags 'di dag dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs gang yang gtum chen du gtarwa gas la/ gtum chung ni/ gtum po khra thogs su grags pa ste/ sham bu'i sngags kyang gzhan no/ /spyir phyag rdor gtum po'i chos skor sngon dus dar tshes pas/ 'dra min mang —325—

la/ rje ras chung pa dngos slob nyid slob dang bcas pas mdzad nges pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi yi ge yang med pa dang / gtum po'i rgyud gzhung ltar snang yang mang zhing / rnam dag rnams kyang / la la rnying ma dang / la la lo tsā ba gzhan nas brgyud pa'ang yod pas/ sgrub thabs 'dra min bgrang bar mi dpyod do/ /'on kyang 'di tsam zhig ni/ rgyu mtshan dang dan rtags du mas/ shin tu yid tshes pa'i gnas su nges pa brnyes la/ rgyud gsang ba bstan par grags pa'i dngos stan gyi phyi dkyil lha bcu gsum ma ni/ da lta'i bar du yang dar rgyas che mod kyi/ ras chung pa nyid kyi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ da lta'i gsang ba bstan par grags pa 'di'i lugs ma yin no/ /zhes kyang grags so/ /de skad smra ba tā ra nā tha ste/ /rang blos zab mo spyod par mi nus kyang / / dam pa mchog gi gsung gis bskul ba las/ /bla ma'i gsung rjes 'brang phyir nyes med snyam/ /gang 'dir semasakhral byas pa las/ /rnam dkar ci mchis de yis kyang / /'gro kun rdo rje'i gnas mchog la/ /da lta nyid du 'khod par shog /gsang ba'i bdag po'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi nang nas/ tshes byin rlabasamyur ba skyes mchog rdo rje grags pa'i bzhed don 'di ni/ bsams bzhin skyes pas 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i skyes mchog sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar mtshungs pa med pas mngon par spras pa/ stag lung pa chen po rje btsun bla ma dam pa ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas bka' bstsal spyi bos nod de/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sug las su 'tshal ba'o// // bkra shis//—326—

tho yig bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ phyag na rdo rje gtso4 po'i dbang gi tho yig ni/ sa chog dang / sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa/ lha sta gon du gnas pa rnams dkyil 'khor spyis rigs 'gre zhing / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten na sa'i lha mo sta gon mi dgos/ lha sta gon yang med pas rung ba tsam yin mod kyi/byas na legs so/ / de bskyed tshul ni/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ tsho mi bu rnams skad cig gis lha so sor bskyed/ ye shes pa stim/ dbang bskur ba mi mdzad/ mchod bstod snyan gsan dbab pa rnams bya'o/ /bum pa mgul 'ching sngon po can bya/ rnam rgyal bum pa bhuX lasagazhal yas khang dang / de nang du lha yongs rdzogs skad cig gis bskyed la/ go cha bgo /ye shes pa stim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod bzlas pa bdud rtsir bzhu ba rnams bya/ las bum gyi nang du phyag na rdo rje yab rkyang zhig bskyed pa la/ go skon pa la sogs pa gong bzhin/ a tsho ta'i sngags bzla/bdud rtsir bzhu ba mi dgos so/ /slob ma sta gon la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa bskyed du gzhug pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ spro ba bskyed pa/ so shing / khyor chu/ srung skud/ ku sha spyin pa/ rmi lam brtag pa rnams spyi dang mtshungs/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ thal mo sbyar nas rjes zlos bya ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /'khor ba'i —327—

'jigs pa chen po las/ /bdag dang 'gro ba skyabs pa'i phyir/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /tshogs kyi mchog gyur dge 'dun te/ /phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med pa/ /gnyug/ ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus dang ngag yid kyis/ /sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /mgon po khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /slad chad sdig pa mi bgyid pas/ /deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi/ khyed kyi slab bya rjes su slob/ khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas/ /kun nas yongs su skyabs su gsol/ /ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba ni spyi dang mtshungs/ de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum ba ra'i me tog bzhin/ /res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'gyung srid/ /rgya lam la ni res 'ga' 'byung / /gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de dag pas kyang shin tu dkon/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di/ /sems can sangs rgyas byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sta gon gyi dkyil 'bor mchod de nam mkhar 'degs pa dang / rdul tshon gyi phyogs la/ thig tshon byin rlabs/ dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing rgyan bkram pa sogs spyi khyab kyi rigs 'gre zhing / dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ bdag bskyed sngon du song bas/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ lha la dbang bskur ba'i bar/ phal cher bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ gtso 'khor thams cad sa bon kho na las bskyed pa dang / gtso bo la lus dkyil khyung lnga las mi byed pa —328

dang / ye shes sems dpa'i sngon du sta gon gyi lha bsre ba ni khyad par ro/ /de nas mchod bstod gtor ma dang bcas pa rgyas par bya/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bdag 'jug gis rjes la btang kyang rung ngo / /yig brgyas nyams chags bkang / slob ma la bskur ba ltar bdag 'jug blang la/dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/ mig dar btang /rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas/ lag tu me tog gtad la/ zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed ma thag tu/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūX zhes brjod pas/ slob ma phyag na rdo rjer gyur pa la/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de nasagasang gdams spyi dang 'dra/ deng nyid rdo rje gtum po bdag khyod kyis snying la yang dag zhugs/ /zhes sogs dang / bla ma'i bka' nyan pa dang / chu blud pa'i sgo nas kyang dam la bzhug /de nas yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad dang / /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma zhugs par bgyi/ /sgo rang phye nas/ nang du zhugs/ khyung lnga'i thugs ka nas so so'i phyag mtshan spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lngar stim/ phyogs bzhi nas phyag gsum gsum bya ste/ tsho( na ma te hūṃ/ zhes sogs kyis so/ / 'di'i rjes zlos/ gsang ba brtan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /ces me tog 'dor/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba btab/ spyi bor bla ma me ri'i nang du bzhugs pa nad gdon bsreg pa dang / nam mkha' nas bya khyung mang po cu ru dra byung / spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang khengs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes sems dpa' dpag tu med pa byung nas/ slob ma la bstim/ tsod a pe sha ya/ du ri ma nu ra ri/ a pe sha ya a pe sha ya/ ste bha ya sto bha ya/ ru ru tsa le hūṃ/ a pe du hūṃ/ ha ṣe swāhā/ zhes rol mo'i sgra bya zhing me tog gtor/—329—

de nas brtan par bya ba/ kha dog 'dri ba/ mig dar 'grol ba rnams bya/ ltos shig ltos shig 'di la ltos/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyod ni rdo rje gtum po'i rigs/ /skal ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /de nas lha ngo rgyas par bstan/ /de nas rnam dag bstan pa ni/ /dbus su phur bus btab pa ni/ /dran pa'o/ /thig skud ni tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'o/ /lha dang lha mo ni dpe/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /pad+ma ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /ze'u 'bru ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ni 'phrin las bzhi ston pa'o/ /sgo bzhi ni tshad med bzhi/ mtshon sna lnga ni ye shes lnga/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ni rnam rtog gcod pa lte ba mthing ga chos kyi sku/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khyung rnams sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku'o/ /yang na mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin ston kyang drang / de nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje gsol ba btab/ /slob ma gtso bor sgom du bcug /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bsgrubs pa/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /bum pa'i dbang 'di khyod kyi long / /bla ma mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas/ /dbang lha dpag tu med pa sprul/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang / /ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi dbang skur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/slob ma rnam snang gi nga rgyal 'phyud rgya byar gzhug /rdor dril spyi bor bzung la/ gang gang gnang ba de dang de/ /phyag na rdo rje rang nyid gtso/ /gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pa/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rin chen nyid/ /oṃ brnya a bhi 'a ṣañca huX ming 'dogs/ rin chen 'byung ldan du bskyed pa'i dbu rgyan skon la/ rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang / /dar —330—

dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi khiñca traX/ rdo rje gas po snang ba mtha' yas su bskyed pa'i/rdo rje gtad la/ de ring sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long / /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣañca hiX de nas don grub tu bskyed pa'i dril bu gtad la/ 'di ni rnal 'byordo ra ma rnams kyi/ khres rab dbyangs/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ karma a bhi tiñca a/ de nas slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdo rje can khyod bka' drin gyis/ /de ring bdag la bstsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ rdo rje che sogs dang / de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur nas/ sngags la sbyor gyi bar dang spyi dang mthun par mda' gzhu sbyin/ 'khor lo dung po ti rnams gtad la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /zhes pa nas/ rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces pa'i bar brjod/ de nas de kho na nyid gsum bzung ba spyi dang 'dra/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ rdo rje sems pas dbu brgyan/rjes gnang la/ mig thur/ me long / rigs lnga'i sprul bshad/ sngags kyi zlas lung rnams bya zhing /lung bstan dang / gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /sogs dbugs tsha/nga ba dang /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yis/ /sogs dam tshig bsgrags pa dang / gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyi ni/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gzengs bstod rnams bya ste/ bum dbang / maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ gsang dbang ngo bo spyi dang mthun/ sher dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gong bzhin/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma sogs kyis rig ma gtad/ zhal sbyor du 'dug par mos/ slob ma'i gnas lngar khyung rigs lnga'i thugs kar yang / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan ye shes lnga'i me 'bar ba bskyed/ desadug lnga bsregs/ byang sems zhu bas dga' bzhi thob par mos/ dbang bzhi pa la maṇ+ḍal gsol —331—

bto gong dang 'dra/ 'dzin pa gang yang med pa sa /rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la bzhag /sems nyid ma bcos gnyug/ ma sa khres pa bzhi pa'i don yin gsung /zhes pa'o/ /dbang gong ma gsum la mig dar bcings 'grol mi mdzad kun gyi mtha' rten cod pan gyi dbang ni/ me tog 'phreng ba spyi bor gtso / sa te/ huX me tog gang la lhung gyur cing / /bskal ba du mar rab sgrub pa/ /las dang skal bar 'dzoms pa yi/ /cod pan 'phreng ba'i dngos grub longs/ /gnyis pa dngos grub kyi dbang ni/ bdud rtsi lan gsum du blud la/ huX skye med sku la brjod bral gsung / /rtog med thugs kyi dngos grub bstsol/ /gsum pa slob dpon du byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ gdugs dang rol mor bcas te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum du byas nas/ sngags dang brgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes pa'o/ /slob ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba ni/ spyi dang mthun no/ /mda' gzhu dang chos bshad dang / sngags kyi rjes gnang ma gtogs/ mig thur nas gzengs bstod kyi bar/ g.yin nas kha bskang bar gnang bas/ lugs 'di la med kyang chog pa 'dra zhing / gzhan nasakha bskang ba/ gzhan yang phra mo snang mod kyi/ de dag ni dgos par mngon no/ /zhes pa gsang bdag gtum po ras chung lugs kyi dbang gi tho yig 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa mchog gi skyes mchog dpal stag lung ngag gis dbang po'i bka' gnang ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //bkra shis//—332—

thams cad bskyed pa'o gzhi zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/na mo badz+ra dha ra ya/ 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi gtso/ /bla ma mchog zhabs lag da nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /kun la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /'dir 'khor lo sgyur dru7gomangon rtogs bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems pa'i sgo bzlas rnams bya/ shrī he ru ko3haX/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃX/ de las 'od zer ye dang ma chad pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khotshor sangs rgyas chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs blo ka gnyis kyi phyag bya/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyi ma rdzo/ dkon mchog/gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ spro na rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / tso ( muX zhes pas gshegs su gsol ba'am mi dmigs par bsam/ tshad med bo zhe spyi dang mthun par bsgom/mgo bor gzugs phung ra las rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon dril bu dkur bsten nas/ nye bar tshor ba lo las/ rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che/ mgrin par 'du shes khyiXlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ long bur 'du byed ho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu g.yas sna tshogasardo rje/ gsum ga'ang g.yon dril bu thugs kar 'dzin cing / bzhin gar yang —333—

phyag snang kar po g.yas rje tshe rje na thugs//snying3ra rnam spyi stobatu de bzhin ni / ༵duXkau ni kar pa heruka ca kyigs she rjed spre pa/ pa'i/ tu tsho dzhai go sto/ nga ba nyad las ru ka nag pa g.yas rnyi dang ༵cas pa'i sa gnan/ni g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa'o//ga tu las gta mug rdo rje da kha po de 7de tsho the / rngo the/rde ra tsho ge tsho rje sdordegayas luXral la she/rje/nā baX hūṃX smus rim po~Xlce nag pa g.yas rdu /snaX ni / phrag she rda ra pa g.yas na pa / rtsa~X āXkau/ sgyu snang chags dorja snar rngi rje snyi pad+ma/lha las da / khams ti/ra sna she sgyu snang / she ljigadhimug rdo rje rda /she rang sten pa zhe rda ༷ ru she rje thar 'dzi 0 / mug rda phyag g.yan spya ka gi 2 //bzhi sbya / sdang ga rja te rda thar 'an pa kau par gzhan rnams kha dā/she ma she lte snang sags dang mtshungs pa/bye ma seraX kyang ral ༷ ༷ she 'dzi na//snying gar chu kham loX las she ༷ ra ma sne she kau rdo lhor la grin 2 pa/meng gar chu khams loX las/byed ma byad ma she ma / /ga 'jan pa/man par khams poX las 'gu/gas da maral gri 'dzin pa tha pa/dpral bar rlung deX/lhams thaX tre /sa gar she ṭā rdzukhural 'aXn pa//mas cad kyang g.yas 'ag mas sdog/g.ya/༷ gnyan/ thad pa dang kha sag 'an pa/gsang gnas su dz+wa// mkha' khams ga gog tha/pad+ma drwa ba can ma dud kha/spyo mug de ge she ba 'a zhal she phyag drug ga tharku'adzin lcags phy-i tshangs she gra gug/g.yan she thad pa kha ṭāX ga zhags/pa 'an pa/gce/kha lnga skra gral ba rnyi bcu bdun ༷ rma kri ti spya/gas/phyagagyolnga ldan/ bu g.yas brkyang bzhu/sa pa'// ta pa sko khri sdoXrdeXsarba dhar+shaX

pra kri ti pa ri shurnyo ྅haX/ oṃ swa bhā wa gos sh+ka gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃXlas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/ tshe ri 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ tshe dhi ni badz+re nas/ la rka hūm̐ hūṃX hūṃX zhes pa'i bar sngags wo drug brjod/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ zleX las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa ser po 'khor lo'i lte bar poX las pad+ma dang / riX las nyi me'i stengadu hūṃX/ de las rang nyid rdo rje sems pa dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu gyon can/dkar ser ljang ba'i/ zhal gsum/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyu/da pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis/ lcags kyu dang6lta kas/pa/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs can de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ bcu spros te/ zhe bor lo'i rdertsibs bcur 'khod pa khro bo bcur 'khod pa dang / bdag nyid rdo rje 'gasabyed hūṃX mdzad he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag /nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabasagayas rkyang bas 'jigs byed dus mtshan gnan pa/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon mo/ sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser nag ljang ba/nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba/ lho ru rdo rje 'khyil ba ljangakhu ljang dkar ser ba/ mer rdo rje gnod spyin dud kha/ dud ser ljang ba/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po/ dmar ser ljang ba/ rma du rdo rje stos po tshenagapo nag ser ljang ba/ dbang gdan du rdo rje 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljaba'i zhal gsum mi g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyi cang te'u dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po/ dkar nag ljang—335—

ba/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa loganag po nagaser ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu/ khro bo bcu po rnams ni phyogs skyong ba bcu gnon pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad rtsa phyag gnyis kyi rang snangagi rig ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ cher khros shing / stag lpags kyi sham thams can/ rus pa dang sbrul gyi brgyan cing / thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / mi mgo'i do shal can/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ nga zhes sogs kyi bka' bgosangs/khro bo rnams kyi bgegs rnams bkug /spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs/de rnams tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra ྅skya ra sogs/ bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du bcom ste de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ kha badz+ra lha ka badz+ra hūṃX kar badz+rahūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lwarga badz+ra hūṃX phaṭa/ o badz+ra nyi ṣa badz+ra hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā tra badz+ra snaX phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra kwa li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā bā la badz+ra hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sgyi ṣa ṇa badz+rahūṃX phaṭa/ gtso bo nyid kyi rtsa sngags zhal bzhi pa gang 'grub bzla/ 'dir thun mong ma yin ru pa) bsrung 'khor shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyi bkod pa yin gyi/tso 'bring sogs bsgom par 'dod na/ khro bo rnam rol du glo par yad zin pa pe tsā bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a ni mi ta rgyun badz+ra swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ra dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ut+pa rka3Xta/ stongapa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam par shes pa nā da'i rna ma pas nam mkhar —336—

gnas/ 'og tu khri las rlud gi dkyil 'khor dkon mchog zla gam/ de'i steng du rngoX las me'i dkyil dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ra las chu'i dkyil 'khoradakar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lam las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/de'i steng du rjuX las rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du skyi lasa'akhor lo zleX gyi mtshan pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las gru pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bo zhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa pha gu dang pre phuladangagaser gyi snam bu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / zla yab dang/ bzungamarnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas steg pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi dang bcas pa/ nangagolha rnams shar dkar/ bya ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus thob/ phyi rolamachod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor go yugaphyirol tu/ dur khrod r+pā po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dadashing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / ri dang/ mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yongs su gang ba/ phyi rolatubasrung ba'i 'khore lo dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang bzhi dkyil gyi dbus su/ rdo rje sems pa'i dkyil 'khor/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyila'akhor/ lho stod du rin wo 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor/ lho smad du snang ba mtha' yas kyi dkyil 'khor/ /byang stod du mi skyod pa'i dkyil ge bor/ byang smad du don yod grub pa'i dkyir 'khor/ thams cad kyang rta babs dang bral ba/lhag ma gzhal med khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nangaka—337—

ba brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng thog mdzes par phug cing / dbus rnams phyur bur gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang 'dab mabargyad pa'i gdan ni re re/ de rnams kyi lte bar rim pas/ seng khri pad+ma nyi ma/'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang / seng khri pad+ma zla ba tshangs pa dang/ rta'i khri pad+ma nyi ma/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang / rma bya'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang phyug chen po dang/glang po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma khyab 'jug dang / mkha' lding khri pad+ma nyi ma lha'i bu zla ba/ gdan drug car gyi steng du a ā nas/ aX a phrag gnyis gnyis yongasasugyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khore drug /ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ya ral wa ḍadharnams phrag gnyis gnyis yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drug /de rnams kyi dbus su rim pas/ hūṃX zleX i hri khaṃ mi boX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/rdo rje dkar po/ snyeng lo/ rin po che/ rdorje sngon po/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/slar 'dus shing thim pa las/ rigs drug gi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ yang yumarang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang dbus ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro/rdorje sems pa sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/yum cho so kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor mkha' 'grom sngon mo/ lho nub tu lwa ma ljangs nub byangadu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dmar mo/ byang shar du gzugs can la ser mo/ thams cad kyangagayas ḍa ma ru dang g.yon thod pa thogs pa/ shar du khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dang rab tu—338—

gtum/ mo/ byang du mahā kaX ka la dang gtum/ pa'i mig can ma/ nub tu kaXkaladang 'od ldan la/ lhor mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste/ dpa' bo rnams sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo rdo rje thod khrag rnams pa/ dkyil 'khore shar ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpalartag pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po/ 'khor lo dang de yu ba byas pa'i drilabu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ /'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'phyud pa/ shar du su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ byang du 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub tu rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyugam/ lhor rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dkar po/'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ yumarnams ser mo 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor lho lha ma'i dbusakyi gdan gyi stong du rdo rje nyi ma rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum zin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'phyud pa/ shar du aX ku ri dang e rab tī/byang du ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rtsa gi shugs can ma/ ltor rdo rje hūṃX mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste/ dpa' bo rnamasaser po rin chen dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams ljangakhurin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dkyil 'khor nub ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dngagayon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu la 'dzin pa yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/—339—
