pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ shar du rab tu bzang po dang shā ba de ni/byang du rdo rje bzang po dang shin du bzang mo/ nub tu 'jigs byed wo po dang rta sna ma/ lhor mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste/ dpa' bo rnams sku mdon dmangapo pad+ma dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams dkar mo pad+ma dngathod pa 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ dkyil 'khor nub byang ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag po/ khro bo'i rdo rje dngades yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdorje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ khro so rdo rje thod khrag 'jin mas 'byud pa/ shar du stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang sho ṇa ni/lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i cha ma ste/ dpa 'bo rnams sku mdog nag po khro bo'i rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dil bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams la ser mordorje dang thod khrag 'dzin ma/ dkyil 'khor byang shar ma'i dbus kyi gdan gyi stengadu dpal rta mchog sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang des yu babyas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang ser/ sna tshogasarderdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ shar du dpal he ru ka dang shin tudapa' mo/ byang du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub tu rnam parasnang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ lhor rdo rje sems pa dang brtson 'as zhi mo ste/ dpa' bo rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang des mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rnams sngo skya sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin ma/ gtso bo bcom ldan drug ni rdo rje'i skyil krung can yum drug ni pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyi 340—

yab la 'khril ba phyag g.yon yab la 'byud pa/ g.yas rdo rje sdigs mdzab dang bcas phyag mtshan rnams 'phyar ba'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams g.yasabarkyangs pas bzhengs shing / dpa' mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi 'khyud pa/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo khra gdong ma sngon po/ g.yas lcags kyu 'edzin pa/ byangasgo lug gdong ma ljang khu g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub skor khyi gdong ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ g.yasatshelong 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/g.yas pas pi wang 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gzhin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmaragayon ljang ba dri lo kyi dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du skyon rje 'joms pa g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ g.yas ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/de ltarasgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ drag mo'i tshul can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na thod pa dang / grub mo g.yon par kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/lngo'i gdan la g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ yab thams cad ral pa'ithor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa dang/ phyag rgya drug dang mgobo / 'phreng ba can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ 'khyud pa'i0shāgargyas yum dang spyor ba/ lha mo thams cad skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/thams cad yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor drug car gyi pad+ma'i mtshams kyis 'dab mabazhil/ ka pā la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba re re'o/ /oṃ āXsnriXsarba bi ra yo gi ni kā ya —341

waka tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3snya/oṃ badz+ra shu khyuXsarba dharmaXbadz+ra shu lte3haX/lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems pa nas/phaṭa phaṭa dudakhatsa'i ka'i ngo bo spyo pa'i bar go chaganyis kyi brgyas btab/spro na gong du ༅da pa'i phung khamasakyi lha bcu bdun po yang bskyed la/bsdu na/gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snangamadzad do//zhes sogs dag pa dran par bya/lha thams cad kyi dpra bar rma/mgrin par āXthugs kar snoX'akhor los sgyur ba drug gi thugs kar rang dnga'adraba'i ye shes sems dpa'/de'i thugs kar ti nge 'dzin sems dpa' rim pagahūṃX zleX oṃX lha hūṃX re/thugs ka'i 'od zer ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha modang bcas pa spyan drangs/h+pha/oṃ ni shir badz+re hūṃX hūṃXphaṭa nas rma dharma dha tu badzi ṇi hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa kyi bar gyis mar/dzaXhuX paṃ hoX.oṃ yo gas khyungaXsam dharmaXyo ga shurnyo3haX/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/zhes dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/gsang gsum gnasalas byung ba yi//rdo rje rnal 'byor ma kun dang //sangs rgyas 'jig wo mgon po yis//brtse nas bdag la dbang bskur stsol///zhes kyang gsol ba steb pagasangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi//gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa//rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin//zhesagasungs zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/sku gang dri mdag/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems pa la sogs pa rigs lnga la/rdorje mkha' 'gro ma dang /rdo rje mkha' 'gro nyid la ye shes mkha' 'gro dang/kholdernams la rang rang gi gtso bo dang /sdi mtshams ma brgyad la rdo rje sems pas

dbu rgyan/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mar pa rnams gas dang mtshungs la/ rdo rje 'chang da dza rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dzā lan+ta rar nag po spyod pa dang / /dge mgon ti lin rom ṇi ka /chos dbang bzod pa yab sras rnam pa gsum/ shwaka rdor sangs rgyas 'bum dang lo mchog pa/ /grags chen 'phags 'od bu ston byang rtse dang / /grags rgyawachos rgyal dpal 'byor bzang po dang / /mthu stobs rab brtan nam mkha' lhun grub dang / / 'jam dbyangs rgyan mtshan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod/ zhes gon pa spo/bstod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lus dang tshor ba dang ces pa nas/gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /phung po drug rnam par dag ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drug khams drug rnam par dag pa ni rdo rje btsun mo drug go /dkyil 'khoradrug ni sa drug ste/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i gnas ni sa lhag ma bzhi'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ tso( shrī mahā su kha badz+ra satwa ḍā ki ni dzālasaX bha raX/ hūṃX āXhūṃX phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shib / ḍā ki a la la la rnoX.ā/༷༷ oṃ ḍā ki ni dzāl saX bha raX hūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sgyir n+ta ḍā ki traX.aX oṃ ḍā ki nī dzā le saX bha raXhūṃX phaṭaswāhā/ oṃ sgyi pad+ma ḍā ki triX.aX oṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la saX bha raX hūṃX phaṭa grwa sma oṃ lha/badz+raḍā ki aX hūṃX phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la saX bha raX hūṃX phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sgyi bi shā ḍā ki hoḥ khaX.āX hūṃX ḍā ki nī dzā la saX bha raX hūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ 'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ khaX hūṃX phaṭa nas/ oṃ yaX hūṃX phaṭa kyi bar/ rang ming gi dang po'i yi ge nyid sngags kyi ngo bor gsungs so/ khrin bsdu bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur ba sogs byas nagadakyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshul ga' na rnams dang mtshungs pa las/ thun mtshams la/ 'jug pe'i tshe/rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /—343—

gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ dril bu'i zhabs lugs kyi man ngag ltar bya ba las/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi rjes su/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangs nges par brjod pa nyid yin no/ zhan tu zab cing gsang ba ste/ /nges par brjod pa'i rgyud rgyal las/ /kun gyi rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bor bsngags pa ste/ /'di yi sgrub thabs byas pa yin/ zhes pa zhe boralo sgyur drug gi sgrub thabs phun tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi zhes bya ba/ rgyud kyi dgongasapaltar/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā tha'am/ kun dga' snying por 'bod pas rangalo sum cu pa la nye bar sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// —344—

rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/na mo tsakra saX bha ra ya/ dpal ldan sku ni thams cad pa/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems dpa' po/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi mun 'joms pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/ /btud nas dpa' bo lha yi ba'i/ /bzhed don 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung / /ji bzhin sdom pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ tshen tu nyung dza'i tshig gis brjod/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi don nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems/rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lte bar ā li kā li g.yon skor du 'khod pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lho tshogs spros te bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ oṃ a ā nas/ ha k+ṣa hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/lan gsum brjod/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /zhes pa nas/nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma drwa ba can no/ /oṃ suX nas/ bha ga bān badz+ra hūṃX phaṭa/sngags rnams nag po ljang khu dkar po ser po'i 'od kyi tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ 'og tu hūṃX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃX gis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mda'i drwa ba rnams su gyur/ ma rmas —345—

rngam dang bcas pas nga tshar gcig brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma bzhi/ gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams/ tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkugahūṃX/ ra ba'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ 'brub khung ba rnams su bcug/phur bus spyi bor btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod/tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogs/ bgegs rnams bde ba chen po'i dbyings su bsgral/ ra ba la thim/de las byung ba'i rdo rje dang pad+ma ma dang 'khor lo'i ra ba rim pa gsum gyis skor zhing phyogs thams cad du ye shes kyi me 'bar gyur/ rang gi snying khar loX las zla ba'i steng du hūṃX sngon po/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ hūṃX las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bī ni hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ sogs brjod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ rtsod med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms/oṃ su bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmāXsu bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i dbus su rang gi lus ngag yid gsum glu( āXhūṃX du gyur/ skye ( āXl thim/ āXhūṃX la thim/ hūṃX cha lnga nā da'i bar du thim/ oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ nā da yang stong par thim/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las spros pa'i yoX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ reX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ra las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas —346—

mtshan pa/ de'i steng du loX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rbuX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du poX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃX gis mtshan pa/de'i lte bar/ g.yon bskor gyi a āXnas/ aX aXnyid 'gyur dang / ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ḍa dha/ da dha/ ya la gnyis 'gyur du gnas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ā li bcu drug dang / kā li bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur gyis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su nam mkha'i nā da yongs su zhugs te/ de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hūṃX dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs/ tshur dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/de'i nye bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i —347—

'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i nye bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu cung zad bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phre bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod chen po brgyad phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang me dang / sprin dang / chu dang ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭāX ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje thegs pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che —348—

dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis sbyan gsum ma/g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/skra grol zhing / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /gnyis ka'ang bskal ba'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lho ru gzugs can ser mo/ thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o//thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ byang du mahā ka la dang gtum/ mig ma/ nub tu ka pā la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho ru mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/shar lhor su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub tu 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang du rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar du rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su ang ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ byang du ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ /nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho ru rdo rje hūṃX mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor rab tu sna po dang ju ma dī/ lho nub tu rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang du 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/—349—

byang shar du mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang paṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang sna ring ma/ lho nub du nam mkha'i snying po/ snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ /lho nub tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/nub byang du rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ byang shar du rdo rje sems pa dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo dang /dpa' bo rnams phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ lhag ma dpal he ru ka dang mtshungs shing nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gi gnas pa'o/ /dpa' mo rnams ni rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa las/ g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo kha gdong ma sngon po/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gzhin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni drag mo'i gzugs can blo'i gdan la gnas pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga /'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi cod pan dang ldan pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis —350—

bzhugs shing / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs khar ye shes sems pa he ru ka sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo yab la 'byud pa/ de'i thugs khar ting nge 'dzin sems pa nyi ma gnas pa'i hūṃX/ yang na snying khar hūṃX dang / lte bar ā li kā li'i 'du 'phro las/ ye shes sems pa bskyed ces gsungs pa ltar/ byas kyang rung ngo / /oṃ āXhūṃX sarba bi ra yo ni kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ badz+ra shudhaXsarba dharmaXbadz+ra shurnyo3haX/ yab yum gnyis ka'i mig gnyis la/ oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa la dza las gzugs rdo rje ma me long 'dzin mas 'phyud pa/ rna ba la hūṃX las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po la hūṃX las sgra rdo rje ma sngon po pi wang 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ sna la treX las ser sna rdo rje ser po la boX las dri rdo rje ma ser mo dung chos 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ lcer āXlas 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa la ho las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ dpral bar lhaX las phrag dog rdo rje ljang khu la 'a las reg rdo rje ma ljang khu nab bza' 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ snying khar hūṃX las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po/ rdo rje dkar po 'dzin pa la rngoX las chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin mas 'byud pa/ de rnams rim pas rnam snang / mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / snang mtha'/don grub/ rdor sems rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa/ yab rnams g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /sgra rdo rje ma ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan can/gti mug rdo rje zla ba dang gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /lte bar loX las —351—

lhung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying khar ra las gsor byed ma sngon po rdo rje/ mgrin par paṃ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo pad+ma spyi bor toX las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu ral gri/ thams cad kyang phyag lhag ma gsum gyis gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ gsang bar kheX las pad+ma dra ba can ma dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug /g.yon gsum na thod pa kha ṭī ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rim pas zleX hūṃX hiXho las rnams las skyes pa'i rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ 'od dpag med/ ri sna wo 'byung ldan/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis yang dag par 'byud pa/ de thams cad kyang zla ba la gnas pa/ mgo bo gzugs phung sdi las rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo 'dzin pa g.yon dkur bsten pa la ltung byed mas 'khyud pa/ nye bar tshor phung eX las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'phyar ba/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi phung po sdiX las pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma 'phyar ba la 'gug byed mas 'byud pa/ long bur 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po go sangs sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar ba la pad+ma gar dbang mas 'byud pa/ gsum char phyag g.yon thugs khar sgyings pa/ snying khar rnam shes kyi phung po hūṃX las rdo rje sems pa dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs khar gtod pa/ g.yon dkur bsten pa dang mtshungs shing / dra ba can mas 'khyud pa/phung po thams cad kyi spyi ni hi las/ he ru ka gnag po rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon can g.yon sgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur bsten pa la/ gsod byed mas 'byud pa thams cad kyang g.yon dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /snying khar oṃ ha —352—

dkar po las rdo rje sems pa/ mgon por na ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hūṃX dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su po khad he nag po las mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su hūṃX hūṃX ho dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ lus thams cad la phaṭa lhaX ljang khu las rta mchog /lte bar oṃ boX dmar mo las rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haX oṃ sngon po las gshin rje ma/ khar hri moX dkar mo las rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar tri hri ser mo las bskyod byed ma/spyi gtsug tu hūṃX hūṃX ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las tsaṇ+ḍi ka /rdo rje sems pa gnyis dang rmongs byed ma zla ba dang /g.yin rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃX dkar po las rdo rje nag po/ byā las nor bu byā gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ sdi las ze'u 'bru phywa gyis mtshan pa/ nye ba dang / snying khar/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang mgo bo la yum gyi snying po dang nye snying / de bzhin du yum gyi lte ba dang snying khar/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying / mgrin pa dang spyi bor yum gyi snying po dang nye snying phan tshun 'byud pa dang tshum pas rjes su chags par byas/ thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa sbyan drangs/ rig ma ra ri rgyu drug gis ma rdzo/ h+pha/ dzaXhūṃX paṃ hoX oṃ yo ga shudhaXsarba dharmāXyo ga shurnyo3haX/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs khar hūṃX/ dbang gi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la mchod par gyur/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshe/gas kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu —353—

ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dang / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung ngo / /thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams/ lwa ba bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs sogs dang 'dra la rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags gnyis kyis bstod/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas/ rjes gzhig gi rim pas dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdus la/ slar yang rdzogs par bzhengs bar bya'o//de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni zhes sogs rnal 'byor ma kun spyod bzhin du brjod do/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul/ lha yi par spyi dang mtshungs shing / 'on kyang sngags bzla tshul/ kha sbyor gyi bzlas pa ni lugs 'di la mi mdzad pas/ so sor bzlas pa bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams rang lus kyi gnas so sor thim/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gsal bar gyur/ spyi bo spyi gtsug rna g.yas ltag pa dang / /rna g.yon smin dbus mig dang phrag pa dang / /mchan khung nu ma lte ba sna rtse mgrin/ kha dang snying kha 'bras bu mtshan ma dang / /bshang lam brla dang byin pa rkang sor bol/ /rkang mtheb pus mo yul chen nyi shur gyur/ /pu dza yo a/ go ra de ma/ ka yo sri pā ka hi/ pre gri so so su na pi ma ku/ /de dag tu gnas pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /mi phyed phra gzugs rtse mo g.yon/ /thung ngu rul sbal sgom la —354—

dbang / /skyon ma 'jug ma ma mo mtshan/ /bsil sbyin tsha ba gzhol (ma karangs/ /gzugs can spyi bor rgyu sbyin mang / /spyor bral sdu gu drug ma 'tshed/ /yid bzang gsung 'khor 'dod ma khyim/ /gtum mo rnams la rim bzhin du/ /rab gtum gtum mig 'od ldan sna chen ma/ /brtan blo mi'u thung lang ka shing grib ma/ /sa bsrung 'jigs byed rlud shugs chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs shin bzang rta rna bya gdong ma/ /'khor shugs dum skyes chang 'tshong go cha ma/ /rab dpal stobs chen 'khor bsgyur brtson chen ma/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ /so sen skra sbu lpags pa dri ma sha /rus pa rgyus pa mkhal ma snying dang mchin/ /mig 'bras mkhris pa glo ba rgyu ma theg /lte ba chu so 'dom bar bad kan rnag khrag rdul tshil dang mchil ma snabs/ /rim bzhin thod dum keng rus chen po dang / /keng rus mche gtsigs lha dgra 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje'i sku dang ni/ /myu gu can dang rdo rje ral pa can/ /dpa' chen hūṃX mdzad rab bzang rdo rje bzang / /'jigs chen rta sna stobs chen rin chen dang / /rta mgrin mkha' snying khrag 'thung gar dbang phyug /rnam snang rdo rje sems pa rnams su gyur/ kha dang sna g.yon gsang ba sna phug g.yas/ /rna ba g.yas g.yon mig rtsa g.yas g.yon la/ khā gdong lug gdong khyi gdong phag gdong dang / /brtan ma pho nya mtshe gtsigs 'joms ma'o/ /snying mgrin lte ba dpral ba'i 'khor lo la/ /mkha' 'gro lwa ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /spyi bo gsang bar thig le dkar dmar ni/ /he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mor gyur/ /de ltar lus dkyil la rgyun ring du sems gtad cing sgom mo/ /de nas chos thams cad bde ba chen por lhag par mos te/ go cha gnyis bgos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /'di nyid kyi rgyun gyi gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sdom 'byung gi sgrub pa'i thabs su bshad pa de kho nas bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba'am/ /'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas 'byung ba de dag kyang ji ltar 'os pa'i tshe bya'o/ /gal te mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ phung khams skye —355—

mched kyi dag pa bor la ye shes tshogs bsogs pa yan sngar ltar bsgom la/ bgrung 'khor dang dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab/ go cha gnyis bgod pa man chad sngar ltar byas pas 'grub bo/ khren tu bsdus pa ni rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad par gyur 'di yang / /phun tshogs yon tan tshad med de/ /grub pa'i dga' ston brgya phrag ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyi rtag tu thob/ /slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'gyung gnas kyi bzhed pa las 'byung ba'i/ sgrub thabs 'khrul pa spong ba'i lugs ltar/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// —356—

me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs me tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs sgeg pa'i nyams rgyas shing // bcu gnyis yan lag ma dang rol/ /spros kun 'od gsal r+ṣa por sdom/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon la 'dud/ /dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs/ /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs/ /phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /dngos grub gter ba'i yi dam lha/ /dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/ /gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa'i bar gyis sems bskyed la sdom pa bzung / de nas he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas bya ba spyi dang mthun/ oṃ shrī he ru —357—

ka haX/ rang skad cig gis phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃX sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes pa nas/ de rnyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis phyag 'tshal/ oṃ gu ru shrī badz+ra he ru ka sarba bi ra yo gi ni ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ de bzhi du pa duX/ sdi khye nas shasta'i bar gyis mar/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas/ /rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang nas/ /bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs nas 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang shing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i don phyir sangs rgyas 'phrin las rnams/ /ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis bgyid par rbe(ga /ces lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las yoX —358—

las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yoX gyis mashaṃ pa/ de'i steng du rngoX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rngoX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du boX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po boX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du loX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi loX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du poX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūṃX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba/ dra ba/gur bla re zla'i dra ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ be dhi ni ba dzī bha ba badz+ra ban+ta hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃX paṃX hūṃX/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃX yoX hūṃX/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃX kheX hūṃX/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la traX soX traX/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ra ka hūṃX hūṃX/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la rgyuX las 'od 'phros/ lus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang mda' yab dang / bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bzhi dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thogs phugs can/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang /nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'bad ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang / sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/—359—

gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing /pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod wo po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang/ ṣ+ka skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang /sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod brten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/g.yon skor gyi/ a ā nas/ aX aX zhes pa'i bar phrag gnyis/ zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas skor gyi ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la ba ḍa rte phrag gnyis/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃX sngon po/de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha bcu gsum yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog /sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum las 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭāX ga /bzhi pa na khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje thegs pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i —360—

thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / nor bu rin wo dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo'i 'phreng ba can/stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag dang kha rgya ga 'dzin pas yab la 'byud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgos shing khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ /byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ /lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ mtshams bzhir bum pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor a gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ khar lhor skyon rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha cha ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing mi mgo'i do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi skabs kyi gnas pas —361—

dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ /lha thams cad kyi spyir bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āXlas dang pad+ma dmar po āXs mtshan pa/ thugs khar hūṃX las rdo rje sngon po hūṃX gis mtshan pa/ yab kyi snying khar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgon bor na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃX las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su no ṣaṭa he las he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis la hūṃX hūṃX ho las 'od dpag med mthing ka / yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haX las rta mchog ljang khu rnams rdo rje dang / dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po rna bar hūṃX las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ snar khaX las phrag dog rdo rje ljang khu/ lcer oṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar traX las ser sna rdo rje ser po/ snying khar hūṃX las dbang phyug rdo rje sngon po rnams/ rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ boX las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying khar haX oṃ las gshin rje ma sngon po/ khar hri mi rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hre hri las bskyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃX hūṃX las skrag med ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las rta ka dud kha rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃX gi 'od zer gyis/ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ h+pha/ dzaXhūṃX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo gā shu zhiXsarba dharmāXyo gā kyo3haX/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dab pa gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ h+pha/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa —362—

yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung / sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma bzhi la don grub kyi dbu brgya par gyur/ ā li kwa li lan gsum du brjod cing / ro brkyang gi lam nas ā li kā li'i 'gro 'ong byas pas rtsa lam khyab par mos/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog rgyas pa spro na skabs 'dir bya ba/gnyis med rdo rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar ram/ spros pa la dga' na bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yig cha ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang skabs 'di nyid kyis cho ga'i yan lag tu de dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /'dus zhabs lugs ltar mchod lha mkha' nang nas spros te/ gong bzhin du ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar rgyes mchod/ lha rnams kyi rang sngags kyi nang mchod myang / gsang mchod bya/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ 'khor lo'i dmigs pa gsal btab la bzlas pa bya ste/ i tshe shrī badz+ra he ru ka ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sa sba ra swāhā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ hi ha ha hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ne ye hūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /ma mo bcu gnyis kyi sngags ni spyi dang mtshungs so/ /rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par langs te/go cha gnyis kyis rgyas btab la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sdom pa 'byung ba bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su bshad zin yin la 'dor chen gyi khyad par lwa ba bcu gsum ma'i skabs su 'chad pa ltar yin pas/ de dang der lta bar bya'o/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i dgongs pa bzhin//—363—

byas/ /'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ mi tri pa'i dgongs don zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas skye bo mang po la phan par mthong zhing / bdag dang skal mnyam gzhan gyi don du sbyar ba ste/ rang lo sum cu pa la/ thub bstan gser mdog can du'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel// //

man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gar+bha bha mu kha he ru ka ya/ rdo rje mthon ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdud dpung lan brgyar bcom byas nas/ /sgrub la bde chen dngos grub stsol/ /rab 'jigs he ru ka la 'dud//'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi khyad par rab 'byams zhig sgrub par 'dod pas/ sdom pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar rdo rje khrag 'thung bong bu'i zhal can sgom par bya'o/ /de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ shrī he ru ko3haX/rang skad cig gis bde mchog zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃX sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX na mo gu ru bhe/ na maXpha shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la bhe/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i/ /spyan mngar so sor 4zhags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa bla bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub bar du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par —365

sgom/ oṃ su bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmāXswā bhā wa shurnyo3snya/ oṃ hūṃ n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las sgru las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla zhing /de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ra las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du tha las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du sri las ri rab rin po chen sna bzhi las/ grub pa/de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba/phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni ba dzī bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃX/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃX rgya hūṃX/oṃ badz+ra bi ra na hūṃX kheX hūṃX/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la treX tri treX/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka hūṃX hūṃX hūṃ/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la sdi las gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/༄pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / drwa phyed dang / shar bu dang / zla yab dang / bzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas steg pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lha ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud —366—

la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs bskyong ba dang / zhing bskyod ba dang / shing dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon bste/ra gyi a ā zhes pa nas/ aX aXzhes pa'i bar phrag gnyis/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas skor gyi ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa khyu/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃX dkar po/ nam mkha'i na da hūṃX yig de nyid la thim/ de las 'od 'phros/'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshun 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog/sku mdog mthing nag drag po chen po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ka bong bu'i gdong pa can khrag chen gyi byugs shing shin tu 'jigs pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/lha zhal khro chags kyi nyams can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum —367—

dang ldan cing mche ba rtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi mi lpags rlon pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pas thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas rkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / nor bu rin po wo dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzug dang bcas pa'i rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyi yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dges shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka 'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ /de bzhi dang rdo rje phag mo ni bong bu'i zhal can/ zhal gyi gra nas mahā hu dhi ra'i rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyi gang ba'i steng du kā pa la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi phyi rol/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor kha gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor a gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan pa g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba ma he'i gdong pa can —368—

pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje'i pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba ri dwags kri ṇa'i gdong pa can/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba stag gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang / g.yon sngo ba dom gyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing / skra grol/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing mi ma sto do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pa dngos grub thams cad brtsol ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la/ byang phyogs dza lan+ta rar mahā kaX ka la/ nub phyogs o gri ya nar kaX ka la/ lho phyogs ar bu ta rar mche ba rnam par rtsigs pa/ shar lho go dha ba rir lho'i sgra/ lho nub ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med/ nub byang dī ko ṭar rdo rje 'od/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po bya khyung gi gdong can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs ka ma ru par aX gu ri/byang phyogs oṃ ṭi ra rdo rje'i ral pa can/ nub phyogs ṭi ka sha ru ner dpa' bo chen po/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃX mdzad/ shar lho ka liskor rab tu bzang ngo / /lho nub la sba kar rdo rje bzang po/ nub byang ka nyir 'jigs byed wo po/byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rma bya'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pra ra pu rir stobs po che/ byang phyogs gri ha de bar rin 369—

chen rdo rje/ nub phyogs so sor ras ṭar rta mgrin/ lho phyogs su brna di par nam mkha'i snying po/ shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka /lho nub rdo pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /nub byang ma run rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku lu tab rdo rje sems pa ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ 'og ma gnyis kyi rtsa gsum dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ nyi ma la g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs shing / rang snang gi shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs khar rang 'dra 'am phyag gnyis pa'i ye shes sems pa/ de'i thugs khar hūṃX dang ra ting nge 'dzin sems pa/ dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs khar hūṃX/ yab rnams kyi rmugs khar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems pa/ mgon po ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /mig gnyis su hūṃX hūṃX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo yab yum rnams kyi lte bar oṃ ra dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haX yoX sngon po gshin rje ma khar hri mi dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hri tri ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃX hūṃX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa dud kha sgo ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems pa dang rmongs byed zla ba'i gdan dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃX gi 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ h+pha/ dzaXhūṃ baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shu zhiXsarba dharmaXyo ga —370—

shurnyo3haX/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ h+pha/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gi khru gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa yab yum la rnam snang / bde chen 'khor lo ba la rin 'byung / thugs 'khor ba la mi bskyod pa/gsung 'khor ba la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor ba la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la bhe/badz+ra ar+ghaX āXhūṃX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyi phyi mchod phul/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oX āXhūṃX/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ skal ldan bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ skye dgu'i 'tsho ba bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ ma hā bo dhi'i zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer gyi zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ gu ge piṇ+ḍa ta'i zhal du oX āXhūṃX/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po lha dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āXhūṃX/ lha thams cad kyi snying pos dkyil 'khor la phul a nu ra ga nas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yang phul la/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyi bstod/ dkyil 'bor gyi ga bor lo bde stong du 'char bar byas te mnyam par bas /rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir sgom/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'am spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gsal btab nas/ bzlas pa bya ste/ sngags 'phreng rgyas par ni/ lha yi pa dang mtshungs la/ bzlas pa'i snying po ni/ glu phu khro ha ha hūṃX —371—

hūṃX phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bdun pa nyid la nan tan du 'bad par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i gzhi ni/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ dmar skya las/ dbugs phyi nang du 'gro ba dang brtun nas/ byed pa man ngag yin no/ /mthar bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pas byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ sa bcu dag gi rim pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis phyi dang nang gi chos rnams kun/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rnam par dag /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang / /tshangs pa'i kud pa la sogs rtag /lha'i snying po'i sngags kyi ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyi mdzes/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /gdub 'khor gyis ni rna ba brgyan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin pa mgur chus mdzes pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ /lpags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma grub gsang sngags kyi/ /ske rags byas pas brgyan pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug po ni/ /phyag rgya yis ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa'o/ /rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin/ /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams ni rnam par dgakha ṭī ga ni lha yi sku/ khres rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /lpin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor mo ni masno mor brjod/ /mya ga las byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa yin/ /dag po cho se kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ yī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru —372—

ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes dag pa dran par byas la/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyi snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal du langs te/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas btab la mthun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ lwa ba bcu gsum ma dang 'dra ba yin pas/ de'i sgrub thabs dang sdom 'byung bcu gsum ma'i sgrubs thabs su shes par bya'o/ /gang zhig sgom par byed pa la/ /phun tshogs bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /'byung 'gyur de yi pha mtha' ni/ /bye ba'i gdong gis brjod nus sam/ /'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel// //—373—

mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar ga sdo/ngas pa bzhugs/rab cha ye shes me lce yis/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ /rab gsal dkyil 'khor ri mo ni/ /ci yang 'char 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs sems rdor sems bsgom bzlas spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying khar ji las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃX/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ 'od zer ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khore bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ skabs 'dir spro na/ rnal 'byor ma lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su 'bri bar 'gyur ba ltar/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ oṃ āXbadz+ra bī ni hūṃX/ nas/ oṃ āXbadz+ra dharme hūṃ/ oṃ āXhūṃX/ oṃ āXbadz+ra mahā su khaX/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/rdo rje sems pa'i yi ge brgya ba lan gcig brjod/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/oṃ sā bhā wa shurnyaXsarba dharmāXswa bhā wa shudhe ྅haX/ oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da nam mkhar gnas/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i ra lan gnyis brjod/ sngags las spros pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang /—374—

rwa ba dang / gur dang / bla re dang / mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re sogs sngags wo drug brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yoX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i stong du rngoX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du rbaX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du loX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/de'i steng du suX las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du poX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ hūṃX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du zleX dkar po las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / grub bzhi༄/ sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab/ bzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ byang ljang /nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nye bur gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs gyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar paṃ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum sgro375—

mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs bskyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang /me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ra kyi steng du/ a āXnas/ aX aX phrag gnyis las zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ḍa dha/ da dha/ ya la phrag gnyis zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du/ hūṃX las rdo rje'i ste bar spyi gi mtshan pa/ de las nam mkha'i nā da thim/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te hūm̐ la thim/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/dbus su 'khor lo bde mchog che/ /drag po chen po he ru ka /sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag /mi bzad sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i sku/ /zhal dang phyag dang zhabs rnams ni/ /thams cad 'bum gyi grangs su bya/ /zhal ni ji rnyed thams cad kyang/ /mdun nag g.yon ljang rgyab dmar ba/ /g.yas pa ser por shes par bya/ /dang po rdo rje dril bus 'byud/ /de 'og lha mo'i nu ma 'tshir/ /de 'og thod pa kha ṭāX bsnams/ /gnyis kyi glang lpags 'dzin pa'o/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dgra sta dang / /mdung rtse gsum pa mgo po nyid/ /cang te'u dang ni gri gug dang / /mda' dang gzhu yang bde bzhin ste/ /thod dbyug dang ni mdung thung dang / /sdigs mdzub dang ni g.yin shing dang / /'khor lo ral gri rin chen —376—

dang / /pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /rdo rjes masno pa'i lo / ga to dang / /ga da mdung ring mdung kha leb/ /rdza ma be con chu gri dang / /dung dang rwa dung pa ṭa ha/ /pi wang gling bu rdza rnga che/ /rdza rnga rnga zlum gri gsum ge slog /sa chu me dang rlud dkyil 'khor/ /sgra gcan keng rus 'jigs byed che/ /lus lag rkang pa lpags pa dang / /lcags sgrogs g.yas pa'i lha na ste/ /g.yon pa'i lhag ma'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltar phyag ni brgya phrag rnams/ /re re dang mtshungs stong phrag brgya/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /dus mtshan tshangs ma dbang mo dang / /dpal mo ga ga dbyangs can ma/ /gzhon nu ma dang drug ldan ma/ /re ba ti dang dga' byed ma/ /tsa mun ḍi dang klu ma dang / / gnod sbyin mo dang zla ba mo/ /nyi ma mo dang dga' ma dang / /tshogs bdag mo ni snying khar mnan/ /g.yon rnams 'jigs byed chen po dang / /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag khyab 'jug kun 'gyed gzhon nu dang / /nag chen dga' byed dbang phyug dang / /gshin rje chu lha lus ngan dang / /zla ba nyi ma lus med dang / /tshogs bdag la sogs kha bub du/ /skyel ba'i steng du rnam par mnon/ /lhag ma'i zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad gnon te bzhugs/ /zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ma/ drag po chen po mche ba rnam par gtsigs pas 'jigs su drang ba/ gzhad pa/ mi sdug pa/ rab du 'jigs pa/ dpa' ba/ sgeg pa/rngam pa/ smin ma rnam par g.yo ba/ snyems pa/ zhi ba/ g.yo ba/ mig g.yo ba/zhal rnam par gdangs pa/ rnam par rol ba/ ljags rnam par bskyod pa/ sna tshogs pa'i nyams gtar par mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas lngas dbu la brgyan pa/—377—

rdo rje sems pas spyi bo'i gtsug tu brgyan byas pa/ rab du 'bar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /zhabs rnams g.yon bskums g.yas brkyang shing / ral ba'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pa dang / thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ba glang gi gdong pa can/ byang du lā ma ljang khu rta'i gdong pa can/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo glang po chen po'i gdong pa can/ lhor gzugs can ser mo ce spyang gi gdong pa can/ thams cad rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnams/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dang / rab tu gdum mo nas/ byang shar ku lu ltar rdo rje sems pa dang rtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /lko pa'i bar spyi dang 'dra/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'jigs byed chen po rnams rnam par gnon pa/ yab rnams bcom ldan 'das mtshungs pa/ zhal phyag sna tshogs pa dang / yum rnams —378—

rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa'i zhal phyag gnyis pa'o/ khar sgor khra gdong ma sngon mo/ /byang sgor wa gdong ma ljang khu/ nub skor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gzhin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba ma he'i gdong pa can/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba bong bu'i gdong ba can/ nub byang du gshen rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba rnga mong gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ ma mo bcu gnyis po rnams ni/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis/ ḍā ma ru dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭāX ga dang bcas pa/ dbu dang phyag dang zhabs dang mtha' yas pa ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pas dngos grub brtsol ba'o/ /bdag nyid kyi lus la rtsa 'bor lo bzhi/ yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ yum gyi snying khar oX ha dkar po nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs khar hūṃX/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃX gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim oṃ yo ga shurnyaXsarba dharmaXyo ga shurnyo3haX/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ h+pha/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi khiñca hūṃX/ su ra ta stuX ā haX/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas —379—

dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ rig ma 'ag drug gis mar/ nang ma rdzo byin gyis mas la/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /ka sna ri mo na ro rin 'byung sbas/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas da sha ba la dang / /'dren pa'i dpal dang shri gup+ta dang / /blo gros 'byung gnas dkar min sprin gyi zhabs/ /dz+nya na mi dra bde chen rdo rje dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'khru gsum btags pas dkyil 'kho/ra gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul/tso tshe āXbadz+ra mahā sdo/ khaX/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa yang phul la/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pasabastod/ nag po pa ltar dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gal te drag po'i las la mos na/ 'khor thams cad kha dog mthing khar bsgom zhing / gtso bo'i zhal yang rtsa zhal khro bo'i zhal la/ zhal lhag ma rnams gdong brnyan du bsgyur te/ kha dang chu skyar g.yid dang ni/ /ce spyang skye gnyis sngags chen po/ khrung khrung ri skeg ka dam pa/ /zhes pa srog chags brgyad dang / bong bu dang / mi dang / rus sbal dang / khyi dang / rnga mong dang / rta la sogs pa/phyugs sna tshogs pa'i gdong brnyan du bsgyur zhing / g.yin yang / rtsa ba'i phyag brgya phrag gcig dang /stong la sogs pa ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni spyi dang mtshungs zhing / bzlas bya ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru kaX ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru nas/ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha raX hū ཾ ༷ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ra hi/ ta bya tha pro snya gi ha na ha na nas/ yo gi shwa ri phaṭa hūX hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar yum gyi sngags sngags so/ /yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyang bzla bar bya'o/ /cher khros pas ha ha hi hi huX hūṃ phaṭa ces kyang zlas so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ oṃ āXhūṃ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod par bsam/ mtshams rngam dang —380—

bcas pa'i nga lan gnyis su bzla/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ yang ba/nga tshar gcig bzlas pas bka' bgos/ de rnams kyi phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug /bsrung 'khor gyi phyir rol du brub khung sdu bcug pa la/ rang gi thugs kha nas spros pa'i phur bu rnams kyis btang/ oX gha gha sogs lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogs/ tho bas brdungs pas/ bgegs rnams ming yang med par byas par bsam/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la lha thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis phur bu dang tho ba 'dzin par bsgyur te/ tsod gha gha sogs kyi bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste/ rang gi sna bug gnyis su zhugs/ snying kha'i hūṃX la thim/ rang nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ phaṭa ces brjod/ slar yang stong pa li ngang las lha skur gyur/ swāhā oṃ zhes brjod/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas btab nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /'di'i kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la/ kha zas thams cad ling gar byas te/ bskral nas bza' bo/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni sdom 'byung gi mngon rtogs su shos par bya'o/ /bdud dpung phyed mar brlag byed cing / grub pa brgyad sogs mngag bzhug dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang srin po sogs/ /tshul 'di sgom pa'i bran du 'gyur/ /zhes pa drag po bdud 'joms pa zhes bya ba 'khor lo bde mchog drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs mngon brjod bla ma las gsal bar gsungs pa/ bla ma dam pa gang ba'i rdo rje'i zhal gyi man ngag bzhin/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha nam/rdo rje ming gis mngon par mtshan pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa snyi la badz+ra gyis rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel// //—381—

ces bya ba bzhugs/tsho'o swā sti/ he yig rol pa ru brjod bral/ /ka yig byed pa shrī yig ni/ /zung 'jug ye shes skur gyur pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir lā ba bcu gsum mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs las 'don pa spos te/ dril bu phyir dkyil lha lnga sgom par 'dod na/rdor sems sgom zlas yan chad 'dra/ shrī he ru ko3haX/ oṃ a ā nas/ rak+ṣa hūṃX phaṭa lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying khar rngoX las/ nas/ dbul bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ āXbadz+ra a dar she hūṃX/ bī ni:ga rnye: rā se: pu ra she: oṃ āXbadz+ra dhar me hūṃX/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo bzhis bdud rtsis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āXhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āXbadz+ra mahā su kha nas/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir ro'i snying khar zla ba/ mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum thod sna tshogs pad+ma'i mu khyud la 'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ gzhal med khang gi phyi rol lkog pa nas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal mthing ga /g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal ljang ba nas/ 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa 'dzin cing rlung gi 'phyar ba/—382—

g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭāX ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po wo pa nas/ thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ skra grol zhing nas thugs khar hūṃX/ snying khar oṃ ha dkar po nas/ tshwa ka'i ngo bo zhes pa'i bar spyi dang mthun/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ byang du lwa ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ /lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga /g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing mgo'i do shal can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi gnas pa dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'o/ kha cig gtso bor 'khor rnams g.yas brkyang ba'i brkyang bskum stabs su 'dod pa ni mun sprul lo/ /lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes pa'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dran sogs byang chub yan lag drug /phag mo'o yang dag spong ba dang / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang dang dad sogs bcu/ 'phags lam rnams ni —383—

bum pa bzhi'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas yum la mi skyod pa/ lha mo bzhi la rim pa/ rtag pa/ don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ tsho gos zhing gi skabs ltar lha mo drug dang / ma hā su khaṃ gi bar gyis mchod dang / rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ oṃ shrī mahā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru ka āXhūṃX hūṃX phaṭa swāhā nas/ ha ho hriX rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma/ /dril bu lā ba 'bar 'dzin dang / /spyod pa pa dang dge ba'i mgon/ /ti lo nā ro pham ting pa/ /bha dan+ta pa mar do dang / /bde mchog rdo rje blo ldan zhabs/ /lho tshad dbang phyug brtson 'grus dang / /'phags pa lo mchog grags chen pa/ /'phags 'od bu ston khyung lhas pa/ /nor bzang ka bzhi rin rgyal dang / /mkhyen rab chos rje lha bo pa/ /mkhas pa kun dga' don grub dang / /bsod nams dpal 'byor bya gling pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ /oṃ āXhūṃX/ yang pu rangs lo chung nas brgyud pa ltar na/ bha dan+ta pa lo chung dang / /sa chen bsod rtse grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa paṇa bo dong rin chen sems pa che dang / yang rtse ba/ bu ston rje dang khyung lhas pa/man chad gong bzhin/ rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btanas pas lha rnams mchod gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i bar du 'dra ba las/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūṃX/ oṃ lā me hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ zhes pa ni 'khor gyi sngags so/ /thun bsdu bar 'dod na rang gi snying kha'i zhes sogs dang / gtor ma'i cho ga yang / dngos grub thig pa bzhin du bya'o/ /dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs 'grel du/ lā ba'i zhabs kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi sgrub thabs gtsug gi nor bu mdzad/ yan lag phra mo 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ cho ga'i sgros gcig yin pas/ 'dir yang bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la 'don pa spos pas/ lha lnga'i sgrub —384—

kun la cher grags kyang / /gzhan 'gas ming yang ma thos pa/ /de don rtogs pa bla phyir sbyar/ /dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gsal byed 'di yang/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum bcu pa la gser mdog can du'o/ /bkra shis// //

'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bde ba bskyed ma zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni tsa rā ṇa ya/ mtha' dag rgyal ba kun gyi bde bskyed yum/ /li khri'i mdangs 'phrog 'jo sgeg lang tsho can/ /mtshar sdug 'od 'bar rab drag dpa' mo'i sku/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la dges par mdzod/ /'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ bde ba'i brtan la kha nub tu phyogs nas/ skyabs sems rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du gtang nas/ bā ra hi ā haX/rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byordo ra mar gyur/ oṃ a ā nas/ aX aX ka kha nas/ha k+ṣa hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa lan gsum/ ā li kā li'i 'phreng ba 'od zer lnga ldan/ lte bar lan gsum g.yon skor du 'khyil ba/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ 'gegs rnams bcom ste/ slar yang lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ rang gi mgo bo/ lte ba/ mgrin pa/ long bu/ snying kha/ spyi gtsug rnams su rim pas/ gzugs kyi phung po oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/tshor ba'i phung po aX las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ 'du shes kyi phung po khyiXlas pad+ma gar dbang dmar po/ 'du byed kyi phung po ho la rdo rje rgyal po ljang khu/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po hūṃX las rdo rje sems pa dkar po/ phung po lnga char gyi ngo bo hi las he ru ka nag po/ mig 'bras/ rna ba'i khung / sna phug /lce'i rtsa ba/—386—

dpral ba/ snying kha rnams su/ rim pas/ mig oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/rna ba hūṃX las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ rna treX las phrag dog rdo rje ser po/ lce a las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar ṇaX las ser sna rdo rje ljang khu/ snying khar hūṃX las dbang phyug rdo rje dmar po/ lte ba/ snying kha/ mgrin pa/ dpral ba/gsang gnas rnams su rim pas/ sa khams loX las ltung byed ma ser mo/ chu khams yoX las gsod byed ma nag mo/ me khams poX las 'gu/gas byed ma dmar mo/ rlud khams toX las gar dbang ma ljang khu/ kha khams kheX las pad+ma drwa ba can ma dud kha rnams su gyur/ 'di dag zhal phyag rgyas par bsgom par 'dod na/ lha hi pa'i 'grel pa shes rab bzung bas mdzad pa ltar shes par bya/ bsdu na yab rnams rdo rje dril bu dang / yum rnams gri thod dang 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying khar poX las pad+ma/ rngoX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baX yig dmar po/ de'i 'od kyi nang gi rnyog pa bsal te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyi bde r+ṣa nyid sogs dang / stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /skal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /oṃ bī ni badz+re ṇi hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa nas/ oṃ dharma dha tu ba dzī ṇi hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa ces pa'i mthar rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ āXhūṃX gis nang mchod phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa ma lus rnams/ khyed rnams kun gyi mngon du so sor bshags par bgyi/ bla ma la sogs rnams kyis bsod rnams bgyis pa gang / de rnams ma lus kun la —387—

rjes su yi rang ngo / /bya ba byas pa byed par 'gyur ba gang dag gi /dge ba des ni sems can ma lus rgyal bar smon/ /dkon mchog gsum la nges par yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba bde la 'gor phyir chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi lam la yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /mgon po bzhes shig bdag gi lus 'di dbul lags kyi/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /ces sogs/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu’༷༷sarba dharmāXswā bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems na da'i rnam par langs nas nam mkhar gnas par bsam/ 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du tha las mo'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du ra las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du sgyi las rin po che ri rab sna bzhi las grub pa/ sdigs mdzug skor zhing se gol gdab pa'i mtshams rngam phyogs bzhin byed bzhin du/ oṃ nga ni nga hūṃ hūṃX phaṭa nas/ birnya rā dza hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa zhes pa'i bar brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur gla re/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsru ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ me bhi ni ba dzī bha wa ban+ta hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra nyu paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañca ra hūṃ yi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi rā na hūṃ rngo hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tri rgya khri/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lar ka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ slar yang phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i/ skye( sum+bha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags lan gnyis brjod/ sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma is ma brgyad kha dog so sor nges pa can/ tho —388—

ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams phyogs skyong bcu'i rnam par bkug ste/ hūṃX las byung ba'i khron pa rnams su bcug /de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs phur bu'i spyi bor tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mut+pa ra sogs/ bgegs rnams phur bus btab pas 'od gsal la thib par 'gyur/bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i/ zleX las rnam par snang mdzad shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang / bre phul dang / gser gyi snam bu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / zla yab dang / bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas steg pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po/ brtsebs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar paX las bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur gur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal —389—

med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing / pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod wo po brgyad dang / phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang /sprin dang / chu dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khordo ra gyi steng du/ a ā nas/ aX āX phrag gnyis las zla ba/ de'i steng du ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ḍa lha/ da dha ya la/ khrag gnyis zhu ba las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du/ baX las rdo rje'i lte bar ra gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus ste ra la thim/de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ lha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sku mdog pad+ma ra ga ltar dmar ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing /skal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo rjes chags bde ba'i nyams kyi myos pa'i sku/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar zhing bkra la/ zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug mthur tu sdigs shing / sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad 'joms pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ mchan khung g.yon par kha ṭāX ga thabs kyi rang bzhin can la/ ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu g.yer kha dang 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba rtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam/po —390—

lnga yi dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i brgyan lngas brgyan pa/ dmar chen gyi gtung rdebs myos shing / si ha la'i rgyun 'bab pa/zhabs g.yon brkum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying po dang nye snying tshar gcig brjod do/ /'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams bzhir khu ba dang / khrag dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / sgron ma lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol du/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su li ra ma lar sar rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dza lan+ta rar gtum mig ma/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs ar gu tar ṇa chen ma/shar lho go dha ni rir dpa' bo'i blo ma/ lho nub ra smi shwa rar mi'u thung ma/ nub byang dī ko ru la sko'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar shing grib ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma ru par sa bsrung ma/ byang rtsibs o zhir 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar chang 'thung ma/ shar lho ka ling kar sngo sangs lha mo/ lho nub ra kar shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kañci ra ta na ma/ byang shar gi ma la yar bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs dre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri hā de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs so so ras ṭar shon ṭi ni/ lto phyogs su bar na di par 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga —391—

rar shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /nub byang ma hur rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku mu tar brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor lug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gzhin rje mche ba g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ de thams cad mo'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing skra grol ba/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing / mi ma sto cod pan can dang do shal can/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pas dngos grub thams cad stsole ba/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /yang na gzha 'dra ba la/ ma mo bcu gnyis rnams phyag dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru dang / kha ṭāX ga /lhag ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par byas kyang wo ngo / /oṃ ḍā ki ni nī ye hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/zhes pa nas/oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūṃX hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar rnams long skabs yod cing spro ba'i tshe/tshar gcig brjod par bya'o/ /rkang mthil rlung / gsum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/rgal tshigs ri rab/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ lus 'dom gang grub bzhi/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis pad+ma/ der rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi —392
