yung dkar nag rdo lcags/ dur khrod kyi ro thal sogs kyis bkang / yugs sa mo'i skra/ bshan pa'i bu mo'i srad bus bsdams gnan gtad du byas na/ 'di yis nges par gsod par byed/ 9ye /gro gar 'khor lo ser po gur gum gyis bris la/ /yi ge brgyad dang ming spel glu( dang bcas pa bris te 'dab mar oṃ oṃ oṃ nas oṃ te/ oṃ lte bar/ oṃ de ba/ da rta ā yu gan dha na snyo ku ru swāhā oṃ ces so/ /me tog ser pos mchod/ 9) /yang na grwahwar yi ge brgyad dang ming chud par bris/ /te 'dab mar swā hā oṃ swāhā sogs/ 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ swāhā 'di la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa oṃ swāhā/ ces so/ /oṃ bcas 'khor los rgyas pa dang swahwa'i 'khor los bsrung ba byed pa'i mchog /lubor lo ser po/ 9) rtsibs bcu pa la a oṃ a nasa.a ha a'i bar dang / nyer a de shin+ti ku ru a ces a yig gnyis gnyis kyi nang du yi ge bcu pa dang ming chud pa/ /tsan+dan chus bris rab gnas la sngags brgya rtsa bzlas/ kham phor dkar po yu med bcas/ /te der bcug me tog dkar po dri bzang gis mchod cing zhag bdun du sgrubs na/ /bskul dang ris sam sogs/ shin tu zhi ba'i las la mchog /jo bo bha ga ces pa mo mtshan gyi dbyibs lta bu gsungs/ 9) bha ga'i mu khyud gsum skor gyi dbus su chos 'gyung dmar po gru gsum mo mtshan mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su liṅga te pho mtshan dmar po'i rtse mo dang / mu khyud dang gnyis kyi bar la hiXyig dmar po gis/ /bskor ba pho mtshan gyi 'bras bu la ming dang bskul sngags bcas/ /pa hi:che ge mo ā kar+ṣa sa hi:ces so/ khor yug phyi ru zhags pa dmar pos skor ba dang / lcags kyu dmar pos skor ba bri/ ming la bud med de'i dri chu skyes pa gzhon nu'i sa bon byugs/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i ku rba'i nga rgyal gyis/ bya lce'i 'og gi rtsar khyi:me 'od 'phro ba'i gdung ba can gyis gdungs/ lhanas pa lcags kyu'i sbyor ba sgom sgrol ma'am/ ku dra'i sngags la hriXde a kar+ṣa sa hriXzhes ngag bcad zlas zhag bdun bdun na 'khor lo'i steng du rang —440—

gi dri chu dor na nyi ma bdun tsam gyis nyi ma ni zlum po mchu can gsungs/ paṇ+ḍita kha cig 'khor lo bri ba min/ 'bur du byed zer/ 'dir 'di yis bsgrub bya 'gu/gas par 'gyur/ /lugs phyi ma kha sbyor gyi dgongs par yang snang ngo / /mdun bskyed ku ru ku lce'i snyen pa dang 'khor lo 'bri skabs gsang mchod pa byas la/smad 'tshong ma'i lag nas byung ba'i ras la/ sna tshogs 9)pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad rim pa gsum skor bas nyi shu bzhi/ /'dab ma'i phyi thig re kha gsum bskor 'dab ma nang mar oṃ bar mar hri phyi mar skyu/ /te 'dab re la re re brgyad gsum mo/ /nye ba la oṃ hwa / sgyu che ge mo wa she ku ru oṃ tshwa / skyu ces bri/ gur gum dang gi khyi sres pa'i rgya tshos kyis skar ma/ rgyal la bris nas sgrubasate 'khor lo bzung ba'i lag pas sgrub bya la reg par byas na/ /bran pho bran mo ltar las byed/ 9) /zhakhru/la 'khor ra gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /gzhal yas khang gi gzhi'i sna tshogs rdo rje stegs bus 'dod snam brgyan/ /du paṃ pu ṭi ltar na sna tshogs rdo rje dang stegs bu med/rdo rje zur bzhi mawo pa spyod/ shar sgor tho ba lho sgor dbyug tho nub sgor pad+ma dang / /byang sgor ral gri sgo bzhi dang te re ga gcig pa 'dod snam sogs mi dgos ut+pa la/ /nang du bcug pa'i thod pa'i gdan dang bcas lcags kyu gzhal med khang gi gra mtshams su'o/ /de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu pa la yi ge bcu pas mtshan pa bri/ /lte ba'i nang gi mtha' skor du oṃ pra san tā re a mṛ ta mu khi a mṛ ta lo tsa ne sarba arba swā dha ni swāhā/dbus su de wā sha du ru zhes 'bri/ dbang du byed pa'i sngags so/ /de nas bka' stsal/ pa/sngags 'di slar yang gsungs pa ni gong du 'bri ba dang las sbyor skabs tsam yin la 'dir las sngags 'di la bsnyen pa 'bum du dgos pas yin gsungs/ oṃ sarba mo ha ni tā re tu stu re sarba sdo:smo ha ya bha ga ba tī sarba du sgyu rna ban+ta ban+ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ gong du spund pa'i —441—

gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs phyi dbyibs 'dra ba de dbus 'khor lo rtsibs drug gam ut+pal 'dab drug gi lte bar zla zla ba taX bcas su ma zad rtsibs drug kyang dbus su'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /〈zhes pa'i don no/ /〉ba tāX yig bcas/ /dbus su oṃ ku ru kul+le sdiXche ge mo las kyi spel tshig gang 'os sbyar nas khyiXzhes bskor bar jo bo bzhed de/ de ltar na dbus dang rtsibs drug ku ru kul+le rtsibs drug la ku ru kul+le/ gong 'khor lo gsum pa dang 'dra/ sngags ni yi ge brgyad hiXganyis dbus chud pa'i/ /ming dang bskul ba khyiXche ge mo wa sha du dra ṇ+ḍiXswahāXces pa'o/ /lte ba dang mu khyud la mo he'i sngags bgod pas las kun byed/ /ku rle'i sngags 'bru brgyad kyis mthar mo he'i sngags sbyar ba/ 'bum phrag bzlas pas sa g.yo zhing / /rgya mtsho bdun bskams mi rgyu ba'i dug zhi bar byed/ /gyo mo'i sbyor ba ni rdza thod la 'dod pa yod na'ang 'dir gyo mo la 'khor lo bris thod par bcug nas gnan nas 'byung bo kun/ /bcings ba'i nus pa dang gzhan yang nas sngags 'di bzlas pas dug dang mdze nad sogs klu'i gnod pa dang 'khor lo de lus la bcangs pa'am grong khyer gyi sgor steng du sbas na 'phra men/ mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /sbyor ba rims nad dang lta stangs sogs 'a tre1ga cing skul tshig dang bcas chu mig tu sbas nas mchod gtor byas na/ char 'bebs dang / kha steng du ltas 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phangs sngags de stong zlas na char gcod gsungs te 'dir ma bshad/ mdo rgyud g.yin dang mthun no/ /skul tshig dang bcas sgrubs nas lus la bcangs na g.yul du'ang / mtsho ni chas/ mi gnod pa'i lus su 'gyur/ /ro/ khe) /dbyid zla ra ba'i wo par bu mo mdzes ma/ /rdul te zla ma' dang ldan pa'i dus kyi gos gyis ni thang ka'i rgyu ras btags la/ /bud med bzang mo'i zla mtshan gyis bsgos pa'i ras de la ni/ /ri mor ri mo ba dam tshig ldan pas bri 'o/ /lha gang 'bri nas/ /sgrol ma dang 'od zer can ma dang / /phag mo'i gzugs rab gnas —442—

spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sbyin sreg rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang / khri phrag gcig nges par bya la mtho(na mchod na/ /gang dang gang 'dod pa'i las thams cad/ /de phrin las thams cad dam/khyad par so so'i las tshogs thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /ro/ /'khrul 'khor la ma brten pa'i las sna tshogs pa'i bshad pa ni/ gzhan yang rtsa ba'i gzungs kyi mthu te rtsa sngags kho na'i las tshogs gsungs pa/ /las 'di dag ni las sbyor skabs la sdus nas gtso mo rkyang ba nga rgyal gyis bya'o/ ho) /gos mtha' 'am skra'i stengs la zla ba la snya bsam la/ de'i 'od kyis gnod byed bkug de bcings par bsam la lan bdun rak+ṣa rak+ṣa btags/ mtho(na bsngags la mdud pa gsum dbugs sdams te bcings/ /'brog dgon dag tu dgra dang gcan gzan sbrul sogs 'jigs pa med par 'gyu/ra/ /maṇ+ḍal zla kham gyi steng du 'o ma can gyi shing rtsing te 9) ut+pal sbyin sreg brgya rtsa yis/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ /de'i sngags ni oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re a che ge mo mu kaX me bdag gi dbang du gyur cig ba sha ma na ye swāhā/ 9) bya rog gshego pa'i dwang ru ma nyams par lan sum cu rtsa gnyis bsngags nas ni/ /dgra bo'i khyim gyi sgo'i sgor ru sbos na dgra bo skrod/ /de'i sngags ni oX tā re tut+ta re tu re tsa la pra tsa la shī gh+raX ga mi ni de ba da t+taX uta tsa ṭā ya huX phaṭa/rgya dpe gcig tu ra dzi ka snang / ma da na 'bru dmar po se 'brum 'dra ba gcig yod gsungs/ (0/so (po ka so 'cha' dang yungs kar dang / /thang phrom gyi snyu dang a shwa ka'i shing me tog /'dab ma bcas pa lan lnga stong sbyin sreg byed pa'am/ /'dir thab zla kham 'am gru gsum byas shing yang gru gsum du rtsig rang bdag bskyed me nang 'das pa me lha skad cig gis sgoms te rdzas sregs pa las/ thab rko skyed 'jig rten pa'i me lha sogs mi dgos so/ /'di skabs kyi sbyin sregs thams cad la'o/ /yang na mngar gsum mar dang ldan pa bsregs byas na//—443—

nyin bdun phul na bu mo rigs nor gzugs mchog dag thob par 'gyur/ /ro/ /de'i sngags ni oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re a mu ka che ge mo zhes bya ba'i bhi dha nāX/ ku mā gzhon nu ma rī ma he mut+pa te bdag la lugs bzhin du na ta phywaXpi rabs ta pra ya:sko ster bar gyur cig swāhā/ 9) zla mtshan can gyi mdom skyis su byin pa'i ras la sgrol ma dmar mo ni/ /g.yas u smra ste la g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa bri/ /rab gnas byas la thun bzhir ma cedrod cing thun rer las skul tshig sbyar ba'i lnga stong bzlas nas ni/ /de min rtsa sngags gong sogs bzla gsung / dbang du 'du ba'i yul rmi lam du shar na zhag/sa pas 'gul bcings/ lcags kyus mo mtshan phug me tog gi mda' snying khar snun/ rkang 'og tu lhung bar bsam la/ sngags 'og ma'am/ las tshogs gnyis pa'i sngags kyis kyang rung gsungs/ de'i snre(ra bas bkug la 'dod pa spyad/ /oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re a mu gī ma ma ba si taX/ bdag la dgos pa'am/ dbang du byar 'os pa'i su sna rmi lam ka rje rna bar sna ya gtam du gyis nyu phaṭa/ rmi lam du gsungs shig gi don no/ 9) /reg phrug tsher ma ma rnyed na dhu sa'i tsher mas rung bar sna tshogs sgrol ma'i rgyud mngon 'byung na yod gsung / zla mtshan bcas/ /ste de la rbangs pa'o/ /sreg blugs stong phrag gcig gis phul ba ni/ /mi bdag rgyal po'i bu mo mchog kyang 'gu/gas/ /de'i sngags ni glu( tā re tu stu re tu re a mu ka bi dha naX rgya dpe gcig na a mu kani ha rna snang sa bag ma che ge mo zhes bya ba'i zi nā dwa kar+ṣa ya rang gi gnas nas khug shig ma murnyi ke dza: bdag gi drung du/9) zla ba gzas bzung ba'i dus su zlas pa byed bzhin du snyoms 'jug byas pa'i 'jig rten dbang / /te thig le dung gi sol ba dang 'ga' zhig ma sreg par 'dod de gang la byin pa'i bu mo de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /btanas te 'dod mar sbyin/ /yang na sbrul mgo gnyis pa'i ste phyogs gnyis char la mgo yod pa'o/ sha /dud —444—

pa ma shor bar thal bar bya ba kha cig 'dod/ () arka'i shing bal la dril bar byas la/ /ba dmar mar khus thod par mar me spar ba la thod pa bkab te nag gi mig sman 'ga' zhig mig sman sha chen ste zer bya/ /lag pa'i srin lag gnyis la 'chil ma skus sngags gsum gyis mnyes/ sor mo rnams bsdus/ sa la rtsa sngags lan lnga zla/ re re nas bkrol te re re nas zlas te mig la byug go /de nas lta stangs dang bcas bzhin pas rdo rje chos dang byang sems rang 'dzag pa ste phyung pa ma yin pa'o/ /zhes paṇ+ḍi ta kha cig 'dod do/ kha cig thig le rak+ta kyus ma te arka'i bal la dril zer/ nyi ma dang / /rta rgyal mchog gi dpa' bo g.yul du gsad pa'i spos bdug nas/ /slob ma'am bu mo khye'u la lta stangs kyi ltas pas pad+ma gar 'ga' zhig mngal khrag zer dbang 'bab/ /grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs/ rgyud gur dang stun na sgrol mas mna' bor ba'i phyir/ 'od dpag med kyi ye shes 'bab pa la bzhed de shin tu legs/ () sprul nag ha la ha la'i mjug ma dang / / 'jam 'bras kyi 'bru dang rtsangs pa'i mjug ma dang / /'gron bu ro te dngul chur bcas pa khams dkar dmar rdo khab len byugs pa'o/ khu ba 'dzin/yon/sdig pa'am sbal pa'i dkar po zhug gis sam/ /ba ra rta'i 'o ye skam rnam gsum a sho kar+ṣa dang sbyar ba dang / /dang por byung ba'i a phu mtshal rdo dang sbyar ba ni/ /gu gul lhad med bcas pa'i ril lu zos pas kyang / /rtag tu khu ba rengs par 'gyur/ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i sngags oṃ tā lo pe re tu stu re tu re san+ta ra ṇi khyiX de ba dat+ta bā shaX ku ru ho/ /de'i sgrubs thabs te 'grel pa gnyis ltar na/ dmar mo phyag g.yon/pad+ma dmar po dang g.yas lcags kyu bcas pa yi/ /bdag skyed bsnyen pa 'bum byas la/skyes pa'am bud med kyi zag rdzas la 'khor lo gong 'dab ma bcu pa dang 'dra ba las/ nye ba dang mu khyud la sngags 'di nyid kyis skor ba bu mo'i skras bcings te/ tsan+dan dmar po dang sman 'tshong ma'i —445—

rak+ta sres pa'i 'byin pa la/ skru ta liṅga byas pa'i snying kar bzhug sman 'tshong ma'i gos kyis bkab la sngags dang phyag rgyas 'gugs par bya/ /dmigs pa pho nya mo dmar mo zhags pa lcags kyu bsnams pa yi/ / lha mos sgrub bya me rlung gi steng du bzhag pho mo so so dang bstun pa'i zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor bas zhag bdun gyis 'gu/ga par byed pa yin/ /sho lo ka gcig po 'di dang / 'og rgyud nyi ma'i nyi ma 'char ka sogs dang / sgrol ma dmar po'i rnal 'byor pas/ zhes pa nas/ 'ong bar 'gyur ro bar rnams don khog pa sgrigs te 'dis khegs par stan/'og gi gnyis po snyen pa dang / rgyas bshad du spyor ba grub chen zhi ba'i man ngag ste yi ge log nas yod pas der shes so/ /oṃ tsa tu rdu dza ca kha bi kri tā nan kaṇi pi shā tsi hūX phaṭa/gshin rje gshed kyi bris sku'i mdun du de'i gzugs ba tha khro mo gdong drug phyag bzhi/ me long thogs pa bris te/ gtsang sbra'i mchod gtor dang bcas zhag bdun bzlas na/ rto ye rna bar sgrog pa grub bo/ /oṃ budha tsu ru mā tsu ru ke swāhā/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten gyi drung du mchod pa dang / gtsang sbra dang bcas pas zla ba gcig bzlas na/ bdag nyid gang du skye bar 'gyur ba dang / tshe zad pa dang / ring du 'tsho ba yang shes par 'gyur ro/ /ha la ha la'i rka zhe sprul gyis sbal pa dkar po bzung ba na/ /sbal pa kha yod bzhin pa/ byis pa sogs kyis gsad pa na/ sbrul dang / sbal pa/ de dag gi sha rus dud med sregs te thal bar bya/ /la/ thal mo sbrang rtsir sbyar ba la sngags lan stong btabs te bud med de'i mchan khung du/ /thig le byas na 'gugs par 'gyur/ /mi tshil (nami yi thod par bzhag /na rma'i bal shing bal rang mdog dmar po snyag yod gsungs gyis sdong bur bya/ /gzugs 'tshong ma rgya bal gyi rigs dang spyod pa dang longs spyod rin thang du bcad pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa dgos kyi bod kyi gcong mos mi btub gsungs/ thod pa —446—

dum bu bzhi pa'am drug pa dag las ni/ /mar me de'i snag tsha snag chags su gzhug ring te/mtshan phyed tsam sngags spel tshig can zlas nas blangs te bu zu1 la/ /thig le byas na 'gugs par 'gyur/ /ro/ /oṃ badz+ra slo po tik+ṣa ya hūX swāhā/ 'o ma la lan bdun mngon par bsngags nas bkrus na mig gi rab rib sel bar 'gyur ro/ /mi rus/ phag 'tshe/ rma bya'i mkhris pa/ mu zi/ ze tshe/ sming ga ra dza/ bdud rtsi lnga/ grul rnams sresapa'i rdzas dang / khwa she mi'i rting pa'i sha dang / byi la nag mo'i mchin pa'i rdzas kyi steng du sgrol ma skyed mchod bstod zlas zhag bdun byas pa bdug pas sngags brgya rtsas sngags pa gnas dang rdzas kyi 'byung po rang gnod pa'am gas gyis rbad pa rnams skrod par 'gyur ro/ /nyung kar ldong ros/ zhus bu'i brun rnams la gzugs brnyan bya/ dri dang ming sogs snying gar gzhug dgug gzhug dang byad du gzhug tsher ma'i shing la sbyin sreg byas na 'byung po 'chi shing /rdzas go rjes pas mi la'ang btub/ bar chod gnod spyi la dmigs na'ang btub/ rgyud gzhan las ཿnga ba 'phros don yin gsung / ni rgu ṭa'i snyu dang mu ni snyu dang bhadha ra nag po'i lo 'bab rkang 'bras bu tshang ma dang / bhadha lho phyogs kyi dang so ma ra tsa'i lo 'dab rkang 'bras rdungs pa la la bud dang sres pa'o/ /nim kha ba'i ro kho na gzhan yin la lho phyogs kyi kha shing cha ba gcig yod do/ rka'/ni sba tig ta'i shun pa dang 'dab ma rnams grib ma la bskams pa dang / be la wa go phye'i 'bras bu dang / ja dhi ha ri ta ka a ru ra 'bigs byed zur drug pa phra mo rnams cha mnyam du btags dang po lnga dang / phyi ma gnyis so sor bu ram la sbyar nas dang po lnga sor gsum gyi tshad du zos zin pa dang / phyi nas chu tshod gcig nas lhag ma gnyis yang sor mo gsum gyi tshad du zos na/ nyi ma dang rma mi 'phog par byas 'o ma kho na bza' zhing btung ba byas na/ zla ba drug nas rgan po yang gzhon nur byed pa de skra dkar nag —447—

por 'gyur ba la sogs pa la the tshom med do/ 'ge /na mo bi ga ta rā ga me tri ya sidha shwe1 tsa ne swāhā/ zhes pas lan khri zlas shing / phyi nas tho rengs brgya brgya bzlas shing chus mig skrus na des kyang rab rib sel bar byed do/ /bdag bskyed sgrol ma bdun bskyed 'od zer can ma'i bsnyen pa grub pas 'od zer can ma'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas 'a ye zlum phyi ma'i sogs po zlum skor gnyis kyi nang ma sna tshogs rdo rje yin la mtshams bzhi po re re su rdo rjes phyed pa ser po re re brgyan/ /huX bzhis rdo rje phyed pa bzhi po des rwa dbus ma'i rtse legs par mtshan/ /zlum skor phyi ma'i zlum thig la ma reg tsam gyi nang du g.yas skor gyis oṃ pa da kra ma sī/ pa ra kra ma sī/ sdo / da ya ma sī/ ni rma ni ra ma sī/ arka ma sī/ ma rga ma sī/ya / mi ma sī/ ba na ma sī/ gu sma ma sī/ tsi ba ra ma sī/ mahā tsi ba ra ma sī/ a rta dha na ma sī si rnams thung ngu'ang 'dug swāhā/ lte ba der dkyil 'khor zlum po la bri ste oṃ ni sngags chen bcu gnyis so/ /thams cad kyi 'gor bor du'o/ /sngags de rnams kyi nang gi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa gsum gsum gyi g.yas dang g.yon du/ oṃ brta lī ni sogasathung tsong ཿga oṃ ba rā li/ oṃ ba rā ha mu khri zhes pa phyed mar bgos te bri'o/ / jo bo dbus rwa la bā g.yas ma ra lī g.yon du bā rā ha bkod de g.yas g.yon smos pas dbus kyang go gsung ngo / /de'i thad kyi mtshams su yang / oṃ mā ri lcu zhes bri'o/ /jo bo che ge mo la rak+ṣa 'dogs nyi ma ni dngos bstan tsam rang lugs hūṃ 'dogs gsung / ༈rdo rje rgya gram de'i dbus su ste lte ba'i mtha' yi nang oṃ bā rā lī/ oṃ ba tā lī/ oṃ ba rā ha mu khri sarba ྅niX pra du niX kā ya bā3khā+e mu khaX ra ya/ ste bha ya zhes/ so/ /de'i dbus su maX yig chen po zig go /maX/ de'i nang du de ba dat+ta rak+ṣa rak+ta 'o/ /paṃ gyi mtha' skor bā ra li sogs kyi nang du rmam ri s+t+ya paṃ de rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'bri ba man ngag go/'di ni gro ga la gur gum gyis —448—

bris na chom rkun dang rgyal po dang / stag sbrul ma he/ me chu lam gol sogs bar chad thams cad du bsrung ba ste/ 'od zer can ma'i 'khor le'o/ /las kyi lha dang dkyil phrog ra gyi 'phros ni yang gsungs pa/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad byas la dbus su lha mo mdog gser dang mtshungs pa/ /gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba can/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /rgyud phyi mar 'byung ngo // sgrol ma 'di'i mawo rdo rje 'dzin ma te de'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rnal 'byor ma ni bcu dang bcas/ /pa yang rgyud phyi mar 'byung ngo / /grwa bzhir 'byung ba bzhi yang dgod/ /te/ dbang ldan du bum pa chus gang ba/ mer ri rab/ bden bral du me thab/ rlung du rlung ras so/ / dkyil 'khor mchog 'di sku yi ni/ /dkyil 'khor ram gsang ba'i phra thig gi ye shes bla med pa'o/ /de'i man ngag sna rtser thig le'i dbus su dal sgom pa thig le dang sangs rgyas rnams zhal du bcug zhu ba pad+ma'i sna rtser thig le phyag mtshan dngas pa'i nang du dal sgom pa phra mo'i yo ga'o/ /de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /dal gyi nang bha ga'i chos wang dbus su gdan zla ba bsgom/ /dmar mo bcu gnyis lo lon pa yi tshul/ /phyag rgya lnga dang thod pas dbu rgyan dang do shal gyis brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyangs rol par mdzad/ /mdun ma gnyis g.yas rkyang / rgyab gnyis g.yas rkyang gar stabs su bya/ zhabs 'og tshangs pa brgya byin/bdud dang /dbang phyug ste bdud bzhi mnyam par snying gar mnan pa'o/ /spyi bor te dbu skra la gi yin la sna lnga'i phreng ba bcings/ /zhal brgyad kyi lhag ma bdun la/ g.yas kyi gsum ni g.yas pa nag po dang ser po dang / /'od sna tshogs 'bar bas khro bo'i 'od zer gyi rnam par 'phro/ /ba'i zhal gsum mo/ /dkar po dang ljang khu dang sngon po ni/ /g.yon gyi zhal gsum gyi kha dog la rim pas so/ /de dag kyang mdun nas rgyab tu rim pa'o rtsa —449—

zhal gyi steng du steng zhal dud kha bong bu'i gdong gi gzugs/ /so/ /ral gri ut+pal mda' bo che/ /rdo rje kyo ba dbyug pa dang / /zangs gri ni gri gug gi ming ste zangs la byas par 'dod pa shin tu 'grul lo/ /mi 'jigs phyag rgya'o/ /thod pa sdigs mdzub de nas gzhan/ /gzhu dang kha ṭāX zhags pa dang / /mgo bo ni lha min gyi mgo bor/ mi'i nyi mas bshad/ tshangs mgor jo bo bzhed na'ang bdud bzhi'i mgo bor man ngag las so/ /nor bu bum par bcas/ /mche gtsigs 'dod pa'i gzugs can ma/ /sgrol ma 'di'i mtshan he ru ka yi sgrol ma'o/ /'di'i dal ni rnal 'byor ma/ gsang ba thig le'i rgyud las 'byung ngo / /'jigs skyobs lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni dal dbus su pad+ma dgu dbus su/ lha'i 'phro ni tāX las ljang khu zhal gcig ma/ /mchog sbyin ut+pal bsnams pa yis/ /zhabs skyil krung ngam g.yas rol bya/ 'dod pa dngos grub thams cad sbyin par byed/ /pa dang / 'khor brgyad po g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /te/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i lha brgyad ste/ /swāhā ma gtogs yi ge brgyad la bskyed cing bzlas oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ tā swāhā sogs zlas pas nges par 'khru1ba par 'gyu/ra/ /ro/ /'di'i man ngag khyad par can la sogs su shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje gdong ldan ces pa 'di la jo bo zhal gnyis mar/ nyi ma zhal gcig phag gdong zer/ rang lugs rdo rje gdong ldan ni phag ldan ma ste phag mo'i mtshan rang yin gsung / phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/ /mo/ /yab tu gyur pa dang / he ru ka dpal yum gyur pa'am/ /bde mchog yab yum go zlog 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud kyi rim pa las/ /yang na yab he ru ka'i sbyor ba las/ /phag mor spyor te/ he ru ka yab yum gang mos pa de sgom pas/ gang la dga' ba de nyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /ro/ /thod pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'khyud rgya khrag 'thung dang / /thod pa dang gri gug phag mos bsnams —450—

pa'o/ /man ngag tu phung po dang lha bu 'jigs byed/ nyon mongs dang / 'chi bdag dus mashaṃ du mdzad/ dngos bstan ltar na tshas pa sogs bdud bzhi po ni rnam par mnan/ /shi nasathal bar song ba'ang slar 'tsho byed kha ṭī bcas/ /bha ga liṅga phag mo dang he ru ka la'o/ /zlog par bya/ /rdo rjes bsnun nas khrag 'thungs pas/ /skad cig gcig gis gsod par byed/ /drag po'i las dang / thegs pa lcags kyu'i sbyor ba dbang gi dmigs pa yis/ /bu mo thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur/ te bsam gtan gyi las so/ /'di'i man ngag rgyas pa logs su shes so/ /mahā ma ya/rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ pre ṭa rnams las bshad pa ltar/ khu ba dgug pa dang / khrag dgug pa dang myong 'jug pa dang ni/ / mi ro sogs gong bu la sogs dgug par bya/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po'i sgrub thabs la/ sngags ni oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni huX/ gro hā gro hā hūX/ gro hā pā ya grihā pā ya hūX/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi du rā dza huX phaṭa/ lha'i rnal 'byor ni hūṃ gi yi ge sa bon las byung ba/ /rdo rje nga sku mdog rab tu gnag /pa phyag g.yas dang por rdo rje me 'bar ba g.yon dang po dung dmar te thod khrag dang / /g.yas gnyis pa na gtun shing g.yon gnyis pa sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dmar po ni/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /ba/ phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ mda' gzhu g.yas 'og ma rdo rje'i dbyug tho dkar po 'dzin pa'i mchog /gtso 'og ma rdo rje sams pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ /spyan gsum pa g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs pa bsgom par bya/ /'o/ /zhi rgyas sogs kyi las dang ri lu sogs grub pa ste/ las kyi rigasarnams thams cad sgrub cing byed pa la sngags pa yi/ /lha yi rgyal po khro bo 'di dag go /'di ni drag las kho na gtso che re rgyud 'di'i srung ma'i tshul du 'jig rten lha'i sgrubs thabs so/ /—451—

'di'i sgrub thabs logs su shes so/ /lha mo nag mo rnal 'byor bsgom/ /g.yas dang po ral gri dang ni g.yon dang po thod pa'i lag /lha min zhabs 'og tu gnon pas 'joms pa g.yon 'og ma dgra bo yi/ /mgo gcod g.yas 'og ma tri shā la 'chang ma/ /bya rgod lce spyang ni 'ol pa ā+o ཾ la spro/ khyu ma mi mgo'i do shal me tog phreng ba lta bu can/ /ma mo brgyad nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /ba/ ro la zhon pa rnam par bsgom/ / gtso mo gdan/ yang na stag mo la gnas pa/ /drag shul spyod pa'i don du sngags pas bsgom par bya/ 'o/ /dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes bshad pa ni khu ba rdo rje dbu mar bcug cing mi 'dzag par byas pa las/ /rang gi sems ni rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i gnas thob par 'gyur/ /te/ de yang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog med cing yod med yin min gyi spros dang bral/ /ba/ mkha' la dngos po thams go kyis ma gos pa ltar rang bzhin kun rdzob kyi chos gang gis kyang gos pa med/ /pa/ rang rig gi ye shes bde ba chen po don dam lhan skyes ste/ / dbang bskur mchog ni 'jig rten las 'das pa 'di lta bu dag go / dbang de'i phyag rgya ni phyag rgya chen po rnam bcas te/ me 'e1nga gzugs brnyan 'dra ba ye shes kyi rnam rol dkyil 'khor dngas pa'i lha mo'i skur gyur pa rang gi sems kyis/ /thig le mi 'gyur ba rdo rjer byed par 'gyur/ /te sems kyis sems brten par byed pa'o/ /btsan thabs sbyor ba bshad pa ni/ srog dang thur sel sgo btsan thabs su dbye bas/ /btsan thabs sbre/ra bas dbugs bkag na/ /thig le 'phral du 'gag cing / de goms pas/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i phyag rgya myur du 'grub nas/ khu ba mi 'gyu/ra ba 'thob pa ste/ /cung zad mi 'gyur ba thob na/ thig le nor bur bkag ste bde ba bsgom/ /mo/ /mngon byang zugad pa ni/ sngon tshogs sbyor du sgrol ma sgoms pas/ zung 'jug sgrol ma'i sku 'grub —452

pa'am/ mthong lam gyi snga rol sgrol ma yod pa de lha mo'i gzugs brnyan lha yab tu bsgyur bar bya/ /ba yin la/ de tshe phyag rgya sgrol ma dang sgrub pa po sgrol ma can gnyis dngos grub sdo/ba par 'gyu/ra/ /ro/ /'di ni he badz+ra las/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas g.yin/ /zhes sogs dang don gcig la yang na rang sgrol ma de thog med don grub kyi gzugs kyis bya te//skyes pa sgrub pa po dang bud med phyag rgya gnyis ka nges par 'gru/ba par 'gyur/ /ro/ /las rab 'byams dngos dang mchog gi las tshogs kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //rjes rgyud gtad pa ni de nas 'khor gyi tshul bstan pa'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig gi mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' go mtshams med par gang ba'o/ /rab 'byams grangs med pa dang / /bstod pa gsung dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i tshig dang sgras mngon par bstod par byas nas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'chang la sangs rgyas de rnams kyis rgyud 'di gtad/ /de dar ba dang / phyi ma'i dus su byin gyis slobs pa'i phyir du'o/ /'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las ti snyi pas ji tsam snyed pa ste sngon 'di las mang ba yod thang bas so/ /rtsa ba'i rtog pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs pa grub chen brnya nā tha'i zhabs las mnos nas/ slar rgya gar gyi mkhan po ni rgya ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas phyis byung gi paṇ+ḍita mi'i nyi ma'i dka' 'grel dang bstun te g.yar khral du bsgyur ba'o/ /yang slad kyis bhang ga lar 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta puṇ+ḍa ba tsho drung du/ slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas 'grel chen po dang bstun nas cung zad bcos shing / thams cad du grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi —453—

zhal lung gi reg zig (zin ka so so rnams dang / khyad par gu ru lho phyogs pa chen po'i man ngag dang bstun nas legs par bcos te dag par bgyis pa'o// //dge legs 'phel/ 'di bzhengs dge ba'i zla zer gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs sgo ku mud tshal/ /yongs rgyas dga' ston gsar pa'i dpal/ /srid mtha'i bar du nyams med shog /ma tis so/ /legs bzhengs de yi mthu las/ /bstan 'gror dge mtshan shar te/ /skal ga rgud tshogs zhi nas/ /rdzogs ldan chos spyod gyur cig /'di yang ma tis so/ / zhug dag //bkra shis// //

las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ sa ma dza pa ra mut+pa sarba ka rmo da ya ut+ta ra tan+t+ra rā dza/bod skad du/ 'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba 'dus pa don dam pa las phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bstan 'bras bu la sbyar ba'i dbang du byas na/ de nas bskyed rim la sbyar ba 'di dag gis dol sgrub pa'ang bstan/ rdzogs rim la sbyar na thun mong ba 〈thun mong ma yin pa rnams 'dir bshad la 〉rnams sgra ji bzhin pa dang mtshungs pa'ang yod la/ bco me 〈bdud bzhi 〉ldan 'das ma chen cho ji bzhin sgra la 'dis ye shes tshogs gsog go /snying gi thig le dang lte ba'i gtum mo ni de bzhin ba/zhegs pa phung po lnga thams cad skyed byed kyi btsun mo'i mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dam pa te tshig spyi bo'i snya sgrol ma ni 〈mgrin pa'i oṃ 〉gong bzhin zhes bya ba/ bar do sbyong byed du byas te/ ༈'dir yang na spyod pa la sbyar ba'i dbang du byas te/ de bzhin g.ye/gas 〈khyab byed 〉pa dang / pad+ma can ma/rdo rje 〈srog 'dzin 〉dang / glang r+sā rin po 〈thur sel 〉che dang / dung can ma dang / pad+ma 〈gyen rgyu 〉dang / ri mo can las kyi rigs 〈nyams gnas 〉 sna tshogs can te rigs lnga sgrol ma rgyal ba rigs lnga thams cad kyi spyi'i yum yin pas na thams cad kyi bdag po/ mi shig pa'i thig le de nyid rgyu 〈bas 〉ba ni zhing du 'gro ba'i spyod pa dang mi rgyu 〈snod 〉bas cig pu 'dug pa'i spyod pas lha dang gzhal yas khang 'i 〈sgo nas 'gro don mdzad pas 〉byed pa po/ sems nyid brtan 〈thugs chos sku 〉pa ni khang pa tshogs khang rtsa dang thig —455—

le dang g.yo 〈rlung 〉ba'i 〈thams cad 〉rnal 'byor pa lha'i 'dram 'bag rang bzhin ste tshogs kyi bdag po'i spyod pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ni/gsang ba spros bcas kyi spyod pa las theg dman la ches shin tu 〈spros med 〉gsang ba/〈rjes su rnal 'byor/〉phyi rol pa la gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug 〈shin tu spros med 〉mas rjes su rnal 'byor spyod pa bdag nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje 〈'od gsal 〉te 'od gsal rgyal 'dod rgyal du 'jug pa'i ming 〈rnal wor wo po 〉'di rnams nyid kyi sgo gsum sku mi shig pa dang gsung mi shig pa dang thugs mi shig pa rdo rje'i 〈ra byed pas rnal 'byor gsum/〉las 〈'dis dkyil 'khor bstan 〉phyung 〈te spros shing gsungs pa'i don no/〉ngo / /dkyil 'bor du khrug pa bcom ldan 'das ma/ dang / sgrol ma/〈gong bzhin 〉rdzogs rim thams cad lta bas zin par bstan/ mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje 〈zla ba rdo rje'i sems skye〉ma/ 'di gnyis kyis mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa bstan/ dam tshig sgro/la ma dam tshig la ba theg pa/ dbyer mi phyed pas rje tsho rje 〈lus lha'i lus bstan pa ni 〉ye shes dbab rnal 'byor ma thabs shes gnyis med chen mo/ lnga po 'dis gtso mo yod/ me long lta bu sogs ye shes dgug gzhug lngas brgyan 〈rigs pa'i dbang lnga 〉pa ma/ hūṃ gi gzungs kyi sgo 'dis bstan/ rgyun mtha'i skabs su sangs rgyas thams cad nam mkha' dbang lha bstan kyis dbang bskur 〈dbang len pa bstan 〉ma/ lam gyi dbang dang dga' ba bzhis dbang bzhi thob pa bstan/ shes rab ma'i bha ga rtsa'i dkyil dang bcas pa ni ye shes shes bya'i dkyil dbang bskur bya'i dal bstan khusti bor/〈thams cad la sprul pa ste de ji snyed mkhyen pa 〉 〈gsal snang la sems 'dzin pa/〉yon tan thabs dga' bzhi/ zla ba'i bde ma/〈sher dbang gi ngo bo'o/〉/te zhu bde mas bstan dga' bzhi/ ngo 〈bzhi pa'i ngo bo 〉mtshar 〈zhing rtogs dka' ba'i 〉 bde ma/〈rang bzhi lhan skyes/〉 〈'di gnyis kyis bde ba la sems 'dzin pa/〉 dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ sdo/ dang ga sdo/nga —456

dang thugs 〈stsu ཿ gsum dang sbyar ba'i rdor bzlas/〉 rdo rje bdag mo ste rang bzhin kyi 'dod ma/ gnas gsum byin brlabs/ 'di sogs bzhi ye shes la sbyor/ phung rje1 〈lnga rigs lnga gnasagyur pas/〉 'od gsal 'jug pa'i bdag mo/ sngags kyi go cha skye mched drug sems pa drug tu gnas gyur pa kyi bdag mor gzung 'dzin gyi rlud bcu gnyis 'ching ba gyur pa/ go cha 'ching ba/ snying ga nas rgyu ba'i 'byung bzhi'i rlung 'gags pa/ 'byu/nga ba bzhi rnams lha mo bzhin rab tu thob pa/ las bzhi dang / gzung 'dzin gyi yul can/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/〈blta ba bstan/〉las tshogs 'grub pas/ rgyud 〈rtsa gsum 〉kun gyi slob dpon du gnang ba thob pa/ dbang phyug 〈dbu 〉ma/ te mchog tu gyur pa/ lam dus kyi 〈yang gyo khar mngon byang gi 〉ye shes rnam pa 〈shes rab ye shes kyi skabs/〉 lngas byang chub pa/ 〈skyed chog mngon byang lnga/〉〈sems zin na 〉rdul 〈'di nas lnga dbang bzhi pa yan lag bdun ldan ston 〉mtshan byas mtshan med kyi rnam rtog ni dang bral ba/ sgrib pa gnyis kyi dri ma med pa/ 〈'gro ba thams cad kyi yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa/〉gsang sngags chen mo/ 〈rang gi rnam rtog rags pa skyobs/〉ye shes kyi rang snang ma gtogs rdul gyi lus spangs pas shin tu phra ba/ 'ja' tshon lta bur sgom dgos so/ /longs sku de nyid/mtshan 〈sgyu lus kyi rdzogs rim bstan/〉dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/'od gsal 〈sems can gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa sher dbang gi 〉 dag byed/ bar chad/ zung 'jug dag 〈shes sgrib kyi 〉 〈bzhi pa'o//〉byed chen mo/ rnam rtog dag lha 〈'di nas myur ma zhes pa man chad sprul sku'i rnam gzhug gtso che 〉 mo'i sngags bzlas na/ 〈'byung bzhi'i rlung 〉las 〈bzhi 〉thams cad grub par byed pa/〈bum dbang gis so//〉rdzogs rim kho nas 'dod pa dngos grub thams cad gsang dbang gis rab tu sbyin pa/ gtso bor thun mong pa 'grub/༈ rlud 'od zer bcu rnam par dag pas/ 〈phar phyin 〉yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrog pa/—457

bzlas pa'o/ /yi ge sgra sgrog te he ru ka dgyes ma/〈te kha sbyor gyi sku ston/〉 ngag 'dren rnams brten/ ༈ snying rjes sems can la/ gdung ma/ thig le 'dzin pa 'gro ba'i don myur ma/〈khyab pa 〉byin rlabs myur rnam par shes pa 〈tshogs brgyad/〉yongs su dag pa/ go 'phang mi 'jigs pa 〈rlung dang sre bas bstan pa 〉sra zhing rang bzhin bde ba/ dbyings su skyal ba ni/ ye shes kyi snying po/ rtogs pas ji lta ba'i mkhyen pa/ mthong lam nas rang bzhin lhan skyes rtogs pas/ bde ba chen mo〈'i sku〉'o/ /'di rnams kyi rgyud pa'i sgyur bas so/ /de la he ru ka'i dal/ 'di ni 'jig rten dang lo ka las 'das pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi spyod pa la 'dus shing dam tshig la 'jog par byed pa'i gnas 〈tshig 'di mtshan nges la sbyor kyang mi 'grig cing 'grel ba gnyis na bshad pa med/ mtshan nges pa'i des logs su yod pa la'ang 'di bris snang la kha/kha cig med pa'i skyon du 'dod/〉so/ /rang lugs bla ma'i man ngag la ltos pa'i phyir tshig 'di gnyis grub pa yin/ don dam pa'i mtshan de skad ces rnams kyang bka' stsa'/ to/ /༈ thabs kyi dum bu 'di nas mgo brtsams pa'o/ /de las thabs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/dang po ngos bzung ba ni/ de nas he ru ka'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor/ /'di bsgos na/gnyis pa phan yon 'dod pa mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad rab tu sgrub/ /〈pa'i thabs te/〉zhi ba'am/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khore rnams kyi mchog gyur te gzhan thams cad las ches zab pa ste dngos grub myur ba zhig gsungs/ /so/ /gsum pa skyed chog ni/ ma mo ste mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor sgoms pas nyams dga'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 'dul 'phral du ma thob par 'gyur ba gnas/ /so/ /'grel chen las gzhal yas khang du bshad/ nyi ma ni ma mo dbyangs yig yin skyed chog stan zer/ ā li las zla ba kā li las nyi/ /ma dbus su hūX gi ye shes te sa bon rnams 'dres pa las rdo rje sems/ /par sgom —458—

ces 'grel ba gnyis ka 'chad/ man ngag las sa bon nyid sku rdo rje sems pa'o/ ༈ /gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig le'i 'od zer/ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rnams 〈su 〉 spro ba/ /byas la don gnyis bya/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngags 'dir mgon po rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo thig le bskul bar bya/ /'o/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra satwa dzaXhūX baX hoXsu ra ta stuX dri ju hoX bskul ba las bzhengs pa ste/ bzhi pa lha'i rnam pa'i khyad par ni rdo rje mi skyod pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /sku mdog nag po zhal nas huX sgrog brgyu 〈ltar dmar ba〉'i mig / gsum pa/ g.yas dang po/rdo rje g.yon dang po thod pas khrag gis gang ba lag sbrel ba/ / g.yas gnyis pa rtse gsum g.yon gnyis pa srin 21'i mgrin pa btsir/ ba yum/ khro mo'i dbang phyug sngon po gri thod 'dzin pas sku la 'byud/ /pa'o/ /'grel par yum dmar mo bya/ lo gwa pra da'i sgrub na yum kha ṭī ga rnam par mdzad do/ /sku stod la mi lpags rlon pa'i na bzar bcas/ /shing / skra ser gyen du 'khyil ba'o/ /'di nas gtum mo'o/ /zhes pa'i bar rgya skad lhug pa yin na'ang brjod pa bde bas tshigs bcad du sdebs/go rī dang tso rī dang rab rmongs ma dang / /ro langs ma dang sbos mo dang za nus ma/ /dang / dur khrod ma dang gtum mo rnams/ /sku mdog ni rim pas sngon mo dang ser mo dang btsod kyi mdog/ can dang / gnag pa dang dmar ser dang ljang khu dang / /sngo bsangs dang de bzhin du ser skya'o/ /mig zim bu 'dod pas myos pa lta bu zhi ba'i lta stangs can/ go rī keng rus kyi dbyug pa dur khrod rgyu ba'i keng rus kyi 'byung po'i gtso bo yin pa'i brda'o/ /dang / /thod pa g.yas dang g.yon par bsnams/ /drag mo'i lta stangs 'bru tshugs su lta ba tso rī mda' gzhu 'gengs byed ma/ /bdud kyi 'khor brdul nas lam la bkod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dbang gi las la sngags pa rnams kyi gtso mo yin pa'i brda'o/ /rab —459—

rmongs ma rab rmongs kyi lta stangs chang gis bzi ba lta bur mi gsal bar lta ba/ rgyal mtshan chu srin gyi tog can dang / thod pa 'dzin/ /bdud kyi bu mo he ru ka'i rdul te mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa ste 'khor bdud kyi lha sogs brdul ba dkar phyogs gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje dang ni byis pa'i ro/ /'dzin pa byis pa'i gdon bco lngar gtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gtso mo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ro langs ma shi ba slong ba'i lta stangs cung zad gyen du lta ba ma yi g.yas dang g.yon na'o/ /sbos mo dbugs 'byin gyi lta stangs phyogs bcur lta ba g.yon mi ro g.yas/ rgyu ma lus srul po mo la dbang ba'i brda' 'dren par byed/ /pa'o/ /za nus ma gar gyi lta stangs g.yas g.yon res kyi lta ba/ rdo rje dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /rigs bdag mo 'dul ba'i don du he ru ka'i sring mor bstan pa'o/ /g.yas snying dang g.yon snying gis bkang ba yi/ /dur khrod ma mo'i gtso mo yin pa'i brda'o/ /thod pas phyag brel ba dur khrod ma/ /ni nam g.yengs kyi lta ba'am/ phus 'debs par grags pa/ phyogs bcur myur bar lta ba'o/ /g.yul du 'gro ba'i srin mor 'dul ba'i brdar/ g.yas mi mgo dang g.yon mi ro'i lus 'dzin pa ni gtu'/ sna1〈te ro ldad pa'i lta stangs steng 'og tu res kyis lta ba/〉'o// /lnga pa snyen bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la skyob / huX huX snying po'o rna/ /khri'am 'bum mam bye ba zla ba/ ༈ 'dir 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma ni/ mā ma dang / zhing spyod dang / kun tu spyod ma gsum du 'du ste/ dang po ni yul 'khor du rgyu ba ni lus 'dzin pa 'tsho ba spangs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni yul chen nyer bzhi sogs na gnas pa phan gnod gnyis ka byed pa ste/ mi yul brten mi brten gnyis ka yod/ de gnyis ka la lha klu sha za gnod sbyin srin mo dri za sogs rigs thams cad yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rigs sna tshogs yod kyang srin po rnams dang spyod yul gcig pa ste/ srin po yang rigs gsum/ de ba rak+ṣa pa/yak+ṣa yak+ṣa pa/ brarmi rak+ṣa pa'o/ /de dag las phye ba dang / rigs rus chos 'brang gi 'brel ba mang du 460—

yod par gda'/ dang po ni/ ming po gsum dang / 'jigs byed dgu lta bu/ phyogs skyong gi gnasabargyad dang ri rab kyi khong seng na gnas pa'o// gnyis pa ni mgrin bcu dang bum sna sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dge sbyong dang bram ze'i lus su ston pa rgya mtsho la gnas shing / yul kun tu rgyu ba/ sring mo bzhi'i 'khor ro/ /dang po dang spyod yul gcig pa ma mo bdun nam brgyad lta bu/ gnyisapa dang gcig pa/ ral ba gcig ma dang / re re ba ti la sogs pa/ gsum pa dang gcig pa ni/dus bzhi'i lha mo dang / sring mo khrung khrung ma la sogs pa'o/ /de dag mi'i lus brten pa'ang yod mod/ phal cher ma yin no/ /de thams cad he ru kas gdul bar bya ba thun mongs min pa'o/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dag pa'i zhing gi rnams la dbye ba nges pa med/ 'jig rten 'dir bzhugs pa ni zhi ba mo dang khro mo gnyis la 'khor sems ma 'jig rten las ma 'das kyang / 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma'i bya ba mi byed par 'jig rten 'das ma dang lhan cig spyod pa mang du yod de/ zhi ba mo ni bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs pa rnams yin/ khro mo ni 'dir smos/ go rī sogs te 'di dag gong gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi lha dang / rgyal mo dang / ston pa mo'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /de dag gi dbang du byas te ci rigs par sbyar nas go dgos te/ de la drug pa las sngags ni/ tsho( e hre hi ru lu ru lu 〈sring mo rnams kyi sngags〉 dzaXhuX baX ho/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dgug sngags khyoX e a ra snyi dzaXdzaX glu tshe ḍā gi nī ā kar+ṣa ya 〈mkha' 'gro ma spyi'i dgug sngags〉ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ rdo ya ban+ta ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/mo ha ya mo ha ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki ni nāX lha da ya hūX phaṭa dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX ṭak+ki hūX dzaX dgug pa'i sngags 〈te khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya 〉so/ /glu( shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba du gin sa ma ya mu tra pra bhañja ka huX phaṭa/ zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags 〈te phyag rgya ni bya thi phyag rgya bya ba'o//〉so/ /oṃ ba ṭa ba mu kha ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be —461 —

sha ya pra be sha ya/ rdo ya ban+ta ya/ to khri ya to khri ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī nāXlhu da yaX/ ha ha hi hi oṃ āXhuX/ dbang du sdud pa'o/ /ni sngags te phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur lasamathe'u chung sbrel 'dzub mo rtse sprad pa dpral bar zlog pa/ bdun pa he ru ka mchod pa'i bya ba ni/gtor ma la thabs shes kyi rdzas sha chen dang bcas pa'i myos byed dang lha min dang 'byung po'i don du ba glang sha /dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i rdzas/ khrag dang bcas pas he ru ka mchod na/ /he ru ka dgyes sa dngos grub mchog /lbob te/ gnas dur khrod chen por stsol bar mdzad/ /do/ khres rab kyi dkyil 'khor la rtsa rgyud du sku'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i kha skong yang gsung pa/ /rdul tshon bri ba'i tshe ngos re la khru lnga lnga re khru ni nyi shu'i tshad kyis rtsig pa dang ldan pa/ /sku yi sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dbus su gtso mo'i gzugs brnyan dgod par bya/ /zhal bzhi gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /phyag rgyas bzhi rim pas rdo rje zhags pa dung g.yas 'khyil dang mda'// g.yon bzhi rim pas lcags kyu ut+pa la ser po'i sdong bu dang gzhu/ /de bzhin gdug la sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungs kyis bzhugs/ / yi ge bcu pa'i gdan las skyes/ /me tog ma dkar de bzhin du/ /spos ma gnag cing mar me ma/ /ser mo dri chab ma kha dog dmar/ /mo de rnams rang ming gi phyag mtshan can no/ /zhi ba mo'o/ /gnod mdzes ma nag po'am brtun shing dang rnam rgyal ma/ /dkar po'am 'bor lo 'dzin pa/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu 〈ma sogs bzhi ste drug po khro bo'o 〉la sogs dgod/ /yang 〈phag mo'am nag mo'i ting 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 〉gsungs pa/ 'di'i man ngag kyang logs su shes so/ /huX gi yi ges te sa bon las byung ba huX zhes sgra 'don ma// rdo rje phag mo nag po'am rnam 〈la wor 〉par sgom/ /zhal gcig po/ rab khros phag gi gdong ldan ma/ /phyag —462—

g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod pa lag na thogs/ /pa/ zhabs gar gyi rol 〈g.yon rkyang ba 〉ldan bsgoms par byas la/ /yi ge hūX gis sbyor ba ting nge 'dzin dang ngag tu bzlas pas/ /gnyid stug gi 'o(da gsal ba 〈ra 'char ba 〉ni byed pa dang / /bgegs zhi ba dang rang gi lus kyi nad rnams 'don cing 'joms pa'o/ /de yan kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ da ni don dam rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ston te/ de la chos rnams sogs 'og nas ston 〈ste don dam dbyings pa 〉'di ni rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /thabs rigs lngas so sor phye ste gsungs pa las/ rnam snang gis gsungs pa ni/ chong/ dbyings ye shes gsungs pa ste/chos rnams 〈kyi 〉rang bzhin yul dus bya ba kun gyis 'gyur ba med// 〈pa 〉dbyings 'di yi ngo bo ye shes rdo rje 〈'od gsal ba 'jig rgyu med pas/〉rtag /spros pa thams cad/gzod 〈ma 〉nas zhi ba yul yul can gnyis su med/ /pa ni/ nam mkhar nam mkha' la bzhag pa ji lta ba'o/ /sgrib gnyis 'joms pas dpa' bo chen po rnam snang 'khore lo'i rdas mtshon pa rig 〈te lha 〉pas de skad ces bka' stsal to/ / 'grel ba chung bar tsakra tsa la kra ma brda g.yo ba rim pas bcings pa dang / 'grel chen na tsā la grwa rta g.yo ba gnan pa ste gnyis ka la rlung 'gags pa'i don du 'chad do/ /zab pa spros bral dang dang rgya che 〈ba ji snyed mkhyen pa〉'i rang bzhin no/ /chos rnams thams cad gdod nas ma skyes pa'i/ ngo bo/ /gzung ba yul dang 'dzin pa yul can gyi ngo bo rnam par spangs/ /pa/gang zhig kun rdzob kyi chos rnams sgyu ma 〈lta bu〉'i rang bzhin can/ /te me long ye shes kyi rnam pa'o/ /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje 'dzin pa mi skyod pas badz+ra bā dzu rā dza te mang po gsal ba shes bya thams cad gzigs pa la 'grel pa gnyis ka 'chad do/ /de skad ces bka' rgyu nyam to/ /bdag gzhan che chung sogs gnyis chos kyi chos rnams thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /—463—

du gzigs pa/ gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med cing ming dang rgyu mtshan gyi gnas pa med/ /pa/ so sor 'byed chos dbyer med cing brjod pa'i yul dang bral ba/ /sems can rang bzhin dag par mthong bas snying rje dmigs med skye ba'i rgyu can/ /no te mnyam nyid kyi dmigs pa'o/ /dpa' bo chen po rdo rje nyi mas 〈rin ཿnga gi 〉sur+ya la sam tā/ u rta ma ra ta ya te/ mchog mnyam dga' byed de chos dbyings mchog tu rang gzhan mnyam pas sems can dga' bar byed do/ /zhes 'grel par ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'di ni bde 〈ba 〉chen po'i ye shes dam pa ste/ /yon tan gsar du 'phel 〈ba 〉dang skyon gsar du 'bri ba yod pa ma yin/ /〈la/〉kun rdzob rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam par 'phrul ba/ /thams cad rten cing 'byung ba 〈sor rtog gi dmigs pa'o/〉 /tsam du mkhyen pa'o/ /dpa' bo chen po 'jig rten lo tsā na ga ti/ mthong bas 'gro ba ye shes mig gis shes bya kun la 'gro ba la dbang 'byor bas dbang phyug tu gnyis las 'chad do/ /dbang phyug ṭa'od dpag med 〉 gis de skad ces bka' stsal/ to/ /bden pa 〈ra blos gzhug tu yod/〉ma yin te phung khams sogs su grub pas phyir ro/ /brdzun par gzhug tu yod pa min te ye shes rnam pa chi cad pa blo las 'das shing 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos/ /〈pa'o/ /〉'gro 〈ba 〉'di thams cad rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yang dag pa/ /ji ltar chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ /du chos dbyings kyi cho 'phrul tsam mchog tu gdod ma nas sgrib gnyis dag pa gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa'o/ /〈bya sgrub kyi dmigs pa'o//〉 gzigs nas 'gro don mdzad pa'o/ /dpa' bo chen po ral gri'i dam 〈kha sgo la kha ṭa ma/ ra gā mi/ nam mkha' 'dus pa 'joms pa ste tshogs pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid las mi 'da' bas dam tshig gi rgyu gnyis las 'chad do/〉/rigs kyi dam tshig gis 〈lha don grub kyi 〉de skad ces bka' stsa'/ rkeste/ /shes rab btsun mos bsdus te gsungs pa las zhus —464—

lan gnyis las zhus pa ni/ de nas rdo rje snying po sogs/ /sngags kyi dpa'o/ /rnams bzhengs shing phyag 'tshal te/ /dam tshig mkhyen pa chen mo sgrol ma rnal 'byore ma/ /dkyil 'bor gyi gtso mo che la 'di skad zhug/ /e ma ho chos rnams ni ngo mtshar ba las byung ba/ /te/ nam mkha' nam mkha'i rang bzhin 〈du bag pa ltar/〉 spros bral chosaspros bral rgya dang bcas pa rgyu 'bras rten 'brel las/ /sna tshogs chos kun 'byung ba ni/ /rdo rje rgyal mo zhes bos nas rgyu mtshan ci zhig lags/ /nyon la lan la mdor na cig rdo rje zhes bos nas don ji bzhin ma 'grul bar nyon/ /cig gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu lta ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad stong nyid du bstan/ /pa kho na mdzad do/ /don du ni thams cad la chos nyid yongs grub kyis/stong pa ma yin kun btanas kyis mi stong min/ /pa'o/ /'grel pa gnyis las med pa dang yod pa'i rnam rtog gi yul min pa'o/ /rgyas bshad dang po snang ba sems ni/ thog ma med pa nasabasags pa'i bag chags kyi mthu las/ /sna tsho/gas pa'i zhid khams snod kyi 'jig rten dang dbang po lnga dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang ro dang ldan pa/ /dang / ji dang reg bya dang ni lus/ /kyi khog pa dang / /phyi don du snang ba dang nang don du rnam par gnas pa/ /thams cad rang sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /yul nye bar dmigs pa la 'khyu/nga ba bzhi rnams dang gzungs sogs yum med de/ /sems nyid kyi dri ma phyi rol du snang ba'o/ /gnyis pa bden pa gnyis su dbye ba ni/ kun rdzob 'jig rten snang ngo ru tu ni 'jig rten 'di dag yod/ /dam pa'i don du ni dbyings las gzhan 'jig rten 'di dag med//gang gzung 'dzin gnyis snang thams cad med pas nang gi sems nyid bde ba dam pa rang rig pa'i/ /ye shes/ shes pa rang nyid gsal ba'i dngos po 'di kho na/ /tsam zhig yod do/ /—465—

༈ gsum pa spros bral du gtan la phab pa ni/ don du srid med ste 'khrul snang yin pas so/ /mya ngan 'das pa med/ /de don dam par mya ga med cing de las 'das par snang ba yang brdzun pa yin pas so/ khams bco brgyad med rnam par shes pa brgyad med/ /la dngos po med cing yul can sgom pa med/ /rgya mtsho la rlabs dang gzugs bar+sā dang srog chags dang / rin po chen sna tshogs kyi gnas yin yang / des ma gos pa ltar/ kun brtags lta bu brtags yod/ gzhan dbang lta bu/ srog chags dang 'dra na/ rdzas yod kyis ma gos shing / de thams cad 'char du rung bas na/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i chos nyid/de bzhin nyid/ /'di ni sdig dang bsod nams kyi bya ba las 'das/ /pa te de'i 'bras bu min la/ gcig dang du ma'i dngos po gang yang kyang min/ /bzhi pa log rtog gol sa bcad pa ni thams cad kyi don dam pa'i dngos po ro gcig tu gyur pa'i/ /mtshan nyid can te/ gnyis med kyi ye shes gcig nyid dngos po thams cad la rnam par spros/ /pa ste thams cad la chos nyid kyis khyab pa'o/ /sdug bsngal bde ba yul rnam shes/ /kun las 'das pa'i ye shes bde chen po/ /'di la rang ngos nas bya ba med cing byed po med/ /la las kyang med pa'o/ /rang bzhin la gnyisasnang gang gis kyang ma dkrugs la rang bzhin glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'o/ /rang bzhin de bde ba yin na/ chags pa'i bde ba yin nam/ chags bral gyi shin sbyangs pa yin nam/ dbu ma stong nyid mthong bas bde ba yin nam zhe na/ rang bzhin don dam 'di la 'dod chags med cing chags pa gdod nas med pas bral rgyu med/ /la/ dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur te 'di tshor ba ma yin cing dngos po'i gnas lugs yin pas dmigs rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /don dam pa'i 'dod chags chen po'i gnyis med ye shes 'di yod pas/ /bde chen sgoms pa na chags ldan rnams la byang chub bde wo gyi sku ster/ /ro/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ 'khor ba ni —466—

sems nyid kyi snang ba ste phyi rol dngos por grub pa med/ /la/ sems las gzhan du mya ga 'das pa byang chub kyang yod pa ma yin/ /no/ /srid pa dang zhi ba 'di gnyis ka don dam pa'i ro dang bral ba snying po bden par med/ /rang sems chos kyi dbyings/ bde chen don dam snying rje'i bdag nyid chos thams cad kyi mgon du don dam gyi skabs 'dir yod/ /do/ /rtsa ba'i don gnyis pa rgyud kyi sbyor ba rgyas pa la/ dang po rgyud ni/ de nas de bzhin gshe/gas pa rnam pa dang mtshan tha dad pa thams cad kyi sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba 'byung ba/ mi bslu bas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/'di skad ces bka' stsal/ to/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa'i lha nyi shu'i sgrub pa dang po sngags ni ()oṃ ma ṇi pad+me huX phaṭa swāhā/ spyan ras gzigs kyi'o/ () /oṃ sarba bzhi ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'o/ 9) /na mo bha ga wa te me ru shi kha ra ku ṭa pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myaklaX ba khyu ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ me ru me ru mahā me ru ye swāhā/ shākya thub pa'i 'o/ kho) /oX āXmi tri ye huX swāhā/ byamasapa'i 'o/ ()/oX badz+ra tik+ṣa dhiX 'jam dpal gyi'o/ 9) /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā wadhe ni/dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha wadhe ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bzhi wadhe ni swāhā/ sher phyin ma'i 'o/ 9) /oṃ ba mo ha swāhā/ gser can sgrol ma'i 'o/ 9) /oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re me dha naX de hi de hi swāhā/ nor bu 'dzin pa'i sgrol ma'i 'o/ rdzo) /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re sa rta rā ṇi khyoXswāhā/dbang byed sgrol ma'i 'o/ slo ska /oṃ ku ru kul+le khyoXswāhā/ ku ru kulbe'i 'o/ lo ska /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba du tsho / ka ha na da ha pa tsa huX phaṭa/ phyag na rdo rje rtsa ba'o/ lo she/oṃ ni lwa sba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti huX phaṭa swāhā/ phyag na rdo rje pho nya'i 'o/ (she /oṃ dzaX dhi ka ṭha mahā ho ha ra sarba dha na sgra bh+yo ra sno hūX rju huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ gtso mo nor rgyun ma'i 'o/—467—

(ye /oṃ ma no ha ra ha ra/ oṃ aṅga sha a du sha khyoXsdiX.ā+o ཾ ༷༷huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ bran mo nor rgyun ma'i 'o/ yon /oṃ ha ya gro ba khyoX.a haX a haX a aX hūX huX swāhā/ khro bo rta mgrin gyi'o/ slon /oṃ mahā ka la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa ma ma kar+yaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ legasaldan nag po r+sā yi'o/ yon /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ hri traX cha dzaX huX ha/ di byā ra sno ga ba ri sha na/ ar pa ka da pa ya sha sa ma ya/ ma nu sma ya/ khyiXhuX phaṭa/ nga la ser po'i 'o/ ho she /oṃ maX di ri di ri tsaṇ+ḍa / ༷ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sha za mo ral pa can gyi'o/ rka' /oṃ ge gā na pa ti ma ma rat+na sirnyi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga na pa ti swāhā/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi tshogs kyi bdag pho'o/ ṇa ska /oṃ ga na baX ho chu dzaXg na paṃ rgya dzaX byang shar tshogs kyi bdag dzo'o/ /gnyis pa lha'i rnam par mug da pa ni/ ()nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas rkyang rol stabs kyis yang dag par bzhugs shing gnas/ /pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon pad+ma dmar po bsnams/ /pas yum la mkhyud pa/ gos dkar mo dmar mo ga༈ yab dang wa ba yis mgul nas 'byud/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma ni g.yas gri slo)gug 'phyar ba g.yon thod pa khrag gang lag na thogs/ /nas thugs kar 'dzin pa phag mo rab khros ma rman khung du kha rgya bsnams/ /pa/ khro tshul cher bstan yang srin mo'i cha byad ma yin par/ lha mo'i tshul can yin pas/ mdzes ma shing ya ba'i me tog mtshungs/ /par dmar ba/ g.yas rkyang gis/ g.yon pas lha mo dkar mo dang g.yas pas phyugs bdag mahā de wa zhabs kyis mnan/ /pa'o/ /jo bo g.yon rkyang du bzhed de gnad gcig yod gsung / 9)gser mdog mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kun rdzogs shing / /phyag gnyis bdud 'dul gyi phyag rgyas sa gnon mnyam bzhag gis khams —468—

gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ /go taX shākya thub pa byang chub chen por bsgom/ /mgo bregs rab tu byung ba'i cha byad kyis brtul zhugs chen lo/ /byams pa ni ṣe)byang chub mchod rten spyi bor 'dzin/ /cing lha'i drang srong gi cha byad can/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog can dang ni g.yas mchog stsol ba'i phyag /ser po/ dong ka'i me tog ltar mdzes pa/ /rnam snang dbu rgyan du bya mi skyod sogs sangs rgyas bzhi mā ma gī sogs rig ma bzhir bcas te brtag /go/6)mdog dkar po 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /ral gri glegs bam phyag na bsnams/ /lte bar yi ge drug pa'i rab bsngags kyis mtshan pa'i 'khore lo rtsabs drug par bcas/ /gzhon nu'i cha byad kyi tshul can bsgom par bya/ /'o/ /sher phyin ma ni 9)zla ba ltar dkar ba g.yas mchog sbyin dang / /g.yon po stis mtshan pa'i chu skyes bcas/ /bsnyen pas bsgoms bzlas byas nas sgrub pa'i dus shu dag dang bcas pas/ /skyur po ma blangs pa 'thungs pas zla ba drug gis blo gros ster/ /g.yas 9)rin chen bum pa g.yon rin chen snye mar bcas/ /gang gi lag na nyer gnas pa/ /gser can sgrol ma bsam byas nas/ /longs spyod yid bzhin nor bu'i sprin lta bu nyid du 'gyur/ /dpag bsam shing brten ()cing g.yas de'i yal ga dang / /g.yon nor bu'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa ni/ /jo bo'i 'grel bar/ ljang khu ras phran 'cha sgrol ma/ zhes pa snang ba tshigs bcad 'grig pa sogs dgos par sems kyang / rgyud kyi rgya dpe gnyisan med cing / grub chen zhi ba yang med bzhed gsung / nyi ma ni mdog kyang ser por ram bzhed pas 'bru 'grel med kyang / 'di mi 'don par mngon/ gser gyi brag phug na gnas par bsam/ /nyi ma 9)'char ka gsar ba'i mdog /g.yas lcags kyu g.yon smra yi/la dmar po bsnams/ /sgeg pa'i cha byad 'chang brgyan du mas rnam brgyan pa/ /dbang —469—

du byed ma'i sgrol ma bsam par bya/ rkan /dmar po phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /dang po gnyis mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /'og ma gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu phyag na bsnams/ /ku ru kul+le bsam par bya/ /g.yas rdo rje ṇa ye thugs kar ga spyod cing 'chang ba phyag rdor g.yon gdan gnon pa/ / sngo bsangs yid tsam khro ba ste/ /sgrub pos mdun du bskyed pa ba theg nas ni/ / mtshan brgyad po ni brjod par byas/ /la zlas pa bya'o/ /nag ṇa ye po cher khros pas mi sdug pa g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba can/ /de'i brla gnyis bar du mkha' lding gi rgyal po ni// dug can a dza ga ra sprul sbram chen 'joms/ /phyag g.yon sdigs byed lag na rdo rje bsgom/ /nor rgyun ma 'di gnyis kyi sgrub thabs kyang logs na yod do/ /mdog lo pe bzang gser lta bu kā ma khyu nu'i 'dod ba/ /g.yas pi tsu ra 'bras ser po kha sngo ba gcig yod gsungs/ g.yon rin chen snye ma 'dzin/ /gter gyi bum pa zhabs sprad pa la gnas pa'i gnod sbyin mo/ /las byed ma rka ṭa spre'u ces bsam par bya/ /pad+ma ṇa pe rā ga'i 'od dang mnyam/ /sangs rgyas zangs kyi kyo ba ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor bus gang ba can/ / nor rgyun ma ni rnam bsgoms na/ /nges par dbang du byed pa yin/ khro bo'i (spu rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ gong du spund pa ltar las khyi gdong can gyi rdo rje lha mo mkha' 'gro ma rigs bzhi/ /yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma lha zhal gyis 'byud pa/ bsgo tshoms nas gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /gzi brjid mthu stobs rta mchog dpal nyid dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /yang na zhal gsum g.yas nag po dang dbus dmar po dang g.yon dkar/ /po'o/ /phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje dang dbyug to dang bcas pa ral gri/ /'o/ /g.yon gsum thod pa zhags pa dang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba thal mor bcas/ /pa'o/ /sprul —470—

pa mkha' lding rgyal po mang po rnam par spro/ /ba'o/ /yang na phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug to 'dzin par byas nas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas kyis klu rgyal nor rgyas dang g.yon tshangs pa bcas pa gnon cing gzir ba/ /bsgoms na sbrul gyis zin pa sogs kyi dug rnams bskyod pa dang / /sna tshogs las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /legs ldan 'di'i sgrubs thabs logs su shes so/ /nag po ni mun yon pa'i sku lus ltar nag pa khrag 'dzag pa'i zhal/ /g.yas ral gri ste gri khug g.yon thod bcas pa'i sha chen za ba/spo khung du kha ṭāX do shal mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /pa sgoms shing / dug shing la byas pa'i sku la mchod par bya/ /'o/ /dzam bha la ṇa po ni nor 'phel ba sgrub pa/ /ser po g.yas bi dza pu ra 'dzin/ /ne'u le g.yon na bsnams par bsgoms byas nas/ /chu sbyin dbang po mchod cing bsgrub par bya/ /'di yang logs su lta'o/ /rab dmar ṇa shethod pa'i gdan la gar stabs kyis gnas/ /pa/ g.yas cang te'u g.yon thod pa shas gang ba 'dzin/ /pa/ ral pa ldan ma bsgoms byas na/ /'di sha za mo'i gtso bo yin pas/ sha za mo rnams mngag gzhug 'gyur/ /'di tshangs spyod bud med dang ma 'brel bas bsgrub dgos gsung / zhal gsum dbus glang po rka' g.yas spre'u rgyal g.yon byi ba'i gdong gi gzugs/ /mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag dang po gnyis dgra sta dang la phug phyag na bsnams/ /'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang myong snod bsnams pa yi/ /phyag bar ba gnyis/ zhi ba la bum pa/ rgyas pa la ne'u le'i skyal pa/ dbang la mda' gzhu/ drag po la gri zhags bya zhes jo bo bzhed/ man ngag la yum la mkhyud pa yin no/ /phyag drug pa zhabs ni bzhi pa la/ /byi ba la g.yon rkyang gis bzhugs pa/ yang zhabs rgyab ma gnyis kyis yum la mkhyud par nyi mas mdzad do chung ma sna chen ma zhes bya/ phag gdong ngam/ lha zhal can/ rin chen —471

'dzin pas mkhyud pa/ yan lag lhag 'dra/ ga sku1ga lnga1ra spre'u'i gzugs can bzhi/ bca/sa bsgoms nas/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po mdun bskyed du de ltar sgoms nas la du la phug sogs dang sha chang mngar gsum sogs kyis mchod par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i dbus su zla khams dmar po gcig byas la/ stegs bu'i steng du sku bzhag mdun bskyed gam las/ tsho gis bdag glang chen gdong / rab dmar slon mche ba gtsigs pa ni/ /phyag mtshan dang las sbyor skabs zhag/sa pa lcags kyu'i rab sbyor ba/ /gnas gsum/ byin rlabs ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan/ 'di yis ha na da ha pa tsa ban+ta bisnan mā ra ya hūṃ brtags na bgegs rnams 'joms pa dang / /las brnyi dza sna ku ru ye swāhā sbyar na blo dang hriḥhriXdza:dzaXbā shing ku ru sgo2 sirnyi dza:dzaXbartags na dbang du byed pa yin/ /gsum pa sa bon gyi rim pa de nyid kyis hiX1baX 2huX 3ra 4dhiX5a 6taX 7taX 8taX 9hiX10huX 11hūX 12paṃ 13lhaX14haX 15huX 16dzhai 1ne sdeX18gaX 19gaX 20zhes rnams so/ /༈ rtsa ba sa bcad gsum pa rmugs 'dzin he ru ka'i sgrub thabs ni/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i spyor rnal 'byor la gnas pa bas tsan+dan dmar po la rja bha la'i sku byas/ 'gron bu rin chen sna lnga/ ras sna lnga rnams stegs bu la zangs gzhongs su bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ mdun du rdza dang / paṃ las gnod gnas dbang po dmar po bi dza pu ra dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ gnod sbyin mo nor rgyun ma/ rang dang 'dra ba la 'ju ga pa bsams nas/ ye shes pa gzhugs pa dang / gtor ma phul la oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha naX mi de hi ḍā ki ni dzā la paṃ bha ra swāhā/ zhes pa 'dis lngin rer lan brgya rtsa brgyad chu sbyin no/ /nga la rang la bstim/ rten rnams mi lpags kyi khug mar bcug bcangs/ khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu 'gyu/ra ba yod la/ min —472—

na'ang nor can du 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa phyag brgyad sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor ni sngon mo spyi dang mthun pad zla la ro/ /tāX yig dang ut+pa la'i ye shes las skyes pa/ /sku mdog dang zhal bzhi pa la sha yi mdog /ltar ljang ba phyag gnyis thugs khar ldi yin la'i phyag rgya 'ching ba can/ /lhag ma g.yas gsum na 'phreng ba dkar po dang mda' chen dang 'khor lo dang / /g.yon gsum na rgyal mtshan dang gzhu dang bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin/ /pa lhag ma spyi bo dang mtshungs pa lha mo sgrol ma bsam par bya/ /yan lag lhag ma rnams kyang byas/ rtsa sngagasazlas pas 'jigs pa brgyad las bsrung bar 'gyu/ra/ /snying ga nas 'jigs pa brgyad skyob lha mo spros nas so so'i bzlas pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bzla zhing mtshan brgya 'don gsungs/lnga pa gtor chog la sngags ni/ sngags 'dis bza' bca' ror bcas 'bul/ /gtor snod bcu gcig tu bshams/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sbyan 'dren pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ yang bcu bshams la 'bul 'jigs pa las nges par skyob/ nang nub 'bul gsungs/ na maXsarba bzhi sde bo dhi satwa nāX/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa naX/ he he bha ga ba te mahā sa tā sarba brnya a ba shwe1 ki te/ mā bi la sba mā bi la sba i daX bā ling gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX hūX hūṃ sarba bi sañca re swāhā/ rdzas ni kha zas bzang dgu la/ zla ba khu ba nyi ma rak+ta sman dri wo dang dri/ /chu/ mar khu ni rkang te bdud rtsi lnga dang / rgo ku sogs sgron ma lngas bcas pa/ /de kho na nyid lha'i rnal 'byor sbyangs rtogs sbar ba'i rnal se byar ldan pas te kha zas bza' ba dang / /tsa rus bza' ston byed pa dang de bzhin du gtor ma 'bul bar bya/ /drug pa bum chog ni maṇ+ḍal pad 'dab brgyad pa/ bum pa spyi mthun du bshams bgegs bskrad/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par skyed/ paṃ las bum chu skyed der sgrol ma phyag brgyad ma skyed pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs bzung thag me tog phreng ba nas bzung / dmigs pa gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ bdag gam sgrub bya'i nad gdon zhi —473—

bar bsam la/ bar bar du mchod bstod gtor ma gsol btabs rnams yang yang bya/ thun bzhir phyogs skyong dang ཿnga po dang bgegs gtor gtong sgrol ma'i gzungs rings kyis bum pa la/ /zhug bdun bzlas te mthar zhu ste nad pa la gosang na pa zhig skon chu phal pas skrus/ kha shar du stan/ bgegs gtor btang / lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyis gtor ma sgron me can zhig btang /yung kar gyis sdig pa sbyangs ba bya/ khrus chu gos ngan yung me rnams bzhi mdo'am chu bor skyal/ yang na pa drug bzhi ldan bya/ de nas stegs bu la bzhag gos dkar po gon nas/ bkru/sa byab srungs gsum shis brjod byas na/ nad gdon nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa mi dang mi ma yin gyi chom po srung ba ni/ chom rkun chings shig ces pa yi ge bcu pa la gdags mang du bzlas/ tso ra bcings par bsam la/ thig gu la mdud pa byas shing / shing bu shing te te zer ba smag shad 'dra ba gcig yod de la zor ba'am sbu gri'i gzugs bcos la a yig 'bri/ de la bsngags la a zhes ba khas pa bzlas pas thogs te song ba chom po bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa phag mo rmi lam du zhal lta ba ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i bsnyen pa song nas/ las sgrubs kyi don du phag mo'i sngags 'bum bzlas te dkyil 'khor 'e ras byug pa bum pa dang bcas pa byas la/ mchod gtor 'bul zhing / oṃ āXbadz+ra na ra ka hri khaX huX phaṭa/ ces pa smra ba bcad de zhag bdun bzlas pa gyis rmi lam du zhal ston par 'gyur te yi ge logs su yod do/ /brgyad pa dbang byed sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ nyi ma 'char ka sogs kyi las tshogs te/'grel pa gnyis ltar na/ sgrol ma dmar mo'i snyen pa song nas/ slar yang de'i ro/ /sgrol ma dmar mo'i snyen pa song nas slar yang de'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas skar ma rgyal la dge ba'i las mchod rten dmar po rab gnas kyang byas la/ gro ga la tshes brgyad la 'dab ma brgyad la yi ge brgyad lte bar oṃ spel tshig hā rnams bris mu khyud la ā li kā li'i skor ba'o/—474—

ut+pal gyi 'khor lo kha sbyor byas la/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i smad kyi char bcug steng du/sgrol ma dmar mo skyed nas 'og tu bud med kyi rdzas dang bcas pa'i ming bcas che ge mo dbang du gyis shig ho ces bskul ba dang bcas zhag bdun du ngag bcad de nyis 'bum sogs bzlas pas gang dbang du bya ba de 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'di la'ang yi ge logs su yod do/ /dgu pa byams pa'i gzungs chu ni gong du bstan pa'i bsnyen pa song nas bum pa spyi dang mthun par bcas pa dkar dang srad bu'ang bzhag bris sku dang sa ra'i po ti dang / byang chub mchod rten mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams la/ bdag mdun mchod bstod 'dzin pa'i gtor ma sogs byas nas bum pa la/ byams pa'i sngags kyis 'bum du bzlas pa'i chus zhakhru da pa dang / sa dkar la 'bum bzlas te ril bu byas pa dang / bsrung skud byas pa de dag ni nad dang gdon las thar pa dang / mtshams med pa byas pa'ang ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyu/ra ro/ /bcu pa ku ru ku lce'i phyag bsnyan sgrub pa ni/ bdag bskyed ku ru ku lce'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas gtsang po'i chu zangs ma'i snod du blangs te mdun du bzhag nas chu'i steng de la a las zla ba la ma las nyi ma la krongs skyed kyis brgyan dang bcas pa'i gnod spyin mo g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin par bu mo chung waṃ rnam pa can du bsams nas/ oṃ urdzi ṣa ya dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swāhā/ 'di bsnyen sngags rma nga mo he hri da yaX warta ni hūX huX phaṭa/ 'di las sngags/ bsnyen pa sum khri byas la/ nangs par sum brgya bzlas nas shub gsum mthungs te/ khrus byas na rgyal khams sam gang 'dod pa/thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /spyod yul la 'jug pa na bsnyen sngags bzlas so/ /bcu gcig pa ro langs ma'i cho ga ni khrag gam tsan+dan gyis maṇ+ḍal byas la/ lha mo be+e ta li ser mo drag mo skra dmar po 'phyang ba sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin —475—

par mdun du bsams nas/ tsho( be+e ta lī pu tra sirnyi huX phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas 'bum phrag bzhi bsnyen pa bya/ sha khrag gi gtor ma 'bul/ de nas bum sgrubs kyi chus skyes pa dang bud med dkrus/ mthung du bcug te bud med de nyid ro langs mar skyed/ gtor ma rgya cher btang bas srid 'chags shing rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /sarba dza ya/ dngul chur bcas pa la be ta le'i sngags stong / pu tra sirnyi re tshab tu a tra ban+ta zhes spel ba btab te/ rna ba'i bu gar bzhag na mtshon gyis chod par mi 'gyur ro/ /ra rgyu gnyis pa gdugs dkar sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid gdugs dkar mo dkar mo phro(ra lo dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rol pa'i khro mo brgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs can can du bsgoms nas/ yan lag lhag ma 'dra ste rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can no/ /ta bya thā/ glu tshe a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/be+e ra be+e ra/ so me so me/ sarba pre a ju nā a dhi nyi te sarba ta thā ga tā sto ṣa si ta ta pa tre huX phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā/ ces mi g.yo ba dang rdo rje phur bu spros/ gcod pa dang / phur bus 'debs pa/ phur bus 'debs par bsam la bzlas pas gzhan gyi byad stemasadang ro langs kyi las 'jig cing bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /bcu gsum pa sa 'og gi dngos grub sgrub pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i lha lag na rdo rje dang gnod mdzes kyi rig sngags grub pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo ba'i rdo rje'am/gnam lcags kyi rdo rje byas la sa tā la sirnyi hūṃ phaṭa ces btanas la bzlas pas rdo rje 'bar bar gyur nas sa 'og gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ srad bu la sogs pa'i lha min gyi 'khrul 'khor bcom nas lha min gnas kyi dpal gyi sgo'am/sa 'og gi bu ga'i sgo phal pa rnams su 'jug ste/ lha min dbang po gdug pa can/stobs can dang 'jam po g.yin len la sogs pas mchod par byed de 'di dag rgyas—476—

par ni ji ltar sa 'og gi rtog pa las bshad pa de bzhin no/ /〈du sgrub po/ /stso bzhi pa ya mā ris drag shul sgrub pa ni sgrubs thabs kyi cho ga spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sgrol ma'i dbang du byas nas mdun skyed dam/ spyir bdag skyed kyang wo zer 〉 dpa' bo gshin rje gshed po ni/ /sku mdog nag po g.yas dbyug pa g.yon zhags pa bsnams/ /pa khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing / ma he la g.yon rkyang gis gnas pa bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ya mun+ta ka hūX bzlas/ te bsnyen pa'o/ / mchod gtor sogs gshin rje gshed spyi sogs dang 'dra ba dang / yi ge bcu bzhi pa dang / so gnyis pa yang las kyi don du 'bum du bzlas la/ nang mar re mig dgu pa la sngags kyi khang pa lnga/ dang / bar ba/ khang pa bcu gnyis dag dang bcas/ /pa la ya sogs dgod/ de la hiXsgyiXl sogs dag gis yi ge re re zhing bskor/ /lte ba dang re mig stong pa la ming spel te/ sgrubs na 'khor lo 'di yis drag shul spyod kun bsgrub/ /dgod bya yi ge ni yak+ṣi ma me da dza sa do sa ṇa yo ni ra yasnro ni ra/ /bco lnga pa ཿnga po rnams kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa ni/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa sgrub bo/ /oṃ yo yak+ṣi ṇi bī ra dze swāhā/ shang leb la ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon gos sna tshogs 'dzin pa mo bris la de bkug te skye gnas su gzir bas bzlas na 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'di man chad kyi sgrub thabs bcu gnyis la rgyud 'di nyid du sngags tsam las mi 'byung na yang gsang ba thig le las rgyas par gsungs pa ltar sbyor dgos te/ der drag pos dgos 'dir ma phye'o/ /'ongs nas kyang ci bgyi byed par 'a 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bha ga wa te swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing la sogs par gzugs brnyan bya'o/ /gnod sbyin mo nor can gyi'o/slo)/na mo be+e shra ma ṇa/ ta ya na ḍa ku be rā ya/ dī bya bi ma na tsi ra ta ya/ he ma mā la kuṇ+ḍal/ sha ri ta ya/ yak+ṣa sa/ ban+ta ya hūṃ bha ga wā na/ ā warnya yi rtsi mi/ ta bya —477—

thā/ oṃ ma ṇi ma ṇi kuṇ+ḍa kuṇ+ḍa/ ku ku ku ku/ pa ra pa ra/ pu ra pu ra/ ku be ra ku be ra na ḍa ku be rā di bya ma na kun ku bi ku bi swāhā/ na ḍa mo yi'o/ 9) /oṃ na ḍa bi na ḍi dha ri ṇi swāhā/ na ḍa pho'i 'o/ 9)/yak+ṣa ki li gi lo na mo sa skyo ba di ti sna pra taX ta sha rmaX paṇ+ḍi da da mi se ma ka mā na pra yalgo swāhā/ ki li ki li'i 'o/9) /phuXhaX phuX klu mo mtha' yas ma'i 'o/9) /oṃ khyoXdza/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i 'o/9) /na mo bha ga wa te pi lu pa lā ya/ pi sha tsi/ sa'i snun te/ sa me ka ma na/ pra yasne sto/ ta bya thā/ hu lu hu lu/ pi sha tsa/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra da ba ra da/tsu lu tsu lu/ tsu ṭu tsu ṭu na maXswāhā/ sha za pi lu ba'i 'o/9) /na mo bha ga wa te pi sha ya/ aX ka ka na pi sha tsa dha ri ma ni swāhā/ sha za nor bu 'dzin pa'i 'o/9) /oṃ kriṣ+ṭha pi shā tsa ya sa ra sa ra sarba a the na me swā dha ya swāhā/ sha za nag mo'i 'o/(pe /a lu ke be le ke gro hā baṇ+ḍa yi shā tsi ni swāhā/ e lu ka'i 'o/lo ska /oṃ kha ra mu kha pe shā tsi nī hi hi da da pa ya swāhā/ bong gdong ma'i 'o/ khwa she /oṃ ta ti le ta ti le spos mu khe mahā pi shā tsi de hi de hi da swāhā/ dus kyi gdong gi'o/lo she /tshe ring sor byed pa'i rdzas ster ba dang / bcud len grub pa'i da chu pa chu sogs ri lu mig sman sogs/ /ster ba dang / 'gro ba pho mo kyang ring po nas 'gugs pa dang / /gzhan sems kyi byed pa dang / thag ring ba dang / sgrib g.yogs kyi lkog gyur shes pa rang la smra zhing / ston pa la sogs/ /dang / de bzhin du zas dang gser gyi 'dod pa wo re bzhi ster/ /bar byed do/ /ra sto drug pa mi g.yo mgon po'i dbugs cung ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das snying stobs nus pa ches phod pas shākya bdud bzhi thub pa de khros pa ni mi g.yo nyid des sprul pa'i khro bo yin pa'o/ /rdo rje gtum po mi g.yo ba spros pa ni/ sa bon huX sku ni ral gri zhags pa —478—

phyag gnyis na bsnams pa'i mchog /skra ser brjes pa 'khrang la grims pa'i lus/ /rin po che'i cod pan sbrul dang rus pas brgyan pa g.yas kyi pus mo dang g.yon gyi zhabs mthil btsugs pa/ stag lpags kyi bsham thabs sogs grol grol ba'o/ /dgra bgegs thams cad gsod pas ma rungs pa khros pas gtum po cher 'khrugs pa/ /sku'i mdog nag po spyan g.yas gyen dang g.yon thur du gzigs pas/ mig yon po dgyes pa spro ba che/ /ba'o/ /sngagasani/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa/ thugs kha'i sngags las spros pa'i pho nya dang / me yis bgegs rnams sprod par bsam pa skrod nus dang / /sngags bzlas chu yis srung ba'am/ /mtshan ma gtsang chu blangs la/ nam mkha' ma mthong bar bya/ snga dro chu de'i phyed kyis khrus bya/ phyed khyor ba g.yas su blug /g.yon pas mnye zhing sngags lan gsum bzlas la btung ba lan gsum bya/ sngags rtsa sngags su ba ched/ bod kyi chu srung la/ na maX tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ya/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa/ k+ṣ-i tre tra sa ya/ k+ṣ-i tre tra sa ya/ paṃ tra ya/ saX tra ya/ hūṃ hūṃ huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'phar ma gnyis pa'i 'khor lor nang ma zlum po la ral gri'i yu bar hūX mtha' skor yi ge 'gyu pa spel tshig can/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs bzhir ral gri/ mtshams bzhir zhags pa rnams hūX gis mtshan pa/ mu khyud la rtsa sngags 'dus pa nas 'byung / de spel tshig bcas bri/ de'i phyir gru bzhi sgo bzhi bya/ khor yug re mig nyer bzhi la le'u dang po'i mi g.yo ba'i rtsa sngags bgos la bri/ phyi rdo ra me ri can no/ /sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ nad gnod khyad par chos kyi bar go srung ba'o/ /bris/ /yang na 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ lte bar hūṃ la oṃ de rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ rtsibs bcu la yi ge bcu mu khyud rim pa gnyis/ dang po la ā li phyi ma la kā li mu khyud nyid 'dab brgyad ma'o/ /ri bo'am dben par 'di yi smin drug yar ngo la zla mtshan gyi ras sam g.yul gyi ras la/ thun bzhir mchod bstod dang bcas/ bris sku byas nas ni/ /rab gnas mchod pa rgya cher bya'o/ / maṇ+ḍal mchod —479—

pa sngon du 'gro bas khro rgyal rtag tu gtor mas mchod/ / 〈rang gi dngos grub kyi don dang /nad pa'i rim gro/ lam gyi 'jigs pa sel ba sogs la ches bsngags/ bris sku 'jigs pa la zhal ston/〉/lha dgu phyi rol tu phyogs skyong gi maṇ+ḍal byas la/ gtum po khro bo'i rgyud kyi/ gtor sngags la sogs kyi sngags btags/ kham phor du yungs kar blug gong gi 'khor lo chung bas kha bcad nyin bdun bzlas/ lag yungs kar brab pa dang / chu la yang cho ga yungs kar dang 'dra ba dang pu ta lis/ /ga snying gar ming dang dri zhes bya ba bris dgug gzhug mang du bya/ gong 'khor lo'i bar du bcug ste sar sgrubs/ bgegs rnams tshogs sogs pho nya spros pa'i tshogs kyis dmigs pa dang / tho ba skyed chog byas te brdung / tshirnya'i sngags so/ /nas rkang du nas rdubs te lam rgya gram du mnan na/ nyams par byed pa gdon zug dang / chags che dang / sre'u ma sos pa dang / 'dre zhugs shing rlams/ thud la sogs pa zlog pa'o/ /dang / /dpung rnams gnon dang dbye ba sgrubs po bzhi ldan las mi nyung ngo / /gcig gis thun brgyad du gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bul zhing sgrub po gcig gis sbyin sreg gcig gis gong gi bgegs 'dul gyis dgra bo'i lha skrad/ gcig gis seng lding gi phur pa la dur khrod kyi rus pa dang yungs kar btags che ge mo dang che ge mo bi di ṣa ya phaṭa ces bris shing zlas/ dgra bo'i sgo gong sbas/ dmag yong phyogs su yungs kar u tsa ṭa'i spel gyis sdig go /yang na dbye ba ni/ gong gi 'khor lo che chung kha dang lhug pa la gnas pa bri/de'i sgro gnyis rta dang ma he'i rmig pa'i bar du btsug dgug gzhug sogs sgrubs te/ sgros sbyin sreg byas la bar du sbas so/ /dang / /bsad pa ni dug khrag gam lan tshwa dang ra bong bu'i khrag dang / sbang sha rus/ sha chen/ ba glang gi sha myos byed rnams dang / nag bra bo sogs sres pa'i spyin sreg ling ga sreg pa sogs bya/ dgra'i zag rdzas la liṅga bya/ 'khor lo snying khar gzhug 'gug 'dren dang lha dbye drag tu bya/ thod par bcug bcings te yang sgrub dur khrod du sbas nas la —480—

the sogs skrad pa dang ngag gnon ni rab bya ste/ /'grel ba gnyis nas yungs kar chu khrag ste brag rdzas bgegs nyams ni dgra'i zung ba bshig pa dpung gnon pa 'jig rten pa'i lha dbye dang ni 'das pa'i lha dbye rnams byas la bsad skrad gnan dbye sogs bya zhes dang / 'khor lo dang gtor ma'i las gong du rtan/ bris dus sgrub pa stan te las tshogs gcig tu ba ched do/ /gtum po khros pa'i rgyud mi g.yo bla med du grags pa dang gtum po yi/ /dam tshig 'byung ba rgyud rgyal po rang bla med yin pa las tshogs gtso bor ston pa gcig ste bod na ni med la sogs par/ /mi g.yo rgyal po nyid kyis gsungs/ /pa bzhin gtso mo sgrol mas 'dir zur tsam gsungasaso/ /sngon tshe skal pa bzang po la ri rab kyi rtse mo'i bdag po/ lha mo bde ldan te rdo rje phag mo'o dang / /sangs rgyas mi 'khru/gas mi skyod pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul bar bzhed nas 'dus pa las/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshul gyis sgrol ba'i bdag dang ming po mi g.yo btsas/ /te sprul lo/ /gling bzhir dgra bcom gtso bo bzhi po rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /'dod lha bdud sdig can dang lha min rnams kyis nyams byas// de nas lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par gyur pa'i tshe/ /mi g.yo mgon gyis lha min gyi dbang / po rgyal po/ khrag khrig bcu ste gnyis ral gris rab tu gtubs nas/ /tshar bcad de/ de de'i chung ma kun la 'dod pas rjes su tshags par byas/ /te lam la bkod do/ /ga phyogs kyi mi dang dri za dang mi'am ci/ /dang / gnod sbyin dang klu gdug pa rnams kyang srog bco ma ste/ /bsad pa thams cad rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du te mngon dga' la 'phangs/ /te/ /de dag kun gyi ming yang byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khra/gas rgyal/ /po sha stag go /de dag sngon byung ste rjes 'jug mi g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/mi la mngon spyod kyi las dang / mi min gzir ba'i las dang khyad par bdud dang / lha min 'dul 481—

ba'o/ /mi g.yo ba chags chen gyi ye shes 'phel bar gyur pa yis/ /sring mo sgrol ma dag dang ma lha mo bde ldan yang bsten/ /pa na/ phyag rgya mo mchog de'i rgyus/ bde ba'i nang nas kyang bde ba lhan skyes bla na med par thob ste bde ba mchog de yis/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas spangs nas sangs rgyas mi g.yo mgon por sangs rgyas par gyur/ /ro/ /de dag mngon byung yin la/ rjes 'jug ltar na/ lha min mo dang mtshungs pa'i phyag rgya nges can sbyangs pas byung ba la brten nas rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skyes par byas/ mi sogs mtshungs pa spyod pa spyad pas de brtan can 'phel bar byas/ sgrol ma nyid dang mtshungs pa nye rgyu bsten pa yin no/ /mi g.yos gling bzhi'i dgra bcom par rnams la smras/ /pa/ bud med dmad cing spangs pa'i spyir sku gsung rdo rje la rmad bye brag lha mo'i rigs la smad pa'i sdig pa 'byung la de las/ /skes rab spangs shing bde ba'i rgyu la smod cing spangs pas stong nyid spangs par 'gyur te/ de rtogs pa bde ba la rags las so/ /des na/ bde ba'ang spangs pas/ /na sems can bde ba la bkod mi thub cing stong nyid ma rtogs na snying rje yang phul phyin mi 'byung bas/ snying rje shin tu stobs dman par byas/ /pa yin te bdag mtshungs kyi byams pa spangs shing bud med la smad pa gnyis kyang sems can gyi phyed spangs pa dang / dman par zhen na stong nyid rtogs pa'i gegs kyang che'o/ / gang zag gang shes rab dang snying rje gang dag spangs pa/ /'dis ni de'i 'brasabu sangs rgyas dang de'i rang bzhi dam chos dang / /de la spyod pa dge 'dun yang ni smod cing rnam par spangs pas/ /dmigs pa can gyi dge slong gang dag bud med la smod par byed pa/ /ni/ so sor thar ba ltar na/ bud med rab tu 'byin pa sogs rjes su bzung ba dang yang 'gal/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems skyed ltar na sems can blos spangs par sogs/ sngags ltar rtsa rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba sogs mang bas na sdom pas dman zhing sdig —482—

pa dang bcas/ /pa'o/ /bud med dang sbyor las thig le dbab zlog goms na thig le 'dzag med 'grub pa'i phyir sdom brtson nyid/ /che mchog tu gyur pa gzhan ni phyag rgya'i lam la ma goms pas ni myongs spyod la gnas pa ltar byas kyang / rmi lam sogs su thig le 'dzag pas na chas spyod kyi sdom pa'i tshangs spyod rnam dag med pa'i phyir/ /mgo bregs tso smrig gi cha lugs can mong zhig tshangs spyod med kyang yod do zhes sgyu mas te g.yo sgyus 'jig rten bslu/ /te mi tshangs spyod srings pa tsam la tshangs spyod du rdzu bas so/ /dgra bcom khyed cag mā ma gi sogs sring mo'i 'phags ma rnams dam tshig rig ma rten par gis/ / shig de tshe gling bzhi na chos ston par gnas pa'i dge slong gi gtso/ /bo bzhi po bud med phyag rgya'i dam tshig las bde ba chen po ye shes thob pa yis/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur/ /te/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs sangs rgyas bzhin rab tu grags/ /so/ /rjes 'jug sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor la mi skyod yab yum spyi bor sgom rigs bzhi yum bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan no/ /bskal pa bzang po'i dus 'dir ming po mi g.yo ba go taX thub pa ste/ /bu mo go pā ni sring mo sgrol ma bdag /yin la/ rig 'dzin lha'i bud med brgyad khri'i dang phyi nang gi 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa'i bde ba yis/ /longs spyod chen po dang bcas pa'i khyim du sa bcu thob/ /pa'i tshul stan te spros bcas kyi spyod pa'o/ /de nas rab tu byung nas zhing du rgyu snyo kun 'dar gyis/ /spyod pa yongs su spyod pa na/ /'jig rten pa rnams 'di drang srong rnams dang lhan cig kun tu rgyu zhes rtog /go /de nas dka' ba spyod par mthong ba ni/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa'o/ /zhes shugs la thob gsung ngo / /grong ba'i bu mo dga' mo dang ni dga' stobs mar/ /sprul pa'i lha mos 'o thug phul bar mthong ba'i tshe/ zas mchog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug gi bde ba yis/ /mtshams —483—

sbyar rdo rje'i gdan la sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur te rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa nyid/ /do/ /byang chub snying por gzhug pa'i tshe/ mi g.yo ba khros pas bdud 'khor bcas thams cad bsad skrad sogs kyis bcom nas/ /bdud kyi bu mo rab bkram gyi grangs tsam rnams/ /'dod chags chen po spyad pas bde chen gyi lam la bkod nas rjes su bzung / /ngo / /des na drag shul spyod pa dang bde ba'i lam 'khrig sbyor las/ /gzhan du byang chub kyi lam zab mo gzhan yod pa min yang / /dus de'i tshe/ skal med mang po phal pa'i chags sdang la sred pa ma gtogs/ chags chen la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thun mong gi snang ngor med pas na/ blo chen rnams chags bral dang byams pa la/ /mos pa'i phyir rgyal bas bdud rnams byams pas brtul shing chags bral lam las sangs rgyas thob par mthong ba'i sgyu ma sprul pa mdzad/ /do/ /'di'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i dam tshig ni bud med sgrol ma bdag sgrub pa de yis ni/ /rdo rje ming po la sogs pa spyi dang 'dod pa'i bde bas mnyes par bya/ /la/ mi g.yo rgyal po'i dam tshig gis/ /ni/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig rdo rje sring mo dang / /rdo rje bu mo dang rdo rje ma yang ma rdzo pa spyi dang gsang bas mchod par bya/ /yugs sa mo zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten na sngon khyo can phyis khyo med du gyur pa ni brda ste/ de ni bud med gang / sngon thig le 'dzag pas thig le 'dzag med du gyur pa'o/ /de kun bde ba yis/ /dga' bar byas na mi g.yo mnyes/ /par 'gyur la cung zad ye shes brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'di dag thams cad sgra ji bzhin par spyod pa yin no/ /mi gang nga la mchod byed pa/ /de la gtum mo la mchod kyang khro bo gtum pos byin gyis rlobs/ /par 'gyur la de bzhin du gtum mo mchod pa yang mtshungs so/ /mi g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul/gdul bya grangs med pa byang chub la gzhol pa'i dbugs dbyung ba〈stan tshul/〉'o/ /bstobadun —484—
