'di'i bar ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'grel mtha' gcod can rang yin pas phyi ma'i rgyud tshig gal che shos rnams so/ /dbang rim gnyis spyod pa sogs/ gsang ba thams cad 'byung pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //le'u lnga pas don bsdu ba la gsum las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de nas 'khore rnams kyis bstod pa/ lam dang dbang gi sgo nas bstod pa kun rdzob kyi thabs shes sam/ don dam gyi bden pa'i bden gnyis sam/ spyi don ltar na yul dang rnam shes kyi dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba gang / /rang bzhin med pa'i rim pas stong pa gsum mam kun rdzob spangs pa'am/ gzung 'dzin bral ba bdag nyid de/ /ye shes 'di ni nyon mongs 'joms pa'i phyir/ ma 3 3 cha ste ye shes lnga rjes chags dang stong sgo la sbyar ba'i lam dus kyi ye shes rnam 'chang ba/ /nyon mongs la mngon par spyod pa brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs sna tshogs pa gcod par mdzad pa po/ /zhes 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ ma mo mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i 'gro ba'i yid sgrib gnyis las skyobs pa'i phyir sngags can ma/ /te/ yang na gsung rdo rje yin pa te longs sku bstan la/ dbang po'i dra ba ni sgyu ma ste de dang 'dra bar sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing 'khrug /sa ste sprul sku bstan/ yang na dbang po'i dra ba ni dbang po thams cad pa ste rang snang gi sprul sku 'od zer gzhan snang gi sprul sku'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa mdzes ma dang gtsugs par mdzad/ /pa ste bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /ji lta dang ji snyed gzigs pa'i blo gros chen pos ni chos sku ste de lta bus bdag la dbang bskur sto'i// /ces gsol ba btab par gyur pa las/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid kyi sku la yongs su zhugs te/ ni sngon byung yin la rjes —529—

'jug ltar na gsang dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ de ltar slob mas gsol ba btab pa la slob dpon rig mar bcas pa'i de bzhin sgom pa'i don no/ /byang chub sems zhu zhing 'khor lo bzhir rim pas rnam par dbab pa gnas so sor mi 'gyur bcing nas dga' bzhi dngos bzung shing brtan par byed dgos pa rdo rje ste dpe nam mkha'i khams thams cad sngon byung sgra ji bzhin pa dang rjes 'jug la mkha' khams gsang ba'i pad+ma yin pas phyag rgya'i de nyid/ yongs su gang bas/sems can kyang sngon byung sgra ji bzhin pa dang / rjes 'jug ltar na slob ma'i phung khams/thams cad mchog tu bde ba grub pa ni slob mas byang sems myangs pas bde ba khyad par can skye bar gyur to/ / gsum pa de kho na nyid bshad pa bcu gsum las/ dang po bdud gzhom pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /hūX gi yi ge las srung 'khor sgomasate bdud rnams gzhom/ /pa'i cho ga sgrub ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa mngon par byang chub lnga'i dag 'bras ni/ ā li mtsho ni byed 8ṣe dang kwa li mtshon byed āXste nyi zla'i sa bon no/ /ā li kā li ni/nyi zla'i mtshan ma ste/ /rtsa gnyis las rkyang ma zla ba dang ro ma nyi ma dag /rnam par dag pa ste/de ltar nyi zla kha spyor/ de dag me long ye shes kyi dag pas rnam par dag pa te/ /sa bon dang phyag mawo mtshan mar gyur pa ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dag sar ngas bshad do/ /nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan thams cad gcig tu gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shesakyi dag pa yin te/ /'od zer spro bsdus 'gro don byed pa ni bya ba nan tan/ /gyis ye shesakyi dag pa'o/ /gtso mo'i gzugs brnyan zhal phyag sogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi dag pa so/ /gsum pa bsgo bya lam dngos ni/ lha yab yum dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi rnam pa can te kha sbyor gyi sku can dang /rdo rje gsum/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ de dngos su med kyang / lha bsgom sngags bzlas stong nyid gsum tshang bas rdo rje gsum lam —530—

byed nges par tshang bas/ yan lag rab tu rdzogs pa ni sngags rnams kun gyi lha'i/ /rnal 'byor thams cad la tshang pa dgos/ zhes pa ste/ theg pa bla na med pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /lam thams cad bsdu na/ gsang ba bskyed rim dang gsang ba chen po rdzogs rim dang shin tu gsang / /ba spyod pa gsum du 'dus so/ /rnal 'byor bskyed rim dang / rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po lhan skyes ji bzhin mtshon nus pa'i rang lus kyi rdzogs rim dang / /rjes su rnal 'byor stong pa nyid shas che ba'i ting nge 'dzin sngags kyi spyor ba can rnams dang shin tu rnal 'byoXr las rgya dang ye rgya'i gsang ba dang / /'di bzhi po yang nang tshan bzhi bzhi dbye bas bcu drug po de dag dang / stong pa gzhi'i ye shes bsdu na snang mched thob pa rnam pa gsum po/ /dang 'brel ba sngags kyi spyor ba ni/ sngags kyi rgyud kun gyi ni gtso bo'i gtso/ / bla med kyi theg pa'i lam dang / de dag ston byed kyang de'i rgyud du btags so/ /mi shigs pa snying kha'i thig le dang sngags kyi thig le rlung ste sna rtser sgom pa dang rdzas/ /kyi thig le nor bur gnas pa ste/ thig le gsum du ngas rgyud rgyas pa'am gzhan du bsha/da de/ /bde stong gi ngang las shar zhing de'i nyams dang ma bral ba'i bskyed rdzogs yin la/ dngos gnas la ma brtags par shar la rang ma yin pa la/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba dang rtog sgom kho na'i bskyed rdzogs ni yongs brtags kyi rnal 'byor dang / /ma brtags par rang shar ba bde stong ngo bor dngos gnas la grub pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te/ rnal 'byor ga sdo/ma/ /mo/ /bzhi pa lam gyi sa mtshams ni/ bskyed rdzogs la gsal snang brtan po ma 'ched pa ni/ mi gsal ba'i gnas skabs kyi gang zag dang bskyed rdzogs goms shing lha sku bde ba gang rung la gsal snang brtan cing mched pa ni ye shes chung / /ba'i gnas skabs dang gnyis ka la brtan cing mched pa ni ye shes gsal ba'i gnas skabs dang gnyis ka'i gsal snang rab —531 —

'byams mched pa ni ye ye/sa chen ce1'i gnas skabs ste/ /gnas skabs bzhi la gnas pa'i gang zag rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ /do/ /lnga pa stong nyid lta ba'i don bsdu ni/ gzugs kyi phung po med tshor ba dang 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam shes kyi phung po dang bral/ /ba te de dag min pa'o/ /dbang po dang yul dang rnam shes te khams bco brgyad med/ /cing ma yin pa dang / nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa med cing ma yin pa dang byang chub kyang glo bur spangs pa'i cha tsam gyis na rang bzhin la med/ /la/ dmigs yul dngos po med cing dngos med kyang med la sgom pa po dang sgom yang med/ /la/ de nyid la yon tan 'phel ba med cing skyon bri ba med/ /dngos med kyi rtag pa min la mi rtag pa yang ma yin pa/ /blo dang sgras yod pa dang med pa dang yod med gnyis yin gnyis min du gzhug rgyu med cing 'das/ /pa'o/ /don dam 'di la gang zag dang / chos kyi bdag med cing / de med pas gzhan yang med/ /bden par blos dpyad du med cing min pa dang /rdzun pa'i dngos dang dngos med kyang ma yin pa/ /rkyen gyis byed pa dang 'gag pa'am rkyen la ltos nas gzhag pa'i stong pa min cing / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /yin pa de ni don dam pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par brjod/ /do// drug pa thabs mkhas spyod pa'i khyad par ni/ dmigs pa 'dzin pa dang dmigs med dmigs pas bkag pa las 'das nas/ /bya spyod kun/ 'char yang 'dzin pa gdod nas/ 'char yang 'dzin pa gdod nas grol bzhin du rang gzhan gyi ye shes mchog gi rgyur/ bya ba ci dgar spyod par byed pa/ /rig sngags grub pa gang yin pa'i/ /spyor lam sa'am 'phags pa'i gnas thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thabs kyi spyod pa la gnas/ /pa'o/ /bsad skud dbye ba sogs kyang sgyu mas sgyu ma bcom pa lta bu dang / /sangs rgyas mchod pa yang sgyu mas sgyu ma mchod byed —532—

ltar/ /ma zhen la/ don chen po sgrub cing / rtag tu 'khor ba dang mthun pa ltar bstan yang 'khor bas ma gos pa'i/ thabs la mkhas pa'i snre/da pa 'di dag gis/ /rmi lam la bya byed med kyang bya byed ltar snang ba bzhin du sngags kyi spyod pa'o/ /bdun pa las rgya'i gsang ba ni ji ltar chos nyid kyi me yis bsregs pa ltar/ /dngos po so so'i ngo bo nyid kyi mthus bud med dang mnyam par spyor ba las/ /bde la mi rtog pa las shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i rigs bskyed/ /bas te rlung ro rkyang gzung 'dzin gyi g.yo ba thim pa dang bde ba skye ba dang / /rnam rtog shugs drag ngo bo nyid kyi gcod/ /par byed do/ /de phyir bud med de la bde stong de rab tu bsgrub/ /po/ zhu bde des don dam mtha' med dbus kyang bzung du med pa rig pa/ /'di ni don dam pa rdo rje ste mi war ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /〈gyi don bde ba'i snying po len pa〉'o/ /brgyad pa rim gnyis kyi gsang ba ni/ lhar snang gi/ rtog pa tha mal gyis rtog pa rnam par spangs par 'gyur te/ /de'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /par bya'o/ /'dod chags la bde ba sgoms pas 'dod chags kyi bde ba 'od gsal nye bar 'gro ba dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhe sdang dang gti mug rnams/ /'od gsal mchog tu nye bar 'gro ba'i/ /lam rgyu ni/ thun mongs ma yin pa'i bde ba dang rlung sems kyi lha sku sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang / /snying khar rlung sems bsdus rnam par mi rtog pa sgoms pas rnam par sbyangs/ /par bya'o/ /dgu pa lam gyi rnam ba 'ag ni/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa la dbye na sa bcu gnyis/ /yod pa ni ngo bo ṣ+ka gi pho nya mo dang gtso bor sbyor ba'i bde stong gi de kho na nyid dang / /nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang de dang de'i khams dang g.yo ba rlung gi bgrod pa yi/ /dbugs 'gro 'ong sogs 'gags pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par bcu gnyis so/ /de nas de'i rjes thogs la ye shes zung 'jug gi sku/ /'grub ste/ sku 'di la rtsa med —533—

khams kyang med/ /rlud gi bgrod pa'ang yod pa ma yin/ /te/ tha mal gyi lusang ga yid gsum 'gags te ye shes kyi lus ngag yid gsum thob pas so/ /'on kyang sems kyi rnam 'phru/la tsam rtsa sogs phra mo'i snang ba ni yod te/ /sems snang gi khams dang rtsa rlung / de dang de 'gags pa las 'phags lam gyi sa bcu/ gnyis/ / 'byung ba'o/ /pho nya mo mchog rnams dang sbyor ba'i dngos grub las/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa dang mtshungs pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po'i ngo bo 'di/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gsang sngags pa rnams kyi sa bcu gnyis zhes brjod/ /de sa'i ngo bo'o/ /bcu pa gang zag bdun bshad pa ni/ las dang po pa ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang med pa dang rnal 'byor pa gsal snang tsam skyes pa dang sgrub pa po/ / las thogs med du grub cing dngos grub 'grub tu drang ba dang / grub pa thun mongs che 'bring thob dang / mchog tu grub pa mchog gi dngos grub thob pa te sa thob pa tsam dang ni sems dpa' chen/ /po ni sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba ni bla med sangs rgyas te sngags spyod pa po rim pa bdun du gsungs/ /pa dang / brtson 'grus can la bla ma'i drin gyis skye ba gcig la bdun ka rdzogs par mngon du gyur pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa dngos po'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/gang du yang bzung rgyu kyi stong pa ma yin blo'i yul gyi rang bzhin mi stong pa'ang min/ /rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i sems 'di chos thams cad de bzhin nyid/ /nam mkha' la dbye ba med kyang / snod kyis dbye ba rtog ngor byed pa ltar/ /las dang po pa sogs gnas skabs bdun du de bzhin nyid mi shes pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams rtog /par byed do/ /semasakyi rdo rje rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa/ /'khor 'das kyi gnas skabs su theg pa'i rim pa thug sa med pa rnams kyis/ /sems kyi dbyings de ni mi 'jig cing g.yo ba med/ /—534—

la/ nam mkha' la sa chu me rlung gang gis kyang mi gos pa lta bur chos thams cad kyis gos pa med/ /la/ 'o na 'khor bar snang ba ci yin snyams na/ ji ltar mig rab rib can dag gis/ /nam mkha' la ni skra shad med kyang mthong / /ba/ /de bzhin du 'bor ba'i snang ba thams cad rnam par rtog /tsam ste/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la 'khor ba med cing 'khor ba po gang zag kyang med/ /do/ /bcu gnyis pa sngags kyi dam tshig gi gsang ba bshad pa ni/ de phyir bcos ma 'khor ba'i rnam rtog kun spangs nas/ /rtog bral gyi lha sku dang / bde stong gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi nges don gyi lam la/ /gsang sngags rig pa rnams rnam rtog ma byed cig /te don dam gyi dam tshig go /bcu gsum pa sngags kyi spyod pa bshad pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang po gsang sngags pas skye bo ni/ /skyes pa bud med ma ning / gang la'ang brnyas par mi bya ste// rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas btab pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos bye brag smra ba dang / mdo sde pa'i lta ba mthar thug tu 'dod pa ste/ de dag gi thab skor nang du zhag bdun lta ci smos cung zad kyang mi gnas shing / /chags bral gyi lam bsam gtan dang gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin la blo mi gus/ / par bya/ bud med rin chen nam yang sems kyis spang bar mi bya/ /lusang ga gisakyang spyir dgag bya dgos pa'i dbye ba shes dgos mod/ gong du bshad pa'i dam tshig ma mtha' rnams nges par skyongs dgos/ rang don dang bden 'dzin can gyi nyan thos kyi spyod pa spangs byas nas/ /'dod chags bde ba chen po snying rje chen po 'char ba dang bcas/ /sems can so so 'dul ba'i thabs tshul kun yang rig pas/ /phyi rol gnyis sbyor gyi bya bas nang du gnyis sbyor las 'das pa'i 'dzag med kyi bde chen /sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas par bya'o/ /sdom pa la blangs byar mi dang sdom min la spangs byar mi 'en pas/ de dag kun las sems 'e1ga/—535—

pa dang / bza' bya zhim po dang bza' min mi gtsang ba sogs su mi brtag ste/ /rigs sogs gtsang dang mi gtsang gi dpyad pa mi bya/ /ste/ thams cad rang bzhin te stong nyid dang de kho na nyid de'i bde gsal du mnyam par shes / /pas longs spyod pa'o/ /mgo zlum ni dge slong gi cha lugs sam/ thig les spyi bo gang ba'i don te brtul zhugs de yang gtum mo'i me rgyas pa'am des bde ba'i 'dod chags gzi brjid can/ /thams cad mnyam nyid dmigs su med pa la/ /rtog pa/ ngan 'gror 'khrid pa'i sdig pa dang bde 'gror 'khrid pa'i bsod nams dang lung ma bstan gyi gnas skabs kun yod pa min/ /'o/ /'o ba ci zhe na dus dang spyod kun kyang byang chub kyi thabs su 'gyur ba'i spyod pa can/ /'jig rten sems can g.yo ba'i rgyu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams byed bud med yin yang 'dir ni thabs mchog gi khyad par gyi bud med la sbyor ba las ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab sogs la sems brtan pa/ /par byed pa/ tshangs spyod ma nyams pa'i dge slong dngos ste/ /de ni khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu grags pa/ lha gsum dang / phyogs skyong / rgyal chen bzhi/ lha min dbang po/ klu r+ṣa sogs kun gyi bla mar gyur/ /pa'o/ /rdo rje 'od gsal byin gyis rlob cing mthar phyin par byed pa'i ye shes kyi rim pa ston pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //'phrin las thams cad 'byung ba sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ rtog pa phyi ma gsang ba ni don gyi the tshom sel bas nges par bstan pa ji snyed pa ni 'di bas mang ba yod du drang yang / zhes pa'o/ /rdzogs te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rtog pa ji snyed pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar lho phyogs 'e shwa ra'i ljongs su sku 'khrungs pa rdo rje theg pa la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rje btsun bachu gup+ta la/ rgyud 'di zhib mor nyan cing bsgyur bar sla ba rnams tho re long nge —536—

ba bsgyur zhing / dka' gnas rnams la reg zig gi rim pa mang du byas nas brtag dpyad mang du bgyis pa las/ slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po ni rgya ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang / yang slad kyi paṇ+ḍita pu rna badz+ra'i spyan sngar 'grel pa so so dang zhib tu sbyar te/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o// //bkra shis/ dge legs 'phel/ shu bhaX/ /༈ rab tu zab cing rgya che ba/ /rgyud kun gsang ba ston byed 'di/ /mchan bus cung zad gsal byas pa'i/ /dge bas sangs rgyas thob par shog /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas dben gnas byang chub chen por bris pa ste/ bla ma dam pa paṇa grub rnam pa gsum gyis zhal gdams thugs bcud rang gi blo la ji ltar gnas pa rnams rjed byang du bkod cing / 'grel pa gnyis kyi khyad don rnam grangs su rung ba rnams kyang ci rigs par cung zad bkod pa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba thams cad gsal bar byas pa yin pas/ 'di dbang thob cing / man ngag dang rgyud bshad/ zab bshad thob cing / mos pa brtan po can yin na ma gtogs/ mi bstan cing gsang ba'i bka' rgyas btab bo/ /rang lo so gsum pa la'o/ /maṅga laX bistar ku sa'adi bzhengs dge ba'i zla zer gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs sgo ku mud tshal/ /yongs rgyas dga' ston gsar ba'i dpal/ /srid mtha'i bar du nyams med shog /'di bzhengs legs dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu/ /nges don zab mor/ /ji bzhin spyod shog /ma tis so// //—537—

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spe5gu ni~X/sdo/la ban ni/la5snideb gya bdun pa/༄༅/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsu/nga 'bum/(45(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/glokrung go'i bod ris pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra nga/ra 'debs kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par ga'i dang po bsgrisasache 2008lo'i zla4pa ra par thengs bang po btabang par grangs/ 0001———1500—————1pya2khe/978——7rtse ge yeb3—0rnge2pyo34 snye re1gsung 'bum cha tshang (deb 1—45yod )la rin sgor/ 9 10 00

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon sbyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i sprun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
